hero.titleZh: 让 AI 真正懂你的项目、终端与每一台设备
hero.titleEn: Work with AI that actually knows your projects, terminal, and devices
hero.subtitleZh: 无论是日常写代码、连上 SSH 服务器排障、用 Worktree 并行跑多个复杂任务，还是出门在外用手机和微信随时跟进——这里按真实工作场景整理了 OpenBitFun 的全部功能与设置，告诉你怎么找入口、怎么和智能体配合、有哪些实用窍门。
hero.subtitleEn: Whether you are shipping code locally, working inside an SSH server, running parallel tasks in Git worktrees, or checking in from your phone — explore every OpenBitFun feature and setting with real entry paths, copy-ready prompts, and practical tips.

gettingStarted.descriptionZh: 在「设置 → 模型与智能体 → 模型」里填好服务商或本地网关，选定主力模型（负责深度编码推理）和快速模型（负责标题、轻量辅助与筛选）。
gettingStarted.descriptionEn: Open Settings → Models & Agents → Models to connect your provider and pick a Primary model for deep work plus a Fast model for lightweight tasks.

gettingStarted.titleEn: Open a local or remote project
gettingStarted.descriptionZh: 从侧边栏「+」打开本机目录，或一键连上 SSH 服务器、Docker 容器与 WSL；还可以在「项目资源」页为不同仓库单独指定默认模型和关联目录。
gettingStarted.descriptionEn: Click + in the sidebar to open a local folder, SSH server, Docker container, or WSL distro — then tailor per-project default models and linked folders in Project Resources.

gettingStarted.titleZh: 选对模式，用 @ 和 / 高效对话
gettingStarted.titleEn: Pick a mode and use @ and / in chat
gettingStarted.descriptionZh: 日常开发选「标准」，硬核攻坚选「极致」，写文档选「办公协作」；输入 @ 引用文件、旧会话或技能，输入 /goal 让智能体持续推进直到达标。
gettingStarted.descriptionEn: Use Standard for daily coding, Ultimate for tough architecture work, or Cowork for docs; type @ to attach files or past sessions, and /goal for multi-turn objectives.

gettingStarted.titleZh: 分栏看 Diff、跑终端、做评审
gettingStarted.titleEn: Review diffs, run terminals & verify code
gettingStarted.descriptionZh: 在会话旁并排对照智能体改过的每一行代码，按文件或单步接受/回滚，配合内置终端与 Deep Review 稳稳把关代码质量。
gettingStarted.descriptionEn: Inspect every AI edit side by side, accept or roll back changes by file or turn, and verify builds in the integrated terminal or with multi-agent Deep Review.

gettingStarted.titleZh: 连上手机、机器人或另一台电脑
gettingStarted.titleEn: Stay connected across phone, bots & devices
gettingStarted.descriptionZh: 开启 Remote Connect 后，离开工位也能用手机网页或微信/飞书/Telegram 审批权限、继续追问，甚至把耗时任务派发到另一台机器离线跑完。
gettingStarted.descriptionEn: Turn on Remote Connect to approve permissions and steer sessions from Mobile Web or WeChat/Feishu/Telegram, or dispatch long jobs to another machine and close your laptop.

scenarios.titleZh: 日常编码、精准改码与 PR 深度评审
scenarios.titleEn: Daily coding, surgical diffs & PR Deep Review
scenarios.descriptionZh: 用 @ 圈定代码上下文让智能体动手实现，在分栏编辑器里逐文件审阅快照与 Diff，再用自动生成的提交说明和 Deep Review 检查潜在隐患与 CI 报错。
scenarios.descriptionEn: Scope context with @, review AI edits with per-turn snapshots and side-by-side diffs, generate clean commit messages, and run Deep Review on branches or pull requests.

scenarios.titleZh: 代码在远端服务器或容器里（SSH / Docker / WSL）
scenarios.titleEn: Code lives on a server or container (SSH, Docker & WSL)
scenarios.descriptionZh: 本机只负责流畅界面，文件树、全文搜索、终端和智能体命令全部直接在目标服务器或容器中运行，还能一键把远端开发端口转发回本地浏览器预览。
scenarios.descriptionEn: Keep a snappy local UI while file browsing, search, terminals, and agent tools run natively on your SSH host, Docker container, or WSL distro — complete with port forwarding.

scenarios.titleZh: 离开工位或多台电脑：四种远程方式怎么选？
scenarios.titleEn: Away from your desk or multi-machine: which remote mode fits?
scenarios.descriptionZh: 项目在服务器上选「远程工作区」；人在外面用手机/微信盯进度选「Remote Connect」；用一台电脑直接操作另一台同账号电脑选「Peer 设备互控」；把大任务丢给台式机跑并合上笔记本选「Detached Dispatch 离线派发」。
scenarios.descriptionEn: Use Remote Workspaces for SSH/Docker code, Remote Connect for phone/chat-bot control, Peer Device Mode to drive another computer live, or Detached Dispatch for offline background jobs.

scenarios.titleZh: 多角色子智能体 + Git Worktree 并行推进
scenarios.descriptionZh: 同时推进修 Bug 和写新功能？给会话绑定独立 Worktree 避免分支打架，再让主智能体并行委派探索、编码与审查子智能体协同提速。
scenarios.descriptionEn: Run multiple features or bugfixes on the same repo without branch collisions using Git worktrees, while the primary agent fans out research, coding, and review subagents.

scenarios.titleZh: 无缝导入 Claude Code / Codex 并扩展 Skills 与 MCP
scenarios.titleEn: Bring your Claude Code / Codex setup, Skills & MCP
scenarios.descriptionZh: 一键扫描本机已有的外部 AI 配置与 Codex/Zcode 历史会话，在独立分支无缝续聊；按项目组装专属 Skills、MCP 工具服务与安全事件 Hooks。
scenarios.descriptionEn: Import Skills, MCP servers, Hooks, and Codex/Zcode sessions into safe branches, then tailor reusable workflows and event hooks per project.

scenarios.titleZh: 纯终端极客流与全天候定时自动化
scenarios.descriptionZh: 在终端里直接输入 openbitfun 开启交互式 TUI 或用 exec 跑脚本流水线，配合任务看板、个人助理与后台守护进程定时生成日报或巡检仓库。
scenarios.descriptionEn: Launch the interactive openbitfun TUI or scriptable exec runs in any terminal, and pair the Task Board with Personal Assistants for recurring automated checkups.

directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 从首页总览、全局搜索、分栏工作台到多目录项目资源管理，快速熟悉 OpenBitFun 的日常操作动线。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Learn your way around Home, Global Search, the split-pane workbench, and per-project workspace management.

directoryGroups.titleZh: AI 会话、模式与角色分工
directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 掌握多模式对话、上下文引用、自定义子智能体并行委派，以及拥有独立记忆与人设的长期个人助理。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Get the most out of agent modes, rich chat context, parallel subagents, and persistent personal assistants.

directoryGroups.titleZh: 编码、终端、Git 与代码评审
directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 围绕代码修改、多格式文档预览、内置终端、独立 CLI/TUI、Git Worktree、PR 诊断与内置浏览器构建完整研发闭环。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Edit files, preview docs and PDFs, run shells or the standalone CLI/TUI, manage Git worktrees, review PRs, and inspect live web pages.

directoryGroups.titleZh: 远程开发与多设备协同
directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 覆盖 SSH/Docker/WSL 远程工作区、手机与聊天机器人遥控、同账号电脑互控（Peer Mode）以及离线任务派发（Detached Dispatch）。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Work seamlessly across SSH/Docker/WSL servers, mobile & chat bots, same-account Peer Device Mode, and offline Detached Dispatch.

directoryGroups.titleZh: 技能扩展、自动化与工作洞察
directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 用可复用 Skills、定时任务看板、受控的外部浏览器/桌面操作与周期性工作洞察报告放大你的效率。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Extend agents with reusable Skills, scheduled jobs, authorized browser/desktop control, and retrospective work insights.

directoryGroups.titleZh: 应用创作、发布与桌面伴侣
directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 创建可交互 Mini Apps 与生成式界面、一键发布 Pages 网页、开启语音听写或实时通话，以及在桌面摆放实时小卡片与伙伴。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Build Mini Apps and Generative UI widgets, publish Pages, talk hands-free, and keep glanceable cards or a companion on your desktop.

directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 连接模型服务商与路由策略，管理审批安全规则、工具并发与超时、会话默认行为及长期记忆。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Configure model providers and routing, approval safety rules, tool concurrency and timeouts, session defaults, and memory.

directoryGroups.titleZh: 工具协议、外部导入与自动化设置
directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 配置 MCP 工具服务、ACP 外部智能体、Claude Code / Codex 外部导入、联网搜索、事件 Hooks 与浏览器/桌面授权。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Set up MCP servers, ACP external agents, External Import, web search providers, event Hooks, and browser/desktop access.

directoryGroups.titleZh: 编辑器、终端与 Git 工作树设置
directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 调整代码排版与格式化偏好、默认终端 Shell，以及文件索引、Git 提交署名与隔离 Worktree 目录策略。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Tune code formatting and display, default terminal shells, workspace search indexing, Git commit attribution, and worktrees.

directoryGroups.titleZh: 外观主题、输入快捷键与应用偏好
directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 定制主题与视觉皮肤包、左侧导航栏固定项、语音与发送习惯、键盘快捷键、桌面伙伴及窗口通知行为。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Personalize themes and visual skin packs, sidebar pins, voice and send behavior, shortcuts, companions, and window notifications.

directoryGroups.titleZh: 用量统计、归档历史与诊断维护
directoryGroups.descriptionZh: 查看 Token 消耗与缓存命中趋势，找回或清理归档会话，以及调整运行日志和导出本地故障诊断包。
directoryGroups.descriptionEn: Track token and cache trends, restore or clean up archived sessions, and manage runtime logs or diagnostic bundles.

小卡片 desktop cards 桌面小组件
内置浏览器 element picker 元素选择
深色模式 dark theme appearance
Git cherry pick 挑选提交
Cron 时间表 schedule types 定时类型

assistant.descriptionZh: 会话、智能体、记忆与智能协作。
assistant.descriptionEn: Sessions, agents, memory, and AI collaboration.

workspace.descriptionZh: 项目、文件、终端、Git、浏览器与开发工具。
workspace.descriptionEn: Projects, files, terminal, Git, browser, and development tools.

automation.descriptionEn: Skills, Mini Apps, tasks, hooks, and External Import.

connect.descriptionZh: 远程工作、多设备控制、派发与页面发布。
connect.descriptionEn: Remote work, multi-device control, dispatch, and publishing.

application.descriptionZh: 外观、输入、开发环境与应用行为。
application.descriptionEn: Appearance, input, development environment, and app behavior.

data.descriptionZh: 用量、归档、日志与问题诊断。

agentToolExclusions.reasonZh: 旧版 Pages 工具兼容入口，仅为已有调用和显式工具配置保留；新功能统一通过 PageManage 提供。
agentToolExclusions.reasonEn: Legacy Pages compatibility entry retained for existing calls and explicit tool configurations; current functionality is exposed through PageManage.

agentToolExclusions.reasonZh: 旧版 Pages 部署兼容入口，仅为已有调用和显式工具配置保留；新功能统一通过 PageManage 提供。
agentToolExclusions.reasonEn: Legacy Pages deployment compatibility entry retained for existing calls and explicit tool configurations; current functionality is exposed through PageManage.

agentToolExclusions.reasonZh: 兼容性委派原语，仅为显式配置的旧版智能体保留，不是独立的用户功能。
agentToolExclusions.reasonEn: Compatibility delegation primitive retained for explicitly configured legacy agents; it is not a standalone user feature.

agentToolExclusions.reasonZh: 延迟工具的契约发现原语，只负责按需加载另一个工具的输入说明，不是独立的用户功能。
agentToolExclusions.reasonEn: Framework discovery primitive for loading another deferred tool's input contract; it is not a standalone user feature.

agentToolExclusions.reasonZh: 延迟工具的框架级分发原语，只转发到已经由具体功能映射的目标工具，不应单独出现在说明书中。
agentToolExclusions.reasonEn: Framework dispatch primitive for forwarding to a target tool that is already mapped to a concrete capability; it should not appear as a separate manual feature.

capabilities.titleZh: 首页、全局搜索与分栏工作台
capabilities.summaryZh: 从首页总览快速进入常用资产与设备，按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 一键搜索消息、文件、命令与设置，并用双栏工作台或悬浮窗自由组织屏幕空间。
capabilities.summaryEn: Jump into agents, apps, skills, and devices from Home, press ⌘K / Ctrl+K to search messages, files, commands, and settings anywhere, and arrange work across split panes or a compact floating window.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧边栏顶部「搜索一切」（⌘K / Ctrl+K）与「首页」入口；左下角齿轮菜单可切换「悬浮窗模式」
capabilities.entryPathEn: Top of the left sidebar: Search everything (⌘K / Ctrl+K) and Home; use the bottom-left gear menu for Floating window mode
highlightsZh: 在「首页」一站查看连续活跃天数、Token 热力图、已连设备、智能体、小应用与技能
按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 全局搜索会话消息、代码文件、功能与设置，输入 > 直接过滤并执行命令
会话与代码/终端自动左右并排展示，支持拖拽标签、最大化分栏与重新打开刚关掉的标签
按个人习惯固定左侧边栏常用入口，或一键切到轻量「悬浮窗模式」边看资料边对话
highlightsEn: Check your activity heatmap, streaks, connected devices, agents, Mini Apps, and Skills from Home
Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K anywhere to search messages, files, features, and settings — or type > for commands
Keep chat and files/terminals side by side with drag-and-drop tabs, split shortcuts, and tab restore
Pin your favorite pages to the left sidebar or collapse into Floating window mode over other apps
scenariosZh: 刚打开 OpenBitFun 想找上次聊到一半的方案，但忘了在哪个项目：直接按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 输入关键词，就能跨会话消息、文件名和功能说明一起定位。
平时高频使用「智能体」「小应用」或「洞察」：去「设置 → 应用与界面 → 外观 → 左侧导航栏」把它们固定到「首页」下方，不用每次翻找。
在浏览器查文档或盯着设计稿修改逻辑时：点左下角齿轮菜单切到「悬浮窗模式」，让对话缩成不挡视线的轻量悬浮窗随时待命。
scenariosEn: Looking for a discussion from last week across several repos? Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and type a phrase to search past messages, sessions, files, and settings all at once.
Use Agents, Mini Apps, or Insights every day? Pin them right below Home in Settings → Application & Interface → Appearance → Left sidebar.
Reading specs or reviewing designs in another app? Switch to Floating window mode from the bottom-left gear menu to keep a compact AI bar handy.

items.titleZh: 在「首页」总览活跃度热力图、已关联设备，并快捷启动智能体、助理、小应用与技能
items.titleEn: Review your activity heatmap and connected devices on Home, with quick actions for Agents, Assistants, Mini Apps, and Skills
items.descriptionZh: 首页汇集了累计与单日峰值 Token、连续使用天数热力图、同账号在线设备卡片，以及创建智能体、创建个人助理、启动已安装小应用和浏览技能市场的直达按钮。
items.descriptionEn: Home brings together token and streak metrics, an activity heatmap, same-account device cards, and one-click launchers to create agents or assistants, open Mini Apps, and discover Skills.

control.reasonZh: 「在「首页」总览活跃度热力图、已关联设备，并快捷启动智能体、助理、小应用与技能」需要结合你在首页卡片上的实时浏览与点选目标来完成操作；智能体可为你直接打开首页，方便你查看概览或点击对应模块。
control.reasonEn: “Review your activity heatmap and connected devices on Home, with quick actions for Agents, Assistants, Mini Apps, and Skills” depends on what you want to inspect or launch from the live Home dashboard; the Agent opens Home directly so you can act in place.

items.titleZh: 用全局搜索（⌘K / Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）跨项目检索消息、文件、功能与设置，或输入 > 运行命令
items.titleEn: Search across messages, sessions, files, features, and settings with ⌘K / Ctrl+K, or type > to run commands
items.descriptionZh: 不管焦点在编辑器还是聊天框，按下快捷键即可呼出全局搜索；可在「全部 / 命令 / 内容」间切换范围，若当前接入了 Peer 对端设备，搜索也会自动针对当前显示设备执行。
items.descriptionEn: Open Global Search from any focus scope, filter by All, Commands (>), or Content, and jump straight to matching conversations, files, actions, or settings on the active device.

control.reasonZh: 「用全局搜索（⌘K / Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）跨项目检索消息、文件、功能与设置，或输入 > 运行命令」需要你输入关键词并在实时匹配的会话、文件或命令结果中挑选目标；智能体也可通过内置控制工具直接帮你跳转到明确的功能或设置页。
control.reasonEn: “Search across messages, sessions, files, features, and settings with ⌘K / Ctrl+K, or type > to run commands” lets you type queries and pick from live session, file, action, and settings matches; you can also ask the Agent to open a specific page directly.

items.titleZh: 在双栏工作台中并排查看会话与代码/终端，拖拽移动标签页或使用分屏快捷键
items.titleEn: Work side by side in the split workbench with draggable tabs, pane maximize, and canvas overview shortcuts
items.descriptionZh: 在会话中点开文件或终端时会自动在另一侧分栏展示，每个会话独立记住自己的右侧面板开合状态；支持 ⌘\ / Ctrl+\ 分屏、⌘Shift+M 最大化当前栏、⌘Shift+E 打开标签总览、⌘Shift+T 恢复刚关闭的标签。
items.descriptionEn: Opening files or terminals beside a chat reveals the opposite pane automatically and remembers pane state per session; use ⌘\ / Ctrl+\ to split, ⌘Shift+M to maximize, ⌘Shift+E for overview, and ⌘Shift+T to reopen closed tabs.

control.reasonZh: 分栏比例、标签拖拽位置与面板焦点属于窗口视觉布局交互，由你在顶部标签栏与分割线上直接拖拽或按键完成。
control.reasonEn: Pane sizing, tab drag-and-drop placement, and split focus are visual layout interactions controlled directly via the tab bar, splitter, or keyboard shortcuts.

items.titleZh: 自定义左侧边栏固定入口与顺序，并固定常用的 Mini App 快捷图标
items.titleEn: Customize pinned items and ordering in the left sidebar, plus pin favorite Mini App shortcuts
items.descriptionZh: 左侧边栏默认精简保留「首页」与「任务看板」，避免视觉拥挤；你可以随时把「智能体」「助理」「小应用」「技能」「发现技能」「洞察」或已安装的 Mini App 固定到侧边栏并调整上下顺序。
items.descriptionEn: The sidebar starts clean with Home and Task Board pinned by default; pin Agents, Assistants, Mini Apps, Skills, Discover Skills, Insights, or individual Mini Apps and reorder them anytime.

control.reasonZh: 「自定义左侧边栏固定入口与顺序，并固定常用的 Mini App 快捷图标」属于当前窗口的个性化导航偏好，可在外观设置的「左侧导航栏」分区中按个人习惯勾选和调整顺序。
control.reasonEn: “Customize pinned items and ordering in the left sidebar, plus pin favorite Mini App shortcuts” is a personal navigation preference configured interactively in Appearance settings under Left sidebar or from Mini App menus.

items.titleZh: 一键切换到轻量「悬浮窗模式」，在其他应用上方随时发起对话或恢复主窗口
items.titleEn: Switch into compact Floating window mode to chat alongside other desktop apps and restore the main window anytime
items.descriptionZh: 点击侧边栏左下角齿轮菜单中的「悬浮窗模式」，主窗口会收起为小巧的桌面悬浮条，方便你在阅读网页、文档或调试其他软件时随手提问，需要看代码时一键展开回完整工作台。
items.descriptionEn: Choose Floating window mode from the bottom-left gear menu to collapse OpenBitFun into a compact floating bar while working in other apps, then expand back to the full workbench in one click.

control.reasonZh: 「一键切换到轻量「悬浮窗模式」，在其他应用上方随时发起对话或恢复主窗口」涉及本机桌面窗口形态与屏幕位置切换，需由你在左下角菜单中手动开启或点恢复按钮回到主窗口。
control.reasonEn: “Switch into compact Floating window mode to chat alongside other desktop apps and restore the main window anytime” changes the local desktop window geometry and focus, so you trigger it from the bottom-left menu and restore the full window when ready.

stepsZh: 点击左侧边栏顶部的「首页」查看你的设备、智能体、小应用、小卡片和技能概览
随时按 ⌘K（Windows/Linux 按 Ctrl+K 或 Alt+F）打开全局搜索；直接输入文字搜会话与文件，输入 > 查看可执行命令
在会话中点开任意文件或按 ⌘Shift+` / Ctrl+Shift+` 打开终端，拖动顶部标签页即可在左右分栏间自由摆放
想把常用入口常驻在左侧边栏时，前往「设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,）→ 应用与界面 → 外观 → 左侧导航栏」勾选并排序
stepsEn: Click Home at the top of the left sidebar to see your devices, agents, Mini Apps, desktop cards, and Skills at a glance
Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K or Alt+F on Windows/Linux) anywhere to search sessions, files, features, and settings — or type > to filter commands
Open any file or press ⌘Shift+` / Ctrl+Shift+` for a terminal beside your chat, and drag tabs between left and right panes
To keep favorite pages in the sidebar, go to Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Appearance → Left sidebar
agentExamplesZh: 帮我打开键盘快捷键设置
带我去外观设置调整左侧导航栏
打开任务看板看看今天有哪些计划任务
agentExamplesEn: Open keyboard shortcut settings for me
Take me to Appearance settings so I can customize the left sidebar
Open the Task Board so I can check today’s scheduled runs
tipsZh: 用 Alt+1 / Alt+2 / Alt+3 可以快速聚焦顶部场景栏的前三个常驻标签；在右侧代码画布里用 ⌘1–9 / Ctrl+1–9 可直接切换编辑器标签。
按 ⌘B / Ctrl+B 可收起或展开左侧导航栏，按 ⌘Shift+B / Ctrl+Shift+B 可同时收起左右辅助面板，立刻获得沉浸式阅读视野。
侧边栏固定项保存在当前设备的界面偏好中，切换 Peer 对端设备时不会弄乱远端主机的配置。
tipsEn: Use Alt+1 / Alt+2 / Alt+3 to jump between your first three top-level scene tabs, and ⌘1–9 / Ctrl+1–9 inside the editor canvas to switch file tabs.
Press ⌘B / Ctrl+B to toggle the left sidebar, or ⌘Shift+B / Ctrl+Shift+B to collapse side panels together when you want distraction-free focus.
Sidebar pin preferences stay local to your current controller window and never overwrite another Peer device’s config.

capabilities.titleZh: AI 会话与多模式协作
capabilities.summaryZh: 围绕项目开展持久对话：按任务挑选「标准 / 极致 / 办公协作 / 深度研究 / 论文写作 / 电脑操作 / 创造」等模式，用 @ 挂载文件与历史会话、用 /goal 持续推进目标，还能直接生成图片与 Office 文档。
capabilities.summaryEn: Collaborate in durable project sessions: switch between Standard, Ultimate, Cowork, Deep Research, Paper Writing, Computer Use, or Creative modes, attach files and past sessions with @, drive multi-turn goals with /goal, and generate images or Office files.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧边栏「会话」列表点击项目旁的「新建会话」，或按 ⌘Shift+A / Ctrl+Shift+A 切回会话（聊天内按 ⌘N / Ctrl+N 新建）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Click New session beside any project in the sidebar, press ⌘Shift+A / Ctrl+Shift+A to open Session, or press ⌘N / Ctrl+N inside chat
highlightsZh: 内置「标准、极致、极简、办公协作、深度研究、论文写作、电脑操作、创造、助理」等模式，各司其职
输入框键入 @ 即可联合引用文件、目录、历史会话、Skills、MCP 与图片；键入 / 触发 /goal、/btw、/compact、/init
运行中随时插话引导（Steer）或排队追加消息；选中任意回复文字可批量「添加批注」或发起不跑题的「侧边提问」
原生支持生成图片与免安装 Office 读写 Word（.docx）、Excel（.xlsx）、PowerPoint（.pptx）
highlightsEn: Built-in modes tailored to every job: Standard, Ultimate, Minimal, Cowork, Deep Research, Paper Writing, Computer Use, Creative, and Assistant
Type @ to attach files, folders, past sessions, Skills, MCP servers, or images; type / for /goal, /btw, /compact, and /init
Steer or queue follow-ups mid-run, or highlight any reply text to batch-submit numbered annotations or ask a side question
Generate images natively and create or revise Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) files without Office installed
scenariosZh: 不确定该选哪个模式？日常写代码修 Bug 选「标准」最均衡；跨模块重构或疑难杂症选「极致」；只想快速问答不需要调工具选「极简」；整理汇报写 Office 文档选「办公协作」；调研文献写论文选「深度研究 / 论文写作」；跨桌面软件点击操作选「电脑操作」；想给 OpenBitFun 自己改界面加小功能就选「创造」。
智能体写完一长段方案，你有五处细节想让它一起改：直接用鼠标划选对应句子点「添加批注」，写完 5 条批注后一次性提交，比来回追问五轮省心得多。
想让智能体「把所有失败单测修到全绿为止」：输入 `/goal 修复当前模块全部失败单测并通过验证`，智能体会自己跨多轮持续执行，直到目标真正达成。
scenariosEn: Wondering which mode to pick? Choose Standard for everyday coding, Ultimate for deep multi-file architecture work, Minimal for fast tool-free Q&A, Cowork for docs and spreadsheets, Deep Research or Paper Writing for synthesis and papers, Computer Use for desktop GUI tasks, or Creative to customize OpenBitFun’s own live UI.
Have five small tweaks on a long AI design doc? Highlight each phrase, click Annotate to attach numbered notes, and submit the whole batch in a single turn.
Need the agent to keep iterating until tests actually pass? Start with `/goal Fix the failing tests in this package and verify they pass` so it continues across turns until done.

items.titleZh: 打开会话场景并快速新建一个 AI 会话
items.titleEn: Open the Session view and start a new AI conversation
items.descriptionZh: 可在当前项目、指定 Git Worktree 或个人助理下新建会话，每个会话都可以作为独立标签页保留在顶部栏。
items.descriptionEn: Start a fresh conversation scoped to your active project, an isolated Git worktree, or a personal assistant, each in its own tab.

items.titleZh: 筛选、重命名、复制、从任意轮次分叉（Fork）、归档恢复与导出会话记录
items.titleEn: Filter, rename, duplicate, fork from any turn, archive, restore, and export sessions
items.descriptionZh: 侧边栏会话支持按「未读 / 需要处理 / 运行中 / Worktree / 远程环境 / 外部来源」筛选；遇到两种实现路线想对比时，可从指定消息「分叉会话」保留共同上下文并独立推进，也可将对话导出为 Markdown 或图片分享。
items.descriptionEn: Filter sidebar sessions by Unread, Needs attention, Running, Worktree, or Environment; fork a conversation from any turn to explore an alternative approach safely, or export transcripts.

control.reasonZh: 这些操作依赖选中的会话、分叉轮次或删除确认；智能体可准确打开会话界面，由你挑选目标会话或历史节点。
control.reasonEn: These actions depend on the selected session, chosen turn to fork from, or deletion confirmation; the Agent opens the session UI so you can pick the exact target.

items.titleZh: 按会话自由切换模型、思考强度、内置工作模式、记忆开关与审批模式
items.titleEn: Switch the model, reasoning effort, work mode, memory toggle, and approval mode per session
items.descriptionZh: 在聊天输入框底部随时切换「标准 / 极致 / 极简 / 办公协作 / 深度研究 / 论文写作 / 电脑操作 / 创造」等模式，调整推理强度（Reasoning Effort），或把当前会话临时设为自动审批。
items.descriptionEn: Use the composer bar to switch between Standard, Ultimate, Minimal, Cowork, Deep Research, Paper Writing, Computer Use, or Creative modes, tune reasoning effort, or adjust session approval behavior on the fly.

control.reasonZh: 「按会话自由切换模型、思考强度、内置工作模式、记忆开关与审批模式」与你当前正在编辑的会话状态紧密相关；智能体可为你打开当前会话入口，方便你在输入框栏直观挑选模式与模型。
control.reasonEn: “Switch the model, reasoning effort, work mode, memory toggle, and approval mode per session” is tied to the live session composer where you can pick modes, models, reasoning effort, and approval posture interactively.

items.titleZh: 在输入框用 @ 挂载文件、目录、历史会话与技能，并用 / 或 $ 触发斜杠指令
items.titleEn: Attach files, folders, past sessions, and Skills with @, and run slash commands with / or $
items.descriptionZh: 输入 @ 可一处搜索项目文件、文件夹、其他历史会话（把过往结论带进新对话）、可用 Skills、MCP 与图片；行首输入 / 可调用 /goal、/btw、/compact、/usage、/init 或外部命令（含 Shell 预览确认），句中输入 $ 或 / 可直接点名某个 Skill。
items.descriptionEn: Type @ to attach workspace files, folders, other sessions, Skills, MCP servers, or images; type / at the start for /goal, /btw, /compact, /usage, or /init, and $ or / inline to invoke a Skill.

control.reasonZh: 「在输入框用 @ 挂载文件、目录、历史会话与技能，并用 / 或 $ 触发斜杠指令」是在撰写消息时的实时上下文拼装与命令补全交互，由你在当前聊天输入框中点选确认后一并发送。
control.reasonEn: “Attach files, folders, past sessions, and Skills with @, and run slash commands with / or $” is an interactive composer workflow where you pick context chips and slash commands while drafting your prompt.

items.titleZh: 在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务
items.titleEn: Use @ in chat to select MCP servers available to the current mode
items.descriptionZh: 输入 @ 进入 MCP 列表，也可以直接搜某个工具名反查它所属的 MCP 服务；注意「极简（Minimal）」模式默认精简隐藏 MCP，切到「标准 / 极致 / 创造」即可使用。
items.descriptionEn: Type @ to pick an enabled MCP server — you can even search by a tool’s name or description to find its server. Note that Minimal mode hides MCP; switch to Standard, Ultimate, or Creative to use them.

control.reasonZh: “在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务”需要用户在当前输入框选择服务并编辑草稿，没有可直接完成该交互的结构化 Command。也可通过工具名称或描述搜索所属服务；工具不会单独列出。目录按当前主机、工作区和模式过滤；Minimal 隐藏 MCP 入口。远程工作区暂不支持此选择器，Peer Host 必须协商 chat_mcp_catalog_v1 能力。
control.reasonEn: “Use @ in chat to select MCP servers available to the current mode” requires the user to select a server and edit the current composer draft; no structured Command completes that interaction directly. Tool names and descriptions can find their owning server without separate tool rows. The catalog is scoped to the current host, workspace, and mode; Minimal hides MCP. Remote workspaces are unsupported; Peer Hosts must advertise chat_mcp_catalog_v1.

items.titleZh: 划选对话文字添加多条编号「批注」合并提交，或发起不打乱主线的「侧边提问」
items.titleEn: Select transcript text to collect numbered batch annotations or ask a focused Side Question
items.descriptionZh: 阅读智能体长回复时，用鼠标选中任意片段即可「添加批注」（积累多条修改意见后一次发给智能体处理）、「添加到会话」引用，或点「侧边提问」在旁侧小窗追问概念细节而不污染主会话上下文。
items.descriptionEn: Highlight any passage in a reply to add numbered annotations and submit them together, quote text into your draft, or open a Side Question thread to clarify a detail without derailing the main chat.

control.reasonZh: 「划选对话文字添加多条编号「批注」合并提交，或发起不打乱主线的「侧边提问」」依赖你在会话消息中划选的具体段落与批注内容，开启文本选择工具栏后选中文字即可直接触发。
control.reasonEn: “Select transcript text to collect numbered batch annotations or ask a focused Side Question” starts from highlighting specific text in the conversation transcript and writing your note or side question in place.

items.titleZh: 在智能体运行中随时插话引导（Steer）、管理待发送队列、按 Esc 中断或恢复异常轮次
items.titleEn: Steer a running turn mid-flight, manage queued follow-up messages, interrupt with Esc, or recover interrupted turns
items.descriptionZh: 发现智能体方向偏了不必等它跑完，直接发消息即可实时引导（也可在输入设置中改为默认加入「待发送队列」并随时调整顺序），或按 Esc 立即停下当前步骤。
items.descriptionEn: Redirect an active run without starting over by sending a steering message (or queue follow-ups and reorder them), press Esc to stop immediately, or resume an interrupted turn.

control.reasonZh: 「在智能体运行中随时插话引导（Steer）、管理待发送队列、按 Esc 中断或恢复异常轮次」取决于当前会话正处于思考、工具执行还是中断状态，你可在聊天输入框与队列条上直接操作。
control.reasonEn: “Steer a running turn mid-flight, manage queued follow-up messages, interrupt with Esc, or recover interrupted turns” depends on the live execution state of the active turn and is controlled directly from the chat composer and pending queue bar.

items.titleZh: 审阅工具与命令权限请求：支持允许一次、记住项目范围、批量放行或附理由拒绝
items.titleEn: Answer tool and command permission prompts once, remember scoped project grants, batch-approve, or reject with feedback
items.descriptionZh: 当智能体准备执行敏感命令或改写受保护范围时，你可以选「允许一次」「始终允许此范围 / 此精确命令」，或输入修改意见点「附理由拒绝」让它换一种安全做法；远控手机也能同步收到并审批。
items.descriptionEn: Approve once, remember exact command or path grants for the current project, approve all pending requests in a batch, or reject with a reason so the Agent adjusts course — locally or from Mobile Web.

control.reasonZh: 「审阅工具与命令权限请求：支持允许一次、记住项目范围、批量放行或附理由拒绝」是保障你环境安全的人工审批边界，必须由你在桌面端或远控端亲自确认，智能体绝不会替你点同意。
control.reasonEn: “Answer tool and command permission prompts once, remember scoped project grants, batch-approve, or reject with feedback” is an explicit human safety boundary that you confirm in the session or from a remote controller; the Agent never self-approves.

items.titleZh: 用 /goal 创建跨轮次持久会话目标，让智能体自主推进直到真正达成
items.titleEn: Set a persistent multi-turn session goal with /goal so the agent keeps driving until completion
items.descriptionZh: 适合「全量测试修绿」「逐模块迁移接口」等长线任务：智能体会围绕目标自动衔接后续轮次，直到验证达标标记完成，或遇到真实外部阻碍时清晰汇报。
items.descriptionEn: Great for long-running work like fixing a full test suite or migrating modules: the Agent continues across turns until the goal is verified complete or surfaces a concrete blocker.

workflowZh: 先用 get_goal 查看当前目标；没有目标时仅在用户明确要求后用 create_goal 创建
目标真正达成时才用 update_goal 标记 complete；同一阻塞条件连续满足门槛且无法继续时才标记 blocked
workflowEn: Inspect the current goal with get_goal; create one with create_goal only when the user explicitly asks
Use update_goal complete only after the objective is achieved, and blocked only after the repeated-blocker threshold is genuinely met

items.titleZh: 在会话顶部目标条随时修改目标描述或清除当前目标
items.titleEn: Edit the active goal objective or clear the session goal from the goal banner
items.descriptionZh: 中途需求调整时，可直接在会话顶部的目标状态条修改目标说明，或一键结束目标模式回到普通一问一答。
items.descriptionEn: Refine what success looks like mid-task by editing the goal banner text, or clear the goal anytime to return to normal turn-by-turn chat.

control.reasonZh: 目标工具只负责读取、创建和受约束的状态转换；修改目标文本与清除目标在当前会话顶部目标栏中由你直接确认完成。
control.reasonEn: Goal tools cover discovery, creation, and guarded status transitions; editing objective text or clearing the goal is done directly in the session goal banner.

items.titleZh: 让智能体拆解待办进度、编写 .openbitfun/plans 实施计划，并在关键分岔点向你提问确认
items.titleEn: Let the agent track step-by-step todos, write .openbitfun/plans specs, and ask clarifying questions when choices matter
items.descriptionZh: 面对复杂特性，智能体会先阅读代码库并把结构化方案保存到 `.openbitfun/plans` 供你在专属计划视图中审阅，只在仓库里查不到、需要你拍板的设计取舍上弹出单选/多选卡片。
items.descriptionEn: For complex work, the Agent tracks live progress items, saves structured plans under .openbitfun/plans for review, and asks concise multiple-choice questions only when a product decision is needed.

workflowZh: 复杂任务用 TodoWrite 维护当前进度；正式计划产物通过 Write 写入项目的 .openbitfun/plans 目录
缺少会改变结果的用户选择时用 AskUserQuestion；能从仓库或当前上下文查明的信息不重复询问
workflowEn: Use TodoWrite to maintain progress for complex work; create formal plan artifacts with Write under the project's .openbitfun/plans directory
Use AskUserQuestion only for a missing choice that changes the outcome; do not ask again for facts available from the repository or current context

items.titleZh: 用 /btw（或 Ctrl+Alt+B）随手发起临时「侧问」，以及在代码编辑器中使用内联 AI
items.titleEn: Ask quick ephemeral side questions with /btw (or Ctrl+Alt+B) and invoke inline AI inside the code editor
items.descriptionZh: 正在跑大重构时突然想查个语法或正则？输入 `/btw 这个问题` 会开启一个继承当前上下文、不调工具、关掉即焚的轻量侧问，完全不打断也不撑爆主对话；写代码时也可直接在编辑器内呼出内联 AI。
items.descriptionEn: Need a quick syntax check mid-task? `/btw your question` opens a lightweight, tool-free side chat that inherits context without cluttering or saving to your main transcript; inline AI is also available right inside the editor.

control.reasonZh: 「用 /btw（或 Ctrl+Alt+B）随手发起临时「侧问」，以及在代码编辑器中使用内联 AI」是在你当前阅读或编码位置即开即用的轻量交互，可随时发起或按取消键中止。
control.reasonEn: “Ask quick ephemeral side questions with /btw (or Ctrl+Alt+B) and invoke inline AI inside the code editor” is an on-the-spot lightweight interaction launched from your active chat composer or editor cursor and cancellable anytime.

items.titleZh: 切换到「创造（Creative）」模式，安全定制正在运行的 OpenBitFun 界面与交互能力
items.titleEn: Switch to Creative mode to customize the live OpenBitFun interface with automatic 15-second rollback protection
items.descriptionZh: 无需下载源码或搭编译环境，直接告诉创造模式的智能体你想怎么改界面样式或组合快捷功能；新改动激活后会弹出 15 秒不可变确认倒计时，万一渲染异常会自动回滚保底。
items.descriptionEn: No source checkout or build toolchain needed: describe the UI tweak or custom workflow you want in Creative mode, preview it live, and rely on the 15-second confirmation window to roll back automatically if anything goes wrong.

workflowZh: 在本地桌面创造模式中调用 FrontendWorkbench prepare，阅读随包 API；只编辑草稿中的 CSS、JavaScript 和自有资源，无需源码或构建工具
用原草稿 ID 调用 apply；宿主在真实界面和自定义代码激活后才启动不可变确认窗口的 15 秒倒计时，apply 会等待并返回 confirmed 或 rolled_back 的最终结果
用 commands、state 和 events 组合可复用能力；通过 FrontendWorkbench inspect 发现命令和错误，再按 schema 用 invoke 验证执行
workflowEn: Call FrontendWorkbench prepare on the local Desktop in Creative mode, read the packaged API, and edit only draft CSS, JavaScript and owned assets without source or build tools

Apply with the original draft ID; the host starts the immutable review window's 15-second countdown only after the real shell and customization activate, and apply waits for a final confirmed or rolled_back outcome
Compose commands, state and events into reusable capabilities; use FrontendWorkbench inspect to discover schemas and diagnostics, then invoke to verify execution

items.titleZh: 通过已配置的默认图像模型在对话中直接生成配图与素材
items.titleEn: Generate illustrations, icons, and visual assets directly in chat with your configured image model
items.descriptionZh: 配置好图像生成服务后，只需描述画面风格、尺寸和张数，智能体就会生成图片并保存到当前本地或远程工作区中交付给你。
items.descriptionEn: Once an image model is configured in Models settings, describe the style, dimensions, and count you need and the Agent saves the generated files straight into your workspace.

workflowZh: 使用 generate_image 按用户描述生成图片，默认省略 service_id 以使用已配置的默认图像模型
按需指定数量和尺寸，通过返回的文件路径交付图片；远程工作区文件通过当前工作区数据面读写
缺少配置、认证失败或额度不足时明确报告，不自动切换到其他服务
workflowEn: Use generate_image to create images from the user's description; omit service_id to use the configured default image model
Specify count and size when needed and deliver the returned file paths; access remote workspace files through the active workspace data plane
Report missing configuration, authentication failures, or quota limits explicitly without automatically switching services

items.titleZh: 用 GenOfficeFile 免安装 Office 创建并编辑 Word、Excel 与 PowerPoint 文档
items.titleEn: Create and revise Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files with GenOfficeFile — no Office installation required
items.descriptionZh: 支持直接生成排版整洁的 `.docx` 报告、`.xlsx` 数据表和 `.pptx` 演示文稿并分批迭代修改；若文件后来被你在外部软件手动改过，工具会默认保护你的外部修改不被静默覆盖。
items.descriptionEn: Build and iteratively refine .docx reports, .xlsx spreadsheets, and .pptx slide decks in local or remote workspaces, with built-in protection against overwriting external edits.

workflowZh: 先用 GenOfficeFile guide 读取格式指南，再通过 create 和 edit 分批生成或修改 .docx、.xlsx、.pptx 文件，无需安装 Office
用 read 分页查看文档结构；文件和引用图片通过当前工作区文件系统读写，支持本地或远程工作区
仅能继续编辑由该工具生成的文件；其他程序改过的内容默认拒绝覆盖，需要用户明确同意丢弃外部修改
workflowEn: Read the format guide with GenOfficeFile guide, then use create and edit to build or revise .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files in batches without installing Office
Use read to page through document structure; documents and referenced images use the active local or remote workspace filesystem
Only files generated by this tool can be reopened for editing; external changes are rejected by default and may be discarded only with the user's explicit agreement

items.titleZh: 展开工具胶囊查看调用详情，并查看、输入或终止正在后台运行的命令
items.titleEn: Inspect tool call capsules and monitor, send input to, or stop background shell commands
items.descriptionZh: 每一次文件读写、搜索和命令执行都会收纳成清晰的步骤胶囊；遇到长耗时开发服务或交互式脚本转入后台时，可随时读取实时输出、补发输入或一键停止。
items.descriptionEn: Every file read, search, and shell call appears as an inspectable capsule; for long-running or interactive background commands, view live output, send stdin, or stop them anytime.

control.reasonZh: 「展开工具胶囊查看调用详情，并查看、输入或终止正在后台运行的命令」与会话中实时滚动的工具卡片和后台进程状态绑定，可直接在对话流中点开查看或控制。
control.reasonEn: “Inspect tool call capsules and monitor, send input to, or stop background shell commands” is bound to live tool cards and background process activity inside the active conversation stream.

items.titleZh: 点击上下文与用量徽章，透视系统提示词、规则、技能、MCP 与对话的 Token 构成及缓存命中率
items.titleEn: Click the context and usage badge to inspect token breakdown across prompts, rules, Skills, MCP, and KV cache hits
items.descriptionZh: 不仅能看当前会话消耗了多少输入输出 Token 和 KV Cache 命中率，还能展开「上下文构成」逐项查看系统提示词、工具定义、AGENTS.md 规则、Skills 和历史对话各占多少空间，并点开预览具体内容。
items.descriptionEn: See input/output tokens and KV cache hit rates for the session, plus a category-by-category Context Composition breakdown (system prompt, tools, rules, Skills, MCP, conversation) with content previews.

control.reasonZh: 「点击上下文与用量徽章，透视系统提示词、规则、技能、MCP 与对话的 Token 构成及缓存命中率」在当前会话状态栏按需估算并展开展示，点击分类即可预览具体注入的上下文片段。
control.reasonEn: “Click the context and usage badge to inspect token breakdown across prompts, rules, Skills, MCP, and KV cache hits” is computed on demand from the session status bar so you can inspect and preview each context category interactively.

items.titleZh: 用 /compact 压缩长对话、用 /init 生成项目 AGENTS.md 规范、热重载上下文或管理长期记忆
items.titleEn: Compact long chats with /compact, initialize AGENTS.md with /init, reload context, and manage long-term memory
items.descriptionZh: 对话太长接近窗口上限时输入 `/compact` 即可提炼摘要腾出空间（原始聊天记录依然完整保存）；新接手仓库输入 `/init` 可自动扫描生成贴合项目的 `AGENTS.md` 协作规范。
items.descriptionEn: Run `/compact` when a long thread fills the context window (your full saved transcript stays intact), `/init` to generate a repo-tailored `AGENTS.md`, or reload context after editing rules and Skills.

control.reasonZh: 「用 /compact 压缩长对话、用 /init 生成项目 AGENTS.md 规范、热重载上下文或管理长期记忆」涵盖多个针对当前会话上下文与记忆库的交互动作，可通过聊天斜杠命令或会话与记忆设置执行。
control.reasonEn: “Compact long chats with /compact, initialize AGENTS.md with /init, reload context, and manage long-term memory” combines session slash commands and memory maintenance controls that you trigger in chat or Sessions & Memory settings.

items.titleZh: 按页回溯超长历史会话，或让智能体跨会话检索过往讨论与决策记录
items.titleEn: Page smoothly through long transcripts or let the agent search indexed history across past sessions
items.descriptionZh: 长会话采用按需分页加载不卡顿；你也可以直接让智能体去翻找之前某个会话里定下的接口约定，智能体会先读索引再精确定位对应轮次，不会把整本历史硬塞进上下文。
items.descriptionEn: Long sessions page smoothly on scroll, and you can ask the Agent to look up decisions from earlier threads — it reads a compact session index first instead of dumping entire transcripts into context.

workflowZh: 先用 SessionControl 的 list 找到目标会话，再用 SessionHistory 导出带索引的会话记录
先只读取导出文件的索引区，再用 Read 或 Grep 定位并读取需要的轮次，避免把完整历史塞进上下文
workflowEn: Use SessionControl list to find the target session, then export its indexed transcript with SessionHistory
Read only the exported index first, then use Read or Grep for the required turns instead of loading the entire history into context

items.titleZh: 让智能体跨工作区列出、新建会话，或把子任务发给另一个持久会话接力完成
items.titleEn: Let an agent create or list sessions across workspaces and hand off work to another persisted session
items.descriptionZh: 需要把后端改动交给另一个后端专属会话联动处理时，智能体可直接向目标会话发送消息并收回结果，本地与远程工作区边界保持严格隔离。
items.descriptionEn: Coordinate across sessions or repos by letting an Agent create a companion session or message an existing one asynchronously while preserving local and remote workspace boundaries.

workflowZh: 用 ListWorkspaces 获取运行主机登记的 workspace_id，再传给 SessionControl.workspace 创建或列出本地或远程会话；绝对路径仅在调用者执行环境中解析；取消只终止当前轮次，删除是独立动作
需要让另一持久会话接手工作时用 SessionMessage，并保留异步返回；跨远程边界时沿用目标会话绑定，不得复用控制器路径
workflowEn: Use ListWorkspaces to discover runtime-host workspace IDs, then pass one as SessionControl.workspace to create or list local or remote sessions; absolute paths resolve in the caller environment; cancel affects only the active turn and delete is separate
Use SessionMessage when another persisted session should take over work and retain its asynchronous result; preserve the target session binding across remote boundaries

items.titleZh: 从项目或会话右键菜单一键打开本机会话存储目录，方便手动备份或排查
items.titleEn: Reveal the local session storage folder from workspace or session menus for backup and troubleshooting
items.descriptionZh: 想备份重要对话原始记录时，在菜单中点一下即可在 Finder / 资源管理器定位存储目录；远程工作区会打开本机保存的镜像目录。
items.descriptionEn: Open the underlying session data folder directly in Finder or Explorer when backing up transcripts or inspecting local mirrors of remote workspaces.

control.reasonZh: 需要用户选择工作区或会话，并在本机桌面文件管理器中操作；远程工作区打开本机保存的会话镜像，对端设备和 Detached Dispatch 会话不支持此操作。打开目录不会修改会话归属。
control.reasonEn: The user selects a workspace or session and works in the local desktop file manager; remote workspaces reveal their locally stored session mirror, while peer and detached-dispatch sessions are unsupported. Opening storage does not change session ownership.

stepsZh: 在侧边栏项目名旁点「新建会话」（或按 ⌘Shift+A / Ctrl+Shift+A 进入会话后按 ⌘N / Ctrl+N）
在输入框下方选择适合当前任务的模式（如日常开发选「标准」，深度攻关选「极致」，写文档选「办公协作」）与模型
输入 @ 添加相关文件、目录或过往会话作为上下文，描述你想达成的效果；长任务可在开头加 `/goal `
运行过程中可随时发送新消息引导方向、审批权限卡片，或划选回复内容添加批注与侧边提问
stepsEn: Click New session beside your project in the sidebar (or press ⌘Shift+A / Ctrl+Shift+A, then ⌘N / Ctrl+N)
Pick the mode that fits your task in the composer bar (Standard for daily coding, Ultimate for deep problem-solving, Cowork for documents) and choose a model
Type @ to attach relevant files, folders, or past sessions, then describe what you need — prefix with `/goal ` for persistent multi-turn objectives
While running, send follow-ups to steer, approve permission prompts, or highlight reply text to add batch annotations or ask a side question
agentExamplesZh: 新建一个会话，帮我排查为什么登录接口偶发返回 401
/goal 把 auth 模块的单元测试补齐并全部跑通
根据这份接口说明帮我生成一份结构清晰的 .xlsx 测试用例表和 .pptx 评审简报
翻一下我上周关于缓存改造的历史会话，把当时敲定的键名规范整理出来
agentExamplesEn: Start a new session and help me debug why the login endpoint intermittently returns 401
/goal Add unit tests for the auth module and iterate until the whole suite passes
Create a clean .xlsx test matrix and a .pptx review deck from this API spec
Search my session history from last week on cache redesign and summarize the key naming rules we agreed on
tipsZh: 在聊天框按 Enter 默认直接发送，按 Ctrl+Enter（或 Shift+Enter）换行；如果你习惯智能体运行时发的消息先排队而不是立即插话引导，可在「设置 → 应用与界面 → 输入与交互」中调整「消息发送」策略。
切换到了「极简（Minimal）」模式却找不到 @MCP？这是刻意设计的轻量无工具打扰模式，切回「标准」或「极致」就能看到已连接的 MCP 服务了。
仓库根目录放一份 `AGENTS.md`（可用 `/init` 自动生成初稿）写明构建与测试命令，所有会话和子智能体都会自动遵守，省去每次重复交代。
tipsEn: In the composer, Enter sends and Ctrl+Enter / Shift+Enter inserts a newline; to queue messages instead of steering active runs immediately, change Message sending under Settings → Application & Interface → Input & Interaction.
Can’t see @MCP in Minimal mode? Minimal intentionally strips extra tool overhead — switch to Standard, Ultimate, or Creative to pick MCP servers.
Run `/init` once in a new repo to generate an `AGENTS.md` file with your build and test rules so every future session follows your team’s conventions automatically.

operations.descriptionZh: 在当前工作上下文中打开一个新的 AI 会话。
operations.descriptionEn: Open a new AI session in your active working context.

capabilities.titleZh: 智能体管理与并行子智能体
capabilities.summaryZh: 查看和定制不同专长的智能体角色，按需裁剪每个角色的工具与 Skills 边界，并让主智能体在复杂任务中自动派生多个子智能体并行调研、编码与审查。
capabilities.summaryEn: Browse and customize specialized agents, tailor each role’s allowed tools and Skills, and let your primary agent spawn parallel subagents for codebase exploration, implementation, and review.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧「首页 → 智能体」卡片，或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索「打开智能体」；项目专属子智能体也可在「项目资源」页管理
capabilities.entryPathEn: Open Home → Agents, press ⌘K / Ctrl+K for Open agents, or manage project-scoped subagents in Project Resources
highlightsZh: 内置代码探索、通用执行、深度评审、研究专家与多角色协作等专业子智能体
支持创建用户级自定义模式智能体与项目级专属子智能体（如前端规范检查员、SQL 审计员）
可精细到按角色勾选工具组、单个工具与 Skills，只读角色天然禁止改动代码更放心
主智能体可一次派生多个子智能体并行工作，并在会话中直观展示每个子智能体的进度与产出
highlightsEn: Built-in specialist subagents for fast codebase exploration, implementation, deep review, and research
Create user-level custom modes or repo-specific project subagents (e.g., API reviewer, migration helper)
Scope each agent’s exact tool groups, individual tools, Skills, and read-only guardrails
Let the primary agent fan out bounded subtasks in parallel and synthesize their findings automatically
scenariosZh: 接手陌生大仓库要先摸清五六个模块的调用链：在「标准」或「极致」模式下直接提问，主智能体会自动派生多个只读探索子智能体分头检索，几秒钟汇总出全景结论，还不污染主对话上下文。
团队有严格的接口安全或无障碍审查要求：在「项目资源 → 智能体」里新建一个只读的项目级审查子智能体，写明检查清单并提交到仓库共享给队友。
想给某类专门工作配一个顺手的对话模式：在「智能体」页面创建自定义智能体，只开启它真正需要的工具组和 Skills，响应更聚焦、成本更可控。
scenariosEn: Mapping out five unfamiliar subsystems in a large monorepo? Ask in Standard or Ultimate mode and let the primary agent spawn read-only explorer subagents in parallel without bloating your main context window.
Have strict security or accessibility rules for one repo? Add a read-only project subagent from Project Resources → Agents so every teammate and review session can invoke it.
Want a dedicated role for database tuning or release notes? Create a custom agent with only the exact tool groups and Skills it needs.

items.titleZh: 按内置、个人、项目与外部来源分类浏览当前环境可用的全部智能体
items.titleEn: Browse built-in, personal, project, and external agents available in the current environment
items.descriptionZh: 在智能体中心一目了然区分主对话模式智能体与可被委派的子智能体，并支持按作用范围或关键词快速筛选。
items.descriptionEn: Filter by level and type in the Agents gallery to see built-in modes, delegatable subagents, personal roles, and project-owned agents.

control.reasonZh: 「按内置、个人、项目与外部来源分类浏览当前环境可用的全部智能体」需要结合当前主机与工作区的实时目录进行筛选查看；智能体可为你直接打开智能体管理中心。
control.reasonEn: “Browse built-in, personal, project, and external agents available in the current environment” displays live agent catalogs scoped to your active host and workspace; the Agent opens the Agents gallery directly for you.

items.titleZh: 创建自定义主对话智能体，设定专属名称、职责说明与系统提示词
items.titleEn: Create custom primary agents with their own name, description, and role instructions
items.descriptionZh: 把你反复使用的角色设定、输出风格和工作边界沉淀成独立模式，新建会话时即可直接选用。
items.descriptionEn: Turn recurring role prompts, output conventions, and guardrails into a reusable custom mode selectable right in the chat composer.

control.reasonZh: 「创建自定义主对话智能体，设定专属名称、职责说明与系统提示词」包含角色提示词编写与工具边界挑选，打开创建弹窗后即可按向导保存。
control.reasonEn: “Create custom primary agents with their own name, description, and role instructions” lets you author role instructions and pick allowed capabilities in the creation dialog.

items.titleZh: 查看详情、随时微调提示词、热重载配置或删除不再需要的自定义智能体
items.titleEn: Inspect, edit instructions, hot-reload, or remove custom agents anytime
items.descriptionZh: 调整完提示词或外部修改配置文件后无需重启客户端，重新加载即可在下一轮对话生效。
items.descriptionEn: Refine a custom agent’s prompt or reload definitions from disk without restarting OpenBitFun.

control.reasonZh: 「查看详情、随时微调提示词、热重载配置或删除不再需要的自定义智能体」需要选定目标自定义智能体并确认编辑或删除动作，智能体会为你打开管理界面。
control.reasonEn: “Inspect, edit instructions, hot-reload, or remove custom agents anytime” targets the specific custom agent you select for editing, reloading, or removal in the Agents view.

items.titleZh: 创建与维护可被主智能体自动委派的个人级或项目级子智能体
items.titleEn: Create and configure personal or project-scoped subagents that primary agents can delegate to
items.descriptionZh: 写清楚子智能体「擅长解决什么问题」，主智能体在遇到匹配子任务时就会自动把它派上场，也可为它单独指定选用哪款模型。
items.descriptionEn: Give a subagent a clear specialty description and optional model preference so primary agents know exactly when to delegate bounded work to it.

control.reasonZh: 「创建与维护可被主智能体自动委派的个人级或项目级子智能体」涉及作用域选择（个人或当前项目）、提示词与模型配置，可在智能体页或项目资源页中直观完成。
control.reasonEn: “Create and configure personal or project-scoped subagents that primary agents can delegate to” lets you choose personal or project scope, craft specialist instructions, and configure subagent behavior in the UI.

items.titleZh: 悬停或点开智能体卡片，透视它的可用工具清单、Skills 与只读安全限制
items.titleEn: Inspect each agent’s enabled tools, Skills, and read-only safety posture at a glance
items.descriptionZh: 不确定某个角色能不能改文件或跑命令？查看能力摘要就能看清它的只读标记、已启用工具数与绑定的技能范围。
items.descriptionEn: Check capability tooltips and detail views to verify whether a role is read-only and exactly which tools and Skills it can invoke.

control.reasonZh: 「悬停或点开智能体卡片，透视它的可用工具清单、Skills 与只读安全限制」用于在界面上直观核对不同角色的能力边界与安全约束。
control.reasonEn: “Inspect each agent’s enabled tools, Skills, and read-only safety posture at a glance” surfaces per-role capability summaries and read-only boundaries interactively in the Agents gallery.

items.titleZh: 按智能体精细开关工具组、单个工具与 Skills，并随时一键恢复默认配置
items.titleEn: Toggle tool groups, individual tools, and Skills per agent — with one-click reset to defaults
items.descriptionZh: 既可以给内置模式增减工具与技能，也可以为自定义角色做最小权限裁剪；改乱了点一下「恢复默认」就能回到出厂推荐组合。
items.descriptionEn: Tailor built-in or custom agents with minimal-privilege tool and Skill pickers, and reset any built-in profile back to defaults in one click.

control.reasonZh: 「按智能体精细开关工具组、单个工具与 Skills，并随时一键恢复默认配置」需要针对具体角色在工具组与技能组选择器中勾选确认，智能体会为你打开对应配置界面。
control.reasonEn: “Toggle tool groups, individual tools, and Skills per agent — with one-click reset to defaults” uses interactive tool-group and skill-group pickers per agent profile so you can review and reset selections safely.

items.titleZh: 由主智能体自动派生并行子智能体协同调研、编码与审查，并统一汇总结果
items.titleEn: Let the primary agent spawn parallel subagents for research, coding, and review and synthesize their output
items.descriptionZh: 主智能体会把大任务拆成互不踩踏的子切片交给多个子智能体同时推进；你在对话流里还能看到可爱的子代理化身卡片并随时点开查看它的独立推理轨迹。
items.descriptionEn: The primary agent breaks complex requests into non-overlapping slices, monitors running subagents, steers or cancels them if needed, and delivers a unified answer.

workflowZh: 使用 AgentSpawn 启动有边界的子任务，并保留返回的 agent_id
用 AgentList/AgentWait 查看进度；需要调整时用 AgentSendInput，必要时再中断或删除，最终综合子智能体结果
workflowEn: Start a bounded subtask with AgentSpawn and retain the returned agent_id
Use AgentList or AgentWait for progress, AgentSendInput for corrections, and interrupt or delete only when necessary before synthesizing the results

stepsZh: 从左侧「首页 → 智能体」卡片进入（或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索「打开智能体」；想常驻侧边栏可在外观设置中固定）
浏览内置角色的能力范围，或点击右上角「创建智能体」新建自定义对话角色与可委派子智能体
在详情页用工具组与技能选择器勾选该角色允许使用的能力；项目专属子智能体也可直接从「项目资源」页创建
回到会话直接描述复杂任务（如「并行排查这三个模块的性能瓶颈」），主智能体会自动调度合适的子智能体分工完成
stepsEn: Open Home → Agents (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and choose Open agents; pin Agents to the sidebar in Appearance settings if you visit often)
Browse built-in roles or click Create agent to define a custom mode or delegatable specialist subagent
Use the tool-group and Skill pickers to scope what the agent can access — or create repo-owned subagents directly from Project Resources
In any Standard or Ultimate session, describe multi-part work naturally and let the primary agent spawn and coordinate subagents in parallel
agentExamplesZh: 打开智能体管理页，我想看看现在有哪些子智能体
并行派几个子智能体分别检查 auth、billing 和 gateway 三个目录里的错误处理漏洞，最后汇总给我
帮我用 create-agent 技能起草一个专门审查数据库迁移脚本的只读子智能体
agentExamplesEn: Open Agents so I can review my available subagents
Spawn parallel subagents to audit error handling across auth, billing, and gateway, then synthesize the findings
Help me draft a read-only subagent specialized in reviewing SQL migration safety
tipsZh: 想控制子智能体默认用哪款模型（比如让探索子智能体默认用高速高性价比模型或模型池）以及并行策略？前往「设置 → 模型与智能体 → 执行与协作」即可一键调整。
编写自定义子智能体时，「描述（Description）」写得越具体（说明何时该调用它、输入输出是什么），主智能体自动委派的时机就越准。
需要跨仓库复用的角色建为「个人级」，只针对当前代码库架构定制的角色建为「项目级」。
tipsEn: Want subagents to default to your Fast model, a specific model, or a Model Pool — or tune parallel execution limits? Head to Settings → Models & Agents → Execution & Collaboration.
Write a crisp, concrete Description on custom subagents ("Use when reviewing Prisma migrations...") so the primary agent knows exactly when to delegate.
Create personal subagents for cross-repo habits, and project-scoped subagents (via Project Resources) for repo-specific architecture rules.

capabilities.titleZh: 个人助理（长期人设与专属空间）
capabilities.summaryZh: 拥有独立工作区、长期记忆与鲜明性格的随身 AI 伙伴：不局限于单个代码仓库，可随时陪你梳理日常事务、撰写文档、跟进长期计划并运行专属定时任务。
capabilities.summaryEn: Create long-lived AI companions with their own workspace, memory, and Markdown persona documents — ideal for ongoing daily planning, writing, research, and assistant-scoped scheduled jobs beyond any single repo.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧「首页 → 智能体」分区的助理入口（创建助理），或点击侧边栏「会话」旁的「+」新建个人助理（也可按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索「助理」，或在外观设置中将「助理」固定到左侧边栏）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Home → Agents section (Create assistant), click + beside Sessions in the sidebar, press ⌘K / Ctrl+K for Assistant, or pin Assistant to the left sidebar
highlightsZh: 不绑定特定代码目录，适合管理跨项目长期事务、个人知识库、读书笔记与日常待办
可视化设定名字、形象气质与头像，底层直接映射为自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md
支持创建多个不同定位的个人助理（如「每日效率管家」「英语写作教练」），并指定一个主助理
在助理详情页可直接发起对话、回看专属历史会话，并配置只属于该助理的定时任务
highlightsEn: Lives in its own dedicated assistant workspace — great for daily planning, notes, writing, and cross-project rituals
Customize name, vibe, and avatar while editing plain-text IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents with autosave
Keep multiple specialized assistants (e.g., Daily Chief of Staff, Writing Coach) and designate a Primary Assistant
Start chats, browse past conversations, and manage assistant-scoped scheduled jobs from one clean page
scenariosZh: 想要一个懂你表达习惯、记住你工作偏好的日常搭子，但不想每次都先打开某个代码工程：直接和主助理开聊，把周报提纲、会议纪要和杂事交给它整理。
希望早上九点自动汇总待办或晚间提醒复盘：在个人助理详情页直接添加定时任务，时间一到它就会带着自己的人设和记忆自动执行。
想分别拥有一位严谨毒舌的「论文审稿人」和一位温和耐心的「学习陪练」：创建两个不同的个人助理，各自维护独立的 `SOUL.md` 灵魂设定与会话历史，互不串味。
scenariosEn: Want an AI partner that remembers your writing tone and ongoing priorities without opening a code repo first? Start a chat with your Primary Assistant anytime from the sidebar.
Need a morning briefing or Friday weekly-review nudge? Add a scheduled job right inside that assistant’s page so it runs in its own workspace with its persona intact.
Want both a tough academic critic and a friendly language tutor? Create two assistants with separate SOUL.md files and isolated conversation histories.

items.titleZh: 在助理空间一览全部个人助理、查看人设与能力摘要，并一键创建新助理
items.titleEn: Browse all your personal assistants, review their persona and capability summaries, and create new ones in one click
items.descriptionZh: 新创建的助理会自动使用开箱即用的默认模板初始化，随后你可以按喜好慢慢雕琢它的名字、头像与性格。
items.descriptionEn: New assistants spin up instantly with sensible defaults so you can start chatting right away or customize their identity whenever you like.

control.reasonZh: 「在助理空间一览全部个人助理、查看人设与能力摘要，并一键创建新助理」需要你在助理空间中浏览卡片并确认新建或进入哪个助理；智能体可为你直接打开助理空间。
control.reasonEn: “Browse all your personal assistants, review their persona and capability summaries, and create new ones in one click” opens the Assistant gallery where you can browse existing companions, create a new one, or jump into its configuration.

items.titleZh: 把暂时不用的助理从侧边栏收起（完整保留人设与历史），需要时随时重新打开
items.titleEn: Hide inactive assistants from the sidebar while keeping their persona and history intact, and reopen them anytime
items.descriptionZh: 在侧边栏关闭助理只会停下正在运行的轮次并收起分组，所有人设文档与历史对话都安全保存在助理空间中。
items.descriptionEn: Closing an assistant in the sidebar cancels any in-flight turn and declutters your list without deleting its persona files or past sessions.

control.reasonZh: 关闭操作依赖用户选择的助理；助理空间保留完整目录，并提供重新打开入口。
control.reasonEn: Closing depends on the assistant selected by the user; the gallery retains the complete catalog and provides a reopen action.

items.titleZh: 将最常用的伙伴设为「主助理」、删除不再需要的副助理，或一键重置为初始状态
items.titleEn: Designate your Primary Assistant, remove extra assistants, or reset an assistant workspace back to defaults
items.descriptionZh: 设为主助理后，新建助理会话与手机远控都会优先使用它；主助理受保护不可直接误删，如需重来可先切换主助理或使用重置。
items.descriptionEn: Your Primary Assistant becomes the default companion for quick assistant chats; non-primary assistants can be deleted, and any assistant can be reset to clean defaults.

control.reasonZh: 「将最常用的伙伴设为「主助理」、删除不再需要的副助理，或一键重置为初始状态」涉及影响长期记忆与历史记录的确认动作，由你在助理详情菜单中核对后执行。
control.reasonEn: “Designate your Primary Assistant, remove extra assistants, or reset an assistant workspace back to defaults” includes destructive reset and deletion confirmations that remain safely under your explicit control in the UI.

items.titleZh: 定制助理昵称、角色设定与说话气质，并挑选官方插画头像、Emoji 或自定义字符
items.titleEn: Edit an assistant’s name, role archetype, and conversational vibe, and pick a preset avatar, emoji, or custom glyph
items.descriptionZh: 给每个助理起个好记的名字、配上辨识度高的头像，在侧边栏和标签栏里一眼就能认出正在和谁对话。
items.descriptionEn: Give each companion a memorable name, vibe, and distinct avatar so you can tell them apart instantly in the sidebar and session tabs.

control.reasonZh: 「定制助理昵称、角色设定与说话气质，并挑选官方插画头像、Emoji 或自定义字符」属于可视化的形象与气质编辑流程，可在助理配置页边改边看实时效果。
control.reasonEn: “Edit an assistant’s name, role archetype, and conversational vibe, and pick a preset avatar, emoji, or custom glyph” is a visual customization flow on the assistant detail page with live avatar preview.

items.titleZh: 直接编辑自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md，用透明 Markdown 掌控人设细节
items.titleEn: Read and edit autosaved IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents in plain Markdown
items.descriptionZh: 没有黑盒参数：`IDENTITY.md` 定义它是谁、`SOUL.md` 定义性格与行事准则、`USER.md` 记录它需要了解的关于你的背景偏好，边写边自动保存。
items.descriptionEn: Zero black-box magic: IDENTITY.md defines who the assistant is, SOUL.md shapes its voice and principles, and USER.md captures your preferences — all autosaved as clean Markdown.

control.reasonZh: 「直接编辑自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md，用透明 Markdown 掌控人设细节」需要你在助理配置页的文档编辑器中审阅与撰写人设正文，所有改动会自动同步保存。
control.reasonEn: “Read and edit autosaved IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents in plain Markdown” provides an interactive Markdown editor with frontmatter synchronization right inside the assistant configuration page.

items.titleZh: 从助理主页直接选模型发消息开聊，并集中回顾与该助理的所有历史会话
items.titleEn: Pick a model, send a quick message, and browse all past conversations from the assistant’s page
items.descriptionZh: 在助理详情页顶部输入框写下一句话就能开启新对话，下方列表按时间整理了你和这位助理聊过的全部主题。
items.descriptionEn: Start a new thread right from the quick composer at the top of the assistant’s page or jump back into any earlier conversation below.

control.reasonZh: 「从助理主页直接选模型发消息开聊，并集中回顾与该助理的所有历史会话」结合了快速输入草稿与历史会话点选，智能体可为你打开该助理主页以便立即开始。
control.reasonEn: “Pick a model, send a quick message, and browse all past conversations from the assistant’s page” combines a quick message composer and session history list on the assistant’s detail view.

items.titleZh: 为当前个人助理单独创建和管理定时会话与周期性自动任务
items.titleEn: Create and manage scheduled sessions and recurring automated jobs scoped to a specific assistant
items.descriptionZh: 在这里添加的定时任务只绑定当前助理工作区，运行记录也会归档在它的会话列表下，和代码项目的构建巡检任务互不混杂。
items.descriptionEn: Scheduled jobs created here belong specifically to this assistant’s workspace, keeping personal briefings and reminders neatly separated from repo build jobs.

control.reasonZh: 「为当前个人助理单独创建和管理定时会话与周期性自动任务」需要你在当前助理的定时任务区设定时间、提示词与启用状态，智能体也可通过定时工具协助管理。
control.reasonEn: “Create and manage scheduled sessions and recurring automated jobs scoped to a specific assistant” lets you review, add, pause, or edit scheduled prompts scoped specifically to the selected assistant workspace.

stepsZh: 从左侧「首页」的「智能体」分区点击助理卡片或「创建助理」进入（也可点侧边栏「会话」旁的「+」直接新建个人助理，或在外观设置中把「助理」固定到左侧边栏）
选择现有的主助理，或点击「创建助理」生成一位新伙伴
修改昵称、头像和气质，按需在 IDENTITY.md / SOUL.md / USER.md 中补充它的说话风格与你的个人背景（自动保存）
在页面顶部输入框直接发消息开聊，或切换到定时任务区给它安排每日早报/提醒
stepsEn: From Home, look under the Agents section to open an assistant or click Create assistant (or click + beside Sessions in the sidebar, or pin Assistant to the left sidebar in Appearance settings)
Select your Primary Assistant or click Create assistant to add a new specialized companion
Set its name, vibe, and avatar, and optionally refine IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md — changes save automatically
Send a message right from the quick input box at the top, or add a recurring briefing under its Scheduled Jobs section
agentExamplesZh: 打开我的个人助理空间
我想修改主助理的人设，让它回答更精炼直接
每天早上 9 点让我的主助理帮我整理一份今日关注事项提醒
agentExamplesEn: Open my personal assistants gallery
Take me to my Primary Assistant so I can make its persona more concise
Schedule a 9:00 AM daily check-in task for my assistant
tipsZh: 「个人助理」和「智能体（Agents）」有什么区别？「智能体」是面向具体开发任务的专业工种或子代理（跟着代码项目走）；「个人助理」则拥有自己独立的工作区、长期记忆和 `SOUL.md` 人格，适合跨项目的日常陪伴与长期事务。
不知道 `USER.md` 写什么？你可以直接在和助理聊天时告诉它你的职业、常用技术栈和偏好，让它帮你整理更新即可。
手机端通过 Remote Connect 连接电脑后，同样可以在侧边栏直接切换到你的个人助理发消息！
tipsEn: Personal Assistants vs. Agents: Agents are task roles and subagents used inside project sessions, whereas each Personal Assistant owns its own persistent workspace, memory, and SOUL.md persona across days and weeks.
Not sure what to put in USER.md? Just tell your assistant about your role, habits, and formatting preferences in chat and ask it to update your profile notes.
When connected via Mobile Web or IM bots, your Personal Assistants appear right alongside your code workspaces so you can message them on the go.

capabilities.titleZh: 项目、工作区与项目资源
capabilities.summaryZh: 打开本地文件夹或远程环境建立工作区，并在专属「项目资源」页集中管理单项目的默认模型、关联目录、权限规则、定时任务与项目级智能体/技能。
capabilities.summaryEn: Open local folders or remote environments as workspaces, and use each project’s Project Resources hub to manage default models, linked directories, permission rules, scheduled jobs, and project-scoped agents or Skills.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧边栏「会话」标题右侧的「+」按钮；或悬停项目行点击「项目资源」图标与文件夹图标
capabilities.entryPathEn: Click + beside Sessions in the left sidebar, or hover a project row for its Project Resources and Open directory icons
capabilities.shortcut: ⌘K → 打开项目 / 新建项目
highlightsZh: 支持打开本机目录、SSH 服务器、Docker 容器或 WSL，还可在同账号其他设备上新建项目
在「项目资源」页为单个仓库独立设置默认主力模型、快速模型与默认智能体模式
把前后端拆仓或共享库添加为「关联目录」，让文件树与智能体在同一工作区内协同读取
按项目集中查看和编辑工具审批规则、工作区定时任务、专属子智能体与项目级 Skills
highlightsEn: Open local directories, SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL distros — even on another signed-in device
Set per-project overrides for Primary model, Fast model, and default Agent mode in Project Resources
Link multi-repo frontend/backend or shared library folders as Related Directories under one workspace
Manage project-scoped permission rules, scheduled tasks, subagents, and Skills in one clean dashboard
scenariosZh: 主力业务仓库需要最强的推理模型，而个人练手小项目想省成本用轻量模型：点开项目行旁的「项目资源」，直接在顶部三个胶囊选择器里为该项目单独指定模型与默认模式，无需来回改全局设置。
前端应用需要对照另一个目录里的后端接口定义或设计规范：在「项目资源 → 目录」点击「添加目录」关联进来，点卡片就能在左侧文件树切换浏览。
侧边栏同时开了十几个项目显得杂乱：暂时不做的项目直接右键「关闭工作区」收起，所有历史会话与配置都会完好保留，随时从最近项目重新打开。
scenariosEn: Want your flagship monorepo to default to a frontier reasoning model while a side project uses a lighter model? Set per-project Primary model, Fast model, and default mode pills at the top of Project Resources.
Working across split frontend and backend repos? Add the companion repo under Related Directories in Project Resources so both stay one click away in your file tree.
Too many open projects cluttering the sidebar? Close idle workspaces from the context menu — your sessions and settings stay safe on disk and reopen anytime.

items.titleZh: 打开现有项目目录，或通过向导创建本地与远程新项目
items.titleEn: Open an existing project folder or launch the new-project wizard for local and remote environments
items.descriptionZh: 点击侧边栏「会话」旁的「+」或直接让智能体打开入口，可选择本机目录、从模板新建工作区，或在已登录的其他设备、SSH 主机、容器与 WSL 中创建项目。
items.descriptionEn: Use the + button beside Sessions or ask the Agent to open an existing directory or start a new project on this machine, a Peer device, SSH, Docker, or WSL.

items.titleZh: 在「项目资源」页配置单项目的默认模型与模式，并集中管理项目权限、定时任务、子智能体与技能
items.titleEn: Configure per-project default models and mode in Project Resources, alongside project permissions, schedules, subagents, and Skills
items.descriptionZh: 点击项目行旁的「项目资源」图标即可设置只对该仓库（含其关联 Worktree）生效的主力模型、快速模型与默认模式，并在同一页增删该项目的工具审批规则、定时任务、项目子智能体和项目级 Skills。
items.descriptionEn: Open Project Resources from a project row to override the Primary model, Fast model, and default mode for that repo (inherited by its worktrees), and manage its tool permissions, scheduled jobs, subagents, and Skills.

control.reasonZh: 「在「项目资源」页配置单项目的默认模型与模式，并集中管理项目权限、定时任务、子智能体与技能」需要针对你选定的具体项目工作区读取并保存覆盖项与权限规则；可在侧边栏项目行点击「项目资源」图标直接进入。
control.reasonEn: “Configure per-project default models and mode in Project Resources, alongside project permissions, schedules, subagents, and Skills” applies to a chosen project workspace and its live host catalogs; open Project Resources from the project row in the sidebar to edit them in one place.

items.titleZh: 在多个已打开项目间自由切换、拖拽排序或关闭闲置工作区
items.titleEn: Switch, drag to reorder, or close open project workspaces in the sidebar
items.descriptionZh: 支持按习惯拖拽调整侧边栏项目顺序；关闭项目只会把它从当前侧边栏收起，磁盘文件和历史会话均不受影响。
items.descriptionEn: Drag project headers to keep active repos at the top, or close idle workspaces without touching files or saved conversation history.

control.reasonZh: 排序与关闭哪个工作区取决于你在侧边栏的实时选择；智能体可帮你打开项目入口，不会擅自关闭你正在使用的工作区。
control.reasonEn: Reordering or closing workspaces depends on your live sidebar selection; the Agent can open the project flow without closing active work behind your back.

items.titleZh: 查看最近打开过的项目列表，一键重开或清理失效记录
items.titleEn: Browse recently opened projects, reopen them in one click, or clean up stale entries
items.descriptionZh: 如果某个本地目录已被移动或删除，可以单独移除记录或一键清理失效路径，保持列表清爽。
items.descriptionEn: Quickly jump back into recent repositories or prune moved and deleted directory entries from your history.

control.reasonZh: 「查看最近打开过的项目列表，一键重开或清理失效记录」需要你从历史项目列表中确认要重开或清理的条目；智能体会为你打开对应入口并在界面中完成选择。
control.reasonEn: “Browse recently opened projects, reopen them in one click, or clean up stale entries” lets you inspect your recent history list and confirm which project to reopen or remove in the UI.

items.titleZh: 添加或移除「关联目录」，维护项目名称描述与工作区人设文件
items.titleEn: Link or unlink Related Directories and maintain workspace metadata and persona files
items.descriptionZh: 在「项目资源 → 目录」中可关联跨仓库目录并附带说明（移除关联只解除引用，绝不删除磁盘文件），也可维护工作区信息或重置 Persona 文档。
items.descriptionEn: Attach companion directories with descriptions in Project Resources (unlinking never deletes files on disk) and maintain workspace info or persona files.

control.reasonZh: 「添加或移除「关联目录」，维护项目名称描述与工作区人设文件」涉及目录选择器、关联说明编辑及移除确认；智能体可带你定位项目入口，由你在界面中确认目录变更。
control.reasonEn: “Link or unlink Related Directories and maintain workspace metadata and persona files” involves folder pickers, descriptions, and unlink confirmation in Project Resources so your directory bindings stay intentional.

items.titleZh: 定制项目专属图标图案、配色或分别上传浅色/深色自定义图片
items.titleEn: Customize project icons with presets and colors, or upload separate light and dark images
items.descriptionZh: 点击「项目资源」页顶部的大图标，可从工作学习、生活兴趣分类挑选图标与配色，或上传浅色/深色模式专属图片，侧边栏会同步更新。
items.descriptionEn: Click the large header icon in Project Resources to pick a preset glyph and color or upload light/dark custom artwork that syncs with the sidebar.

control.reasonZh: 点击项目资源页的大图标，从工作学习或生活兴趣分类选择图案及颜色，或分别上传浅色、深色图片，预览后保存到工作区所属主机。
control.reasonEn: Click the large icon on the Project resources page to choose a work/study or life/hobby icon and color, or upload separate light and dark images, preview them, then save on the workspace host.

items.titleZh: 自动监听工作区文件变动，并在大型仓库监听中断时一键恢复
items.titleEn: Watch workspace file changes automatically and retry the watcher if OS limits interrupt it
items.descriptionZh: 当你在外部终端或 IDE 修改文件时，文件树和编辑器会自动感知最新状态；若因系统句柄上限暂停，可查看状态并重试。
items.descriptionEn: Keeps the file tree and open buffers in sync when external tools touch files, with status inspection and one-click retry if a watcher stops.

control.reasonZh: 「自动监听工作区文件变动，并在大型仓库监听中断时一键恢复」由工作区生命周期自动维护，当你需要排查监听状态或手动重启监听时可在界面中查看与触发。
control.reasonEn: “Watch workspace file changes automatically and retry the watcher if OS limits interrupt it” runs automatically with your workspace lifecycle and exposes live watcher status and retry controls when troubleshooting large repos.

items.titleZh: 在本地工作区内按文件名、路径或正文快速检索定位
items.titleEn: Search local workspaces by filename, path, or full-text content
items.descriptionZh: 在左侧「工作区资源 → 文件」或全局搜索中输入关键词，即可快速定位目标代码文件与匹配上下文。
items.descriptionEn: Filter by filename, relative path, or file contents right from Workspace Resources or Global Search to jump straight to matching lines.

control.reasonZh: 「在本地工作区内按文件名、路径或正文快速检索定位」面向你在文件面板与全局搜索中的实时交互检索；若你直接向智能体提问，智能体也会用内置搜索工具自行查找代码。
control.reasonEn: “Search local workspaces by filename, path, or full-text content” powers interactive search in the file panel and Global Search while the Agent also searches your codebase directly during tasks.

items.titleZh: 直接从新建项目向导接入 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL 远程工作区
items.titleEn: Connect to SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL directly from the New Project wizard
items.descriptionZh: 新建或添加项目时无需离开主流程，直接选择远程环境并浏览远端目录即可建立完整的远程工作区。
items.descriptionEn: Select an existing or new SSH, container, or WSL target right inside the project creation flow and pick the remote directory visually.

control.reasonZh: 「直接从新建项目向导接入 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL 远程工作区」需要选择连接主机、完成认证并在远端目录浏览器中选定文件夹；智能体可打开新建项目向导供你完成连接。
control.reasonEn: “Connect to SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL directly from the New Project wizard” walks through host selection, authentication, and remote folder picking in the New Project dialog after the Agent opens it.

items.titleZh: 在「项目资源」与状态栏查看 Git 改动路径数、会话数、任务数及配置健康度
items.titleEn: Check changed Git path counts, conversation totals, scheduled tasks, and config health
items.descriptionZh: 项目资源顶部统计条会汇总去重后的 Git 改动文件数、未归档会话总数、定时任务以及项目专属智能体与技能数量，点击数字即可滚动聚焦对应分区。
items.descriptionEn: The Project Resources summary strip shows distinct changed Git paths, unarchived conversations, scheduled jobs, and project Agents/Skills — click a count to jump to its section.

control.reasonZh: 「在「项目资源」与状态栏查看 Git 改动路径数、会话数、任务数及配置健康度」汇总了当前工作区、连接与应用运行时的实时指标，可在项目资源页和状态界面直观查看。
control.reasonEn: “Check changed Git path counts, conversation totals, scheduled tasks, and config health” aggregates live workspace, Git, and application health metrics for visual inspection in Project Resources and app status views.

stepsZh: 点击左侧边栏「会话」标题右侧的「+」（添加项目或个人助理），或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 选择「打开项目 / 新建项目」
选择本机文件夹，或切换到 SSH / 容器 / WSL 及其他在线设备并选定项目目录
悬停在侧边栏项目名称上：点「文件夹」图标可在左侧展开该项目的「工作区资源」（文件树 + 终端）；点「项目资源」图标可进入项目仪表盘
在「项目资源」顶部按需为该项目指定专属的主力模型、快速模型和默认模式，或添加关联目录与项目级权限规则
stepsEn: Click + beside Sessions in the left sidebar (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and choose Open project / New project)
Pick a local folder, or choose an SSH host, Docker container, WSL distro, or Peer device and select its directory
Hover the project header in the sidebar: click the folder icon to open Workspace Resources (files + terminals), or click the Project Resources icon for its dashboard
In Project Resources, optionally set per-project Primary/Fast models and default mode, link related directories, or add project permission rules
agentExamplesZh: 帮我打开一个本地项目
打开新建项目向导，我想连一个远程目录
看看我当前工作区下有哪些项目，在这个项目新建一个会话
agentExamplesEn: Help me open a local project folder
Open the new-project dialog so I can connect a remote directory
List my registered workspaces and start a new session in this project
tipsZh: 在「项目资源」里设置的默认模型和默认模式，会自动被该项目派生的所有 Git Worktree 继承，并行开分支也不用重复配置。
如果侧边栏会话列表切换到了「全部（平铺）」视图，新打开一个还没有会话的空项目时，OpenBitFun 会自动切回「分组」视图，确保你能立刻看到新项目标题。
移除「关联目录」只会解除项目引用，绝对不会删除你硬盘上的任何源文件，可以放心整理。
tipsEn: Per-project default models and modes set in Project Resources are automatically inherited by linked Git worktrees of that repo.
If your session list is in flat All view when you open a brand-new project, OpenBitFun automatically switches to Grouped view so the new project header is visible right away.
Removing a Related Directory only unlinks it from the project — your files on disk are never deleted.

operations.descriptionZh: 弹出目录选择器并打开一个已有项目文件夹。
operations.descriptionEn: Open the directory picker to open an existing project folder.

operations.descriptionZh: 打开新建项目向导，支持本地目录、模板或远程环境。
operations.descriptionEn: Launch the new-project wizard for local folders, templates, or remote targets.

capabilities.titleZh: 文件、代码编辑与多格式预览
capabilities.titleEn: Files, code editor & rich document previews
capabilities.summaryZh: 在会话旁浏览和编辑项目代码，逐文件或逐轮次审阅智能体改动并随时回滚快照，原生支持 Markdown、LaTeX 编译预览与 PDF 高亮批注审阅。
capabilities.summaryEn: Browse and edit code right beside your chat, review or roll back AI changes by file or turn, and work natively with Markdown, LaTeX PDF compilation, and annotated PDF reviews.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 点击左侧边栏项目行的「文件夹」图标展开「工作区资源」，或在会话右侧空白分栏点「浏览文件」（也可按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K → 打开文件）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Click the folder icon on any project row in the sidebar to open Workspace Resources, click Browse files in the right pane, or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Open files
highlightsZh: 与会话左右并排查看文件树和代码，支持 F2 重命名、拖拽附件与一键定位系统文件夹
按单次操作、单轮对话或整个文件精细查看 Diff，逐项接受/拒绝改动或一键回滚到任意历史轮次快照
内置富文本 Markdown、实施计划阅读器、LaTeX 编译对比预览，以及带高亮/批注/手写墨迹的 PDF 审阅器
按当前语言提供器实际能力诚实呈现格式化、跳转定义、查找引用与重命名菜单，绝不展示无效空壳按钮
highlightsEn: Keep file trees and editors side by side with your session, with F2 rename, drag-and-drop attachments, and OS folder reveal
Inspect diffs by operation, turn, or file — accept or reject edits selectively, or roll back to any earlier turn snapshot
Built-in rich Markdown editor, Plan viewer, LaTeX-to-PDF compiler preview, and PDF annotation/review (Highlight, notes, Ink)
Surfaces formatting, go-to-definition, references, and rename strictly when supported by the active language provider
scenariosZh: 智能体一口气改了 8 个文件，你想确认其中 2 个核心文件没改歪：点开会话底部的修改文件统计条，在右侧分栏逐个对照高亮 Diff，满意的点「接受」，不满意的单文件「拒绝」或直接回滚到上一轮快照。
写学术论文或技术方案时：直接在工作区打开 `.tex` 文件编译预览 PDF，或在 PDF 阅读器里圈选段落打高亮与回复批注，批注以标准 PDF 注释保存，发给同事用其他阅读器也能直接看到。
界面报错截了张图想让智能体帮忙定位样式文件：直接在桌面本地会话按 Ctrl+V / ⌘V 粘贴截图，或把日志与文件夹拖进聊天框即可立刻分析。
scenariosEn: The Agent touched eight files and you want to verify two critical ones line by line: click the modified-files bar in chat to inspect side-by-side diffs, accept good changes, and reject or roll back anything unwanted to an earlier turn.
Drafting a paper or spec? Edit `.tex` files with workspace LaTeX compilation, or mark up PDFs with standard Highlight, comment, and Ink annotations that round-trip cleanly in external PDF readers.
Debugging a visual glitch? Paste a clipboard screenshot right into a local Desktop session or drag files and folders onto the chat input.

items.titleZh: 在左侧「工作区资源」浏览目录树，新建、读取、重命名或删除文件与文件夹
items.titleEn: Browse the Workspace Resources file tree and create, read, rename, or delete files and folders
items.descriptionZh: 文件树中支持快捷键操作（⌘N 新建文件、⌘Shift+N 新建文件夹、F2 重命名、Delete 删除、F5 刷新），也可直接在选定目录右键「在此新建终端」。
items.descriptionEn: Use keyboard shortcuts in the file tree (⌘N new file, ⌘Shift+N new folder, F2 rename, Delete, F5 refresh) or right-click any folder to open a terminal right there.

workflowZh: 用 LS 浏览目录、Read 读取文件；创建或修改内容时使用 Write/Edit，删除时使用 Delete
重命名等文件系统动作使用工作区数据面上的 ExecCommand，并在写操作后重新读取或查看差异确认结果
workflowEn: Use LS to browse directories and Read for files; use Write or Edit for content changes and Delete for removal
Use ExecCommand on the workspace data plane for operations such as rename, then read back or inspect diffs after mutations

items.titleZh: 在分栏代码编辑器中编辑与保存文件，未保存关闭时自动弹出保护提醒
items.titleEn: Edit and save files in the split code editor with unsaved-change close protection
items.descriptionZh: 支持多标签并行打开与左右分屏对照；重命名文件会自动更新已打开标签页的路径，关闭未保存标签时会明确提示保存、放弃或取消。
items.descriptionEn: Open multiple tabs across split panes; file renames update open tabs seamlessly, and closing a dirty buffer always prompts to Save, Discard, or Cancel.

workflowZh: 先用 Read 读取当前内容，再根据改动范围选择 Edit 精确替换或 Write 创建/完整写入文件
文件工具沿用 OpenBitFun 的工作区、权限与变更快照语义；写入后重新读取或查看差异确认结果
workflowEn: Read the current content first, then use Edit for exact replacements or Write for creation/full rewrites
The file tools preserve OpenBitFun workspace, permission, and change-snapshot semantics; read back or inspect the diff after writing

items.titleZh: 按单个文件、单次工具操作、单轮对话或整个会话查看代码 Diff 与增删行数统计
items.titleEn: Inspect diffs and line-change stats by file, single tool operation, turn, or full session
items.descriptionZh: 不管是点对话里的文件编辑卡片，还是点输入框上方的改动文件汇总条，都能立即在右侧对照修改前后的每一处差异。
items.descriptionEn: Click any file-edit card in the transcript or the modified-files bar above the composer to compare exact before-and-after diffs.

workflowZh: 若 GetFileDiff 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载它的当前契约
按工作区、会话或目标文件读取差异，并在页面或快照变化后重新获取最新结果
workflowEn: If GetFileDiff is deferred, load its current contract with GetToolSpec first
Inspect changes for the workspace, session, or target file and refresh the result after page or snapshot changes

items.titleZh: 按单次操作、单个文件或整个会话一键「接受」或「拒绝」智能体产生的代码改动
items.titleEn: Accept or reject AI code changes by individual operation, file, or entire session
items.descriptionZh: 把最终拍板权留在你手里：保留改得漂亮的部分，一键撤销不符合预期的文件修改，无需手动敲 Git 恢复命令。
items.descriptionEn: Stay in full control of your working tree: keep clean edits and revert unwanted file or operation changes in one click.

control.reasonZh: 「按单次操作、单个文件或整个会话一键「接受」或「拒绝」智能体产生的代码改动」需要你在审阅具体 Diff 后做出保留或还原的判断，可在会话修改栏与差异视图中直接点击完成。
control.reasonEn: “Accept or reject AI code changes by individual operation, file, or entire session” lets you review the concrete diff first and confirm which edits to keep or revert in the diff viewer and modified-files bar.

items.titleZh: 基于自动变更快照查看文件修改轨迹，随时把会话与代码一起回滚到指定历史轮次
items.titleEn: Browse automatic file-change snapshots and roll back a session and its files to any earlier turn
items.descriptionZh: 如果后面几轮尝试走偏了，直接选择「回滚到此轮」，OpenBitFun 会利用操作前自动保存的快照把代码干净还原到当时的状态。
items.descriptionEn: If a multi-turn experiment goes sideways, roll back to an earlier turn and let OpenBitFun’s automatic pre-edit snapshots restore your files cleanly.

control.reasonZh: 「基于自动变更快照查看文件修改轨迹，随时把会话与代码一起回滚到指定历史轮次」会同时回退工作区文件内容与对话时间线，需要你在会话轮次上明确选择回滚节点并确认。
control.reasonEn: “Browse automatic file-change snapshots and roll back a session and its files to any earlier turn” rewinds workspace files alongside the conversation timeline, so you explicitly choose and confirm the target turn in the UI.

items.titleZh: 原生编辑与预览 Markdown、实施计划、LaTeX 编译文档，并在 PDF 中添加高亮与批注审阅
items.titleEn: Edit and preview Markdown, implementation plans, and LaTeX builds, and annotate PDFs with highlights, notes, and ink
items.descriptionZh: 打开 `.md` 享受所见即所得排版与图表渲染，打开 `.tex` 可直接调用本机环境编译预览 PDF，打开 `.pdf` 则支持添加标准高亮、批注回复与手写批改并处理多端写入冲突。
items.descriptionEn: Open `.md` files in the rich Markdown editor, compile `.tex` documents in place, inspect `.openbitfun/plans` specs, and review `.pdf` files with persistent Highlight, comment, and Ink annotations.

control.reasonZh: 「原生编辑与预览 Markdown、实施计划、LaTeX 编译文档，并在 PDF 中添加高亮与批注审阅」面向文档阅读、排版编译与画布坐标批注等视觉交互，在工作区打开对应格式文件即可自动启用专属视图。
control.reasonEn: “Edit and preview Markdown, implementation plans, and LaTeX builds, and annotate PDFs with highlights, notes, and ink” activates format-aware visual editors and annotation layers automatically whenever you open Markdown, plan, LaTeX, or PDF files.

items.titleZh: 支持文件名通配与正则全文搜索，流式展示工作区匹配行与上下文
items.titleEn: Search the workspace by filename globs, plain text, or regular expressions with streaming context previews
items.descriptionZh: 无论是你自己按关键词搜代码，还是智能体在后台定位调用链，都会直接运行在当前本地或远程工作区数据面上，绝不会把远程工作区误搜成本机目录。
items.descriptionEn: Stream filename and regex content matches across local or remote workspaces without ever falling back to local files when working remotely.

workflowZh: 用 Glob 按路径或文件名模式查找候选文件，再用 Grep 搜索正文、正则和上下文
两者都使用当前会话的工作区数据面；远程工作区不会静默回退到本机目录
workflowEn: Use Glob for path or filename patterns, then Grep for text, regular expressions, and surrounding context
Both tools use the current session workspace data plane and never silently fall back to local paths for a remote workspace

items.titleZh: 启用本地工作区加速搜索索引，实现毫秒级大仓库内容检索
items.titleEn: Maintain accelerated local workspace search indexes for instant large-repo lookups
items.descriptionZh: 针对大型本地代码库可开启加速索引提升检索速度；连接远程工作区时会自动隐藏不适用的本地索引项。
items.descriptionEn: Speeds up searches across large local repositories while automatically scoping out local-only index controls on remote workspaces.

control.reasonZh: Glob/Grep 可直接完成智能体搜索，而界面搜索索引的启停状态归属工作区搜索设置管理。
control.reasonEn: Glob and Grep provide direct agent search, while UI search-index lifecycle is managed through workspace search settings.

items.titleZh: 仅在当前语言提供器实际支持时显示格式化、定义与类型跳转、引用、重命名、快速修复和符号导航
items.titleEn: Show formatting, definition and type navigation, references, rename, quick fixes, and symbol navigation only when supported by the active language provider
items.descriptionZh: 编辑器右键菜单与面包屑符号树会根据当前文件语言的真实支持能力动态呈现，点得出来的动作就一定能用。
items.descriptionEn: Context-menu actions and symbol breadcrumbs adapt dynamically to what the active file’s language provider genuinely supports.

control.reasonZh: 「仅在当前语言提供器实际支持时显示格式化、定义与类型跳转、引用、重命名、快速修复和符号导航」与你在编辑器中聚焦的文件类型和光标所在符号位置绑定，可在代码编辑器右键菜单或快捷键中直接调用。
control.reasonEn: “Show formatting, definition and type navigation, references, rename, quick fixes, and symbol navigation only when supported by the active language provider” depends on the focused file type and cursor symbol in the code editor, surfaced through context menus and breadcrumbs.

items.titleZh: 在本地桌面会话中直接粘贴剪贴板截图，或把本机文件与文件夹拖进聊天框
items.titleEn: Paste clipboard images or drag local files and folders straight into Desktop sessions
items.descriptionZh: 拖入文件时会显示直观的类型预览卡片，方便你在提问前核对挂载了哪些材料。
items.descriptionEn: Drag files, folders, or screenshots onto the session view with live drop-preview cards before sending your prompt.

control.reasonZh: 该流程需要用户选择或提供本地附件；智能体可读取已经进入会话的文件，但不会自行声称完成了用户侧拖放或剪贴板选择。
control.reasonEn: This flow requires the user to select or provide local attachments; the Agent can read files already in context without pretending it performed the user's drag, drop, or clipboard selection.

items.titleZh: 让智能体直接查看并深度分析工作区配图、UI 截图、报错图或架构草图
items.titleEn: Let the agent inspect and analyze UI screenshots, error captures, diagrams, and workspace images
items.descriptionZh: 即使当前选用的主对话模型是纯文本模型，只要在模型设置中配好了图像理解服务，智能体也能调用视觉分析工具读懂画面细节。
items.descriptionEn: Works seamlessly with vision-capable primary models or falls back to your configured image-understanding model when using a text-only chat model.

workflowZh: 对本地图片先用 view_image 查看原图或高质量预览；需要结构化视觉分析时再用 analyze_image
远程或不可直接读取的图片需先通过当前工作区数据面取得，不得把远程路径静默当成本机路径
workflowEn: Use view_image for a local image preview or original view, then analyze_image when structured visual analysis is needed
Retrieve remote or otherwise inaccessible images through the active workspace data plane first; never reinterpret a remote path as local

items.titleZh: 在 Finder 或系统资源管理器中一键定位当前本机文件或文件夹
