items.titleEn: Reveal any local file or folder directly in Finder or your OS file manager
items.descriptionZh: 仅对本机桌面项目启用；当浏览远程服务器或对端设备项目时，按钮会明确置灰说明原因，绝不会误打开本机同名路径。
items.descriptionEn: Available for local Desktop projects; disabled with a clear explanation on SSH or Peer workspaces so remote paths never leak into local file managers.

control.reasonZh: 这是控制器本机的界面动作，且远程工作区路径不能回退到本机打开；智能体会打开文件入口，不会把目标机路径静默交给控制器系统。
control.reasonEn: This is a controller-local UI action, and remote-workspace paths must never fall back to the local file manager; the Agent opens the file surface without silently reusing a target-host path locally.

stepsZh: 在左侧边栏悬停项目行并点击「文件夹」图标，左侧导航会切换为该项目的「工作区资源」（上方文件树、下方终端列表）
点击任意文件即可在当前会话另一侧的分栏画布中打开；按 ⌘F / Ctrl+F 在文件内搜索，按 ⌘\ / Ctrl+\ 拆出并排编辑视图
智能体改完代码后，点击对话中的文件卡片或底部改动汇总条对比 Diff，按文件或操作点「接受 / 拒绝」
若想推翻最近几轮尝试，在对应历史轮次菜单中选择「回滚到此轮」即可一键恢复快照
stepsEn: Hover a project in the left sidebar and click its folder icon to switch into Workspace Resources (file tree on top, terminals below)
Click any file to open it in the pane opposite your active chat; use ⌘F / Ctrl+F to find in file and ⌘\ / Ctrl+\ to split editors
After the Agent edits code, click a file card or the modified-files bar to inspect diffs and Accept or Reject changes selectively
Need a clean do-over? Use Roll back to turn on any earlier message to restore your files from pre-edit snapshots
agentExamplesZh: 打开当前项目的文件面板
帮我看看这轮会话一共改了哪些文件，把核心逻辑的 Diff 总结一下
对照这张报错截图排查对应的前端组件样式问题
agentExamplesEn: Open the project file tree for me
Show me what files changed in this session and summarize the core diffs
Analyze this UI screenshot and track down the component causing the layout overflow
tipsZh: 在「工作区资源」里浏览其他项目的文件树时，不会强制打断或切换你当前正在聊的会话——想边参考老项目代码边在新项目提问非常顺手。
刚关掉一个正在看的代码标签？在右侧画布按 ⌘Shift+T / Ctrl+Shift+T 就能立刻重新打开它。
想调整编辑器字号、Tab 缩进、小地图（Minimap）或保存自动格式化，可前往「设置 → 编程与开发 → 编辑器」。
tipsEn: Browsing another repo’s files in Workspace Resources does not hijack your active chat session — handy when referencing code from a second project.
Accidentally closed an editor tab? Press ⌘Shift+T / Ctrl+Shift+T inside the canvas to reopen it immediately.
Customize font size, tab width, minimap, and format-on-save in Settings → Programming & Development → Editor.

capabilities.titleZh: 内置终端与命令行协作
capabilities.summaryZh: 在项目目录内随时开启多实例 Shell：清晰区分「我的终端」与「智能体终端」，支持保存常用启动配置，且关掉普通终端标签页不会误杀正在运行的后台服务。
capabilities.summaryEn: Run multiple shells scoped to your local or remote workspace: separate Mine vs. Agent terminals, save reusable startup configurations, and close terminal tabs without killing running dev servers.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 按快捷键 ⌘Shift+` / Ctrl+Shift+`，或展开左侧「工作区资源 → 终端」分区（文件树任意目录右键也可「在此新建终端」）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Press ⌘Shift+` / Ctrl+Shift+`, expand Workspace Resources → Terminals in the left panel, or right-click any folder for New terminal here
highlightsZh: 在左侧「工作区资源」中按「我的 / 智能体」分类管理终端，互不混杂
既可在会话右侧分栏或底部停靠面板打开终端，也可一键定位当前工作目录到文件树
关掉普通终端视图标签只会分离画面（Detach），开发服务继续稳稳运行；想彻底停掉进程再点停止/移除
在 SSH 远程工作区中新建终端时，会自动直接连入目标服务器目录执行，无需手敲 ssh
highlightsEn: Organize terminals cleanly into Mine vs. Agent views inside Workspace Resources
Dock terminals at the bottom of a chat or beside code in the split workbench, and reveal cwd in the file tree
Closing a regular terminal tab detaches the view without killing your running dev server — stop processes explicitly when ready
Opening a terminal inside an SSH remote workspace automatically spawns the shell on the remote host
scenariosZh: 你在终端里跑着 `pnpm dev`，想先把终端标签页关掉腾出屏幕看代码：放心按关闭即可——普通终端标签默认只是分离视图，后台服务不会断，随时从左侧「工作区资源 → 终端」点一下就能重新接回实时输出。
每次打开项目都要敲一串带环境变量的启动命令：在终端菜单中选择「保存配置」，下次就能直接从列表按保存好的配置一键启动。
跑单测报错了一大屏堆栈：直接让智能体在同一工作区环境下复现命令、读取标准输出并交互式调试修复。
scenariosEn: Running `pnpm dev` and want screen space back? Close the terminal tab worry-free — regular tabs detach cleanly while the process keeps running in Workspace Resources → Terminals.
Tired of typing the same startup command every morning? Save a terminal configuration on the workspace and start it on demand.
Hit a wall of test failures? Ask the Agent to run the suite in your workspace environment, inspect stdout/stderr, and iterate on the fix.

items.titleZh: 打开终端视图并在当前工作区一键新建终端会话
items.titleEn: Open the terminal view and create a new shell session in the active workspace
items.descriptionZh: 自动绑定当前项目的根目录（含 SSH 远程工作区连接），让你一打开就处在正确的代码目录下。
items.descriptionEn: Automatically binds to your active project’s root directory — including SSH remote workspaces — so you land in the right folder immediately.

items.titleZh: 按「我的 / 智能体」分类查看、切换终端，或保存常用的终端启动配置
items.titleEn: Browse and switch terminals across Mine and Agent views, and save reusable terminal configurations
items.descriptionZh: 左侧「工作区资源 → 终端」会清晰标出每个终端的运行中、已保存或已结束状态；打开已保存配置不会擅自自动跑命令，等你点启动才执行。
items.descriptionEn: See Running, Saved, or Ended badges in Workspace Resources → Terminals; opening a saved profile never runs its startup command until you explicitly start it.

control.reasonZh: 这些操作依赖当前终端会话列表和活动面板；智能体可直接新建终端，并可用终端工具执行任务，而多会话切换与配置管理保留在界面中完成。
control.reasonEn: These actions depend on the live terminal-session list and active panel; the Agent can create terminals and run commands via tools while multi-session management stays in the UI.

items.titleZh: 自动检测系统可用 Shell（如 zsh、bash、PowerShell、Git Bash）并按需切换新建终端类型
items.titleEn: Auto-detect installed shells (zsh, bash, PowerShell, Git Bash, WSL) and pick a default or per-terminal shell
items.descriptionZh: 既可在「设置 → 编程与开发 → 终端」设定全局默认 Shell，也可在新建终端下拉菜单里临时挑选别的 Shell。
items.descriptionEn: Set your global default shell in Settings → Programming & Development → Terminal, or pick a specific shell on the fly when creating a terminal.

control.reasonZh: 「自动检测系统可用 Shell（如 zsh、bash、PowerShell、Git Bash）并按需切换新建终端类型」需要读取当前主机实际安装的 Shell 列表并由你挑选目标类型，可在终端新建菜单或终端设置中完成。
control.reasonEn: “Auto-detect installed shells (zsh, bash, PowerShell, Git Bash, WSL) and pick a default or per-terminal shell” queries the shells installed on your host so you can choose one from the New Terminal menu or Terminal settings.

items.titleZh: 在文件树任意子目录右键「在此新建终端」，或让智能体在指定子目录执行命令
items.titleEn: Open a terminal directly inside any subfolder from the file tree, or let the agent run commands in a target directory
items.descriptionZh: 处理 Monorepo 子包时无需手动 `cd`，直接在目标包文件夹右键即可打开定位于该子目录的终端，也可从终端反向在文件树定位当前工作目录。
items.descriptionEn: Working in a monorepo package? Right-click any folder in the file tree to launch a shell right there, or reveal a terminal’s working directory back in the file tree.

workflowZh: 调用 ExecCommand 时把目标目录放在 workdir；省略时使用当前工作区根目录
workflowEn: Pass the target directory as ExecCommand workdir; omit it to use the current workspace root

items.titleZh: 由智能体执行构建与测试命令、向交互式进程输入内容，或发送中断与停止信号
items.titleEn: Let the agent run build and test commands, send interactive stdin, or interrupt and terminate hung processes
items.descriptionZh: 智能体跑命令同样严格遵守你的权限规则与远程工作区边界；遇到交互式脚手架提示时可启用 TTY 持续输入或终止卡死命令。
items.descriptionEn: Agent shell calls honor your workspace boundary and approval rules, supporting interactive TTY input, output polling, and clean signal termination.

workflowZh: 用 ExecCommand 启动命令；需要交互时启用 TTY，并保留返回的 session_id
用 WriteStdin 输入或轮询输出，用 ExecControl 发送中断或强制终止
workflowEn: Start the command with ExecCommand; enable TTY for interactive programs and keep the returned session_id
Use WriteStdin to enter text or poll output, and ExecControl to interrupt or terminate the process

items.titleZh: 在底部面板与右侧分栏间流畅拖拽调整终端尺寸，自动适配全屏 TUI 与长行排版
items.titleEn: Resize docked bottom or split-pane terminals smoothly with automatic row/column adaptation for TUI tools
items.descriptionZh: 拖拽分割线时会自动防抖同步 PTY 行列尺寸，确保 `htop`、`vim`、`lazygit` 等终端全屏工具画面不乱码不错位。
items.descriptionEn: Dragging panel splitters synchronizes PTY rows and columns cleanly so full-screen terminal apps like htop, vim, or lazygit render crisply.

control.reasonZh: 「在底部面板与右侧分栏间流畅拖拽调整终端尺寸，自动适配全屏 TUI 与长行排版」随你在工作台中拖拽面板分割线或切换窗口大小实时自动同步，无需任何手动设置。
control.reasonEn: “Resize docked bottom or split-pane terminals smoothly with automatic row/column adaptation for TUI tools” happens automatically as you drag panel splitters or resize the window in the workbench.

items.titleZh: 回溯终端命令历史并识别 Shell Integration 状态
items.titleEn: Browse terminal command history and detect Shell Integration support
items.descriptionZh: 保留终端执行过的历史记录与退出后的屏幕输出，进程结束后依然能往上翻看完整报错日志，直到你主动关闭移除该终端。
items.descriptionEn: Even after a shell process exits, its scrollback output stays readable for inspection until you explicitly remove the terminal entry.

control.reasonZh: 「回溯终端命令历史并识别 Shell Integration 状态」与具体终端实例的运行缓冲和 Shell 环境相关，可在终端面板中直接翻阅查看。
control.reasonEn: “Browse terminal command history and detect Shell Integration support” is tied to each live or exited terminal session in the terminal panel.

items.titleZh: 区分「关标签分离视图」与「彻底停止关闭进程」，安全关停单个或全部终端
items.titleEn: Detach views safely when closing tabs, or explicitly stop and shut down individual or all terminal processes
items.descriptionZh: 关掉顶部或右侧标签只收起画面不杀进程；当你确实想释放端口或退出所有后台 Shell 时，可在终端操作菜单中显式停止关闭。
items.descriptionEn: Closing a tab detaches without stopping your server; use Stop / Remove in the terminal actions menu when you actually want to free ports and end processes.

control.reasonZh: 「区分「关标签分离视图」与「彻底停止关闭进程」，安全关停单个或全部终端」避免误杀正在运行的服务或未保存的终端作业，由你在终端列表菜单中明确选择停止或移除。
control.reasonEn: “Detach views safely when closing tabs, or explicitly stop and shut down individual or all terminal processes” protects running dev servers and interactive jobs until you explicitly stop or close them from the terminal list.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘Shift+`（Windows/Linux 按 Ctrl+Shift+`），或点侧边栏项目行的「文件夹」图标展开「工作区资源 → 终端」
点击「+」新建终端（或在下拉箭头里挑选 zsh / PowerShell / Git Bash 等指定 Shell）
输入命令启动服务或测试；想看代码时直接关掉终端标签页，进程会在左侧终端列表继续保活
需要彻底释放端口时，在左侧「工作区资源 → 终端」对应条目菜单里点击「停止」或「移除已结束终端」
stepsEn: Press ⌘Shift+` (Ctrl+Shift+` on Windows/Linux) or click a project’s folder icon in the sidebar to open Workspace Resources → Terminals
Click + to start a shell in your project root, or use the shell picker to choose zsh, bash, PowerShell, or Git Bash
Run your dev server or tests; close the tab anytime to free screen space while keeping the underlying process alive
When you want to stop the process and free its port, choose Stop or Remove from the terminal row menu in Workspace Resources
agentExamplesZh: 帮我在当前项目新建一个终端
跑一下当前包的单元测试，把失败用例的报错原因告诉我
打开默认终端 Shell 设置
agentExamplesEn: Create a new terminal in the current project
Run the unit tests for this package and explain any failures
Open default terminal shell settings
tipsZh: 看到终端显示「运行中」代表 Shell 会话还活着，并不代表里面的 Web 服务健康无报错——需要核实服务状态时点开看看实时日志最稳妥。
如果你更喜欢纯键盘、全终端无 GUI 的沉浸式开发体验，还可以安装独立的 `openbitfun` 命令行工具（详见下一篇「OpenBitFun CLI 与终端交互界面」）。
在连接 SSH 远程工作区时新建终端，不会读取你本机的默认 Shell 路径，而是直接启动远端服务器的原生登录 Shell。
tipsEn: A Running badge means the shell PTY is active — open the terminal view to check foreground server logs when verifying health.
Prefer living 100% inside iTerm2, Ghostty, WezTerm, or an SSH session? Check out the standalone `openbitfun` CLI & TUI guide right next to this page.
New SSH workspace terminals always launch the remote server’s native shell rather than reusing your local computer’s shell executable.

operations.descriptionZh: 在当前工作区新建一个终端会话。
operations.descriptionEn: Create a new terminal session in the current workspace.

capabilities.titleZh: OpenBitFun CLI 与终端交互界面（TUI）
capabilities.summaryZh: 在系统终端直接运行 `openbitfun`：既有快捷键顺手的全屏交互式 TUI（含 `!` Shell 模式、图片粘贴与多窗口共享运行时），也支持可写进脚本与 CI 的 `exec`、后台 `daemon` 与远程派发。
capabilities.summaryEn: Run `openbitfun` right in your system terminal: enjoy a full-featured interactive TUI (with `!` Shell mode, image paste, and `--shared` multi-terminal sessions) plus scriptable `exec`, `daemon`, `dispatch`, and stdio `server` commands.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 在系统终端运行 `openbitfun` 进入交互式 TUI，或运行 `openbitfun exec "..."` 执行单次非交互任务（源码仓库内可通过 `pnpm run cli:install` 安装）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Run `openbitfun` in any terminal for the interactive TUI, or `openbitfun exec "..."` for non-interactive runs (install from repo with `pnpm run cli:install` or release archives)
highlightsZh: 输入 `openbitfun` 即开全功能交互式 TUI：支持 `/sessions`、`/fork`、`/goal`、`/queue`、`/diff`、`/undo`、`/editor` 等全套斜杠命令
空输入框按 `!` 秒切 SHELL 模式直接跑命令，结果会作为标准对话轮次保存，回到桌面版也能看到同一张工具卡片
用 `openbitfun exec "..." --output-format text|json|stream-json` 轻松接入自动化脚本与流水线
与桌面版共用同一套配置、模型、Skills、MCP、Hooks 和会话存储，还能作为无界面的 Peer Host 或远控守护进程长驻服务器
highlightsEn: Full interactive TUI via `openbitfun`: `/sessions`, `/fork`, `/goal`, `/queue`, `/diff`, `/undo`, `/editor`, subagent tree viewer, and prompt stash
Press `!` in an empty composer for instant SHELL mode — commands save as standard turns visible in both CLI and Desktop
Scriptable `openbitfun exec` with `text`, `json`, or `stream-json` JSONL output and explicit `--auto` permission control
Shares one config, session store, MCP, Skills, and Hooks runtime with Desktop — and hosts headless Peer Mode, bots, and Cron via `daemon`
scenariosZh: SSH 登录到一台没有图形界面的 Linux 开发机：装上 `openbitfun` 二进制就能直接在终端里用 TUI 结对写代码，甚至开启 Remote Connect 用手机和本机桌面端连上来可视操控。
写了一半复杂提示词，突然要先插一句别的命令：打开 TUI 命令面板执行「Stash prompt」把包含 `@` 文件引用的草稿暂存起来，忙完再「Stash pop」一键取回。
想在自动化脚本里调用智能体检查变更并拿结构化 JSON 结果：运行 `openbitfun exec "检查本次改动风险" --output-format json`，标准输出只输出干净 JSON，日志走 stderr 绝不污染管道。
scenariosEn: Logged into a headless Linux box over SSH? Run `openbitfun` for a rich terminal coding session — or start `daemon` so your phone and laptop Desktop app can connect to it remotely.
Halfway through drafting a detailed prompt with `@` file references when an urgent question pops up? Use Stash prompt in the TUI command palette and Stash pop it back later.
Automating checks in a shell script? Run `openbitfun exec "Audit staged changes" --output-format json` — stdout emits pure structured JSON while logs stay on stderr.

items.titleZh: 一键安装 `openbitfun` 命令行工具，并用 `doctor` 自检运行环境与配置状态
items.titleEn: Install the `openbitfun` executable and run `openbitfun doctor` to verify environment health
items.descriptionZh: 官方发行包直接附带 `openbitfun` 可执行文件，源码环境运行 `pnpm run cli:install` 即可安装到 `~/.local/bin`（Windows 为 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenBitFun\bin`），并支持安全自更新。
items.descriptionEn: Included in official release archives or installed via `pnpm run cli:install` to `~/.local/bin` (or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenBitFun\bin` on Windows), with lock-protected self-update and `openbitfun doctor` diagnostics.

control.reasonZh: 「一键安装 `openbitfun` 命令行工具，并用 `doctor` 自检运行环境与配置状态」是在你的系统终端或内置终端中执行的命令行安装与环境巡检操作，智能体可为你打开终端方便直接运行。
control.reasonEn: “Install the `openbitfun` executable and run `openbitfun doctor` to verify environment health” is run directly from your terminal shell; the Agent can open the terminal surface so you can run install or doctor commands.

items.titleZh: 在交互式 TUI 中使用 `/sessions`、`/fork`、`/goal`、`/queue`、`/diff`、`/undo`、`/editor` 与子智能体树检视器
items.titleEn: Work in the interactive TUI with `/sessions`, `/fork`, `/goal`, `/queue`, `/diff`, `/undo`, `/editor`, prompt stash, and subagent tree view
items.descriptionZh: 延续熟悉的终端快捷键习惯：支持用外部编辑器（`$VISUAL` / `$EDITOR`）撰写长提示词、用 `/queue` 上下移动调整待发送消息队列、只读展开查看并行子智能体的对话树，以及跨进程保留草稿暂存（Prompt Stash）。
items.descriptionEn: Compose long prompts in `$VISUAL`/`$EDITOR`, reorder queued messages with `/queue`, inspect read-only child subagent transcripts without losing your draft, and stash prompts across CLI runs.

control.reasonZh: 「在交互式 TUI 中使用 `/sessions`、`/fork`、`/goal`、`/queue`、`/diff`、`/undo`、`/editor` 与子智能体树检视器」是运行在终端中的全屏交互界面能力，启动 `openbitfun` 后即可通过斜杠命令与命令面板调出。
control.reasonEn: “Work in the interactive TUI with `/sessions`, `/fork`, `/goal`, `/queue`, `/diff`, `/undo`, `/editor`, prompt stash, and subagent tree view” is an interactive full-screen terminal session launched by running `openbitfun` in your project directory.

items.titleZh: 在空输入框按 `!` 秒进 SHELL 命令模式，或按 `Ctrl+V` 粘贴剪贴板图片与本地图片路径
items.titleEn: Type `!` on an empty prompt for SHELL mode, or press `Ctrl+V` to attach clipboard images and local image paths
items.descriptionZh: `!` 模式拥有独立的命令历史且把执行记录保存为标准会话轮次（按 `Esc` 退回聊天）；嵌入式 TUI 单条消息最多可粘贴 5 张 20 MiB 以内的 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP 图片。
items.descriptionEn: `!` SHELL mode keeps separate history and saves output as a standard session turn (press `Esc` to return to chat); Embedded TUI also accepts up to five 20 MiB images via `Ctrl+V` or pasted file paths.

control.reasonZh: 「在空输入框按 `!` 秒进 SHELL 命令模式，或按 `Ctrl+V` 粘贴剪贴板图片与本地图片路径」属于 TUI 输入框内的即时键盘交互，打开 `openbitfun` 聊天界面后即可直接使用。
control.reasonEn: “Type `!` on an empty prompt for SHELL mode, or press `Ctrl+V` to attach clipboard images and local image paths” is an immediate keyboard workflow inside the interactive TUI composer.

items.titleZh: 用 `openbitfun exec` 执行非交互式任务，输出纯文本、JSON 或流式 JSONL 并显式控制 `--auto` 审批
items.titleEn: Run non-interactive tasks with `openbitfun exec`, `--output-format text|json|stream-json`, and explicit `--auto` approval
items.descriptionZh: 为了安全，`exec` 默认拒绝需要人工确认的敏感操作；仅在你明确允许本次自动放行时加上 `--auto`，非常适合挂进 Git Hooks、CI 检查脚本或批处理管线（且能完整跟踪 `/goal` 多轮目标直至结束）。
items.descriptionEn: Safe by default: `exec` rejects interactive permission asks unless `--auto` is passed explicitly, streams clean `text`, `json`, or `stream-json` to stdout, and follows `/goal` continuations to completion.

workflowZh: 在需要脚本化调用 CLI 子命令（如 openbitfun --help 或只读状态检查）时，通过 ExecCommand 在目标工作区执行并读取标准输出
workflowEn: When invoking CLI subcommands programmatically (such as --help or read-only status checks), run them via ExecCommand in the target workspace and inspect stdout

items.titleZh: 通过 `openbitfun chat --shared` 让多个终端窗口共享同一个工作区运行时
items.titleEn: Reuse one workspace runtime across multiple terminal windows with `openbitfun chat --shared`
items.descriptionZh: 开多个终端分屏分别盯不同会话时，`--shared` 可复用同一个后台工作区运行时节省资源，同时保证每个会话同一时刻只有一个控制端不冲突。
items.descriptionEn: Open multiple terminal panes against one shared workspace runtime while preserving single-controller safety per session.

control.reasonZh: 「通过 `openbitfun chat --shared` 让多个终端窗口共享同一个工作区运行时」需要从多个系统终端窗口启动共享客户端会话，由你在终端环境中按需开启。
control.reasonEn: “Reuse one workspace runtime across multiple terminal windows with `openbitfun chat --shared`” is launched across your terminal windows whenever you want multi-pane TUI access to one shared runtime.

items.titleZh: 使用 `daemon` 托管远控机器人与定时任务，用 `dispatch outbound` 远程派发，或启动 `server` 标准流服务
items.titleEn: Host bots and Cron jobs via `daemon`, submit remote jobs with `dispatch outbound`, or run the stdio `server` host
items.descriptionZh: CLI 不仅能交互聊天，还提供完整的管理子命令群（`agents`、`models`、`mcp`、`plugins`、`hooks`、`config`、`acp`、`computer-use`），退出 TUI 后守护进程仍能继续替你监听微信/飞书/Telegram 机器人和定时任务。
items.descriptionEn: Manage `agents`, `models`, `mcp`, `plugins`, `hooks`, `config`, `acp`, and `computer-use` from the terminal, keep bots and scheduled jobs alive in `daemon`, dispatch jobs to other machines, or spawn `openbitfun server` over JSON-RPC stdio.

control.reasonZh: 「使用 `daemon` 托管远控机器人与定时任务，用 `dispatch outbound` 远程派发，或启动 `server` 标准流服务」涵盖守护进程、跨机派发与编辑器协议宿主等命令行入口，可根据部署场景在终端中直接运行对应子命令。
control.reasonEn: “Host bots and Cron jobs via `daemon`, submit remote jobs with `dispatch outbound`, or run the stdio `server` host” provides dedicated CLI subcommands for background daemons, cross-device dispatch, and stdio JSON-RPC editor integrations.

stepsZh: 从官方发行包获取 `openbitfun`，或在仓库根目录运行 `pnpm run cli:install` 后重开一个终端窗口使 `PATH` 生效
进入任意项目目录，直接输入 `openbitfun` 启动交互式 TUI（首次使用可先跑 `openbitfun doctor` 检查环境）
在 TUI 中直接打字对话，输入 `/` 浏览 `/goal`、`/fork`、`/diff`、`/queue` 等命令，或在空行按 `!` 快速运行 Shell 命令
需要脚本化批处理时运行 `openbitfun exec "你的指令" --output-format json`；需要后台长驻远控或定时任务时启用远控渠道自动拉起 `daemon`
stepsEn: Install `openbitfun` from an official release archive or run `pnpm run cli:install` and open a fresh terminal so `PATH` updates
cd into any project directory and run `openbitfun` to launch the interactive TUI (run `openbitfun doctor` anytime to verify setup)
Chat naturally, type `/` for `/goal`, `/fork`, `/diff`, `/queue`, and `/compact`, or type `!` on an empty line for quick shell commands
Use `openbitfun exec "your prompt" --output-format json` in scripts and CI, or start Remote Connect channels so the background `daemon` stays listening after you exit
agentExamplesZh: 打开终端，帮我跑一下 openbitfun --help 看看支持哪些子命令
我想了解怎么在无界面的 Linux 服务器上用 openbitfun CLI 开启微信机器人远控
告诉我怎么用 openbitfun exec 在脚本里输出 JSON 结果
agentExamplesEn: Open a terminal and check `openbitfun --help` for available subcommands
How do I set up WeChat bot remote control on a headless Linux server using the OpenBitFun CLI?
Show me how to run `openbitfun exec` with structured JSON output in a CI script
tipsZh: 在 CLI 配置里加上 `[ui] notifications = true`，当长任务跑完、报错或等待你审批权限时，iTerm2 / Ghostty / WezTerm 等终端会自动弹出系统提醒或响铃，不用一直盯着屏幕。
`openbitfun mcp import` 采用安全的先预览后应用机制，不会偷偷拷贝外部环境变量里的敏感密钥，新导入的服务默认保持关闭等你确认后再启用。
同一用户数据目录下同一时刻只有一个实例（桌面版或 CLI 守护进程）持有定时任务调度租约，避免同一个定时任务被重复执行两次。
tipsEn: Set `notifications = true` under `[ui]` in your CLI config to get OSC 9 / bell terminal alerts whenever a long turn finishes or needs permission approval.
`openbitfun mcp import` uses an explicit preview-then-apply flow without copying secret env vars, keeping newly imported servers disabled until you review them.
Only one Desktop or CLI process holds the Cron scheduling lease per user data directory at a time, preventing duplicate runs of scheduled jobs.

capabilities.titleZh: Git 版本控制与 Worktree 并行隔离
capabilities.summaryZh: 在会话与终端中顺畅完成状态检查、暂存提交、分支管理与 Cherry-pick，并借助 Git Worktree 在同一仓库同时并行推进多个互不干扰的 AI 会话。
capabilities.summaryEn: Inspect changes, stage, commit, manage branches, and cherry-pick through AI sessions and terminals — and use Git worktrees to run multiple parallel sessions on the same repository without branch collisions.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 在 AI 会话中直接用自然语言操作 Git、查看底部文件 Diff 栏，或在新建会话 / 「设置 → 编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git → Worktrees」管理隔离工作树
capabilities.entryPathEn: Ask in any AI session, inspect the modified-files diff bar, use `/diff` in CLI, or manage isolated worktrees in Settings → Programming & Development → Workspace & Git → Worktrees
highlightsZh: 直接用自然语言让智能体检查变更、整理暂存、生成规范 Commit Message 并安全提交
支持分支切换、提交图谱历史追溯、查看任意历史提交中的文件内容与 Cherry-pick 挑选合并
核心利器 Git Worktree：不用克隆多份仓库，就能让两个会话在不同分支上同时改代码、跑测试互不覆盖
内置高危 Git 参数拦截与仓库信任检查，强制推送或硬重置前都会经过安全确认
highlightsEn: Ask the Agent in plain language to inspect status/diffs, stage files, draft clean commit messages, and commit safely
Manage local branches, inspect commit history and arbitrary revisions, and run or resolve cherry-picks
Git Worktree isolation: run two or more AI tasks on different branches of the same repo simultaneously with zero conflict
Built-in guardrails for force-push, hard reset, and repository trust keep destructive Git actions explicit
scenariosZh: 正在重构大功能改了一半，线上突然来了一个紧急热修（Hotfix）：不用 `git stash` 手忙脚乱，直接开启一个绑定独立 Worktree 的新会话修 Bug 提 PR，两边目录完全隔离。
想把另一个实验分支上的某两次干净提交摘到主干分支：告诉智能体「帮我把那两个修复提交 cherry-pick 过来」，遇到冲突还能一步步协助解决或随时 `--abort` 中止还原。
写完一堆零散改动懒得憋英文提交说明：让智能体先看一遍 `git diff` 按仓库历史风格生成 Commit Message，你过目点头后再提交。
scenariosEn: Deep in a multi-file refactor when an urgent production bug lands? Start a Worktree-isolated session for the hotfix instead of juggling `git stash` — both sessions edit and run tests independently.
Need just two clean bugfix commits from an experimental branch? Ask the Agent to cherry-pick them and help resolve any conflict (or abort cleanly if needed).
Finished a feature and want a commit message that matches your repo’s style? Have the Agent inspect `git status` + `git diff` + recent `git log` and draft it for your approval.

items.titleZh: 查看仓库工作树状态、已跟踪改动数与逐文件 Diff 详情
items.titleEn: Inspect working-tree status, tracked change counts, and per-file diffs
items.descriptionZh: 在「项目资源」顶部可直接看到去重后的 Git 改动路径总数，在会话中也能随时让智能体梳理未暂存、已暂存与未跟踪文件。
items.descriptionEn: See distinct changed-path counts in Project Resources and inspect staged, unstaged, and untracked file diffs right from your session.

workflowZh: 在当前工作区通过 ExecCommand 运行 git status 与 git diff
检查当前工作树、暂存区和目标文件差异
workflowEn: Run git status and git diff through ExecCommand in the current workspace
Inspect the working tree, index, and selected file changes

items.titleZh: 管理仓库信任授权，以及创建、绑定、提升、重建和清理隔离的 Git Worktree
items.titleEn: Manage repository trust and create, bind, promote, recreate, or clean up isolated Git worktrees
items.descriptionZh: 为并行会话分配独立 Worktree 工作目录后，智能体的文件修改和构建命令都会锁定在该工作树中；任务完成后可合并提升或一键清理目录。
items.descriptionEn: Bind parallel sessions to dedicated Git worktrees so edits and builds stay completely isolated, then promote or clean them up when done.

control.reasonZh: 「管理仓库信任授权，以及创建、绑定、提升、重建和清理隔离的 Git Worktree」涉及仓库安全信任确认及多会话工作树生命周期管理，可在会话工作树入口或「设置 → 工作区与 Git → Worktrees」中直观操作。
control.reasonEn: “Manage repository trust and create, bind, promote, recreate, or clean up isolated Git worktrees” involves repository trust confirmation and worktree lifecycle choices managed in session worktree controls and Workspace & Git settings.

items.titleZh: 按文件精准暂存（Stage）、取消暂存或安全重置到指定提交
items.titleEn: Stage selected files, unstage changes, or reset to a chosen commit with safety checks
items.descriptionZh: 可以把不同主题的改动分批暂存拆成多次干净提交；涉及丢弃改动的 `reset` 参数会自动触发权限与安全拦截确认。
items.descriptionEn: Split mixed edits into clean atomic commits by staging selectively; destructive reset flags remain gated by permission checks.

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git add、git restore 或 git reset
完成暂存、取消暂存和选定提交重置；危险参数仍经过权限与安全检查
workflowEn: Run git add, git restore, or git reset through ExecCommand
Stage, unstage, or reset to a selected commit; risky arguments still pass permission and safety checks

items.titleZh: 结合真实改动自动拟定规范提交说明并创建 Git Commit
items.titleEn: Generate clear commit messages from actual diffs and create commits after your review
items.descriptionZh: 智能体会先比对暂存内容与仓库近期提交规范生成标题和正文，并可在「设置 → 工作区与 Git」中配置是否附带协作署名。
items.descriptionEn: Drafts accurate commit titles and bodies grounded in your staged diff and recent commit conventions, respecting your Git attribution settings.

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 先运行 git status 与 git diff
再运行 git commit 创建经用户确认的提交
workflowEn: Run git status and git diff through ExecCommand first
Then run git commit to create the user-approved commit

items.titleZh: 查看本地与远端跟踪分支，新建特性分支、切换分支或清理已合并分支
items.titleEn: List local and tracking branches, create feature branches, switch branches, or clean up merged ones
items.descriptionZh: 开启新功能前让智能体先基于最新主干切好规范命名的分支，省去手敲命令或切错基准分支的烦恼。
items.descriptionEn: Have the Agent branch cleanly off your latest base ref before starting work and tidy up merged local branches afterward.

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git branch 查看、创建或删除分支
运行 git switch 或 git checkout 切换分支
workflowEn: Run git branch through ExecCommand to list, create, or delete branches
Run git switch or git checkout to change branches

items.titleZh: 从远端仓库拉取更新（Pull）并将本地提交推送到远端（Push）
items.titleEn: Pull upstream updates and push local commits to remotes with force-push protection
items.descriptionZh: 仅在你明确要求推送到远端时才会执行 `git push`，且 `--force` 等高风险覆盖动作默认会被拦截或要求你显式确认。
items.descriptionEn: Runs `git push` only when you ask to push, keeping force-pushes and history rewrites blocked or explicitly confirmed.

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git pull 或 git push 同步远端
强制推送等高风险参数仍会被拦截或要求确认
workflowEn: Run git pull or git push through ExecCommand to synchronize remotes
High-risk arguments such as force push remain blocked or require confirmation

items.titleZh: 跨分支挑选合并指定提交（Cherry-pick），并支持冲突后继续或安全中止
items.titleEn: Start, continue, or cleanly abort a Git cherry-pick across branches
items.descriptionZh: 精准把其他分支上的修复提交移植过来；如果出现代码冲突，智能体可帮你定位冲突块并在修好后 `--continue`，或随时 `--abort` 恢复原状。
items.descriptionEn: Backport or port individual commits cleanly across branches, with guided conflict resolution via `--continue` or instant rollback via `--abort`.

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git cherry-pick
使用 --continue 或 --abort 继续或中止流程
workflowEn: Run git cherry-pick through ExecCommand
Use --continue or --abort to continue or cancel the operation

items.titleZh: 检索提交历史与演进脉络，快速定位引入回归问题的提交（git log / blame）
items.titleEn: Explore commit history and graphs to pinpoint when a behavior or regression was introduced
items.descriptionZh: 遇到「上周还好好的怎么突然坏了」，直接让智能体结合提交历史与变更记录顺藤摸瓜找出关键提交。
items.descriptionEn: Ask the Agent to trace recent commits and history graphs whenever you need to find exactly which change altered behavior.

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git log 或 git show 读取提交图谱与历史
界面的最近访问记录仍由 Git 场景保存；智能体读取历史不会伪装成修改该 UI 状态
workflowEn: Run git log or git show through ExecCommand to inspect the commit graph and history
Recent-history UI state remains owned by the Git surface; reading history does not pretend to mutate that presentation state

items.titleZh: 解析任意分支、Tag 或 Commit SHA，直接对比或读取历史版本中的文件内容
items.titleEn: Resolve any branch, tag, or commit SHA and read historical file contents without checking out
items.descriptionZh: 不必切换当前工作分支，就能直接查看某个旧标签或主干提交里的文件原文进行比对参考。
items.descriptionEn: Read or diff a file from `main`, a release tag, or an older commit SHA without disturbing your current working tree.

workflowZh: 通过 ExecCommand 运行 git show
解析 revision 并读取指定提交中的对象或文件内容
workflowEn: Run git show through ExecCommand
Resolve a revision and inspect objects or file content from a selected commit

stepsZh: 在项目会话中直接告诉智能体你的 Git 诉求（如「看看当前改了哪些文件」「基于 main 切一个修复分支」），或在内置终端 / CLI 中输入 `/diff` 查看变更
想同时跑两个互不干扰的任务时，为新会话启用 Worktree 隔离（可在侧边栏会话筛选器中按「主工作区 / 工作树会话」分类查看）
开发完成后，点击会话改动条逐文件审阅 Diff，再让智能体按仓库风格拟定提交信息并完成本地 Commit
确认无误后再明确指令智能体执行 `git push` 或使用 `commit-push-pr` 技能一气呵成发起 PR
stepsEn: Tell the Agent in chat what you want to do in Git ("Show unstaged changes", "Create a fix branch off main"), or run `/diff` in the CLI
When running parallel tasks on one repo, create a Worktree-isolated session (and filter Main vs. Worktree sessions anytime in the sidebar view menu)
Review per-file diffs in the session’s modified-files bar, then ask the Agent to draft a commit message and create the commit
Once satisfied, explicitly ask the Agent to push or invoke the built-in `commit-push-pr` Skill to open a pull request
agentExamplesZh: 看看当前仓库有哪些未提交的改动，帮我把日志调试代码剔除后整理一次干净提交
帮我把 commit a1b2c3d cherry-pick 到当前分支，如果有冲突先列给我看
查一下最近两周是谁、在哪次提交里改了 token 刷新的超时逻辑
agentExamplesEn: Check git status and diff, strip any leftover debug logs, and stage a clean commit with a descriptive message
Cherry-pick commit a1b2c3d onto my current branch and walk me through any conflicts
Search recent git history to find which commit changed the token refresh timeout logic
tipsZh: 默认情况下智能体绝不会未经允许自动 `git push` 或使用 `--force` 改写远端历史，你可以放心让它在本地整理分支与提交。
想定制新 Worktree 根目录、分支前缀、保留上限、「默认复制本地改动」（把未提交改动与暂存状态一并带入新工作树）或「Git 提交署名（Co-authored-by）」，可前往「设置 → 编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git」；编码或提交后的快捷动作则在「设置 → 工具与集成 → 自动化」中管理。
在 Peer 对端设备模式下，「信任仓库（`git_trust_repository`）」属于本机操作员级别的安全决定，必须由目标机器本机确认。
tipsEn: Agents never push to remotes or run destructive `--force` / `--hard` commands unless you explicitly ask and approve.

Configure your Worktree root path, branch prefix, retention limit, Copy local changes by default (carries uncommitted workspace changes and staged state into new worktrees), and Git Co-authored-by attribution in Settings → Programming & Development → Workspace & Git; post-coding and commit Quick Actions live under Settings → Tools & Integrations → Automation.
Repository trust (`git_trust_repository`) is an operator-local safety gate on the host machine and is never silently bypassed by remote controllers.

capabilities.titleZh: 深度代码评审（Deep Review）与 Pull Request
capabilities.summaryZh: 一站读取 GitHub / GitLab / GitCode / Gitee 的 PR 改动、关联 Issue 与失败的 CI 运行日志，并可调度多角色评审团队对本地修改、指定提交或远端 PR 进行严格结构化审查。
capabilities.summaryEn: Load pull request diffs, linked issues, and failing CI logs from GitHub, GitLab, GitCode, or Gitee — and launch multi-agent Deep Review against local edits, commits, or PRs.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 在 AI 会话中直接发起评审或贴入 PR 编号/链接；评审并发容量可在「设置 → 模型与智能体 → 执行与协作」调整
capabilities.entryPathEn: Ask for a review or paste a PR number/URL in any AI session; tune review concurrency in Settings → Models & Agents → Execution & Collaboration
highlightsZh: 原生对接 GitHub（复用本机 `gh` 登录）、GitLab、GitCode 与 Gitee，直接拉取 PR 详情与代码变更
CI 挂了不用来回切网页翻几千行构建输出：直接读取对应 CI 任务日志精准定位报错根因
一键发起多智能体「Deep Review（严格审查）」，由多个评审工种分头挑刺再经质量门过滤误报，输出可定位的结构化问题单
写代码收尾时自动比对变更上下文，生成清晰达意的提交说明与 PR 概要
highlightsEn: Works natively with GitHub (reusing local `gh` CLI auth), GitLab, GitCode, and Gitee to read PR diffs and discussions
Pull failing CI job logs straight into your session to diagnose broken builds without hunting through web logs
Run multi-agent Deep Review against uncommitted changes, a commit, or a PR — complete with quality-gate filtering to cut false positives
Generate clean commit messages and PR summaries grounded in your actual diff and linked issue context
scenariosZh: 准备提 PR 前心里没底，怕漏掉边界条件或并发竞态：在对话里说一句「对当前分支改动做一次 Deep Review」，专门的审查智能体团队会逐模块深挖潜在 Bug 并按严重度列给你。
队友发来一个大 PR 请你帮忙把关，或者你自己的 PR 远端 CI 红了：直接说「帮我看看 PR #128 的改动重点和挂掉的 CI 日志」，智能体会拉取分页详情与失败日志给出修复建议。
首次在 GitHub 私有仓看 PR 还没登录 `gh`？界面支持一键唤起终端会话引导完成与当前仓库域名匹配的 `gh auth login`（含 GitHub Enterprise 域名），而 GitLab、GitCode 与 Gitee 则可独立保存本机访问令牌。
scenariosEn: About to open a big PR and want a second pair of eyes? Ask for a Deep Review on your working tree or branch so specialist review agents hunt for race conditions, edge cases, and regressions before teammates see it.
Your PR’s CI check just turned red? Ask the Agent to fetch the PR’s failing CI log, pinpoint the exact assertion or build error, and patch it locally.
Working with GitHub Enterprise or a private repo? GitHub integration aligns `gh` CLI login with your PR’s exact host, while GitLab, GitCode, and Gitee tokens stay safely stored on your machine.

items.titleZh: 针对本地未提交改动、指定 Commit 或远端 PR 发起多角色 Deep Review 结构化审查
items.titleEn: Run multi-agent Deep Review against uncommitted workspace changes, a commit, or a pull request
items.descriptionZh: Deep Review 会派出评审工作组检查正确性、边界条件、架构规范与安全隐患，再通过质量门复核剔除吹毛求疵的噪音，汇总成清晰可操作的问题清单。
items.descriptionEn: Dispatches specialist review workers to check correctness, edge cases, architecture boundaries, and security, then filters findings through a quality gate into actionable issues.

workflowZh: 用 LaunchReviewAgent 按已确认的工作区、提交或 PR 目标启动专门评审智能体，并等待其发现
评审智能体用 submit_code_review 提交结构化问题；队列管理和人工查看仍可打开 Deep Review 场景
workflowEn: Launch a specialist review agent with LaunchReviewAgent for the confirmed workspace, commit, or PR target and wait for findings
Review agents submit structured findings with submit_code_review; queue management and human inspection remain available in the Deep Review surface

items.titleZh: 分页读取 Pull Request / Merge Request 的描述、评论讨论与关联代码改动
items.titleEn: Read pull-request descriptions, review threads, and paged file changes directly in context
items.descriptionZh: 即使面对包含上百个文件的大号 PR，也会按页有序读取概览与关键改动，不会一次性撑爆模型上下文窗口。
items.descriptionEn: Loads PR overviews, review comments, and file diffs in clean pages so even large pull requests stay fast and within context budgets.

workflowZh: 若 ReviewPlatform 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载其动作契约
调用 get_pull_request 或 get_pull_request_detail_page 读取 PR 概览、分页详情与改动
workflowEn: If ReviewPlatform is deferred, load its action contract with GetToolSpec first
Call get_pull_request or get_pull_request_detail_page to inspect PR overview, paged detail, and changes

items.titleZh: 一键拉取 PR 失败或运行中的 CI 任务日志，快速定位构建与测试报错
items.titleEn: Fetch CI run logs for a pull request to pinpoint build, lint, or test failures
items.descriptionZh: 智能体会先列出该 PR 下的各项 CI 检查状态，再只拉取失败那一项的日志正文，迅速帮你复现并修好问题。
items.descriptionEn: Lists check statuses on the PR first, then fetches the specific failing job log so the Agent can reproduce and fix the root cause.

workflowZh: 若 ReviewPlatform 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载其动作契约
先读取 PR/CI 条目，再用 get_pull_request_ci_log 获取对应运行日志
workflowEn: If ReviewPlatform is deferred, load its action contract with GetToolSpec first
Read the PR/CI entries first, then use get_pull_request_ci_log for the selected run log

items.titleZh: 自动识别当前仓库的 Git 远端地址、分支快照与对应的评审平台目标
items.titleEn: Detect the active repository’s remotes, branch snapshot, and matching review-platform target automatically
items.descriptionZh: 不用每次手贴完整仓库 URL，只要当前分支已经关联了远端仓库，就能自动匹配对应的 GitHub、GitLab、GitCode 或 Gitee 项目。
items.descriptionEn: Resolves your current checkout’s `origin`/`upstream` remotes and branch automatically so you can refer to PRs by number.

workflowZh: 若 ReviewPlatform 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载其动作契约
调用 get_workspace_snapshot 或 list_remotes 读取当前仓库、远端与评审目标
workflowEn: If ReviewPlatform is deferred, load its action contract with GetToolSpec first
Call get_workspace_snapshot or list_remotes to load the current repository, remotes, and review target

items.titleZh: 读取关联 Issue 的需求背景、验收标准与讨论上下文
items.titleEn: Load linked Issue titles, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and discussion context
items.descriptionZh: 评审代码是否「漏实现了需求」时，可结合关联 Issue 原文逐项核对，确保代码实现与最初诉求严丝合缝。
items.descriptionEn: Cross-check code changes against the original Issue description and acceptance criteria to catch missing requirements early.

control.reasonZh: 「读取关联 Issue 的需求背景、验收标准与讨论上下文」与评审面板中选定的仓库及 Issue 编号联动，可在查看 PR 与评审详情时一并展开核对。
control.reasonEn: “Load linked Issue titles, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and discussion context” connects to the selected repository and issue reference inside your review workflow.

items.titleZh: 对接本机 GitHub CLI（`gh`）登录态，或安全保存/清除 GitLab、GitCode 与 Gitee 访问令牌
items.titleEn: Reuse local GitHub CLI (`gh`) login or securely store and clear GitLab, GitCode, and Gitee access tokens
items.descriptionZh: GitHub 仓库优先直接复用你本机已登录的 `gh` 凭据（需要时还会贴心打开终端引导对应域名的 `gh auth login`）；GitLab、GitCode 与 Gitee 则支持单独保存和随时清除私有访问令牌。
items.descriptionEn: GitHub repositories reuse your local `gh` CLI authentication (and can open a terminal session for host-matched `gh auth login`), while GitLab, GitCode, and Gitee support dedicated token management.

workflowZh: 若 ReviewPlatform 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载其动作契约
GitHub 使用本机 gh 登录；仅在用户明确提供时，才用 update_auth_token/clear_auth_token 管理 GitLab、GitCode 或 Gitee 凭据
workflowEn: If ReviewPlatform is deferred, load its action contract with GetToolSpec first
GitHub uses local gh authentication; only use update_auth_token/clear_auth_token for GitLab, GitCode, or Gitee when the user explicitly provides or clears credentials

items.titleZh: 一键预览、生成或快速填充贴合改动的提交信息
items.titleEn: Preview, generate, or quick-fill commit messages tailored to your staged changes
items.descriptionZh: 修复完评审指出的问题后，可快速生成符合规范的修复提交说明，保持分支提交历史清晰易读。
items.descriptionEn: After addressing review findings, generate a concise, conventional commit message in one click.

control.reasonZh: 「一键预览、生成或快速填充贴合改动的提交信息」需要结合当前工作区暂存改动并在提交输入框中由你过目确认或微调文案。
control.reasonEn: “Preview, generate, or quick-fill commit messages tailored to your staged changes” drafts a commit message from your current changes so you can review and tweak the wording before committing.

stepsZh: 若使用 GitHub 仓库，先确保本机已安装并登录 `gh`（未登录时可按界面提示一键打开终端完成 `gh auth login`）；GitLab / GitCode / Gitee 准备好访问令牌即可
评审本地代码：在会话中直接说「对当前未提交改动发起 Deep Review」或指定某个 Commit
评审或排查远端 PR：直接发送 PR 编号或链接（如「查看 PR #42 的失败 CI 日志并修复」）
逐条查看结构化评审结论，点击问题定位到对应代码行，或让智能体直接按评审意见完成修复与复测
stepsEn: For GitHub repos, ensure `gh` CLI is signed in (or use the one-click terminal prompt for `gh auth login`); for GitLab, GitCode, or Gitee, provide an access token when prompted
To review local work: ask in chat to "Run Deep Review on my current uncommitted changes" (or name a specific commit)
To inspect or fix a PR: mention the PR number or URL (e.g., "Check why CI failed on PR #42 and fix the root cause")
Walk through the consolidated findings by severity, jump to files, or ask the Agent to apply fixes and re-verify
agentExamplesZh: 对当前分支相对于 main 的全部改动做一次严格的 Deep Review
帮我看看当前分支关联的 PR 为什么 CI 挂了，把报错原因和修复方案列出来
阅读 PR #86 的改动和关联 Issue，检查有没有遗漏边界情况
agentExamplesEn: Run a thorough Deep Review on all changes in my current branch against main
Check why CI failed on the PR for this branch and propose a fix
Read PR #86 and its linked issue to verify whether any edge cases were missed
tipsZh: 想控制同时可以跑多少个评审任务，可在「设置 → 模型与智能体 → 执行与协作」中调整审核容量上限。
内置的 `commit-push-pr` 技能可以把「检查改动 → 生成提交信息 → 推送分支 → 创建 PR 描述」串成丝滑的一步操作，日常提 PR 强烈推荐试试。
注意：CLI 无界面交付模式默认不加载桌面端的 Deep Review 专属智能体团队，完整多角色 Deep Review 建议在桌面端会话中使用。
tipsEn: Adjust how many review tasks can run concurrently in Settings → Models & Agents → Execution & Collaboration.
Try the built-in `commit-push-pr` Skill when you want a smooth one-prompt flow from clean local edits to a well-written pull request.
Full multi-agent Deep Review is designed for Desktop sessions; lightweight CLI runs still support standard `ReviewPlatform` PR/CI inspection.

capabilities.titleZh: 内置浏览器与网页元素拾取
capabilities.summaryZh: 在会话旁并排预览本地开发服务与文档网页：点一下「元素选择器」就能把页面上的 DOM 节点抓进聊天框改样式，也能让智能体直接在页面上点击、填表、滚动和截图验证。
capabilities.summaryEn: Preview local dev servers and web pages right beside your chat: click any DOM node with the Element Picker to send its exact selector and HTML into your prompt, or let the agent click, fill forms, scroll, and capture screenshots.
capabilities.entryPathZh: 按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索「打开浏览器」（会话激活时自动在右侧辅助分栏打开，其他时候作为独立场景打开）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and choose Open browser (opens in the split pane beside an active session, or as a standalone scene)
capabilities.shortcut: ⌘K → 打开浏览器 · Esc（退出拾取）
highlightsZh: 前端开发神器：左边对话改代码，右边实时预览 `localhost` 页面，无需在两个软件间频繁切屏
点开「元素选择器」悬停点击页面上任意按钮或卡片，自动把它的标签、CSS 路径与 HTML 塞进当前输入框上下文
智能体可读页面、点按钮、填表单、滚屏与截图自测 UI，与外部 Chrome/Edge（CDP）共用同一套动作契约
需要复用你平时浏览器里已登录的账号 Cookie 时，可无缝切换到设置中已授权连接的外部浏览器操作
highlightsEn: Frontend superpower: keep `localhost` live beside your chat so you never have to alt-tab while tweaking UI
Use the Element Picker to click any component on the page and drop its exact CSS path, attributes, and HTML straight into your prompt
Let the Agent snapshot, click, fill forms, scroll, and verify UI changes — sharing one BrowserActions contract with external CDP browsers
Need your signed-in cookies? Seamlessly target the external Chrome/Edge browser you authorized in Settings
scenariosZh: 页面上某个间距歪了或按钮颜色不对，但你不知道它叫什么组件名：点一下内置浏览器工具栏的「元素选择器」，在那个按钮上点一下，它的完整 CSS 路径和 HTML 就自动挂进了聊天框，直接说「把这个按钮改成圆角主色」就搞定！
刚让智能体写完一个注册表单，想验证交互逻辑通不通：直接说「在内置浏览器打开 `http://localhost:3000/signup`，填一组测试数据提交看看有没有报错」。
连接了 SSH 远程工作区并在服务器上跑起了 Web 服务：先让智能体把远端监听端口转发回本地（PortForward），再在内置浏览器里实时预览与调试。
scenariosEn: Spotted a misaligned card on localhost but don’t know which component owns it? Click the Element Picker icon, click the card on the page, and tell the Agent "Add 16px padding and fix the hover border on this element."
Just built a multi-step checkout form? Ask the Agent to open `http://localhost:3000` in the built-in browser, fill out the fields, click submit, and verify the confirmation state.
Need to automate a site where you are already logged in? Connect your external Chrome/Edge browser in Settings → Browser & Desktop Control instead of re-entering credentials.

items.titleZh: 输入完整网址、本地域名或开发服务端口并在 OpenBitFun 内打开
items.titleEn: Open full URLs, local hostnames, or development-service ports inside OpenBitFun
items.descriptionZh: 支持直接输入 `localhost:5173`、局域网预览地址、外部文档链接，或直接预览工作区内的本地 HTML 文件。
items.descriptionEn: Enter `localhost:5173`, LAN preview hosts, public documentation URLs, or open local HTML files right inside OpenBitFun.

items.titleZh: 既可作为独立浏览器场景，也可在会话旁的辅助面板中打开
items.titleEn: Use the browser as a standalone scene or an auxiliary panel beside a session
items.descriptionZh: 当你在会话中呼出浏览器时，它会自动停靠在对话旁边的分栏里，方便边聊边看实时渲染效果；也可拖拽到顶部成为独立场景标签。
items.descriptionEn: Opens automatically in the split pane beside an active chat for side-by-side UI iteration, or runs as a full-width scene tab.

items.titleZh: 启动元素选择器，悬停时高亮页面元素并显示标签、ID 和 Class
items.titleEn: Start the element picker to highlight hovered elements and show tag, ID, and class details
items.descriptionZh: 点击浏览器地址栏旁的拾取按钮进入指哪打哪模式，鼠标移过之处会实时浮现半透明蓝色高亮框与节点标签信息。
items.descriptionEn: Click the inspector button in the browser toolbar to hover over live DOM nodes with a blue highlight overlay showing tag, ID, and class names.

items.titleZh: 点击元素后捕获 CSS 路径、属性、文本和 HTML，并加入当前会话上下文
items.titleEn: Click an element to capture its CSS path, attributes, text, and HTML into the current session context
items.descriptionZh: 点选目标元素后无需手动复制粘贴选择器，节点特征会自动变成上下文标签插入你正在编写的聊天草稿中。
items.descriptionEn: Clicking a highlighted element automatically inserts a structured context chip with its CSS selector, attributes, text, and outerHTML into your chat composer.
evidence: source:src/web-ui/src/app/scenes/browser/browserInspectorScript.ts#On click, captures: tagName, CSS path, attributes, textContent, outerHTML

items.titleZh: 再次点击选择按钮或按 Esc 取消元素选择并清理高亮
items.titleEn: Click the picker again or press Escape to cancel selection and remove overlays
items.descriptionZh: 不想选了随时按一下 Esc 或再点一次拾取图标，页面立即恢复正常点击与滚动交互。
items.descriptionEn: Press Escape or click the picker button again anytime to clear highlight overlays and return to normal page interaction.

items.titleZh: 让智能体对内置网页执行快照、读取、点击、悬停、填写、按键、滚动、等待、脚本求值和截图
items.titleEn: Let an agent snapshot, read, click, hover, fill, press keys, scroll, wait, evaluate scripts, and capture the built-in page
items.descriptionZh: 智能体可以先观察页面结构拿到精确的元素引用，再模拟真实用户操作走完端到端流程并截图验收。
items.descriptionEn: Agents inspect structured page snapshots, interact with current element refs, run scripts, and capture screenshots to verify end-to-end UI flows.

workflowZh: 普通页面操作直接用 ControlHub；匹配内置常见流程时可先让 Playbook 返回已解析步骤，再逐步交给 ControlHub 执行
每次页面变化后重新快照并使用最新元素引用；Playbook 只是步骤指南，不能把尚未执行的步骤报告为完成
workflowEn: Use ControlHub directly for normal page actions; for a matching built-in common flow, resolve steps with Playbook and execute each through ControlHub
Take a fresh snapshot after page changes and use current element refs; Playbook is only a step guide and unexecuted steps must never be reported as complete

items.titleZh: 让智能体搜索公开网页并按需抓取指定页面正文用于技术查证
items.titleEn: Let an agent search the web and fetch clean article text on demand for fast research
items.descriptionZh: 只需查公开 API 文档或报错信息时，智能体会用轻量的网页搜索与正文抓取快速核实，不必每次大动干戈拉起可视浏览器。
items.descriptionEn: When checking public docs or error messages that don’t need clicks or login state, the Agent uses fast WebSearch + WebFetch instead of spinning up a browser window.

workflowZh: 先用 WebSearch 找到候选来源并保留标题与 URL，再只对需要核实的页面调用 WebFetch
需要登录态、点击或填写时改用 ControlHub 控制内置/外部浏览器；不要把文本抓取当成交互浏览
workflowEn: Use WebSearch to find candidate sources and retain their titles and URLs, then call WebFetch only for pages that need verification
Switch to ControlHub for authenticated, click, or form workflows; do not treat text fetching as interactive browsing

items.titleZh: 使用后退、前进和地址栏顺畅浏览页面访问历史
items.titleEn: Navigate page history with Back, Forward, and the address bar
items.descriptionZh: 具备熟悉的浏览器前进、后退与地址输入体验，方便在多级路由页面间来回验证。
items.descriptionEn: Move back and forth across client-side and multi-page routes with standard address-bar and history controls.

items.titleZh: 一键刷新页面，并实时同步当前 URL、加载进度与错误提示
items.titleEn: Reload pages and synchronize the live URL, loading state, and error feedback
items.descriptionZh: 当开发服务器还没启动完成或端口填错时，会给出清晰的加载状态与错误反馈，改好后点刷新即可重连。
items.descriptionEn: Surfaces clear loading indicators and connection errors while dev servers boot up, with one-click reload when ready.

items.titleZh: 内置 WebView 与外部 CDP 浏览器共用同一套 BrowserActions 参数、元素引用、结果与错误契约
items.titleEn: Use one BrowserActions parameter, element-ref, result, and error contract across the built-in WebView and external CDP browsers
items.descriptionZh: 无论目标选内置浏览器还是你本机的外部 Chrome/Edge，智能体的操作方式完全一致，行为稳定可预期。
items.descriptionEn: Whether targeting the built-in WebView or an external Chrome/Edge instance over CDP, the Agent uses the exact same action semantics and error reporting.

items.titleZh: 通过 target 选择内置或外部浏览器，并用 session_id、URL 或标题精确定位页面
items.titleEn: Choose the built-in or external browser with target and locate a page by session_id, URL, or title
items.descriptionZh: 同时开了多个预览标签也不怕点错窗口：智能体会按会话 ID、网址或页面标题精准锁定你要操作的那一页。
items.descriptionEn: Targets the exact open tab you mean by session ID, URL, or page title so automation never clicks into the wrong browser tab.

items.titleZh: 桌面端采用独立原生 WebView 渲染，Web 端回退受限 iframe，并在当前页接管新窗口链接
items.titleEn: Render with a native WebView on desktop and a sandboxed iframe on web, opening new-window links cleanly in place
items.descriptionZh: 桌面端原生 WebView 不受普通网页跨域 iframe 拦截限制；页面内带有 `target="_blank"` 的跳转也会自动留在当前面板打开，不会乱弹外部窗口。
items.descriptionEn: Desktop uses a native WebView (avoiding typical X-Frame-Options blocks) and intercepts `target="_blank"` links so navigation stays neatly inside your panel.

stepsZh: 在打开会话的状态下按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索「打开浏览器」（或直接对智能体说「在内置浏览器打开 http://localhost:3000」）
在右侧浏览器面板输入本地开发地址或网页 URL 预览画面
想修改页面某处细节时，点击地址栏旁的「元素选择器」图标，再点击页面上的目标元素，把选择器上下文带入聊天框
描述你想修改的样式或交互，或者直接让智能体替你在页面上点击、填表并截图验证改动效果
stepsEn: With a session open, press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and select Open browser (or simply ask the Agent to "Open http://localhost:3000 in the built-in browser")
Enter your local dev server port or webpage URL in the address bar beside your chat
To tweak a specific UI element, click the Element Picker icon in the browser toolbar and click the target element on the page to attach its context chip
Tell the Agent how to restyle or fix it — or ask the Agent to click through, fill forms, and verify the updated page automatically

workflowZh: 用户给出网址时，用 browser.navigate（target=builtin）直接打开，缺少页面时自动创建；需要读取或交互时附带 observe=article 或 snapshot，并复用返回的 session_id；用户只要求显示内置浏览器且没有网址时，改用 OpenBitFunControl 打开 feature.browser 能力根入口，不得臆造 about:blank
对同一个 session_id 指定 target 为 builtin；选择已打开页面时，用 browser.connect 和唯一匹配的 target_url 或 target_title；快照、点击、填写、滚动和截图等动作与外部 CDP 浏览器共用同一套契约
复用 navigate 返回的观察结果，只在下一步需要新页面状态时重新快照；涉及用户账号登录态时，优先使用用户在设置中已授权连接的 external 浏览器，未授权时请用户连接，不得自行开启权限；CDP 协议扩展同样需要可用的外接连接
workflowEn: When the user supplies a URL, use browser.navigate with target=builtin (creates a page when needed), add observe=article or snapshot for reading/interaction, and keep the returned session_id; when they only want the built-in browser surface, open the feature.browser capability root with OpenBitFunControl and never invent about:blank
Address that session_id with target set to builtin; to select an existing page, use browser.connect with a unique target_url or target_title match. Portable actions share the external CDP contract

Reuse the observation returned by navigate; refresh only when the next decision needs new page state. For account/login-dependent work, prefer the external browser the user authorized in Settings; if unavailable, ask the user to connect it and never enable permissions yourself. CDP extensions also require an available external connection

agentExamplesZh: 在内置浏览器打开 http://localhost:5173，帮我测一下登录表单空提交时的错误提示对不对
读取当前内置浏览器打开的文档页面，帮我总结核心配置参数
我刚用元素选择器选中了顶栏按钮，帮我把它的内边距调紧凑一点并在深色模式下加深边框对比度
agentExamplesEn: Open http://localhost:5173 in the built-in browser and test whether submitting an empty sign-in form shows validation errors
Read the documentation page currently open in the built-in browser and summarize the required config fields
Using the navbar button I just picked with the element picker, tighten its padding and improve its dark-mode border contrast
tipsZh: 想更改聊天消息里点击普通网页链接时的默认打开方式（用「内置浏览器」打开还是跳去「系统默认浏览器」），可前往「设置 → 工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制」。
涉及需要登录企业内网 SSO 或第三方账号的网页自动化时，不必在内置浏览器里重新登录——去「设置 → 工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制」连接你平时已登录的 Chrome / Edge 浏览器最省事。
如果开发服务跑在 SSH 远程服务器上，记得先让智能体用端口转发（PortForward）把远端端口映射到本地，再用内置浏览器访问。
tipsEn: Prefer links clicked in chat to open in your system browser instead of the built-in browser (or vice versa)? Toggle link behavior in Settings → Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control.
Working with pages behind corporate SSO or personal logins? Connect your everyday Chrome or Edge browser in Browser & Desktop Control settings so the Agent reuses your authorized session.
If your dev server is running inside an SSH remote workspace, ask the Agent to forward the remote port first (`PortForward`), then preview it locally in the built-in browser.

capabilities.summaryZh: 让智能体连接你平时用的 Chrome / Edge 等外部浏览器（直接复用已登录的网页账号），或在你的明确授权下共享指定应用窗口与桌面画面，完成截图观察、点击、输入和滚动操作，并提供实时预览卡片与一键急停。
capabilities.summaryEn: Let agents connect to your everyday Chrome or Edge browser (reusing signed-in web sessions) or, with explicit authorization, share a specific App window or screen to inspect, click, type, and scroll—complete with a live preview card and instant stop.
highlightsZh: 一键探测并连接 Chrome / Edge 等外部 CDP 浏览器，无缝复用你的已登录网页状态
引导检查并跳转系统「辅助功能」与「屏幕录制」隐私权限，状态透明清晰
支持只共享单个 App 窗口而非整块屏幕，先选窗口再授权输入，安全可控
会话内展示实时控制预览卡片与虚拟指针位置，随时一键停止并释放控制权
highlightsEn: Discover and connect Chrome, Edge, and other CDP browsers to work with already signed-in web apps
Check OS Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions clearly and jump straight to system settings
Share a single application window instead of your whole screen, granting view and input separately
Watch a live authorized preview card with virtual pointer feedback in chat, and stop control anytime in one click

items.titleZh: 一键检查桌面控制可用性及「辅助功能」「屏幕录制」授权状态
items.titleEn: Check Computer Use availability plus Accessibility and Screen Recording status
items.descriptionZh: 清楚告诉你当前系统环境支持哪些能力、还差哪一项系统权限没开，不用盲目猜为什么点不动。
items.descriptionEn: See immediately whether your OS session supports desktop control and exactly which system permissions are granted or missing.

control.reasonZh: 「一键检查桌面控制可用性及「辅助功能」「屏幕录制」授权状态」会实时读取当前系统的图形会话与隐私授权状态；智能体会为你直接打开「浏览器与桌面控制」设置页核对。
control.reasonEn: "Check Computer Use availability plus Accessibility and Screen Recording status" reads live graphical-session and OS privacy state; the Agent opens Browser & Desktop Control settings so you can review each check.

items.titleZh: 在界面内一键触发桌面控制所需的操作系统权限申请
items.titleEn: Request required operating-system permissions for desktop control
items.descriptionZh: 直接唤起 macOS 等系统的原生授权弹窗，按指引勾选 OpenBitFun（或在 CLI 下勾选所用终端应用）即可。
items.descriptionEn: Trigger the native OS consent prompt directly so you can authorize OpenBitFun without hunting through menus.

control.reasonZh: 「在界面内一键触发桌面控制所需的操作系统权限申请」必须由本机用户在操作系统原生权限弹窗中亲自确认；智能体会打开授权设置入口但绝不能代你越权开启。
control.reasonEn: "Request required operating-system permissions for desktop control" must be confirmed personally in the operating system’s native consent prompt; the Agent opens the setup page and never grants permissions itself.

items.titleZh: 直达系统「隐私与安全性」对应设置面板
items.titleEn: Jump straight to the matching OS Privacy & Security settings pane
items.descriptionZh: 如果之前点过拒绝导致系统不再弹窗，点一下就能精准跳到系统设置的对应权限列表手动勾选。
items.descriptionEn: If an OS prompt was previously dismissed, jump directly to the exact system privacy pane to flip the toggle on.

control.reasonZh: 「直达系统「隐私与安全性」对应设置面板」会唤起操作系统的外部系统设置窗口供你手动勾选开关；智能体会为你打开对应的控制设置页触发跳转。
control.reasonEn: "Jump straight to the matching OS Privacy & Security settings pane" opens your operating system’s external Settings app for manual toggling; the Agent opens the control settings entry so you can launch it.

items.titleZh: 自动发现本机受支持的浏览器并查看实时 CDP 连接状态
items.titleEn: Discover installed supported browsers and inspect live CDP connection status
items.descriptionZh: 自动扫描本机已安装的 Chrome、Edge 等 Chromium 内核浏览器，展示当前是否已就绪连通。
items.descriptionEn: Automatically scan installed Chromium-based browsers such as Chrome and Edge and show whether a live CDP link is active.

control.reasonZh: 「自动发现本机受支持的浏览器并查看实时 CDP 连接状态」依赖实时扫描本机浏览器进程与调试端口状态；智能体会打开设置页展示当前检测到的浏览器列表。
control.reasonEn: "Discover installed supported browsers and inspect live CDP connection status" scans local browser installations and live debugging ports; the Agent opens Browser & Desktop Control settings to display the detected list.

items.titleZh: 启动受控浏览器，或随时连接 / 断开已开启 CDP 的浏览器
items.titleEn: Launch browser control, or connect to and disconnect from a CDP-enabled browser
items.descriptionZh: 要用的时候连上让 AI 协作操作，处理私密事务时随时点「断开」切断智能体访问。
items.descriptionEn: Connect your browser when you want AI assistance, and disconnect in one click whenever you want private manual browsing.

control.reasonZh: 「启动受控浏览器，或随时连接 / 断开已开启 CDP 的浏览器」涉及你日常浏览器的连接授权与会话切换；智能体会为你打开「浏览器与桌面控制」页面由你点击连接或断开。
control.reasonEn: "Launch browser control, or connect to and disconnect from a CDP-enabled browser" controls live access to your personal browser session; the Agent opens Browser & Desktop Control settings so you can connect or disconnect explicitly.

items.titleZh: 一键配置默认 CDP 远程调试参数并按需优雅重启浏览器
items.titleEn: Enable default CDP debugging setup and restart the browser when needed
items.descriptionZh: 不用自己去命令行拼 `--remote-debugging-port` 启动参数，在界面按提示确认即可自动配好并重启生效。
items.descriptionEn: Skip manual `--remote-debugging-port` flags—enable the default CDP setup from the UI and restart your browser cleanly when prompted.

control.reasonZh: 「一键配置默认 CDP 远程调试参数并按需优雅重启浏览器」重启浏览器可能影响你当前打开的网页标签，必须由你在界面确认后执行；智能体会打开对应设置入口。
control.reasonEn: "Enable default CDP debugging setup and restart the browser when needed" restarting your browser affects open tabs and requires your explicit confirmation; the Agent opens the setup panel so you decide when to restart.

items.titleZh: 获权后由智能体完成画面读取、元素定位、点击、输入与滚动
items.titleEn: Let authorized agents capture, locate elements, click, type, and scroll
items.descriptionZh: 授权完成后，智能体会结合最新画面与无障碍树稳健执行点击、填表和快捷键操作；缺权限时会主动停下提示你。
items.descriptionEn: Once authorized, the agent combines fresh captures and accessibility trees to click, type, and scroll reliably—and stops to tell you if permissions are missing.

workflowZh: 先让 ComputerUse 检查当前可用动作和授权；缺少系统权限时明确引导用户授权
授权后使用最新截图或元素定位结果执行点击、输入、滚动和可见界面读取
workflowEn: Ask ComputerUse to inspect available actions and permissions first; surface missing operating-system permissions explicitly
After authorization, use the latest screenshot or element-location result to click, type, scroll, and inspect the visible interface

items.titleZh: 在会话控制卡片中实时查看当前受控目标、模式与授权画面预览
items.titleEn: Watch the current target, control mode, and live capture preview in the session card
items.descriptionZh: 展开聊天流里的控制状态卡片，就能看清 AI 正在看哪个窗口、虚拟鼠标指在哪里，全程透明不黑盒。
items.descriptionEn: Expand the in-chat control status card to see the exact window being shared and where the virtual pointer is acting in real time.

control.reasonZh: 「在会话控制卡片中实时查看当前受控目标、模式与授权画面预览」需要当前存在活动的桌面控制会话并在界面展开控制卡片查看（预览仅限已授权目标与虚拟指针，远程设备不会回退截取控制端本机画面）。
control.reasonEn: "Watch the current target, control mode, and live capture preview in the session card" requires an active control session and expanding the live card in chat (the preview shows only the authorized target and virtual pointer, without local fallback on remote hosts).

items.titleZh: 随时一键停止桌面控制会话并立即释放截图与输入占用
items.titleEn: Stop the active desktop-control session immediately and release all resources
items.descriptionZh: 无论是对 AI 说“停下”还是直接点控制卡片上的停止按钮，都会立刻终止当前接管并释放屏幕捕获资源。
items.descriptionEn: Click Stop on the control card or ask the agent to stop—screen capture and input hooks are released immediately.

workflowZh: 通过 ComputerUse control_status 确认当前会话的目标、所有者与模式；没有活动会话时不要启动新会话
使用 ComputerUse stop_control 释放该工具拥有的会话；用户也可在执行端控制卡片点击停止，按钮只针对显示的会话代次，不停止后来创建的会话
workflowEn: Use ComputerUse control_status to inspect the current target, owner, and mode; do not start a session when none is active

Use ComputerUse stop_control to release the tool-owned session. Users can also stop from the executing Desktop control card; its button addresses the displayed generation rather than a subsequently created session.

items.titleZh: 按单个 App 窗口精细共享，先确认画面再独立授权键鼠控制
items.titleEn: Share an individual App window and grant or revoke input control separately
items.descriptionZh: 不必把整个桌面暴露出来——你可以只选定某一个软件窗口给 AI 看，并随时单独开启或收回输入控制权。
items.descriptionEn: Keep the rest of your desktop private by picking a single application window to share and toggling input permissions independently.

control.reasonZh: 共享窗口及控制模式由用户明确选择；智能体只能请求共享，不能代替用户授权。
control.reasonEn: Window selection and input mode require an explicit user choice; agents can request sharing but cannot grant themselves control.

items.titleZh: 直接在共享预览画面中点击、拖拽、滚动与输入交互
items.titleEn: Click, drag, scroll, and type directly through the authorized shared preview
items.descriptionZh: 在获权预览画面上的交互严格绑定当前共享窗口与坐标版本，不会误点到窗口外的其他软件。
items.descriptionEn: Interactions inside the preview stay strictly bound to the shared window and authorization revision so clicks never stray elsewhere.

control.reasonZh: 预览输入需要用户授权，并绑定共享窗口、图像坐标及授权版本。
control.reasonEn: Preview input requires user authorization and is bound to the shared window, image coordinates and authorization revision.

items.titleZh: 按应用可执行文件与控制模式记住常用授权，或随时撤销记忆
items.titleEn: Remember or revoke control grants per application executable and input mode
items.descriptionZh: 对信任的常测应用勾选记住后更省心；一旦程序文件更新或请求更高控制模式，会自动重新向你确认。
items.descriptionEn: Save time on trusted apps you test repeatedly—if the app binary changes or a different input mode is requested, OpenBitFun asks again automatically.

control.reasonZh: 记住授权只在用户选定并共享同一应用后生效，应用文件或输入模式改变时需要重新授权。
control.reasonEn: Remembered control applies only after the user shares the same application; changed executable contents or input modes require a new grant.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘, / Ctrl+, 打开设置，进入「工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制」
若需操控外部浏览器：在「浏览器控制」区域选择已安装的浏览器，按提示启用默认 CDP 调试端口并连接（必要时按提示重启浏览器）
若需操控桌面或原生应用：开启桌面控制并按引导在系统设置中授予「辅助功能」与「屏幕录制」权限
在会话中发起任务后，选择要共享的 App 窗口与输入模式；执行期间可在聊天控制卡片查看画面预览，或随时点击「停止」收回控制
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control
For external browser automation: pick your installed browser, enable default CDP setup (restarting the browser if prompted), and connect
For desktop/app control: enable Computer Use and grant OS Accessibility and Screen Recording access via the one-click system settings buttons
When an agent requests access in chat, pick the target App window and input mode; monitor the live preview card or click Stop anytime
agentExamplesZh: 打开浏览器与桌面控制设置，我想把 Chrome 连进来
检查一下当前电脑的桌面控制权限是不是都已经配好了
停止当前的桌面控制会话
agentExamplesEn: Open Browser & Desktop Control settings so I can connect Chrome
Check whether Computer Use permissions are ready on this machine
Stop the active desktop control session right now
capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control
scenariosZh: 要在已经登录了企业 SSO、云厂商后台或内部系统的外部 Chrome 里查工单、抓报错或填复杂表单，不用重新导 Cookie
开发桌面端软件或跨软件联调时，把目标应用窗口单独共享给智能体，看着它自动点按验证交互流程
对经常配合测试的本地软件选择「记住授权」，后续同一程序同模式复测无需每次重走繁琐确认
scenariosEn: Automate repetitive form filling or inspect dashboards inside your main Chrome browser where corporate SSO is already signed in
Share just your native desktop app window with the agent so it can click through UI flows and verify visual behavior
Remember control grants for trusted local test apps while automatically re-prompting if the executable or input mode changes
tipsZh: 设置位置更新提示：旧版文档中的「执行控制」已拆分为独立的「工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制」，查找外部浏览器和屏幕权限直接来这里即可。
内置浏览器 vs 外部浏览器：调试本地无需登录的前端页面直接用「内置浏览器」最快；需要复用日常账号 Cookie 时再连接外部浏览器。
远程安全红线：在手机远控或远程 SSH 工作区场景下，绝不会静默截取或操控你手头控制端电脑的屏幕。
tipsEn: Updated settings path: Browser & Desktop Control now has its own dedicated page under Settings → Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control.
Built-in vs External browser: use the Built-in Browser for zero-setup localhost previews, and connect your external CDP browser when you need existing login cookies.
Strict remote safety: remote SSH workspaces and headless hosts never fall back to capturing or controlling your local controller screen.

capabilities.summaryZh: 把领域经验、团队代码规范、排查套路和辅助脚本封装成可复用的 Skill。既能从技能市场一键安装，也能放在项目仓库里随团队共享，或在对话中通过 $、/ 与 @ 随时点名调用。
capabilities.summaryEn: Turn domain know-how, team conventions, debugging playbooks, and helper scripts into reusable Skills—install from the Marketplace, commit project-scoped Skills with your repo, or invoke them on demand with $, /, or @ in chat.
highlightsZh: 内置精选技能（如视觉皮肤设计 openbitfun-skin-designer、PPT 设计、提交与 PR 等）开箱即用
逛技能市场一键安装，或直接导入本地 SKILL.md 文件夹到个人全局或当前项目
支持在对话中输入 $、句中输入 / 或用 @ 菜单直接点名调用指定技能
支持全局开关与按智能体模式（如 Standard、Creative）精细分配可用技能组
highlightsEn: Ships with built-in Skills out of the box (including openbitfun-skin-designer, ppt-design, debug, and commit-push-pr)
Install community Skills from the Marketplace or add local SKILL.md folders at user or project scope
Trigger a Skill directly in chat with $, mid-sentence /, or the @ context menu, or let agents load matching Skills automatically
Toggle Skills globally or tailor which Skills and skill groups each Agent mode can access

items.titleZh: 集中浏览内置、个人全局、当前项目与外部导入的全部已安装 Skills
items.titleEn: Browse built-in, user, project, and imported Skills in one unified catalog
items.descriptionZh: 清晰展示每个技能的来源标签、路径、扫描状态与简介，哪个是全局通用、哪个是当前仓库专属一目了然。
items.descriptionEn: See every Skill’s source badge, location, scan health, and summary in one place so user-wide and repo-specific workflows stay clear.

control.reasonZh: 「集中浏览内置、个人全局、当前项目与外部导入的全部已安装 Skills」支持按来源筛选、搜索与查看扫描诊断详情；智能体会直接为你打开已安装技能目录。
control.reasonEn: "Browse built-in, user, project, and imported Skills in one unified catalog" supports source filtering, live search, and scan-diagnostic inspection; the Agent opens the Installed Skills catalog directly for you.

items.titleZh: 逛 Skill 市场：搜索、分类浏览与刷新社区精选技能
items.titleEn: Explore, search, and refresh community workflows in the Skill Market
items.descriptionZh: 按关键词查找现成的开发、写作、设计与自动化工作流，点击即可预览技能详情与使用说明。
items.descriptionEn: Search by keyword to discover ready-made coding, writing, design, and automation workflows before installing.

control.reasonZh: 「逛 Skill 市场：搜索、分类浏览与刷新社区精选技能」需要你结合任务偏好浏览和挑选合适的市场条目；智能体会为你打开「发现技能」市场视图。
control.reasonEn: "Explore, search, and refresh community workflows in the Skill Market" lets you browse descriptions and pick workflows that match your needs; the Agent opens the Discover Skills marketplace view for you.

items.titleZh: 将市场中的 Skill 一键安装到个人全局或当前项目
items.titleEn: Install a Marketplace Skill to your user profile or active project
items.descriptionZh: 通用效率技能装到「用户级」所有项目都能用；团队协作规范装到「项目级」方便随 Git 提交共享。
items.descriptionEn: Install personal productivity Skills at user scope for every workspace, or at project scope to share with teammates in Git.

control.reasonZh: 「将市场中的 Skill 一键安装到个人全局或当前项目」需要你确认安装目标（个人全局还是当前项目工作区）；智能体会打开市场入口交由你一键确认安装。
control.reasonEn: "Install a Marketplace Skill to your user profile or active project" requires choosing whether to install at user scope or into the current project; the Agent opens the market listing so you can confirm.

items.titleZh: 校验本地文件夹（含 SKILL.md）并添加为个人或项目 Skill
items.titleEn: Validate a local SKILL.md folder and add it at user or project scope
items.descriptionZh: 自己动手写新技能时，导入前会自动检查目录结构与 Frontmatter 格式，有问题当场给出清晰提示。
items.descriptionEn: Authoring your own Skill? OpenBitFun validates the folder and SKILL.md frontmatter before linking it to your user or project catalog.

control.reasonZh: 「校验本地文件夹（含 SKILL.md）并添加为个人或项目 Skill」需要选择本地技能目录、查看校验反馈并选定作用范围；智能体会打开添加技能向导供你完成操作。
control.reasonEn: "Validate a local SKILL.md folder and add it at user or project scope" requires picking a folder, reviewing validation results, and choosing user or project scope; the Agent opens the Add Skill dialog for you.

items.titleZh: 安全移除不再需要的个人级或项目级已安装 Skill
items.titleEn: Remove an installed user-level or project-level Skill safely
items.descriptionZh: 清理过时或测试用的自定义技能（内置系统技能受保护不会被误删），操作前有明确确认提示。
items.descriptionEn: Clean up outdated user or project Skills with explicit confirmation while built-in Skills remain protected.

control.reasonZh: 「安全移除不再需要的个人级或项目级已安装 Skill」属于删除操作，需要你在技能列表中核对来源并二次确认，防止误删项目共享技能。
control.reasonEn: "Remove an installed user-level or project-level Skill safely" is a destructive action that requires verifying the Skill’s scope and confirming deletion in the catalog.

items.titleZh: 在全局一键启用或暂时停用某个 Skill，无需卸载
items.titleEn: Enable or temporarily disable any Skill globally without uninstalling it
items.descriptionZh: 某个技能暂时不用但以后还想保留？关掉开关即可对所有新轮次隐藏，随时再点一下就能恢复。
items.descriptionEn: Keep a Skill installed on disk while hiding it from agents until you need it again.

control.reasonZh: 「在全局一键启用或暂时停用某个 Skill，无需卸载」依赖你查看当前技能列表状态并选择要切换的具体条目；智能体会打开技能管理页供你直接点按开关。
control.reasonEn: "Enable or temporarily disable any Skill globally without uninstalling it" depends on inspecting your installed list and toggling the target entry; the Agent opens the Skills page so you can flip the switch.

items.titleZh: 按智能体模式（如 Standard、Creative）定制可用 Skill 组合并支持恢复默认
items.titleEn: Customize which Skills and skill groups each Agent mode can use, with one-click reset
items.descriptionZh: 给编码模式配齐调试与重构技能，给写作模式只留文档与排版技能，职责清爽不串味，改乱了随时一键恢复默认。
items.descriptionEn: Give coding modes debugging and Git Skills while keeping writing or minimal modes focused—and restore defaults anytime.

control.reasonZh: 「按智能体模式（如 Standard、Creative）定制可用 Skill 组合并支持恢复默认」涉及对比不同模式的技能矩阵与分组勾选；智能体会打开对应配置界面供你精细调整或恢复默认。
control.reasonEn: "Customize which Skills and skill groups each Agent mode can use, with one-click reset" involves picking across mode-specific Skill groups and overrides; the Agent opens the configuration view so you can tune or reset selections.

items.titleZh: 自动按「项目级优先于个人级」处理同名 Skill 并在界面提示遮蔽关系
items.titleEn: Automatically prioritize project Skills over same-named user Skills with clear badges
items.descriptionZh: 当仓库自带了同名技能时，列表会清楚标注哪个版本正在生效、哪个被遮蔽，排查为什么某条规则生效不再靠猜。
items.descriptionEn: When a repo defines a same-named Skill, the catalog badges which version is active and which is shadowed so precedence is never a mystery.

control.reasonZh: 「自动按「项目级优先于个人级」处理同名 Skill 并在界面提示遮蔽关系」用于在界面查看同名技能的来源层级与实际生效版本；智能体会打开技能列表让你直观核对遮蔽详情。
control.reasonEn: "Automatically prioritize project Skills over same-named user Skills with clear badges" surfaces scope precedence and shadowed-item badges directly in the catalog UI; the Agent opens the Skills list so you can inspect them.

items.titleZh: 在会话中由智能体按需自动加载或响应 $ 点名执行可见 Skill
items.titleEn: Load and follow a visible Skill on demand or via $ mention in chat
items.descriptionZh: 触发后智能体会先完整阅读 SKILL.md 及其配套参考文档，再严格按照里面的步骤、脚本和质量红线推进任务。
items.descriptionEn: Once triggered, the agent reads the complete SKILL.md instructions and bundled resources before executing the workflow step by step.

workflowZh: 只有任务匹配且 Skill 对当前智能体可见时才调用 Skill；先读取完整 SKILL.md，再按其约束执行
Skill 的安装、删除和全局启停仍通过 Skills 场景管理，执行工具不会伪装成包管理器
workflowEn: Call Skill only when the task matches and it is visible to the current agent; read the complete SKILL.md before following it
Installation, removal, and global enablement remain owned by the Skills surface; the execution tool does not pretend to be a package manager

stepsZh: 在左侧边栏点击「首页」滑到「技能」区域点击「已安装技能」或「搜索更多技能」（或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索「打开技能」），在「已安装技能」与「技能市场」页签间切换
从市场搜索并下载喜欢的 Skill（可选安装到个人全局或当前项目），或点击「添加技能」选择本地包含 SKILL.md 的目录
按需开启/停用单个 Skill，或在「智能体」管理页按模式配置可见的技能组
在会话中直接描述任务让 AI 自动匹配加载，或输入 $技能名（以及 @ → 技能）显式指定按该技能执行
stepsEn: From Home, click Installed Skills or Find More Skills (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Open skills) to switch between the Installed Skills and Marketplace tabs
Download a Skill from the Market to user or project scope, or click Add Skill to validate and link a local SKILL.md folder
Toggle individual Skills on or off globally, or customize per-mode Skill selection in Agents
Describe your task naturally so the agent loads matching Skills on demand, or type $skill-name (or @ → Skills) in chat to invoke one explicitly
agentExamplesZh: 用 openbitfun-skin-designer 技能参考这张图片帮我设计一套深色视觉皮肤
看看当前项目有哪些可用的 Skills，按发版检查技能帮我过一遍改动
打开技能管理页面，我想去技能市场逛逛
agentExamplesEn: Use the openbitfun-skin-designer Skill to create a dark visual skin inspired by this image
Check which Skills are available in this project and run our release-checklist workflow
Open Skills so I can browse the Skill Market
capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧边栏「首页」→ 已安装技能 / 搜索更多技能，或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K → 打开技能（项目级技能也可在项目旁「项目资源」管理）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Home → Installed Skills / Find More Skills, or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Open skills (project-scoped Skills also live in Project Resources)
scenariosZh: 把团队的 API 命名规范、数据库迁移检查单写成项目级 Skill（放在 .openbitfun/skills），全组同学拉下仓库就能让 AI 按统一标准写代码
想给客户端换一套独特主题？在聊天里调用内置的 openbitfun-skin-designer 技能并附上一张参考图，让 AI 自动生成并校验完整视觉皮肤包
从外部 AI 工具（如 Claude Code、Codex）迁移过来时，把原有技能一键导入并在不同工作模式中按需启用
scenariosEn: Check team API guidelines or release checklists into .openbitfun/skills so everyone on the repo gets consistent AI behavior automatically
Drop a reference artwork into chat and invoke the built-in openbitfun-skin-designer Skill to craft a custom Visual Skin Pack
Install specialized testing or documentation workflows from the Skill Market and scope them only to the modes that need them
tipsZh: 同名技能项目优先：如果当前项目与个人全局安装了同名 Skill，项目内版本会自动覆盖全局版本（列表会清晰标注遮蔽状态），方便单仓定制。
装得多也不费 Token：平时对话上下文只携带可见技能的简短名称与描述，只有真正调用某个 Skill 时才会按需读取完整指南与脚本。
固定到侧边栏：经常开关或调试自写 Skill 的话，可在「设置 → 应用与界面 → 外观 → 左侧导航栏」把「技能」固定到主导航。
tipsEn: Project overrides user scope: when a project defines a Skill with the same name as a user-level Skill, the project version wins automatically and the UI marks the shadowed entry clearly.
Token-friendly by design: idle Skills only expose compact metadata—full SKILL.md instructions load on demand when a task actually uses them.
Pin to sidebar: if you author or switch Skills often, pin Skills or Discover skills in Settings → Application & Interface → Appearance → Left sidebar.

capabilities.summaryZh: 在 OpenBitFun 内逛市场安装现成效率小工具，或用自然语言让智能体直接为你写一个带独立界面、本地持久存储、Node/JS 后台 Worker 和内置 AI 对话能力的小应用——支持草稿实时改版、版本回滚，还能发布分享到市场。
capabilities.summaryEn: Install ready-made tools from the Mini App Market, or ask an agent in plain language to build a lightweight app with its own UI, persistent storage, background Worker, and embedded AI—complete with live customization drafts, version rollback, and market publishing.
highlightsZh: 一句话从零创建或修改小应用，客户端内置编译保存，无需你手动建工程配打包器
逛小应用市场一键安装、更新、收藏与评分，或从本地包直接导入
每个小应用拥有独立标签页、持久存储、按需授权的工作区路径访问与专属 AI 会话
支持定制草稿隔离预览与多版本历史一键回滚，打磨成熟后可提交到市场分享
highlightsEn: Create or update Mini Apps from a plain-language prompt—compiled and saved directly inside OpenBitFun without external build setup
Browse the Mini App Market to install, update, favorite, and rate community apps, or import local packages
Run each app in its own tab with isolated storage, explicit path/workspace permissions, background workers, and embedded AI calls
Customize safely in isolated drafts, roll back to any prior version, and submit polished apps to the Market

items.titleZh: 列出、查看源码、直接创建、增量更新或删除已安装小应用
items.titleEn: List, inspect source, create, update, or delete installed Mini Apps
items.descriptionZh: 既能在应用库可视化管理、从本地目录导入，也能在聊天里直接让 AI 创建新应用或无损升级已有应用。
items.descriptionEn: Manage apps visually or let the agent list, inspect, compile, patch, and remove installed Mini Apps directly.

items.titleZh: 浏览小应用市场、查看应用详情与包信息，一键安装或升级版本
items.titleEn: Browse the Mini App Market, inspect listings, and install or update releases
items.descriptionZh: 探索社区分享的各类效率与创意应用，查看截图、权限说明与更新日志，有新版本时一键升级。
items.descriptionEn: Explore community-built tools, check screenshots, permissions, and release notes, and install or update with one click.

control.reasonZh: 「浏览小应用市场、查看应用详情与包信息，一键安装或升级版本」需要你浏览市场卡片、核对应用说明与权限范围后确认安装；智能体会为你直接打开小应用市场。
control.reasonEn: "Browse the Mini App Market, inspect listings, and install or update releases" lets you browse listings, review permissions, and confirm installation; the Agent opens the Mini App gallery directly for you.

items.titleZh: 登录市场账号，收藏喜欢的小应用、打分评价并查看安装来源
items.titleEn: Sign in to favorite and rate Market apps and track installed origins
items.descriptionZh: 登录 OpenBitFun 账号后即可同步收藏夹、为好用的作品点赞评分，并清晰区分本地自建与市场安装来源。
items.descriptionEn: Sign in to bookmark favorites, rate helpful community apps, and distinguish local creations from Market installs.

control.reasonZh: 市场登录必须由用户在外部认证流程中确认；智能体可以打开准确入口，但不能代替账户持有人完成认证。
control.reasonEn: Market sign-in requires the account holder to confirm an external authentication flow; the Agent can open the exact entry but cannot complete that authentication for them.

items.titleZh: 按具体文件夹或工作区精细授权，并在应用定制前审查权限变更
items.titleEn: Grant scoped folder or workspace access and review permission diffs before applying
items.descriptionZh: 小应用默认受沙盒约束，只有经过你点头授权的路径或工作区才能读写；草稿若新增了权限要求会高亮提醒你审查。
items.descriptionEn: Mini Apps stay sandboxed by default—grant access only to chosen paths or workspaces, and review clear diffs whenever a draft requests new permissions.

control.reasonZh: 「按具体文件夹或工作区精细授权，并在应用定制前审查权限变更」涉及文件系统访问边界与安全授权决策，必须由你在界面亲自核对路径与权限差异后确认。
control.reasonEn: "Grant scoped folder or workspace access and review permission diffs before applying" governs filesystem access boundaries and requires your explicit review of path scopes and permission diffs in the UI.

items.titleZh: 运行小应用前端与后台 Worker、自动安装依赖并管理运行状态
items.titleEn: Run Mini App UI and background Workers, manage dependencies, and stop workers
items.descriptionZh: 不仅能画前端界面，还支持运行后台 Worker 处理数据、安装声明的依赖包、从文件同步重编译或随时停止后台任务。
items.descriptionEn: Beyond static UI, Mini Apps can run background JS Workers, install declared dependencies, recompile on sync, and stop workers cleanly.

control.reasonZh: 「运行小应用前端与后台 Worker、自动安装依赖并管理运行状态」绑定正在运行的小应用实例生命周期与后台 Worker 控制；智能体会打开小应用管理面供你查看运行中状态或停止任务。
control.reasonEn: "Run Mini App UI and background Workers, manage dependencies, and stop workers" tracks live Mini App instances and background Worker lifecycles; the Agent opens the Mini Apps surface so you can inspect or stop running workers.

items.titleZh: 为正式版小应用与定制草稿分别提供互不干扰的持久化存储
items.titleEn: Persist app state separately for installed Mini Apps and customization drafts
items.descriptionZh: 你在小应用里记的笔记、配好的参数都会稳妥保存在本地，关掉重开甚至编辑草稿都不会冲掉正式数据。
items.descriptionEn: Notes, settings, and state inside each Mini App persist across restarts while draft experiments use isolated storage.

control.reasonZh: 「为正式版小应用与定制草稿分别提供互不干扰的持久化存储」属于应用内部运行时的状态读写隔离机制；智能体会打开对应小应用让你直接在界面中使用并保存数据。
control.reasonEn: "Persist app state separately for installed Mini Apps and customization drafts" is managed automatically by each app’s runtime storage sandbox; the Agent opens the Mini App so you can view and edit your saved state.

items.titleZh: 在小应用内部直接调用大模型补全、流式对话与专属智能体会话
items.titleEn: Power Mini Apps with built-in model completions, chat streams, and agent sessions
items.descriptionZh: 无需在小应用里重复配置 API Key，应用可直接复用客户端已配好的模型能力，打造真正的 AI 原生小工具。
items.descriptionEn: Build true AI-native tools without hardcoding API keys—Mini Apps can call your configured models and run dedicated agent turns.

control.reasonZh: 「在小应用内部直接调用大模型补全、流式对话与专属智能体会话」由小应用内部界面触发实时流式生成与会话交互；智能体会为你打开对应小应用体验内置 AI 能力。
control.reasonEn: "Power Mini Apps with built-in model completions, chat streams, and agent sessions" runs interactively inside the Mini App’s own interface; the Agent opens the Mini App so you can use its embedded AI features.

items.titleZh: 开启定制草稿边改边实时预览，满意后再应用或随时丢弃草稿
items.titleEn: Create live customization drafts to preview edits before applying or discarding
items.descriptionZh: 想给现有小应用大改版？先拉一份草稿实时看效果，改满意了一键合并上线，不满意直接丢弃，零风险试错。
items.descriptionEn: Experiment freely in a live preview draft—apply changes when they feel right, or discard the draft with zero impact on your installed version.

control.reasonZh: 「开启定制草稿边改边实时预览，满意后再应用或随时丢弃草稿」涉及草稿与正式版并排预览对比及最终应用/丢弃确认；智能体会打开小应用定制视图供你把关效果。
control.reasonEn: "Create live customization drafts to preview edits before applying or discarding" lets you preview visual changes live before committing or discarding the draft; the Agent opens the customization view for your review.

items.titleZh: 浏览小应用的每次修改版本历史，随时一键回滚到旧版本
items.titleEn: Browse Mini App version history and roll back to an earlier release anytime
items.descriptionZh: 每次升级或定制都会留下清晰足迹，遇到新版本不顺手或内置应用更新不想接受时，随时退回熟悉的旧版。
items.descriptionEn: Every update keeps a version checkpoint so you can revert to a known-good release in seconds if an edit misses the mark.

control.reasonZh: 「浏览小应用的每次修改版本历史，随时一键回滚到旧版本」需要你从历史版本号列表中选定回退目标并确认回滚；智能体会打开应用详情的历史面板供你选择。
control.reasonEn: "Browse Mini App version history and roll back to an earlier release anytime" requires choosing a target revision from version history and confirming the rollback; the Agent opens the app’s version panel for you.

items.titleZh: 由智能体包办受管草稿初始化、前后端编写与构建清单校验
