items.titleEn: Let an agent scaffold, author, compile, and validate a complete Mini App
items.descriptionZh: 针对复杂多文件应用，AI 会通过专用开发工具走完草稿初始化、编写代码、清单与权限校验全流程，确保交付即可用。
items.descriptionEn: For richer apps, the agent initializes a managed workspace, writes UI and worker code, and validates manifests and builds end to end.

workflowZh: 先用 InitMiniApp 创建受管草稿并取得工作目录，再用 Read/Write/Edit 实现应用
完成后调用 FinalizeMiniApp 校验清单、构建产物与权限，只有通过后才视为可用
workflowEn: Initialize a managed draft and obtain its workspace with InitMiniApp, then implement it with Read, Write, and Edit
Run FinalizeMiniApp to validate the manifest, build output, and permissions; treat it as usable only after validation succeeds

items.titleZh: 在你的明确要求下，由智能体整理发布说明并提交小应用到市场审核
items.titleEn: Ask an agent to package release notes and submit your Mini App for Market review
items.descriptionZh: 写完好用的工具想分享出去？告诉 AI 许可证与更新亮点，它会帮你校验打包并提交审核，缺登录态时清晰引导你下一步。
items.descriptionEn: Ready to share your creation? Tell the agent your license and release notes to validate and submit it, with clear guidance if sign-in is needed.

workflowZh: 仅在用户明确要求对外提交时调用 PublishMiniApp，并提供已完成应用、许可与发布说明
登录、校验或上传返回可恢复状态时，向用户展示具体下一步，不把待授权或待审核状态报告成发布成功
workflowEn: Call PublishMiniApp only after an explicit request to submit externally, with the completed app, license, and release notes
When authentication, validation, or upload returns a resumable state, show the exact next step and never report pending authorization or review as published

items.titleZh: 让智能体读懂小应用源码并直接在当前窗口帮你交互操作
items.titleEn: Let an agent understand a Mini App’s source and operate its live UI for you
items.descriptionZh: AI 能先看懂小应用的业务接口与数据结构，再直接在你眼前打开的实例里读取状态、填写或触发动作，且不会弄丢你的未保存草稿。
items.descriptionEn: The agent inspects the app’s semantic bridge and source, then operates the live open instance right in front of you without clobbering drafts.

workflowZh: 先用 OpenBitFunControl 的 get 查询 feature.miniapps，并按 schema 用 inspect-app 读取源码，理解业务函数、动作参数和状态；源码更新属于应用改造，不是日常操作的前置步骤
用 MiniAppBrowser 的 open 连接当前实例，优先 observe_bridge 读取业务状态、act_bridge 执行语义动作并核对结果，保留用户草稿，不改源码、不重载、不切换呈现。旧应用缺少接口时使用可用的 DOM/输入或说明限制；自动活动信息不能代替业务状态
workflowEn: Use OpenBitFunControl get for feature.miniapps, then inspect-app source to understand business functions, action parameters, and state. Source updates are app enhancements, not prerequisites for routine operation

Open the current instance with MiniAppBrowser; prefer observe_bridge for business state and act_bridge for semantic operations and result verification. Preserve drafts without editing source, reloading, or changing presentation. For legacy apps use available DOM/input controls or report the gap; activity is not business state

items.titleZh: 查看我的市场投稿审核进度、撤回发布申请与预览展示页
items.titleEn: Track your Market submissions, withdraw pending releases, and render showcase slides
items.descriptionZh: 提交市场后可随时查看审核队列状态，发现疏漏支持主动撤回重提，并可渲染应用展示幻灯片。
items.descriptionEn: Check where your submitted releases stand in review, withdraw a pending submission if you spot a bug, and render presentation slides.

control.reasonZh: 智能体已能提交完成的 Mini App；撤回、审核队列和幻灯片渲染仍依赖账户权限或当前界面状态，因此保留准确入口而不扩大工具承诺。
control.reasonEn: The Agent can submit a completed Mini App; withdrawal, review queues, and slide rendering still depend on account permissions or live UI state, so the contract keeps an exact entry without overstating tool support.

stepsZh: 从「首页 → 小应用」区域（或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索「打开 Mini Apps」）进入小应用中心，浏览「已安装」或「市场」
想装现成的可在市场点安装，或点击「导入小应用」加载本地包；想从零自己做，在首页点「创建小应用」、在小应用页点「使用创造模式创建」，或直接在任意会话里告诉智能体你想做什么工具
点击应用图标即可在独立标签页启动使用（也可从「首页」小应用图标栏一键秒开）；若应用请求访问本地目录，按提示审查授权
需要二次改造时，既可直接让智能体修改指定小应用，也可开启定制草稿边改边预览，不满意随时回滚旧版本
stepsEn: Open Home → Mini Apps (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Open Mini Apps) to browse Installed apps or explore the Market

Install any Market listing in one click or click Import mini app for a local package; to build your own, click Create Mini App on Home, Create with Creation Mode in the gallery, or simply ask an agent in chat
Launch any installed app in its own tab (or straight from the Home app strip) and review path/workspace permissions if requested
Iterate anytime by asking the agent to update the app, opening a live customization draft, or rolling back in version history
agentExamplesZh: 帮我创建一个带任务统计和声音提醒的番茄钟小应用
列出我目前已安装的所有小应用
把「每日清单」小应用里的按钮改成圆角并加上按标签筛选功能
打开小应用市场，我想找找效率工具
agentExamplesEn: Create a Pomodoro MiniApp with daily stats and custom break lengths
List all the MiniApps installed on this machine
Update my Daily Notes MiniApp with tag filtering while keeping my saved notes
Open the Mini App market so I can browse productivity tools

operations.descriptionZh: 读取产品宿主上的已安装应用及版本。
operations.descriptionEn: Read installed apps and versions from the product host.

operations.descriptionZh: 按应用 ID 读取可编辑字段、源码、权限和版本，不返回控制端路径。
operations.descriptionEn: Read editable fields, source, permissions and version by app ID without controller-local paths.

operations.descriptionZh: 直接提交名称和源码，编译并保存到客户端；无需源码仓库或构建工具。
operations.descriptionEn: Compile and install a name and source directly in the client, without a repository or build tools.

operations.descriptionZh: 按应用 ID 修改指定字段，保留未提供的源码和用户数据，通知已打开的应用刷新。expectedVersion 可防止覆盖新的修改。
operations.descriptionEn: Patch specified fields by app ID, preserve omitted source and user data, and notify open runtimes. expectedVersion guards against stale edits.

operations.descriptionZh: 按应用 ID 停止后台任务并删除应用；仅在用户明确要求删除时使用。
operations.descriptionEn: Stop the worker and delete an installed app by ID, only on an explicit deletion request.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧边栏「首页」→ 小应用（创建小应用 / 管理小应用），或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K → 打开 Mini Apps（常用小应用可固定到左侧边栏）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Home → Mini Apps (Create Mini App / Manage Mini Apps), or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Open Mini Apps (favorite apps can also be pinned to the left sidebar)
scenariosZh: 需要一个顺手的正则调试器、日志可视化面板、番茄钟或每日站会记录板，在聊天里说清楚需求，几十秒就能生成并固定到侧边栏天天用
从市场装了一个开源小应用，想把界面改成符合自己习惯的布局——让 AI 读取源码更新字段，同时完整保留你之前存好的业务数据
让智能体通过 MiniAppBrowser 直接操作你当前打开的小应用界面，帮你批量录入或整理里面的内容
scenariosEn: Need a custom regex workbench, log viewer, Pomodoro timer, or personal CRM? Describe it in chat and launch it as a permanent tool in seconds
Tweak an installed app’s layout or add an export button—patch it cleanly or test in a customization draft without losing your saved data
Ask the agent to inspect and operate an open Mini App on screen for you while preserving your in-progress drafts
tipsZh: 修改应用不丢数据：让智能体直接修改升级小应用的界面或逻辑时，会自动保留你已经保存在该应用里的用户数据，并通知已打开的窗口实时刷新。
草稿沙盒放心试错：大改功能时使用定制草稿，草稿拥有独立的存储和权限对比提示，确认应用前完全不影响正式版。
对外发布由你把关：只有当你明确要求提交到市场时，智能体才会发起发布流程，且待登录或待审核状态会如实提示下一步。
tipsEn: Updates preserve your data: patching an installed Mini App updates its code and refreshes open tabs without wiping your stored app data.
Safe customization drafts: drafts keep separate storage and show permission diffs upfront so experiments never break your live app.
Explicit market publishing: agents only submit a Mini App to the Market when you explicitly ask, surfacing clear sign-in or review steps.

capabilities.summaryZh: 在「任务看板」一处查看计划概览、未来 24 小时待执行列表与月度日历，按单次、固定间隔或自定义 Cron 时间表让智能体自动巡检项目、跑回归或写总结，支持跑在已有会话或每次新建会话。
capabilities.summaryEn: Plan and track automated work in the Task Board—view upcoming runs and a monthly calendar, schedule one-time, interval, or custom Cron jobs scoped to a workspace and agent, and run them in an existing thread or a fresh session.
highlightsZh: 计划概览 + 待执行任务 + 月历视图 + 无后续执行归组，排期节奏一目了然
支持单次定时、固定时间间隔（每 N 分钟/小时/天）与带时区的 Cron 表达式
可自由指定执行工作区、智能体模式、模型，以及续写已有会话还是每次新建会话
既可在看板可视化创建，也能直接在聊天中一句话让 AI 设好闹钟或周期任务
highlightsEn: See Plan Overview, upcoming 24-hour runs, an interactive Calendar, and paused/completed jobs at a glance
Choose one-time timestamps, fixed intervals (every N minutes/hours/days), or timezone-aware Cron expressions
Bind each job to a workspace, agent mode, and model—targeting either an existing session or a brand-new session each run
Create and manage jobs visually in the Task Board or simply ask the agent in natural language

items.titleZh: 在计划概览、待执行任务、日历与已暂停/无后续执行列表间清晰管理
items.titleEn: Track work across Plan Overview, Scheduled Tasks, Calendar, and Inactive sections
items.descriptionZh: 一眼看到总任务数与 24 小时内即将触发的项，跑完的单次任务或手动暂停的任务会自动归入下方区域不添乱。
items.descriptionEn: See total scheduled items and runs due within 24 hours up top, while paused or finished one-time tasks stay neatly grouped below.

control.reasonZh: 「在计划概览、待执行任务、日历与已暂停/无后续执行列表间清晰管理」结合实时倒计时徽章、月历点选与列表分区浏览；智能体会为你直接打开「任务看板」界面。
control.reasonEn: "Track work across Plan Overview, Scheduled Tasks, Calendar, and Inactive sections" combines live due-time badges, interactive month-day selection, and grouped sections; the Agent opens the Task Board scene directly for you.

items.titleZh: 创建、编辑、暂停/启用、删除或立即运行定时任务
items.titleEn: Create, edit, pause/enable, delete, or immediately trigger scheduled jobs
items.descriptionZh: 无论是点开编辑器细调参数，还是在对话里让 AI 帮你新增、改时间或先手动试跑一次，都能顺畅完成。
items.descriptionEn: Manage schedules visually in the Todo editor or ask the agent in chat to add, update, pause, remove, or test-run a job immediately.

workflowZh: 若 Cron 是延迟工具，先用 GetToolSpec 加载；用 list 取得 job_id
用 add、update、remove 或 run 创建、修改、启停、删除或立即运行任务
workflowEn: If Cron is deferred, load it with GetToolSpec and use list to obtain the job_id
Use add, update, remove, or run to create, edit, enable/disable, delete, or immediately run a job

items.titleZh: 设置单次、固定间隔或自定义 Cron 时间表
items.titleEn: Choose one-time, interval, or custom Cron schedule types
items.descriptionZh: 既支持“今天 17:30 跑一次”和“每 2 小时跑一次”，也支持标准 Cron 表达式与时区感知，AI 创建前会先核对当前准确时间。
items.descriptionEn: Supports exact one-off timestamps, simple intervals (every N minutes/hours/days), and full timezone-aware Cron expressions verified against live system time.

workflowZh: 涉及相对日期或时区时先用 GetTime 确认当前时间，再使用 Cron 的 at、every 或 cron schedule 结构
创建前向用户复述绝对执行时间和时区，避免把“明天”等相对描述解析错
workflowEn: Use GetTime first for relative dates or timezone-sensitive requests, then express the schedule with Cron at, every, or cron
Restate the absolute run time and timezone before creation so relative phrases such as tomorrow are not misinterpreted

items.titleZh: 在月度日历上点选日期，直观预览下一次与未来排期分布
items.titleEn: Click any date on the calendar to preview next and future run occurrences
items.descriptionZh: 复杂 Cron 表达式不用自己心算——在日历上直接看到每天排了几项任务，避免多个重任务撞在同一时刻。
items.descriptionEn: No mental Cron math required—see daily job counts on the monthly grid and click any date to inspect what will fire when.

control.reasonZh: 「在月度日历上点选日期，直观预览下一次与未来排期分布」用于交互式切换月份与点选具体日期查看当天排期明细；智能体会为你打开任务看板日历视图。
control.reasonEn: "Click any date on the calendar to preview next and future run occurrences" lets you flip through months and click individual days to inspect scheduled runs; the Agent opens the Task Board calendar for you.

items.titleZh: 为每项任务指定工作区、智能体角色、模型及目标会话方式
items.titleEn: Configure the workspace, agent role, model, and session target per job
items.descriptionZh: 你可以让例行巡检每次新建干净的会话，也可以让提醒和跟进消息直接追加到你正在聊的那条会话里。
items.descriptionEn: Run recurring checks in fresh sessions each time, or route reminders and follow-ups straight into an existing conversation thread.

control.reasonZh: 「为每项任务指定工作区、智能体角色、模型及目标会话方式」需要在编辑器中联动选择当前可用工作区、智能体模式与会话目标；智能体会打开任务编辑入口供你配置。
control.reasonEn: "Configure the workspace, agent role, model, and session target per job" links live workspace, agent-mode, and target-session selectors in the Todo editor; the Agent opens the task surface so you can configure them.

items.titleZh: 支持为本机工作区或已连接的远程环境安排定时执行
items.titleEn: Schedule automated work for local projects or connected remote environments
items.descriptionZh: 任务严格绑定创建时选定的工作区环境，远端环境不可达时明确记录状态，绝不错误落到本机目录执行。
items.descriptionEn: Each job stays bound to its owning local or remote workspace context and reports unavailability explicitly rather than running in the wrong folder.

control.reasonZh: 「支持为本机工作区或已连接的远程环境安排定时执行」需要结合当前已打开或已连接的远程环境选择目标工作区；智能体会打开任务面板交由你确认绑定目标。
control.reasonEn: "Schedule automated work for local projects or connected remote environments" depends on selecting among currently open local or connected remote workspaces; the Agent opens the Task Board so you can confirm the target.

items.titleZh: 应用启动就绪后再可靠恢复调度，确保任务环境完整可用
items.titleEn: Wait for host runtime readiness on startup before firing due schedules
items.descriptionZh: 桌面端或守护进程启动时会先等核心服务与配置加载完毕再拉起调度器，避免刚开机时环境未就绪导致误报失败。
items.descriptionEn: On startup, OpenBitFun waits until core runtime services are initialized before resuming the scheduler so early runs don’t fail half-booted.

control.reasonZh: 「应用启动就绪后再可靠恢复调度，确保任务环境完整可用」属于宿主生命周期与任务总览检查；智能体会打开任务看板让你直观核对当前已加载的任务列表与下次运行时间。
control.reasonEn: "Wait for host runtime readiness on startup before firing due schedules" reflects host scheduler lifecycle and live job-list state; the Agent opens the Task Board so you can verify loaded schedules and next run times.

stepsZh: 点击左侧边栏顶部的「任务看板」（或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 选择「打开待办」），先确保已打开一个要绑定执行的工作区
点击右上角「新建待办」，填写任务名称、要交给 AI 执行的提示词，并选择智能体模式与目标会话方式（已有会话 / 新建会话）
选择计划类型：单次（指定具体时间）、间隔（每 N 分钟/小时/天）或 Cron 表达式，保存并启用任务
在右侧日历点击任意日期预览排期，或随时暂停、编辑、手动立即触发运行
stepsEn: Click Task Board near the top of the left sidebar (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Open todos) with a target workspace open
Click New Todo, enter a clear task name and prompt, and choose the agent mode and session target (Existing session vs New session)
Pick a schedule kind—One-time, Interval (every N minutes/hours/days), or Cron—then save and enable the task
Click any day on the Calendar to preview scheduled runs, or pause, edit, or trigger a run anytime
agentExamplesZh: 每天早上 9 点帮我检查这个仓库的失败测试并生成汇总报告
每 30 分钟巡检一次开发服接口状态，有问题就在当前会话告诉我
列出我目前所有的定时任务，把周报那个任务先暂停
agentExamplesEn: Every morning at 9 AM, check failing tests in this repo and write a short summary
Check the staging API health every 30 minutes and post in this session if anything breaks
List all my scheduled jobs and pause the weekly report job for now
capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧边栏顶部「任务看板」，或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K → 打开待办（单项目定时任务也可在「项目资源」管理）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Left Sidebar → Task Board, or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Open todos (project-scoped jobs also live in Project Resources)
scenariosZh: 每个工作日早上 9:00 自动检查仓库最新提交、昨晚 CI 结果与未合并 PR，汇总成早报放进项目会话
每隔 1 小时运行一次健康巡检脚本，一旦发现接口报错立刻分析日志并定位问题代码
正在写代码怕忘事，随口跟 AI 说“45 分钟后在当前会话提醒我切分支发版”，到点自动唤醒执行
scenariosEn: Every weekday at 9:00 AM, summarize overnight commits, CI status, and open PRs into a morning briefing session
Run a health check every 2 hours on a connected workspace and investigate logs automatically if a check fails
Ask in chat: "In 45 minutes, remind me in this session to tag the release and verify changelog entries"
tipsZh: 保持执行宿主在线：定时任务由所属主机（打开中的桌面端，或在后台运行 `openbitfun daemon` 的 CLI）按时触发；电脑关机期间不会隔空运行，重新启动后会恢复后续计划。
单次失败不盲目死循环重试：某次定时触发若因模型网络或环境报错失败，会如实记录状态并等待下一次计划时间，不会无限刷爆你的 Token。
助理也有专属日程：在「个人助理」详情页和「项目资源」页，都可以只看归属于该助理或该项目的定时任务。
tipsEn: Keep the host running: schedules fire on the owning machine (an open Desktop app or `openbitfun daemon` on CLI); if the machine was asleep, scheduling resumes cleanly once it starts again.
No runaway retry storms: if a scheduled occurrence fails, OpenBitFun records the failure cleanly rather than endlessly retrying and burning tokens.
Scoped views everywhere: both Personal Assistant pages and Project Resources show filtered views of just the jobs owned by that assistant or project.

capabilities.summaryZh: 把你近期的多轮对话、项目推进轨迹与模型使用记录浓缩成一份好读的深度工作复盘——帮你看清时间都花在了哪些项目与任务类型上，总结高光成果、揪出协作卡点，并给出能立刻用起来的提效建议。
capabilities.summaryEn: Distill your recent conversations, project activity, and model usage into an engaging work retrospective—see where your energy went, celebrate key wins, uncover workflow friction, and get practical tips for collaborating better with AI.
highlightsZh: 按自选日期范围与分析模型一键生成图文并茂的个人工作洞察报告
提炼高光成果、常见协作摩擦点与针对性的提示词 / 工作流优化建议
联动展示项目投入分布、活跃时段习惯以及模型 Token 与缓存统计
自动留存历史报告，随时切换回看不同阶段的效率变化
highlightsEn: Generate a rich work-insights report for any chosen date range and analysis model
Surface concrete wins, recurring collaboration friction, and tailored workflow suggestions
Connect session habits and project focus with underlying model, token, and cache metrics
Keep historical reports on hand so you can compare progress across weeks or sprints

items.titleZh: 自动检测当前设备与工作区是否已积累足够的可分析会话数据
items.titleEn: Check whether current sessions contain analyzable activity data
items.descriptionZh: 进入页面即可知晓可分析的数据状态，没有足够历史记录时会给出友好提示，避免空跑消耗额度。
items.descriptionEn: Know right away whether enough session history exists before spending tokens on a report run.

control.reasonZh: 「自动检测当前设备与工作区是否已积累足够的可分析会话数据」依赖读取当前主机的本地会话统计状态；智能体会为你打开「洞察」页面直观展示可用范围。
control.reasonEn: "Check whether current sessions contain analyzable activity data" checks live session data on the active host; the Agent opens the Insights scene to show what data is ready.

items.titleZh: 自选时间范围与分析模型，一键生成深度工作洞察报告
items.titleEn: Generate a tailored work-insights report for a chosen date range and model
items.descriptionZh: 你可以按周、按月挑选回顾区间，并自由指定擅长总结推理的模型来执笔撰写报告。
items.descriptionEn: Pick the exact window you want to reflect on and choose which configured model synthesizes the findings.

control.reasonZh: 「自选时间范围与分析模型，一键生成深度工作洞察报告」需要你确认分析的时间窗口与消耗额度的模型选择；智能体会打开生成面板交由你点按启动。
control.reasonEn: "Generate a tailored work-insights report for a chosen date range and model" lets you choose the date range and model before spending tokens; the Agent opens the Insights view so you can start generation.

items.titleZh: 随时取消正在生成的洞察分析任务
items.titleEn: Cancel an in-progress insights generation run anytime
items.descriptionZh: 如果选错了时间跨度或换了主意，点一下即可立即中止后台汇总任务，不必干等跑完。
items.descriptionEn: Changed your mind about the date range or model? Stop the running analysis cleanly with one click.

control.reasonZh: 「随时取消正在生成的洞察分析任务」仅在报告生成进行中可用；智能体会打开当前洞察界面供你随时停止正在运行的分析。
control.reasonEn: "Cancel an in-progress insights generation run anytime" applies while a report job is actively running; the Agent opens the Insights view where you can cancel it immediately.

items.titleZh: 即时阅读最新洞察报告，或随时加载以往保存的历史报告
items.titleEn: Read your latest report instantly or switch to any saved historical report
items.descriptionZh: 每次生成的报告都会妥善留存，打开即看最新一期，也能翻出上个月的报告纵向对比变化。
items.descriptionEn: Open straight to your most recent retrospective or load past reports from history to see how your workflow evolved.

control.reasonZh: 「即时阅读最新洞察报告，或随时加载以往保存的历史报告」支持在可视化排版界面中切换历史期数与分区阅读；智能体会为你直接打开报告阅读视图。
control.reasonEn: "Read your latest report instantly or switch to any saved historical report" supports browsing formatted sections and switching among historical snapshots; the Agent opens the Insights reader for you.

items.titleZh: 将工作产出与模型分布、Token 消耗及缓存命中率对照查看
items.titleEn: Connect project activity with model, token, and prompt-cache metrics
items.descriptionZh: 把“做了什么事”和“花了多少 Token、缓存省了多少”放在一起看，账目与产出两相印证。
items.descriptionEn: See what you accomplished side by side with token consumption and KV-cache savings for a complete picture.

control.reasonZh: 「将工作产出与模型分布、Token 消耗及缓存命中率对照查看」结合图表与洞察卡片联动呈现；智能体会打开洞察页供你对照浏览各项指标。
control.reasonEn: "Connect project activity with model, token, and prompt-cache metrics" pairs visual usage metrics with narrative report cards; the Agent opens Insights so you can explore both together.

items.titleZh: 复盘项目精力分布、高效工作时段、任务类型与人机协作默契度
items.titleEn: Reflect on project focus, active hours, task types, and AI collaboration style
items.descriptionZh: 不仅统计数字，更帮你梳理沟通风格、常见卡点与下一阶段值得尝试的自动化方向。
items.descriptionEn: Go beyond raw counters—understand your prompting style, recurring bottlenecks, and high-leverage automation ideas.

control.reasonZh: 「复盘项目精力分布、高效工作时段、任务类型与人机协作默契度」以多维度卡片与可读叙事呈现个人工作画像；智能体会直接为你打开洞察场景阅读详情。
control.reasonEn: "Reflect on project focus, active hours, task types, and AI collaboration style" presents multi-faceted narrative cards across your projects and habits; the Agent opens the Insights scene for you to read.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 打开全局搜索，输入「洞察」或「Insights」进入工作洞察页（常看可在外观设置里将其固定到左侧边栏）
页面会自动检查当前积累的可分析会话范围；选择你想回顾的日期区间与用于撰写报告的模型
点击生成报告（生成途中若想调整范围可随时取消），稍等片刻即可阅读完整分析与改进建议
在报告切换器中随时翻阅最新一期或以往保存的历史报告
stepsEn: Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and search "Insights" to open the Insights scene (or pin it permanently in Appearance → Left sidebar)
Pick the date range and model you want to use once OpenBitFun confirms analyzable session activity is available
Click Generate (you can cancel anytime if you pick a different range) and read your structured overview, wins, friction points, and tips
Switch between your latest report and earlier saved reports anytime from the report selector
agentExamplesZh: 打开 Insights，我想生成一份这周的工作洞察报告
带我查看最近一次的工作洞察总结
agentExamplesEn: Open Insights so I can generate a report for this week
Show me my latest work insights report
capabilities.entryPathZh: 按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 打开全局搜索 → 输入「洞察」或「Insights」（也可在「设置 → 应用与界面 → 外观 → 左侧导航栏」固定到侧边栏）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Search "Insights" (or pin Insights to the left sidebar in Settings → Application & Interface → Appearance → Left sidebar)
scenariosZh: 周五写周报或冲刺复盘前打开 Insights，几分钟理清这周跨多个仓库到底推进了哪些核心事项
想看看自己和 AI 配合哪里还能更顺：报告会指出哪些重复解释其实适合固化进 AGENTS.md 或封装成 Skill
结合模型与缓存命中统计，检查主力大模型与轻量模型的分工是否划算合理
scenariosEn: Before a Friday retro or weekly update, generate an Insights report to recap what you shipped across multiple repos
Spot repeated back-and-forth patterns that could become a permanent AGENTS.md rule or reusable Skill
Pair qualitative workflow takeaways with token and cache-hit statistics to tune your model mix
tipsZh: 为什么默认在侧边栏没看到？为了让日常编码界面保持清爽，侧边栏默认只固定「任务看板」；用 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 秒开，或去「设置 → 应用与界面 → 外观 → 左侧导航栏」一键固定即可。
刚装好还没数据时：需要先积累一定量的真实会话互动，Insights 才能提炼出有价值的模式分析。
和「调用统计」怎么配合看？查账单级 Token 明细去「设置 → 数据与维护 → 调用统计」；看工作内容总结与提效建议来「洞察」。
tipsEn: Where is it in the sidebar? To keep the default sidebar clean, Insights isn’t pinned out of the box—open it instantly via ⌘K / Ctrl+K, or pin it in Settings → Appearance → Left sidebar.
New install? Run a few real coding or assistant sessions first so Insights has meaningful activity to analyze.
Insights vs Call Statistics: visit Settings → Data & Maintenance → Call Statistics for raw token charts, and Insights for narrative retrospectives and workflow coaching.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 工具与集成 → 外部导入
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Tools & Integrations → External import
capabilities.summaryZh: 集中扫描本机或当前工作区中 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、ZCode 等外部 AI 工具的配置与历史记录，安全续聊 Codex / ZCode 会话（自动切出独立分支），并按冲突审阅导入受支持的 Skills、MCP 与 Hooks。
capabilities.summaryEn: Discover existing configurations and histories from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, and other AI tools—continue Codex or ZCode sessions safely on independent branches, and import supported Skills, MCP servers, and Hooks after conflict review.
highlightsZh: 在“外部导入”中按“已识别”与“更多应用”清晰查看各工具的扫描状态与可用资产
无缝续聊 Codex 与 ZCode 历史会话：打开自动刷新原记录，发首条消息时派生独立分支，原应用数据零改动
支持审阅冲突并导入受支持的 Skills、MCP 服务器与 Hooks 副本
内置自动发现总开关：关闭后立即隐藏跟随中的外部会话视图，但保留你已分叉续聊的本地副本
导入完成后引导你前往 Skills、MCP 或自动化页确认启用与连接，“已导入”不会静默越权激活
highlightsEn: Browse detected external AI apps and inspect what assets were found per category in External import
Continue Codex and ZCode sessions seamlessly: opening refreshes source history, and your first reply forks an independent OpenBitFun branch without touching the original app
Preview conflicts and import local copies of supported Skills, MCP servers, and Hooks
Toggle Automatic discovery anytime: turning it off hides live source-following session views while keeping branches you already forked
Imported copies stay safe until you confirm activation or credentials on the Skills, MCP, or Automation pages
scenariosZh: 从 Claude Code 或 Codex 换到 OpenBitFun，不想把攒了好久的 Skills、MCP 服务器和 Hooks 重新手配一遍：打开“外部导入”点开对应应用，勾选想要的条目审阅冲突后一键保存副本，再去对应设置页开启即可。
刚才在终端用 Codex 或 ZCode 排查问题聊到一半，想切到 OpenBitFun 结合图形 Diff 和内置浏览器接着改：开启自动发现后直接在工作区会话列表点开那条外部会话，接着往下发消息就会自动新建独立分支续聊。
不想在侧栏看到某个外部工具的只读跟随会话：在“外部导入”关闭自动发现或单独移除该来源会话（随时可从已移除列表恢复），原工具里的历史文件毫发无损。
scenariosEn: Moving over from Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode without rebuilding your setup from scratch: open External import, pick the source app, review any naming conflicts, and import copies of your Skills, MCP servers, and Hooks.

Picking up a debugging thread you started in Codex or ZCode CLI: open the discovered external session in your workspace—OpenBitFun refreshes the latest turns and automatically forks an independent branch as soon as you send a new message.

Cleaning up sidebar clutter without losing data: hide or remove external source sessions (and restore them anytime later) or turn off Automatic discovery while keeping every branch you already forked.

items.titleZh: 自动扫描并发现 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、ZCode 等外部来源与可用内容
items.titleEn: Discover Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, and other external AI sources and assets
items.descriptionZh: 汇总展示本机及当前工作区已识别到的外部 AI 工具，并可通过标题旁的“自动发现”开关随时暂停或恢复扫描。
items.descriptionEn: Lists detected external AI tools across user and workspace paths, with an Automatic discovery toggle right beside the External apps heading.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“工具与集成 → 外部导入”
确认“外部应用”标题旁的“自动发现”开关已开启，从“已识别”列表中点选 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 或 ZCode
想要导入配置：点开对应的 Skill、MCP 或 Hook 分类弹窗，搜索勾选目标条目、处理同名冲突并确认保存副本
前往对应的“Skills”、“MCP”或“自动化”设置页确认副本已启用、凭据或服务连接已就绪
想要续聊外部会话：直接在对应工作区打开已发现的 Codex / ZCode 会话查看最新历史，发送第一条消息即自动切出独立分支续聊
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Tools & Integrations → External import
Ensure Automatic discovery is enabled beside External apps, then pick a detected source such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or ZCode
To migrate assets: open the Skill, MCP, or Hook category dialog, select items, resolve any naming conflicts, and confirm saving copies
Visit the matching Skills, MCP, or Automation settings page to enable imported copies and verify connections or credentials
To continue past chats: open a discovered Codex or ZCode session in your workspace—sending your first message automatically forks a clean branch
tipsZh: 重要提示：在“外部导入”页看到状态变为“已导入”，仅代表配置文件副本已安全写入本地，不等于已经生效运行！请务必去对应的 Skills、MCP 或自动化（Hooks）管理页确认开启与连接。
目前支持创建本地副本导入的资产类型为 Skill、MCP 与 Hook；外部 Command、Tool 与子智能体则通过兼容策略直接关联管理。
关闭“自动发现”会立即隐藏侧栏里跟随外部源文件实时刷新的只读会话入口，但你之前已经发过消息分叉出来的 OpenBitFun 本地会话会完整保留。
tipsEn: Important: "Imported" on the External import page means a local copy was saved—it does not mean the item is active or connected yet. Confirm activation and credentials on the Skills, MCP, or Automation pages.
Copy-import currently covers Skills, MCP servers, and Hooks, whereas external Commands, Tools, and Subagents operate through live compatibility policies.
Turning off Automatic discovery immediately hides source-following external session entries, while any OpenBitFun branches you already forked remain safely in your workspace.

capabilities.summaryZh: 把项目放在远程 Linux 服务器、Docker 容器或 Windows WSL 中直接打开——你在本机流畅浏览与对话，文件读写、全文搜索、终端命令和智能体工具全部在目标环境原生执行。
capabilities.summaryEn: Open projects directly on a remote SSH server, inside a Docker container, or in Windows WSL—browse and chat smoothly on your machine while file I/O, search, terminals, and agent tools run natively in the target environment.
highlightsZh: 直连 SSH 主机、跳板机、远程 Docker 容器与本机 WSL 发行版
文件树、搜索、终端与智能体共享同一远程数据面，绝不静默误改本机
支持一键探测远程监听端口并转发到本机浏览器预览
支持拖拽或菜单上传、下载文件并随时取消大文件传输
highlightsEn: Connect directly to SSH hosts, jump hosts, remote Docker containers, and local WSL distributions
Share one remote data plane across files, search, terminals, and agents without silent local fallback
Detect remote listening ports and forward them to localhost for instant preview
Upload and download files between local and remote hosts with cancellable transfers

items.titleZh: 保存、测试与管理常用 SSH 连接配置
items.titleEn: Save, test, and manage reusable SSH connection profiles
items.descriptionZh: 把常用的开发机、测试服存为连接配置，打开项目前可一键连通性自检，随时更新或清理旧主机。
items.descriptionEn: Save frequently used dev servers as profiles, run one-click connection checks before opening a folder, and edit or remove stale hosts anytime.

control.reasonZh: 「保存、测试与管理常用 SSH 连接配置」涉及填写主机参数、连通性探测与删除确认；智能体会为你打开连接配置界面，由你核对并保存目标主机。
control.reasonEn: "Save, test, and manage reusable SSH connection profiles" involves editing host parameters, running live connectivity checks, and confirming removals; the Agent opens the connection setup dialog so you can review and save the host.

items.titleZh: 支持密码、私钥、证书、~/.ssh/config 与跳板机登录
items.titleEn: Authenticate via passwords, keys, certificates, ~/.ssh/config, and jump hosts
items.descriptionZh: 兼容企业常见的堡垒机/跳板机链路与本地 SSH 配置，密码与私钥通过受保护凭据通道提交，不会暴露给模型。
items.descriptionEn: Works with bastion/jump-host chains and existing ~/.ssh/config entries while keeping passwords and private keys inside the protected credential flow.

control.reasonZh: SSH 密码、私钥与证书属于秘密输入，必须由用户通过受保护的凭据入口提供；智能体不会读取或回显这些秘密。
control.reasonEn: SSH passwords, private keys, and certificates are secret inputs that must enter through the protected credential flow; the Agent neither reads nor echoes them.

items.titleZh: 自动发现远程 Docker 容器并进入容器内开发

items.descriptionEn: List running containers on a host and open any container as your active workspace so tools and dependencies match the container image.

control.reasonZh: 「自动发现远程 Docker 容器并进入容器内开发」需要先连接宿主机并从实时容器列表中选择目标环境；智能体可打开远程项目向导，由你选定容器与目录。
control.reasonEn: "Discover remote Docker containers and work directly inside a container" requires connecting to the host and picking from live running containers; the Agent opens the remote project wizard so you can select the container and folder.

items.titleZh: 在 Windows 上直接把 WSL 发行版作为项目工作区

items.descriptionEn: Detect installed WSL distributions on Windows and pick your Linux user and folder so terminals and agents run natively inside Linux.

control.reasonZh: 「在 Windows 上直接把 WSL 发行版作为项目工作区」需要读取当前 Windows 主机的发行版列表并由你选定 Linux 用户与工作目录；智能体会打开连接配置入口供你选择。
control.reasonEn: "Open a Windows WSL distribution directly as a Linux workspace" requires listing distributions on the Windows host and choosing a Linux user and directory; the Agent opens the connection dialog so you can pick them.

items.titleZh: 打开、关闭或移除远程工作区并查看远端系统信息

items.descriptionEn: Distinguish local and connected workspaces clearly in the sidebar, check remote OS details, and close workspaces safely without deleting remote files.

control.reasonZh: 「打开、关闭或移除远程工作区并查看远端系统信息」依赖当前已连接主机与你在目录浏览器中选定的路径；智能体会打开对应入口，由你确认要打开或移除的远程项目。
control.reasonEn: "Open, close, or remove remote workspaces and inspect host details" depends on the active host connection and folder selection; the Agent opens the workspace flow so you can confirm which remote project to open or remove.

items.titleZh: 在远端文件树直接浏览、搜索、编辑、重命名与删除文件
items.titleEn: Browse, search, edit, rename, and delete files directly on the remote host
items.descriptionZh: 无论是你在编辑器里手动改代码，还是让 AI 用 Read / Edit / Grep 搜索修改，所有读写都直接作用于远端文件系统。
items.descriptionEn: Both manual edits in the workbench and agent tools like Read, Edit, and Grep operate directly on the remote filesystem.

workflowZh: 在已打开的远程工作区中直接使用 LS/Read/Glob/Grep；这些工具沿用会话的远程数据面
写入、编辑、删除或重命名分别使用 Write/Edit/Delete/ExecCommand，失败时明确返回远程连接或能力状态，禁止静默落到本机
workflowEn: Use LS, Read, Glob, and Grep directly in an opened remote workspace; they follow the session's remote data plane
Use Write, Edit, Delete, or ExecCommand for mutations and rename; surface remote connection or capability failures explicitly and never fall back locally

items.titleZh: 在本机与远端之间上传、下载文件或压缩包并可随时取消
items.titleEn: Upload and download files or archives between local and remote hosts
items.descriptionZh: 支持把本机素材传上服务器，或把远端生成的构建产物、日志打包下载回本地电脑，大文件传输中途可随时取消。
items.descriptionEn: Send local assets to the server or download remote build artifacts and logs back to your computer, with live cancellation for large transfers.

control.reasonZh: 「在本机与远端之间上传、下载文件或压缩包并可随时取消」需要你在本机与远端目录之间选择源文件及保存路径，并跟踪实时传输进度；智能体会打开文件面板交由你确认操作。
control.reasonEn: "Upload and download files or archives between local and remote hosts" requires picking local and remote paths and monitoring live transfer progress; the Agent opens the file surface so you can confirm the transfer.

items.titleZh: 在远端环境执行构建与长耗时命令并保持交互控制
items.titleEn: Run builds and long-running commands natively in the remote environment
items.descriptionZh: 终端与智能体的 ExecCommand 共享远端上下文，支持交互式输入、读取增量输出或在卡住时发送中断信号。
items.descriptionEn: Terminals and agent ExecCommand calls run directly on the target host with interactive stdin, live output polling, and clean interrupt signals.

workflowZh: 在远程工作区上下文中用 ExecCommand 启动命令，并保留长任务返回的 session_id
用 WriteStdin 输入或轮询输出，用 ExecControl 中断或终止；连接断开和不支持状态必须明确返回
workflowEn: Start commands with ExecCommand in the remote-workspace context and retain the session_id returned for long-running work
Use WriteStdin for input or polling and ExecControl to interrupt or terminate; disconnected and unsupported states must be explicit

items.titleZh: 探测远端监听端口并一键开启或关闭本地端口转发
items.titleEn: Detect remote listening ports and start or stop local port forwarding
items.descriptionZh: 不用手敲复杂的 ssh -L 命令，AI 可直接查出远端正在运行的端口并映射到本地，调完随时关闭释放端口。
items.descriptionEn: Skip manual ssh -L flags—let the agent list active remote ports, forward the one you need to localhost, and stop it cleanly when done.

workflowZh: 若 PortForward 是延迟工具，先加载契约；先列出或探测远程端口，再对明确目标启动转发
保留返回的转发标识，用 list 检查状态并在不再需要时 stop；不得猜测远程主机或端口
workflowEn: Load PortForward if deferred; list or detect remote ports first, then start forwarding for an explicit target
Keep the returned forwarding identifier, inspect it with list, and stop it when no longer needed; never guess the remote host or port

items.titleZh: 查看实时 SSH 连接状态，按需断开单个或全部连接
items.titleEn: Monitor live SSH connection state and disconnect one or all sessions
items.descriptionZh: 一眼掌握当前远端链路是否在线，切换网络或结束工作后可干净断开指定主机或全部 SSH 会话。
items.descriptionEn: Check at a glance whether a remote link is healthy and cleanly disconnect individual or all SSH sessions when switching networks.

control.reasonZh: 「查看实时 SSH 连接状态，按需断开单个或全部连接」会改变当前已打开远程工作区的在线状态，需根据实时连接列表确认断开范围；智能体会打开连接状态入口供你操作。
control.reasonEn: "Monitor live SSH connection state and disconnect one or all sessions" affects live remote workspaces and requires choosing which active connection to close; the Agent opens the connection control entry for confirmation.

stepsZh: 点击左侧边栏「会话」旁的 + 按钮（或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 选择「新建项目」），切换连接方式为 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL
选择已保存的主机或从系统 ~/.ssh/config 导入配置，填写认证信息（支持密码、私钥、证书与跳板机）并测试连接
在远程目录选择器中选定项目文件夹打开工作区，侧边栏和终端即刻切换到目标环境
像本地项目一样编辑与对话；需要访问远端 Web 服务时，直接让智能体转发对应端口
stepsEn: Click + beside Sessions in the left sidebar (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → New project) and choose SSH, Docker container, or WSL
Pick a saved connection or import a host from ~/.ssh/config, enter credentials (password, key, certificate, or jump host), and test the connection
Browse and select the target project folder to open the remote workspace
Edit files, run terminals, and collaborate with agents natively on the remote host; ask the agent to forward ports whenever you need local browser access
agentExamplesZh: 看看远端服务器现在监听了哪些开发端口，帮我把 3000 端口转发到本机
在当前远程工作区运行测试套件，定位失败用例并直接修复
帮我连接一个新的 SSH 远程工作区
agentExamplesEn: Check which dev ports are listening on the remote host and forward port 3000 to my machine
Run the test suite in this remote workspace, find the failing case, and fix it
Open remote-project setup so I can connect an SSH workspace
capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧边栏「会话」旁点击 +（添加项目）或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K → 新建项目 → 选择 SSH / 容器 / WSL
capabilities.entryPathEn: Click + beside Sessions in the left sidebar (or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → New project) → Choose SSH, Container, or WSL
scenariosZh: 轻薄本算力有限或缺少 GPU 时，直接连上云端开发机或实验室服务器编译大型 Rust / C++ / 深度学习项目
服务运行在远端容器的内网端口（如 3000 或 8080），让智能体自动建立端口转发，在本机浏览器直接打开调试
在 Windows 电脑上直接使用 WSL 里的原生 Linux 工具链开发，无需手动来回同步两套文件系统
scenariosEn: Develop heavy Rust, C++, or GPU workloads on a cloud VM or lab server without taxing your laptop
Ask the agent to forward a dev server running on a remote container port so you can preview it on localhost
Work natively inside a Linux WSL distribution on Windows without copying files across filesystems
tipsZh: 绝不静默回退本机：如果 SSH 断线或远端缺少命令，OpenBitFun 会明确提示连接或环境状态，绝不会把远端路径当成本机路径误操作。
善用 ~/.ssh/config：已在系统 SSH 配置里写好的 Host 别名、ProxyJump 跳板链和 IdentityFile 可直接识别复用，省去重复填表。
本机专属能力边界：远程工作区使用 POSIX 路径，不支持本机文件管理器「打开所在文件夹」以及聊天框 @ 选择本机 MCP 服务。
tipsEn: No silent local fallback: if SSH drops or a command is missing remotely, OpenBitFun surfaces a clear error rather than running against your local disk.
Reuse ~/.ssh/config: host aliases, ProxyJump chains, and IdentityFile entries in your SSH config are discovered automatically.
Clear local boundaries: remote workspaces use POSIX paths and intentionally disable local OS file-manager reveal and local @ MCP server picking.

capabilities.titleZh: Remote Connect 远控与多设备互控
capabilities.summaryZh: 离开工位也能用手机网页，或接入微信、飞书、Telegram 中的聊天机器人查看对话进度、审批权限并继续指挥；同账号多台电脑还能开启 Peer Device Mode，在一个窗口里直接切换操作另一台机器的工作区与会话。
capabilities.summaryEn: Follow sessions, approve permissions, and keep working from Mobile Web or a WeChat, Feishu, or Telegram bot—or enter Peer Device Mode to browse and drive another same-account computer right from your current OpenBitFun window.
highlightsZh: 手机扫码即连：官方 Relay 免部署开箱即用，桌面端还可同时开启局域网 Relay
接入微信、飞书或 Telegram 机器人，在常用聊天软件里收发进度与批复权限
同账号多设备互控（Peer Mode）：左侧边栏直接展开另一台电脑的项目与会话
智能体可直接帮你启停远控渠道、生成微信扫码登录并查看监听状态
highlightsEn: Scan to connect from phone: zero-setup official Relay plus optional concurrent Desktop LAN Relay
Pair a WeChat, Feishu, or Telegram bot to chat and approve permissions from your messenger
Same-account Peer Device Mode: expand and operate another computer’s workspaces right in your sidebar
Ask the agent directly to start/stop channels, launch WeChat QR login, or inspect listener health

items.titleZh: 本机可被控制
items.titleEn: Allow control of this device
items.descriptionZh: 在设备与连接的概览中切换。关闭后，本机显示为离线，仍可控制其他在线设备。
items.descriptionEn: Switch this in the Devices & Connections overview. When off, this device appears offline and can still control other online devices.

control.reasonZh: 请在当前设备的「设备与连接」概览中切换「本机可被控制」，选择其他设备能否连接这台设备。
control.reasonEn: Choose “Allow control of this device” in the local Devices & Connections overview to set whether other devices can connect to this one.

items.titleZh: 使用免部署官方 Relay 或桌面端局域网 Relay（可同时开启）
items.titleEn: Use the zero-setup official Relay or Desktop LAN Relay concurrently
items.descriptionZh: 外网出门走官方加密中继即开即用，内网高速互连可同时打开桌面端局域网 Relay；首次身份认证均需联网登录。
items.descriptionEn: Use the official Relay anywhere with zero server setup, and optionally run the Desktop LAN Relay alongside it on local networks (sign-in requires internet access).

control.reasonZh: 「使用免部署官方 Relay 或桌面端局域网 Relay（可同时开启）」需要结合你当前的网络环境确认连接入口；官方 Relay 开箱即用，私有 Relay 仅面向配套定制客户端构建，界面不提供自定义服务器地址输入。
control.reasonEn: "Use the zero-setup official Relay or Desktop LAN Relay concurrently" depends on your current network setup and host confirmation; the official Relay needs no deployment, while private Relays require matching custom builds rather than a custom URL field.

items.titleZh: 一键启动、停用远控渠道并查看实时连接与设备信息
items.titleEn: Start or stop Remote Connect channels and inspect live connection status
items.descriptionZh: 无论是手机网页远控还是各平台机器人，都能随时独立启停并查看监听状态、配对情况与异常提示，停用不会清空历史会话。
items.descriptionEn: Start or stop Mobile Web and individual bots independently while inspecting live listener state, pairing status, and recovery hints without losing sessions.

items.titleZh: 查看本机局域网地址、网络网卡状态与扫码邀请链接
items.titleEn: Inspect LAN IP addresses, network interfaces, and shareable QR invitations
items.descriptionZh: 直观展示当前可用局域网 IP 与二维码邀请卡片；二维码仅用于引导识别目标主机，仍需账号权限校验才可访问。
items.descriptionEn: View available LAN IPs and invitation QR cards; scanning identifies the host while still enforcing full account authorization.

control.reasonZh: 「查看本机局域网地址、网络网卡状态与扫码邀请链接」涉及查看本机实时网卡地址与屏幕上展示邀请二维码供手机扫描；智能体会为你直接打开「设备与连接」中的「手机或浏览器」连接面板。
control.reasonEn: "Inspect LAN IP addresses, network interfaces, and shareable QR invitations" involves inspecting live network interfaces and displaying a visual QR invitation for your phone; the Agent opens the Phone or browser panel in Devices & Connections directly for you.

items.titleZh: 接入微信扫码、飞书或 Telegram 聊天机器人（每次连接一个聊天应用，与手机远控并行不悖）
items.titleEn: Connect a WeChat (QR login), Feishu, or Telegram bot alongside Mobile Web
items.descriptionZh: 支持微信扫码登录或从本机私有凭据文件加载飞书 / Telegram 配置；同一主机一次连接一个聊天应用（切换前先断开当前机器人，与「手机或浏览器」远控互不影响），凭据安全保存在执行主机。
items.descriptionEn: Launch WeChat QR login in chat or load Feishu/Telegram configs from a private host file—one chat app stays connected at a time (disconnect before switching, while Mobile/Browser Relay runs independently alongside it), and credentials never enter model context.

items.titleZh: 通过 GitHub 或邮箱验证码登录账号并查看身份状态
items.titleEn: Sign in with GitHub or an email verification code and check account status
items.descriptionZh: 统一承载多设备发现、手机远控与 Pages 发布的身份认证，随时查看当前登录账号或安全退出。
items.descriptionEn: Powers device discovery, mobile remote control, and Pages publishing through one account sign-in flow, with clear status and sign-out controls.

control.reasonZh: 登录必须由用户在外部认证页面完成。GitHub 与邮箱是独立账号，各设备需使用同一种方式和同一账号；旧客户端或服务可能仅支持 GitHub。智能体可打开入口并读取非秘密状态，不能代替用户认证。
control.reasonEn: The user must complete sign-in on the external authentication page. GitHub and email are independent accounts; devices need the same method and account. Older clients or services may support GitHub only. The Agent may open the entry and read non-secret status, but cannot authenticate for the user.

items.titleZh: 查看同账号在线设备、系统型号、自定义设备别名与移除旧设备
items.titleEn: Browse same-account devices, OS/model info, custom aliases, and device removal
items.descriptionZh: 在首页「设备」栏或设备管理弹窗查看所有关联机器的在线状态与平台图标，给常用机器起个顺口别名（如“办公室台式机”）。
items.descriptionEn: See every linked machine’s online status and OS badge on Home or in Device Management, set friendly display aliases, and remove retired devices.

control.reasonZh: 「查看同账号在线设备、系统型号、自定义设备别名与移除旧设备」需要核对控制端账户下的具体设备并确认别名修改或移除操作（若只想让智能体列出可用设备，可直接调用远程派发的列出目标能力）。
control.reasonEn: "Browse same-account devices, OS/model info, custom aliases, and device removal" requires selecting a specific device under the controller account and confirming alias edits or removal (to simply read the device list in chat, use list-targets on Detached Dispatch).

items.titleZh: 开启 Peer Device Mode，在当前窗口无缝接管另一台电脑的工作区
items.titleEn: Use Peer Device Mode to operate another computer’s workspaces in your current window
items.descriptionZh: 无需远程桌面推流画面——本地保留丝滑原生界面，文件、会话、命令和实时事件直接由对端桌面或 CLI 主机驱动。
items.descriptionEn: No laggy screen-sharing video: keep a crisp local UI shell while workspaces, sessions, commands, and live events stream directly from the peer Desktop or CLI host.

control.reasonZh: 「开启 Peer Device Mode，在当前窗口无缝接管另一台电脑的工作区」会切换当前窗口所绑定的远端主机数据面，需要你在侧边栏或设备面板明确点击目标设备确认切换。
control.reasonEn: "Use Peer Device Mode to operate another computer’s workspaces in your current window" switches the active window’s live data plane to another host and requires an explicit device selection in the sidebar or device switcher.

stepsZh: 点击左下角设备状态按钮打开「管理设备」（即「设备与连接」弹窗），先在「概览」或「我的设备」中登录账号；登录后左侧会显示「手机或浏览器」与「聊天应用」
手机或跨电脑互控：在两台设备使用同一种方式（同为 GitHub 或同为邮箱验证码）登录同一账号；官方 Relay 无需额外部署
手机远控可在「手机或浏览器」中扫描官方或桌面局域网邀请二维码并确认目标设备；跨电脑互控直接在左侧边栏展开对应设备即可进入 Peer Mode
机器人远控：在「聊天应用」选择微信扫码（或加载飞书 / Telegram 凭据配置），把返回的配对码发给机器人完成绑定
stepsEn: Click the bottom-left device status control → Manage devices to open Devices & Connections, and sign in under Overview or My devices; once signed in, Phone or browser and Chat apps appear in the dialog sidebar
For mobile or cross-computer control, sign in on every device using the exact same login method (GitHub or email code) and account; the official Relay works out of the box
On mobile, scan the official or LAN invitation QR under Phone or browser and confirm the host; on another computer, simply expand that device in the left sidebar to enter Peer Device Mode
For IM bots, open Chat apps to scan the WeChat QR (or supply your Feishu / Telegram bot config) and send the pairing code to the bot chat to finish linking
agentExamplesZh: 开启手机网页远控，我想在手机上接着看进度
帮我启动微信机器人登录二维码，配好消息监听
查看当前远控和机器人的运行状态
暂时停用 Telegram 机器人，保留已有配置
agentExamplesEn: Enable Mobile Web remote control so I can follow this session from my phone
Start WeChat bot QR login and set up message listening
Check the current Remote Connect and bot status
Stop the Telegram bot for now while keeping its configuration

operations.descriptionZh: 读取当前执行主机的监听、配对、停用与恢复错误；不返回凭据，监听任务存活不等于消息已完成往返。
operations.descriptionEn: Read listener, pairing, disabled and restore-error state on the executing host without credentials. A live listener task does not prove a message round trip.

operations.descriptionZh: 启动指定机器人或手机网页远控。CLI 自动启动 daemon，退出当前聊天后继续监听。新机器人需将返回的配对码发给机器人；CLI 不支持局域网 Relay。
operations.descriptionEn: Start the selected bot or Mobile Web. CLI starts its daemon and keeps listening after this chat exits. Send the returned pairing code to a new bot. CLI does not host a LAN Relay.

operations.descriptionZh: 停用选定渠道并保留配置和会话。机器人停用状态跨重启保留。关闭手机网页会同时断开该主机的 Peer 设备路由，机器人保持运行。
operations.descriptionEn: Stop the selected channel while retaining configuration and sessions. Bot disablement survives restart. Stopping Mobile Web also disconnects Peer routing on this host; bots keep running.

operations.titleZh: 从主机凭据文件配置机器人
operations.titleEn: Configure a bot from a private host credential file
operations.descriptionZh: 读取执行主机上用户提供的私有 JSON 凭据文件并保存配置；不会自动启动。文件包含 bot_type 和对应凭据字段，需绝对路径和仅所有者可读权限；不要把凭据贴到聊天中。远程工作区路径不能用作主机凭据路径。
operations.descriptionEn: Load a user-supplied private JSON BotConfig file on the executing host, with bot_type and provider credential fields; save without starting. Requires an absolute host path and owner-only permissions. Do not paste credentials into chat or use a remote-workspace path.

operations.descriptionZh: 生成微信登录二维码。CLI TUI 在工具卡片中直接显示 qrTerminal，无需模型重写；其他终端逐字显示，图形界面显示 qrImageUrl，再用 sessionKey 轮询。扫码本身尚未完成机器人监听和配对。
operations.descriptionEn: Create a WeChat login QR. CLI TUI renders qrTerminal in the tool card without model transcription; other terminals show it verbatim and graphical surfaces show qrImageUrl. Poll using sessionKey; scanning alone does not complete listening and pairing.

operations.titleZh: 完成微信登录并启动监听
operations.titleEn: Complete WeChat login and start listening
operations.descriptionZh: 轮询同一登录会话。确认后在主机保存凭据并启动监听，向用户展示返回的机器人配对码。凭据不会返回给模型。
operations.descriptionEn: Poll the same login session. Confirmation saves credentials on the host and starts listening; show the returned bot pairing code. Credentials are never returned to the model.

operations.descriptionZh: 切换所有机器人的详细输出模式并保存。
operations.descriptionEn: Persist verbose output mode for all bot channels.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 左侧边栏左下角点击设备状态按钮 → 管理设备（设备与连接）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Click the device status button at the bottom-left of the sidebar → Manage devices (Devices & Connections)
scenariosZh: 在工位发起复杂改码任务后下楼买咖啡，用手机网页或微信机器人实时看输出、点一下放行命令权限
家里 MacBook 想接着推进公司台式机上没关的会话：同账号登录后直接在左侧边栏点开公司电脑（Peer Mode），像本机一样无缝续聊
在常驻开发机上用 CLI 启动机器人监听（自动拉起后台 daemon），退出终端后依然全天候响应你的飞书或微信指令
scenariosEn: Step away from your desk while a refactor runs, then check progress and approve tool permissions from your phone or WeChat
Open your laptop at home and switch to your office desktop via Peer Device Mode in the sidebar to continue an open session in place
Start a Feishu or Telegram bot from the CLI (backed by the background daemon) so your workstation stays reachable after closing the terminal
tipsZh: 四种远程模式一秒分清：① 代码在服务器、窗口在本机 → 选「远程工作区」；② 用手机或微信遥控当前电脑 → 选「Remote Connect」；③ 用电脑 A 窗口直接操作电脑 B → 选「Peer Mode」；④ 把任务派给别处跑完再同步、本机直接合盖离线 → 选「Detached Dispatch」。
统一登录方式：GitHub 与邮箱验证码对应两套独立账户，多设备互认时请确保两端都用同一种方式登录。
保持被控主机在线：手机远控与 Peer Mode 都直接读取目标主机的实时流（中继服务器不存聊天记录），建议在桌面端「通用设置」开启「阻止系统睡眠」。
tipsEn: Which remote mode fits? ① Code on SSH server, UI here → Remote Workspaces; ② Phone or IM bot driving an online host → Remote Connect; ③ Computer A operating Computer B live → Peer Device Mode; ④ Hand off a job and close your laptop → Detached Dispatch.
Keep sign-in methods consistent: GitHub and email-code logins create separate accounts—use the same method across all your devices.
Keep the host awake: Mobile Web and Peer Mode stream directly from the online host (the Relay stores zero chat history); enable Prevent system sleep in General settings for unattended use.

capabilities.summaryZh: 把耗时的编码、测试或重构任务从当前 Git 工作区派发到另一台同账号设备或 SSH 主机执行。提交后你可以直接合上电脑离开——目标机器在独立 Worktree 中持续跑完并保存完整事件流，重连后随时回看进度、远程批复权限或把代码同步回来。
capabilities.summaryEn: Send long-running coding, test, or refactoring jobs from your current Git workspace to another same-account device or SSH host. Close your laptop right after submitting—the target runs in an isolated Git worktree, records every event, and lets you answer permissions or sync changes back whenever you reconnect.
highlightsZh: 可选择已配置的 SSH 主机派发任务，智能体也可派发到同账号设备
提交后控制端可随时断网或休眠，目标机在独立 Git Worktree 自治执行
断线重连后按游标增量回填完整对话与工具轨迹，支持远程回答权限请求
任务完成后可将目标端改动安全同步回本机，绝不把本机当成脆弱的文件代理
highlightsEn: Dispatch to a configured SSH host, or ask the Agent to dispatch to a same-account device
Disconnect or close your laptop freely while the target works in an isolated Git worktree
Replay missed events incrementally by cursor on reconnect and answer pending permissions remotely
Sync completed changes back cleanly without turning your controller into a fragile file proxy

items.titleZh: 列出同账号下的所有设备与本机已保存的 SSH 目标
items.titleEn: List same-account devices and saved SSH dispatch targets
items.descriptionZh: 一次看清哪些同账号电脑当前在线（含系统与机型信息）以及哪些 SSH 主机可直接投递任务。
items.descriptionEn: See every device on your account—with live online status, OS, and model info—alongside saved SSH hosts ready to accept jobs.

items.titleZh: 在派发前按需将任务所选的模型配置同步给目标主机
items.titleEn: Sync required model configuration to the target before job submission
items.descriptionZh: 确保远端机器拥有执行本次任务所需的模型通道配置，避免任务启动后才发现远端没配模型。
items.descriptionEn: Ensure the target host has the model configuration needed for your task before the run begins.

control.reasonZh: 「在派发前按需将任务所选的模型配置同步给目标主机」需要核对目标端缺失的模型配置并由你确认跨机同步；智能体会打开派发准备入口保留可见确认。
control.reasonEn: "Sync required model configuration to the target before job submission" requires reviewing missing model settings on the target and confirming cross-host sync; the Agent opens the dispatch preparation UI for your review.

items.titleZh: 从当前 Git 工作区向设备或 SSH 目标提交可离线运行的持久任务
items.titleEn: Submit a durable Git-worktree job to a same-account device or SSH target
items.descriptionZh: 基于当前仓库基准提交在目标机创建隔离 Worktree 启动任务，明确指定审批策略后即可放心断线。
items.descriptionEn: Branch an isolated Git worktree from your current base ref on the target host, set an explicit approval policy, and let the job run unattended.

items.titleZh: 查看本机或目标机持有的派发任务列表、实时进度与错误详情
items.titleEn: List dispatched jobs and inspect live status, incremental events, and errors
items.descriptionZh: 既能查本机投递出去的所有任务，也能直接询问目标机器当前正在跑哪些任务及其最新增量输出。
items.descriptionEn: Check all jobs submitted from this machine or query a target directly for the jobs it owns, including cursor-based event updates.

items.titleZh: 断线重连后自动保存、追加并完整恢复任务对话记录
items.titleEn: Save, append, and reload reconnectable job execution transcripts
items.descriptionZh: 控制端关机或切网期间产生的每一轮思考与工具输出都会由目标端持久记录，重连后无缝回填到会话界面。
items.descriptionEn: Every model turn and tool output produced while you were offline stays persisted on the target and streams back cleanly when you reopen the session.

control.reasonZh: 「断线重连后自动保存、追加并完整恢复任务对话记录」由会话界面随重连游标自动回填与持久化同步；智能体会直接为你打开对应的派发会话视图查看完整上下文。
control.reasonEn: "Save, append, and reload reconnectable job execution transcripts" is synchronized automatically with resumable cursors in the session view; the Agent opens the dispatched session so you can inspect the full transcript.

items.titleZh: 远程批复目标端等待中的权限请求并继续推进任务
items.titleEn: Answer pending target-side permission requests remotely and continue work
items.descriptionZh: 当远程任务遇到需要人工确认的高风险命令时，会在权限信箱中挂起等待，你在本机点一下允许即可让远端接着往下跑。
items.descriptionEn: When a remote job pauses on a guarded action in Remote approval mode, review and approve it from your controller to resume execution immediately.

control.reasonZh: 「远程批复目标端等待中的权限请求并继续推进任务」需要你逐条审阅待授权的操作内容与后续补充指令；智能体会定位到该会话的审批界面交由你拍板。
control.reasonEn: "Answer pending target-side permission requests remotely and continue work" requires your explicit review of each guarded operation and any follow-up instructions; the Agent opens the session approval prompt for your decision.

items.titleZh: 随时远程取消本机派发的正在运行任务
items.titleEn: Cancel an active dispatch job submitted from this host
items.descriptionZh: 发现方向不对或不再需要时一键叫停，目标端会安全终止进程并保留已产生的执行记录供排查。
items.descriptionEn: Stop a dispatched run cleanly whenever plans change—the target halts execution while keeping the recorded history intact.

items.titleZh: 将目标机完成的代码改动安全同步回本机工作区
items.titleEn: Sync completed target-side code changes back to your local workspace
items.descriptionZh: 目标机全程在自己的本地磁盘高速编译读写，完工后再按需把分支或改动同步回你的电脑审阅合并。
items.descriptionEn: Let the target machine compile and edit at full native disk speed, then bring the resulting changes back to your local repo when ready.

control.reasonZh: 「将目标机完成的代码改动安全同步回本机工作区」涉及对比本机当前分支状态与确认合并方式；智能体会打开派发结果同步入口，确保不会意外覆盖你未保存的本地改动。
control.reasonEn: "Sync completed target-side code changes back to your local workspace" involves checking local working-tree state and confirming how changes land; the Agent opens the result-sync flow so local edits are never overwritten.

stepsZh: 先在 SSH 目标上安装兼容的 OpenBitFun CLI，并保存 SSH 连接。
在聊天输入框底部点击「本机」，选择 SSH 主机。要派发到同账号设备时，直接告诉智能体目标设备和任务。
发送任务后，目标主机会同步所需的模型配置，并在独立的 Git worktree 中执行任务。
执行期间可随时离线；重新打开会话即可查看最新进度、批复等待中的权限，完成后一键将结果同步回本机工作区
stepsEn: Install a compatible OpenBitFun CLI on the SSH target and save its SSH connection.
Select an SSH host from the This computer menu in the composer. To use a same-account device, ask the Agent to dispatch your task to that device.
Submit the task. The target syncs the required model configuration and runs the job in a dedicated Git worktree.
Disconnect anytime; reopen the session later to catch up on streamed events, approve pending permissions, or sync finished changes back locally
agentExamplesZh: 帮我看看现在有哪些在线设备和 SSH 主机可以派发任务？
把“跑通集成测试并修复报错”派发到我的办公室 Mac 上运行
查一下刚才派发的任务跑到哪一步了
取消刚才派发出去的那个远程任务
agentExamplesEn: Which of my devices and SSH hosts are available for dispatching tasks right now?
Dispatch "run the integration tests and fix any failures" to my office Mac
Check the latest status of the job I just dispatched
Cancel the dispatch job I submitted earlier

operations.descriptionZh: 读取同账户下所有 OpenBitFun 设备（含本机，带 isCurrentDevice 标记、在线状态、型号与系统）以及本机已保存的 SSH 连接。回答“有几台设备”或派发前先调用；未登录账户时 devices 为空并说明原因。
operations.descriptionEn: Read every OpenBitFun device on this account (including this one, marked isCurrentDevice, with online state, model and OS) plus this host's saved SSH connections. Call it before stating how many devices exist or before submitting; when signed out, devices is empty with a reason.

operations.descriptionZh: 把任务提交到另一台同账户设备（名称、别名或 device:<id>）或 SSH 目标（ssh:<connectionId>）。目标在自己的 Git worktree 中从 baseRef（默认 HEAD）开始执行，本机可以断开。仅在用户明确要求派发时调用，并明确选择 approvalPolicy；离线设备直接报错，不会在本机执行。
operations.descriptionEn: Submit work to another same-account device (name, alias, or device:<id>) or SSH target (ssh:<connectionId>). The target runs in its own Git worktree branched from baseRef (default HEAD) and this host may disconnect. Call only when the user asked to dispatch, and choose approvalPolicy explicitly; an offline device is an error, never a local run.

operations.descriptionZh: 按 jobId 读取本机派发任务的状态与增量事件；cursor 传上次返回值以只取新事件。
operations.descriptionEn: Read state and incremental events of a job submitted from this host; pass the previous cursor to read only new events.

operations.descriptionZh: 不带 target 时列出本机提交过的任务；带 target 时直接询问该目标正在持有的任务。
operations.descriptionEn: Without target, list jobs submitted from this host; with target, ask that target for the jobs it owns.

operations.descriptionZh: 取消本机提交的指定任务；目标端停止执行并保留记录。
operations.descriptionEn: Cancel a job submitted from this host; the target stops it and keeps its record.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 聊天输入框底部「这个任务在哪运行」目标菜单（默认显示「本机」芯片），或左下角设备状态按钮 → 管理设备
capabilities.entryPathEn: Run-target menu ("Where this task runs", default chip "This computer") at the bottom of the chat input, or Bottom-left Device Menu → Manage devices
scenariosZh: 临近下班要把全量测试修绿：在输入框切到办公室常开主机一键派发，直接合上笔记本去坐地铁，到家打开就能验收改动
本机正在录制演示或跑高负载构建，把另一个耗时的模块迁移任务派发给空闲的 Mac Studio 或远程 Linux 主机并行处理
在命令行用 `openbitfun dispatch outbound submit` 批量向远端机器投递巡检或修复任务，随时按 Job ID 查询增量状态
scenariosEn: Heading out for the evening? Dispatch a full test-and-fix run to your always-on office workstation, shut your laptop lid, and review the finished diff from home
Keep your primary machine responsive during demos or heavy builds by offloading a parallel module migration to a spare Mac or Linux server
Use `openbitfun dispatch outbound submit` in scripts or terminal workflows to queue durable jobs and poll incremental JSON status by job ID
tipsZh: 目标离线会明确报错：当指定设备不在线时，OpenBitFun 会立即提示不可达，绝不会静默改在本机偷偷运行。
提示词尽量一次说清：后台派发运行在无交互宿主上，不支持中途弹出多选追问（AskUserQuestion），把约束和偏好写在开头最稳妥。
防无限套娃保护：已经由远程派发启动的任务可以查询状态，但不会再次向外层层派发新任务。
tipsEn: Explicit offline errors: if the chosen target is offline, OpenBitFun fails clearly instead of silently running the job on your local machine.
Front-load key decisions: headless dispatch jobs disable interactive AskUserQuestion prompts, so include branch, scope, and constraints right in your prompt.
No nested fan-out loops: a running dispatch worker can report status cleanly but is prevented from recursively dispatching further jobs.

capabilities.summaryZh: 不用买服务器、不用配繁琐的部署流水线——把智能体生成的交互网页、产品原型、数据报告或个人作品集直接发布成在线链接，自由控制公开或私密访问权限，每次更新自动保存历史版本，随时一键回滚或下线。
capabilities.summaryEn: Skip server setup and CI pipelines—publish AI-built webpages, interactive prototypes, reports, or portfolios to a live URL in seconds. Control public or private visibility, keep immutable version history on every save, and roll back or unpublish anytime.
highlightsZh: 一句话把本地或刚生成的 HTML 网页打包保存并发布到专属在线地址
三级访问权限随心切：仅自己可见（private）、登录用户可见（relay）或完全公开（public）
每次修改都会生成不可变历史版本，可先保存预览、确认后再切流量上线，随时一键回退旧版
支持随时取消发布（保留历史版本备查）或彻底删除单个版本与整个页面
highlightsEn: Turn any generated or workspace webpage bundle into a hosted URL right from chat or the Pages manager
Switch visibility anytime between Private (only you), Relay (signed-in users), and Public (anyone with the link)
Every save records an immutable version—stage updates safely before deploying live, and roll back in one click
Unpublish a Page to take it offline without losing history, or delete specific versions when cleaning up

items.titleZh: 列出账号下全部已发布与未发布的 Pages 及其状态、权限和链接
items.titleEn: List all published and unpublished Pages with their URLs, visibility, and timestamps
items.descriptionZh: 一句话就能盘点你名下托管了哪些页面、当前对外是谁可见、最后一次更新在什么时候。
items.descriptionEn: See every Page under your account—including unpublished drafts, live URLs, access levels, and last-updated times.

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=list 列出已发布页面的名称、URL、权限和更新时间；published_only=false 包含未发布页面
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=list for published Page names, URLs, visibility and update times; published_only=false includes unpublished Pages

items.titleZh: 每次保存自动生成不可变历史版本，随时翻阅完整版本记录
items.titleEn: Save immutable Page versions automatically and browse full version history
items.descriptionZh: 不用担心改坏了找不回来——每一次内容提交都对应独立版本号，历史脉络清清楚楚。
items.descriptionEn: Every content update creates an immutable snapshot with its own version ID so earlier iterations are never lost.

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=publish/update 保存完整内容为新版本，action=versions 查看版本历史
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=publish/update to save complete content as a new version, and action=versions for history

items.titleZh: 保存、发布网页或将任意历史版本一键重新部署上线
items.titleEn: Publish or deploy a selected Page version live
items.descriptionZh: 既可以把刚写好的新页面直接上线，也能在多个历史版本之间随时无缝切换线上生产版本。
items.descriptionEn: Launch a brand-new Page to production or promote any existing saved version to become the live version instantly.

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=publish/update 保存内容；仅用户要求上线时设置 deploy=true；action=deploy 切换到已有版本
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=publish/update to save content, set deploy=true only when requested, and action=deploy to promote an existing version

items.titleZh: 灵活修改页面标题，并在私密、登录可见与公开之间随时切换
items.titleEn: Update Page titles and switch between private, signed-in, and public visibility
items.descriptionZh: 内部初稿先设 `private` 自己看，团队评审改 `relay` 登录可看，正式对外再切 `public` 公开分享，链接地址保持不变。
items.descriptionEn: Keep early drafts Private, open them to signed-in users via Relay, or make them Public when ready—all without changing your Page slug.

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=update 修改标题，action=permissions 将访问权限设置为 private、relay 或 public
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=update for the title and action=permissions to set private, relay or public visibility

items.titleZh: 一键生成并打开可分享的在线访问链接
items.titleEn: Create and open a shareable access link for any Page
items.descriptionZh: 在 Pages 管理界面中直接打开预览或复制分享地址发给协作者，支持带登录态的安全跳转。
items.descriptionEn: Open your hosted Page directly in the browser or copy a clean share link from the Pages manager.

control.reasonZh: 「一键生成并打开可分享的在线访问链接」涉及在当前客户端生成带会话上下文的打开链接或复制到剪贴板；智能体会为你打开 Pages 管理页（公开链接也可直接通过列表读取）。
control.reasonEn: "Create and open a shareable access link for any Page" generates an openable session link or copies it in the UI; the Agent opens the Pages scene so you can launch or share it directly.

items.titleZh: 随时一键下线已发布的页面，同时完好保留所有历史版本
items.titleEn: Unpublish a live Page offline while keeping all saved versions intact
items.descriptionZh: 活动结束或链接不想再让人访问？取消发布即可立即关闭外部访问，需要时随时能原样重新上线。
items.descriptionEn: Take a Page offline immediately when a campaign or review ends while keeping every saved version ready to republish later.

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=unpublish 下线页面并保留已保存版本
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=unpublish to take a Page offline while retaining saved versions

items.titleZh: 按需清理单个冗余历史版本，或彻底删除整个 Page
items.titleEn: Delete an individual old version or remove an entire Page permanently
items.descriptionZh: 既支持只删掉某次测试草稿版本，也支持把不再需要的整个页面干净移除。
items.descriptionEn: Prune a single scratch version by version ID or delete the whole Page when you no longer need it.

workflowZh: 使用 PageManage action=delete 删除整个页面；提供 version_id 时仅删除该版本
workflowEn: Use PageManage action=delete to delete a Page, or supply version_id to delete only that version

stepsZh: 先点击左下角设备状态按钮 →「管理设备」（设备与连接），在「概览」或「我的设备」中登录 OpenBitFun 账号（支持 GitHub 或邮箱验证码；CLI 用户可执行 `/login`）
在对话中直接告诉智能体要发布或更新的页面内容与可见性（例如“把这个网页发布成公开 Page”），或按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 搜索 `Pages` 打开可视化管理页
在 Pages 管理页（或智能体返回结果中）获取可分享链接、浏览历史版本列表、修改页面标题与访问权限，或随时切换线上版本与下线
stepsEn: Click the bottom-left Device Menu → Manage devices (Devices & Connections) and sign in under Overview or My devices with GitHub or an email code (or `/login` in the CLI)
Ask the agent in chat to publish or update your page (e.g., "Publish this HTML prototype as a public Page"), or press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and search "Pages" to open the visual manager
Copy shareable links, browse version history, change titles or public/private access, promote an earlier version, or unpublish anytime
agentExamplesZh: 把当前目录里的演示网页发布成公开 Page，把链接发给我
列出我账号下所有已发布和未发布的 Pages
把产品原型那个 Page 的访问权限改成仅自己可见
把这个 Page 回滚到上一个历史版本上线
agentExamplesEn: Publish this demo webpage as a public Page and give me the link
List all published and unpublished Pages under my account
Change my prototype Page visibility to private
Deploy the previous saved version of this Page
capabilities.entryPathZh: 按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K 打开全局搜索 → 输入「Pages」打开管理页，或直接在会话里让智能体帮你发布和管理
capabilities.entryPathEn: Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K → Search "Pages" to open the Pages manager, or ask the agent directly in chat to publish and manage Pages
scenariosZh: 刚让 AI 做好一个新功能交互原型或活动落地页，直接说“发布成公开 Page 给我链接”，立刻发到群里让同事点开体验
整理了一份团队内部复盘报告，发布为「仅自己可见」或「登录用户可见」，在手机或另一台电脑上随时安全查阅
已经上线的活动页需要改文案：先让 AI 保存一个新版本检查无误，再一键切换为线上正式版；万一写错秒切回上一版
scenariosEn: Just built a clickable prototype or landing page in chat? Ask the agent to publish it and share the live link with teammates immediately
Host an internal technical memo with Private or Signed-in visibility so you can read it across devices without exposing it publicly
Save a revised version of a live Page first, verify everything looks right, and promote that version to production—with instant rollback if needed
tipsZh: 怎么打开 Pages 管理界面？当前版本默认隐藏了左侧边栏的固定图标，按 `⌘K`（Windows/Linux 按 `Ctrl+K`）输入 `Pages` 即可秒开，或者直接在聊天里吩咐 AI 管理更省事。
保存版本 ≠ 立即覆盖线上：AI 更新页面时默认可先保存为新版本而不立刻替换线上流量，只有你明确要求上线部署时才切换生产版本。
保持同一种登录方式：GitHub 登录与邮箱验证码登录各自独立拥有名下的 Pages，跨设备查看时请用同一方式登录。
tipsEn: Where is the Pages UI? The sidebar icon is hidden by default to keep navigation uncluttered—press ⌘K / Ctrl+K and type "Pages" to open the visual manager, or simply ask the agent in chat.
Safe staged updates: saving a new Page version does not overwrite live traffic until you explicitly deploy it, making updates stress-free.
Same sign-in method: GitHub and email-code logins maintain separate accounts—use the same login method across Desktop and CLI to see the same Pages.

capabilities.summaryZh: 提供两套互补的语音体验：平时在聊天框点一下麦克风，用本机离线模型（轻量默认的 SenseVoice 支持自动识别中英粤日韩，或下载 Qwen3-ASR 解锁 30+ 语言，录音不上传）快速把口述转成可编辑文字；想彻底解放双手时，在非会话视图点右下角 Hi 打开悬浮对话窗（或开启悬浮窗模式）并点顶部电话图标「切换到实时语音」，像打电话一样让助手跨项目跑任务并播报进展。
capabilities.summaryEn: Two complementary ways to work by voice: click the composer mic for fast, private on-device dictation (lightweight SenseVoice for Auto/ZH/Yue/EN/JA/KO, or Qwen3-ASR for 30+ languages—audio never leaves your machine), or open the floating conversation dock from the bottom-right Hi launcher on non-session views (or Floating Window mode) and click the header phone icon (Switch to realtime voice) to run project tasks hands-free.
highlightsZh: 本地离线听写：提供轻量 SenseVoice（中英粤日韩）与多语种 Qwen3-ASR（30+ 语言）两款本地模型，录音不出本机
转写文字自动填入输入框草稿，发送前可从容补充代码路径或修正术语
设置页内置麦克风选择与一键试录测速，直观查看推理耗时与识别效果
客户端级实时语音通话（右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式 → 顶部电话图标）：口述即可让助手进入项目启动/停止任务并语音播报进展
highlightsEn: Private on-device dictation: choose lightweight SenseVoice (ZH/Yue/EN/JA/KO) or Qwen3-ASR (30+ languages) so audio never uploads
Transcribed text lands right in your chat draft so you can review or tweak terms before hitting send
Built-in microphone picker and live recognition test in Settings showing exact inference timing
Client-wide realtime voice calls (bottom-right Hi dock or Floating Window mode → header phone icon): talk naturally to launch or stop project tasks and hear spoken updates

items.titleZh: 在聊天输入框一键开始、完成或取消语音听写录音
items.titleEn: Start, finish, or cancel voice dictation right from the chat composer
items.descriptionZh: 点一下麦克风开口就说，说错了或不想发了可随时取消，不会误触发消息发送。
items.descriptionEn: Click the mic icon in the chat input to speak—finish to transcribe into your draft, or cancel anytime without sending.

control.reasonZh: 「在聊天输入框一键开始、完成或取消语音听写录音」需要你亲自对着麦克风说话并控制录音起止；智能体会为你打开语音设置或引导使用输入框麦克风按钮。
control.reasonEn: "Start, finish, or cancel voice dictation right from the chat composer" requires live microphone speaking and user-timed start/stop control; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can enable and use the composer mic.

items.titleZh: 录音期间实时分块采集音频并直观展示准备与识别状态
items.titleEn: Stream audio chunks during recording with live preparation and transcription status
items.descriptionZh: 边说边处理音频流，结束录音瞬间即可快速出字，状态提示清楚不卡顿。
items.descriptionEn: Audio feeds smoothly while you speak so transcription finishes briskly with clear visual status.

control.reasonZh: 「录音期间实时分块采集音频并直观展示准备与识别状态」随聊天输入框的实时录音会话自动工作；智能体会打开语音配置入口方便你检查麦克风与模型就绪状态。
control.reasonEn: "Stream audio chunks during recording with live preparation and transcription status" runs automatically during an active composer recording; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can verify model and mic readiness.

items.titleZh: 从右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式切换到实时语音通话，边聊边让助手跨项目执行或停止任务
items.titleEn: Switch to a client-wide realtime voice call from the Hi dock or Floating Window mode to run or stop project tasks
items.descriptionZh: 在非会话页点右下角 Hi（或进入悬浮窗模式）再点顶部电话图标「切换到实时语音」，助手即可读懂当前客户端状态、为你启动任务并亲口播报结果。
items.descriptionEn: Open the floating dock via bottom-right Hi on non-session views (or Floating Window mode) and click the header phone icon (Switch to realtime voice)—the assistant starts sessions, flags needed approvals, and speaks concise conclusions.

control.reasonZh: 「从右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式切换到实时语音通话，边聊边让助手跨项目执行或停止任务」依赖实时麦克风收音、双向音频流与你的口头指令；智能体会打开对应入口并将通话控制与任务进展保留在可见界面。
control.reasonEn: "Switch to a client-wide realtime voice call from the Hi dock or Floating Window mode to run or stop project tasks" depends on live microphone input, streaming audio playback, and spoken commands; the Agent opens the voice setup and keeps call controls visible.

items.titleZh: 在「宠物与助手」页配置实时语音开关、火山引擎 API Key 与音色角色
items.titleEn: Configure the realtime voice assistant toggle, Volcengine API Key, and voice persona
items.descriptionZh: 填入你自己的端到端实时语音密钥与音色（默认官方 Jupiter 女声），配置自动生效且密钥仅留存在当前本机控制端。
items.descriptionEn: Set your controller-local Volcengine Realtime API Key and voice ID (defaults to Jupiter, autosaved) safely in Pet & assistant settings.

control.reasonZh: 「在「宠物与助手」页配置实时语音开关、火山引擎 API Key 与音色角色」包含私密 API Key 凭据与音色选择，必须由你在设置界面亲自填写，不会经过大模型上下文。
control.reasonEn: "Configure the realtime voice assistant toggle, Volcengine API Key, and voice persona" includes private API Key credentials and voice selection that you enter directly in Settings outside model context.

items.titleZh: 浏览、下载、校验、修复或清理 SenseVoice 与 Qwen3-ASR 本机离线语音模型
items.titleEn: Browse, download, verify, repair, or delete local SenseVoice and Qwen3-ASR speech models
items.descriptionZh: SenseVoice Small 轻快覆盖中英粤日韩，Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 解锁 30+ 语言；均支持完整性校验与修复，确保口述音频 100% 在本机识别。
items.descriptionEn: Choose lightweight SenseVoice Small (Auto + ZH/Yue/EN/JA/KO) or Qwen3-ASR 0.6B (30+ languages), with local integrity verification so dictation stays 100% offline.

control.reasonZh: 「浏览、下载、校验、修复或清理 SenseVoice 与 Qwen3-ASR 本机离线语音模型」涉及磁盘空间占用、模型下载进度与删除确认；智能体会为你打开「输入与交互 → 语音」设置页操作。
control.reasonEn: "Browse, download, verify, repair, or delete local SenseVoice and Qwen3-ASR speech models" involves disk space, live download progress, and deletion confirmation; the Agent opens Input & Interaction → Voice settings for you.

items.titleZh: 随时取消正在下载中的本地语音模型任务
items.titleEn: Cancel an in-progress local speech-model download anytime
items.descriptionZh: 网络慢或临时不想下了，点一下即可干净中断下载，不会留下损坏的半成品影响使用。
items.descriptionEn: On a slow connection or picked the wrong model? Stop an active download cleanly in one click.

control.reasonZh: 「随时取消正在下载中的本地语音模型任务」仅在模型下载进行中触发；智能体会打开语音模型管理页供你查看实时进度或点击取消。
control.reasonEn: "Cancel an in-progress local speech-model download anytime" applies while a model download is actively running; the Agent opens the Voice settings section where you can cancel it.

items.titleZh: 选择「自动」或指定识别语言，并切换当前使用的系统麦克风
items.titleEn: Choose Auto or an explicit recognition language and pick your active system microphone
items.descriptionZh: SenseVoice 支持自动与中英粤日韩，安装 Qwen3-ASR 后更可指定德、法、西、阿等 30+ 种语言，外接多只麦克风时也能精准选定收音设备。
items.descriptionEn: Use Auto or ZH/Yue/EN/JA/KO with SenseVoice—or unlock 30+ selectable languages with Qwen3-ASR—alongside explicit input-device selection.

control.reasonZh: 「选择「自动」或指定识别语言，并切换当前使用的系统麦克风」需要结合你当前插拔的音频输入硬件与口述语种偏好在界面点选；智能体会打开语音设置供你切换。
control.reasonEn: "Choose Auto or an explicit recognition language and pick your active system microphone" depends on your connected audio hardware and language preference; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can pick the right mic and language.

items.titleZh: 在设置页直接试录一段话，测试麦克风收音并查看毫秒级推理耗时
items.titleEn: Run a quick mic and recognition test in Settings with millisecond timing feedback
items.descriptionZh: 不用先去会话里发消息试错——在设置页说句话就能当场看到转写结果、推理耗时（ms）或设备报错。
items.descriptionEn: Speak a short test phrase right in Settings to verify your mic, preview transcription accuracy, and see exact inference latency in ms.

control.reasonZh: 「在设置页直接试录一段话，测试麦克风收音并查看毫秒级推理耗时」需要你现场开口试录并核对识别文本；智能体会直接定位到语音测试面板交由你体验。
control.reasonEn: "Run a quick mic and recognition test in Settings with millisecond timing feedback" requires speaking a live test phrase and checking the transcribed output; the Agent opens the Voice diagnostics section for you.

items.titleZh: 识别完成后将文字放回聊天输入框，方便补充修改后再发送
items.titleEn: Place transcribed text into the chat composer so you can edit before sending
items.descriptionZh: 口述难免有口头禅或函数名大小写想微调，转写结果总是先落在输入框里等你过目确认，绝不抢跑乱发。
items.descriptionEn: Transcriptions always land safely in your composer draft—tweak variable names, add `@file` tags, and send only when you’re ready.

control.reasonZh: 「识别完成后将文字放回聊天输入框，方便补充修改后再发送」在当前聊天输入框草稿中直接完成；录音结束后你可自由增删文字或附加文件，满意后再按发送。
control.reasonEn: "Place transcribed text into the chat composer so you can edit before sending" takes place directly inside your live chat composer draft so you can refine wording or attach files before sending.

stepsZh: 配置本地语音听写：打开「设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 输入与交互 → 语音」，按语种需求下载 SenseVoice 或 Qwen3-ASR 本地模型并开启输入框语音按钮，随后在聊天框点麦克风即可口述转文字
配置实时语音通话：打开「设置 → 应用与界面 → 宠物与助手 → 实时语音通话」，开启客户端语音助手并填写火山引擎实时语音 API Key 与音色 ID（默认 Jupiter，修改后自动生效）
发起实时通话：在首页、设置等非会话页面点击右下角的 `Hi` 按钮打开悬浮对话窗（或从左下角齿轮菜单进入「悬浮窗模式」），再点击窗口顶部电话图标「切换到实时语音」即可开口指挥，随时可静音或切回文字聊天
stepsEn: Set up local dictation: go to Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Input & Interaction → Voice, download SenseVoice or Qwen3-ASR, enable the composer mic button, and click the mic in chat to dictate

Set up realtime voice calls: go to Settings → Application & Interface → Pet & assistant → Real-time voice calls, enable the client voice assistant, and enter your Volcengine Realtime API Key and voice ID (defaults to Jupiter; changes save automatically)

Start talking: on non-session views like Home or Settings, click the bottom-right `Hi` button to open the floating dock (or enter Floating window mode from the bottom-left menu), then click the header phone icon (Switch to realtime voice) to talk, trigger or stop tasks, mute, or switch back to text chat
agentExamplesZh: 打开语音输入设置，我想下载本地听写模型
帮我打开宠物与助手设置，我想配一下实时语音通话
agentExamplesEn: Open voice-input settings so I can download a local dictation model
Take me to Pet & assistant settings to configure realtime voice calls
capabilities.entryPathZh: 语音输入：设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 输入与交互 → 语音；实时语音通话：设置 → 应用与界面 → 宠物与助手 → 实时语音通话（开启后在首页/设置等非会话页点右下角 Hi 或进入悬浮窗模式 → 顶部电话图标「切换到实时语音」）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Voice dictation: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Input & Interaction → Voice; Realtime calls: Settings → Application & Interface → Pet & assistant → Real-time voice calls (then click bottom-right Hi on non-session views or enter Floating Window mode → header phone icon "Switch to realtime voice")
scenariosZh: 要给 AI 交代一大段业务背景、复现步骤或架构想法时，懒得敲几百字——点聊天框麦克风口述完再顺手补个 `@文件` 发送，省时省力
在首页翻看资料、画白板或站着走动思考时，点开右下角 `Hi` 打开悬浮对话窗（或切到悬浮窗模式），点顶部电话图标切换到实时语音，动嘴指挥助手去跑检查并听它汇报结论
换了外接耳机或会议麦不确定收音正不正常，去「输入与交互 → 语音」点「开始测试」说句话，一秒验证麦克风与识别速度
scenariosEn: Explain a long bug reproduction or architecture idea out loud with the composer mic, attach an `@file` reference, and send in half the time

Step back from the keyboard—click `Hi` in the bottom-right corner on Home or Settings (or use Floating Window mode), tap the header phone icon to switch to realtime voice, and let the assistant run checks hands-free
Switched headsets? Run a quick 3-second test in Input & Interaction → Voice to verify your mic and see local inference latency in milliseconds
tipsZh: 两个设置入口别走错：旧版的独立语音页已按场景归位——「语音转文字（输入框麦克风）」在「输入与交互 → 语音」，「实时语音通话（右下角 Hi 悬浮窗 → 顶部电话图标）」在「宠物与助手 → 实时语音通话」。
隐私与密钥边界清晰：本地听写全程离线不上传音频；实时语音通话仅在桌面端可用，且你的火山引擎 API Key 只保存在当前控制端本机，绝不会发往远程 SSH 主机或 Peer 设备。
识别语言默认选「自动」即可：轻量模型 SenseVoice 覆盖自动及中、粤、英、日、韩，若需德、法、西、阿等 30+ 语种可下载本地 Qwen3-ASR 模型。
tipsEn: Where each setting lives now: the old standalone Voice page split cleanly into Input & Interaction → Voice (for local composer dictation) and Pet & assistant → Real-time voice calls (launched via the bottom-right `Hi` dock or Floating Window mode → header phone icon).
Clear privacy boundaries: local dictation never uploads audio; realtime voice calls are Desktop-only and keep your Volcengine API Key strictly on the local controller—never sent to SSH or Peer hosts.
SenseVoice vs Qwen3-ASR: SenseVoice Small handles Auto plus Chinese, Cantonese, English, Japanese, and Korean; download Qwen3-ASR 0.6B locally whenever you need full 30+ language dictation.

capabilities.summaryZh: 在屏幕一角养一只灵动的像素桌面伙伴，它会跟着智能体思考、写代码、等待权限确认或顺利收工实时切换神态动作——支持一键切换内置形象、导入本地 Petdex 角色包、自由缩放窗口，需要极致专注时也能随时隐藏或彻底关闭。
capabilities.summaryEn: Keep a lively pixel companion on your desktop that reacts as your agent thinks, writes code, waits for approval, or finishes work—switch built-in characters, import custom Petdex packs, resize or hide its window anytime, or disable it completely when you want zero distraction.
highlightsZh: 实时联动会话状态：空闲陪伴、思考运转、等待授权与任务完成各有生动动画反馈
内置多款预设角色，支持从本地导入自定义 Petdex 像素角色动画包
独立透明悬浮窗可自由拖动、缩放大小、随时隐藏，或一键唤回 OpenBitFun 主窗口
支持在设置中一键全局关闭，演示投屏或沉浸编码时零遮挡零打扰
highlightsEn: Reacts live to agent activity—idle, thinking, running tools, waiting for approval, and task completion
Switch among built-in pixel characters or import custom local Petdex animation packages
Draggable, resizable companion window that can hide anytime or bring the main OpenBitFun window back to focus
One-click global toggle in Settings for a completely distraction-free screen during presentations or deep focus

items.titleZh: 一键全局开启或关闭智能体桌面伙伴
items.titleEn: Enable or disable the agent desktop companion globally
items.descriptionZh: 想有人陪伴盯进度时打开，投屏汇报或沉浸写代码时一句话或一个开关即可干净收起。
items.descriptionEn: Turn your companion on whenever you want ambient status feedback, or switch it off in one click for zero screen clutter.

items.titleZh: 浏览并随时切换内置形象与已导入的 Petdex 角色
items.titleEn: Browse and switch among built-in characters and imported Petdex packs
items.descriptionZh: 查看所有可用伙伴形象，点选即可立即换装生效，无需重启客户端。
items.descriptionEn: Preview built-in and imported characters and switch your active companion instantly without restarting OpenBitFun.

items.titleZh: 在设置页导入 `.zip` 角色压缩包，或让智能体加载本机 Petdex 目录 / `.zip` 包
items.titleEn: Import a `.zip` pack in Settings, or ask an agent to load a local Petdex folder or `.zip` archive
items.descriptionZh: 设置页「导入」按钮支持直接选取 `.zip` 角色包；若你在本机解压或自制了包含精灵图与动作配置的 Petdex 目录（如 `~/petdex/pixel-fox`），直接发消息让智能体导入启用即可。
items.descriptionEn: Click Import in Settings to choose a `.zip` character archive, or ask the agent in chat to load either a `.zip` pack or an unpacked local Petdex folder on your Desktop host.

items.titleZh: 移除不再使用的自定义 Petdex 包并自动回退到可用角色
items.titleEn: Remove an imported Petdex package and fall back cleanly to an available character
items.descriptionZh: 清理旧导入包时内置角色受保护不可误删，若删除的是当前激活角色会自动无缝切回默认伙伴。
items.descriptionEn: Built-in characters stay protected, and removing the active imported pack automatically falls back to a working preset.

items.titleZh: 显示、隐藏与自由缩放独立桌面伙伴窗口，并可一键唤回主界面
items.titleEn: Show, hide, and resize the companion window, and return quickly to the main window
items.descriptionZh: 独立无边框悬浮窗支持按屏幕分辨率调大调小，主窗口最小化时点它就能快速回到工作台。
items.descriptionEn: Resize the frameless companion window to fit high-DPI or compact displays, and jump straight back to the main OpenBitFun window anytime.

control.reasonZh: 「显示、隐藏与自由缩放独立桌面伙伴窗口，并可一键唤回主界面」涉及你在桌面上直接拖拽缩放悬浮窗尺寸或点击唤回主窗口；智能体可帮你开关伙伴并打开「宠物与助手」设置页。
control.reasonEn: "Show, hide, and resize the companion window, and return quickly to the main window" involves visual window placement, resizing, and clicking on your desktop; the Agent can toggle the companion or open Pet & assistant settings for you.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘, / Ctrl+, 打开设置，进入「应用与界面 → 宠物与助手」
在「宠物」区域开启桌面伙伴开关，从预设角色列表中挑选形象；如需自定义形象，可在设置页点击「导入」选择 `.zip` 角色压缩包，或在会话中直接让智能体导入本地 Petdex 目录（如 `~/petdex/my-cat`）或 `.zip` 包
在桌面上拖动伙伴到不挡视线的位置并调整合适尺寸；需要专注或投屏时随时在设置中隐藏或关闭
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Application & Interface → Pet & assistant

Enable the desktop companion under Pet and pick a built-in character; for custom characters, click Import in Settings to pick a `.zip` pack, or ask the agent in chat to import a local Petdex folder (such as `~/petdex/my-cat`) or `.zip` archive
