Drag and resize the companion window anywhere comfortable on your desktop, or toggle it off anytime for zero distraction

workflowZh: 先用 search 搜索“桌面宠物 / Petdex / companion”，再 get `setting.application.pet` 读取当前选项和受支持操作
用 configure 修改 `enabled`；用 execute 的 `list-pets`、`use-pet`、`delete-pet` 查看、导入/选择或删除角色
执行后再次 get 或 list-pets 回读真实状态；本地包路径不可用于远程工作区，失败时明确返回而不是伪成功
workflowEn: Search for desktop pet, Petdex, or companion first, then get `setting.application.pet` for current options and supported operations
Use configure for `enabled`, and execute `list-pets`, `use-pet`, or `delete-pet` to inspect, import/select, or remove a character
Read back the real state with get or list-pets; local package paths are unavailable to remote workspaces and failures must be explicit

agentExamplesZh: 帮我把桌面宠物打开，看看现在有哪些可选角色
从 ~/petdex/pixel-fox 导入并启用这个新的桌面伙伴
先帮我把桌面伙伴关掉，一会儿要投屏演示
agentExamplesEn: Turn on the desktop companion and list the available characters
Import and switch to the Petdex pack at ~/petdex/pixel-fox
Turn off the desktop pet for now while I share my screen
capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 宠物与助手 → 宠物
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Pet & assistant → Pet
scenariosZh: 让 AI 在后台跑耗时构建或长任务，自己切去浏览器查资料——看一眼角落里伙伴的状态就知道任务跑完了还是卡在等权限
把喜欢的像素角色打包成 Petdex 目录（例如 `~/petdex/my-cat`），直接对智能体说一声或去设置页导入换新装
主窗口最小化到托盘后，不用去任务栏翻图标，直接通过桌面伙伴就能快速回到主界面
scenariosEn: While reading docs in another app during a long build, glance at your companion in the corner to see whether the agent finished or needs approval
Import a custom Petdex character folder (such as `~/petdex/my-cat`) to personalize your workspace vibe
Bring the main OpenBitFun window right back up from the companion when the app is minimized to the tray
tipsZh: 设置页名称小提示：桌面伙伴现在位于「设置 → 应用与界面 → 宠物与助手」（与实时语音通话、桌面小卡片同页），找起来更集中。
删除自定义包自动兜底：当你删掉某个自己导入的 Petdex 角色包时，系统会自动切回内置可用形象，不会报错或黑块。
直接对智能体说也能改：桌面伙伴已接入产品控制面板，你甚至不用自己翻设置，直接在聊天里说“关掉桌面宠物”或“换个宠物角色”即可生效。
tipsEn: Where to find it: Desktop companion controls live in Settings → Application & Interface → Pet & assistant, right alongside Realtime Voice Calls and Desktop Cards.
Graceful fallback on delete: deleting an imported Petdex pack automatically switches you back to a valid built-in character.
Control it right from chat: you can simply tell the agent "turn off the desktop pet" or "switch my pet character" without opening Settings.

capabilities.summaryZh: 让智能体把倒计时提醒、上线核对清单、PR 状态、接口健康指标或行情看板做成轻巧的独立小卡片，贴在屏幕任意顺眼的位置——支持定时自动拉取数据刷新、Windows 桌面图标层固定，关掉应用再重开也会按原位置和尺寸自动恢复。
capabilities.summaryEn: Let agents place lightweight, draggable cards outside the main window for glanceable info like countdowns, checklists, PR status, service metrics, or quotes—with automatic HTTP/command refresh, Windows desktop-layer pinning, and exact position/size restore on relaunch.
highlightsZh: 一句话创建倒计时、待办清单、便签、进度条、指标卡、图表卡等多种形态，支持定时自动刷新
卡片上可直接打勾清单、手动刷新、置顶悬浮，或一键跳回创建它的原始会话
Windows 支持「固定到桌面」嵌入桌面图标之上、应用窗口之下，像原生桌面小组件一样不挡视线
在「首页 → 小卡片」或设置页统一查看、显示、隐藏或删除所有卡片，重启应用自动恢复布局
highlightsEn: Ask in chat for countdown, checklist, note, progress, metric, chart, or custom cards—with optional scheduled HTTP or local-command refresh
Check off tasks, refresh live data, toggle always-on-top, open links, or jump straight back to the source session from any card
On Windows, pin cards to the desktop layer (above desktop icons, behind app windows) so they never block active work
Manage visibility and clean up cards in one place from Home → Desktop cards or Settings, with layout restored across restarts

items.titleZh: 一句话创建倒计时、清单、便签、进度、指标与图表卡片，支持 HTTP 或命令定时刷新
items.titleEn: Create countdown, checklist, note, progress, metric, and chart cards with optional live refresh
items.descriptionZh: 内置丰富卡片预设，既能展示静态备忘与倒计时，也能绑定 HTTP 接口或本机轻量命令定期拉取最新数字。
items.descriptionEn: Pick from rich built-in presets or custom layouts, optionally wired to an HTTP endpoint or local command for scheduled updates.

items.titleZh: 在「首页 → 小卡片」集中浏览全部卡片，一键显示、隐藏或删除
items.titleEn: View all cards in Home → Desktop cards and show, hide, or delete any card
items.descriptionZh: 哪怕卡片被你藏起来了或挪到了外接显示器角落，回到首页「我的卡片」列表也能一目了然地找回或清理。
items.descriptionEn: Even if a card is hidden, every card stays listed in Home → Desktop cards so you can show, hide, or remove it easily.

items.titleZh: 在卡片上直接刷新数据、勾选待办项、切换窗口置顶或一键回到来源会话
items.titleEn: Refresh data, check off items, toggle always-on-top, open links, or jump to the source session
items.descriptionZh: 卡片不只是静态展示牌——直接在上面勾掉完成的任务，或者点一下回到当初生成它的聊天窗口继续吩咐 AI。
items.descriptionEn: Cards are interactive: check off tasks right on the surface, trigger an immediate refresh, or jump back to the chat that created it.

items.titleZh: 在卡片菜单、首页卡片列表或设置里将卡片固定到 Windows 桌面图标层
items.titleEn: Pin cards to the Windows desktop layer from the card menu, Home list, or Settings
items.descriptionZh: 嵌入 Windows Explorer 桌面层（位于桌面图标之上、其他软件窗口之下），连已隐藏的卡片也可提前切换固定偏好。
items.descriptionEn: Embeds the card onto the Windows desktop plane—above desktop icons and behind normal app windows—without blocking active coding.

control.reasonZh: 「在卡片菜单、首页卡片列表或设置里将卡片固定到 Windows 桌面图标层」会将卡片放入 Windows Explorer 桌面层（位于桌面图标之上、应用窗口之下，需 Explorer 可用且 DPI 上下文一致）；这项显示偏好由你在卡片菜单、首页卡片列表或设置页手动切换，智能体可为你直接打开对应管理入口。
control.reasonEn: "Pin cards to the Windows desktop layer from the card menu, Home list, or Settings" places the card into the Windows Explorer desktop layer (above desktop icons and behind app windows while Explorer is available with a matching DPI context); you toggle this display preference in the card menu, Home list, or Settings while the Agent opens the exact entry.

items.titleZh: 自由拖拽摆放并拉伸卡片边缘调整尺寸，关闭重启 OpenBitFun 后自动按原样恢复
items.titleEn: Drag and resize cards freely on screen, with positions and sizes restored on relaunch
items.descriptionZh: 退出客户端时卡片会随之干净收起，下次启动自动回到你上次摆好的屏幕坐标与大小，不用重新排布。
items.descriptionEn: Cards tuck away cleanly when OpenBitFun exits and reappear at the exact same position and dimensions next time you launch.

control.reasonZh: 卡片位置由用户在桌面上直接拖动决定，没有可以代替视觉摆放的结构化命令；智能体只说明操作方式，摆放保留给用户。
control.reasonEn: Card positions are chosen by dragging directly on the desktop, and no structured command can replace that visual placement; the Agent explains the interaction and leaves placement to the user.

stepsZh: 在任意桌面端本地会话中告诉智能体你想盯什么信息（如倒计时、待办清单、PR 状态或某个接口指标），智能体会自动挑选合适模板创建卡片
按住卡片拖到屏幕顺手的位置，拖动边缘或四角调整到舒服的大小
通过卡片右上角菜单可手动刷新、勾选清单、切换「置顶」或在 Windows 上选择「固定到桌面」
需要暂时收起或清理时，在卡片菜单、「首页 → 小卡片」区域或「设置 → 应用与界面 → 宠物与助手 → 小卡片」中隐藏或删除
stepsEn: Ask an agent in a Desktop session for the glanceable card you want (countdown, checklist, PR watcher, or live metric)
Drag the card anywhere on your screen and resize it from its edges or corners
Use the card menu to refresh data, check off items, toggle always-on-top, or Pin to desktop on Windows
Show, hide, or delete cards anytime from the card menu, Home → Desktop cards, or Settings → Pet & assistant → Desktop cards

workflowZh: 不确定卡片形态时先用 `presets` 查看预置卡片，再用 `create` 创建；需要定时刷新时为卡片提供 http 或 command 数据源
用 `list`/`get` 读取已有卡片，避免重复创建；用 `update`、`show`、`hide`、`delete`、`refresh` 维护卡片
小卡片仅在桌面端可用，远程控制会话无法使用；远程工作区不能使用本机命令数据源，失败时明确告知用户
workflowEn: When unsure about the card shape, call `presets` first, then `create`; give the card an http or command data source when it should refresh
Use `list`/`get` to read existing cards instead of creating duplicates; maintain cards with `update`, `show`, `hide`, `delete`, and `refresh`
Desktop cards exist only on the desktop host and are unavailable from remote control sessions; remote workspaces cannot use local command data sources, and failures must be reported explicitly

agentExamplesZh: 20 分钟后提醒我参加产品评审会
做一张桌面小卡片帮我盯着当前分支 PR 的 CI 状态
帮我把今晚发版要检查的 5 件事做成一张桌面清单卡片
把桌面上那张已经跑完的倒计时卡片删掉
agentExamplesEn: Remind me about the meeting in 20 minutes
Make a card that keeps an eye on this PR
Create a desktop checklist card for tonight’s 5 release verification steps
Hide or delete the finished countdown card on my desktop
capabilities.entryPathZh: 在对话中直接让智能体创建；集中管理位于「首页 → 小卡片」或「设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 宠物与助手 → 小卡片」
capabilities.entryPathEn: Ask an agent in chat to create a card; manage all cards in Home → Desktop cards or Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Pet & assistant → Desktop cards
scenariosZh: 写代码容易忘时间？随口说一句“25 分钟后提醒我站起来活动一下”，屏幕角落立刻多出一张倒计时卡陪你专注
提交完大 PR 等 CI 跑完，让 AI 做一张每两分钟自动刷新的 PR 状态小卡片贴在副屏，不用来回切网页盯进度
把发版前的 6 步手工核对项做成桌面清单卡，做完一步勾一步，随时点卡片菜单跳回原对话让 AI 接着执行下一步
scenariosEn: Say "Remind me about design review in 20 minutes" and get a clean countdown card tucked in the corner of your screen
Keep a self-refreshing PR status or build-health card on your secondary monitor instead of constantly reloading GitHub tabs
Pin a release checklist card to your desktop, check items off as you go, and jump back to the originating chat in one click
tipsZh: 「置顶」与 Windows「固定到桌面」的区别：开启「置顶」会让卡片浮在所有窗口最前面（适合紧急倒计时）；Windows 的「固定到桌面」则把卡片贴在壁纸图标层上，看桌面时才露出来，平时完全不挡代码窗口。
在设置里关闭总开关不会删卡：如果你在「宠物与助手 → 小卡片」里暂时关闭小卡片功能，所有卡片只是隐藏收起，重新开启后立刻原样恢复。
桌面端本机专属：小卡片需要本机图形窗口承载，手机远控会话暂不支持创建；在远程 SSH 工作区中可使用 HTTP 数据源卡片，但不能绑定本机命令刷新。
tipsEn: Always-on-top vs Pin to desktop (Windows): Always-on-top floats above active windows for urgent timers, while Pin to desktop tucks the card onto the wallpaper layer behind your apps.
Turning off Desktop cards keeps your data: disabling the master toggle in Pet & assistant settings hides existing cards safely until you re-enable them.
Desktop-host scope: Desktop cards require the native Desktop host (unavailable from mobile remote control), and remote SSH workspaces cannot attach local shell commands as card data sources.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 通用
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → General
capabilities.summaryZh: 一站式调整界面语言、开机自启、长任务防休眠、窗口关闭回托盘、系统通知与应用更新。
capabilities.summaryEn: Configure interface language, launch at login, sleep prevention during active runs, close-to-tray behavior, notifications, and app updates.
highlightsZh: 界面语言即时切换（简体中文 / English / 繁體中文）
开机自启、运行防休眠与自动更新检查
主窗口关闭行为（最小化到托盘 / 退出 / 每次询问）
任务完成与权限确认的系统桌面通知
highlightsEn: Instant UI language switching (Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese)
Launch at login, sleep prevention while running, and automatic update checks
Main-window close action (minimize to tray, quit, or ask each time)
Desktop notifications for completed turns and pending permission prompts
scenariosZh: 把长耗时重构或批量测试交给智能体后离开工位，开启“阻止电脑睡眠”与系统通知，不怕机器中途休眠断连，需要审批时也能第一时间看到提醒。
习惯随手点右上角关闭窗口，但希望后台定时任务、远程中继或桌面小卡片继续在线时，确认关闭按钮保持“最小化到托盘”。
刚安装好客户端想把界面切换成英文或繁體中文，直接在“通用”页顶部下拉框一键切换，无需重启应用。
scenariosEn: Leave a long refactor or test suite running while you step away: turn on Prevent System Sleep and desktop notifications so your machine stays awake and alerts you if an approval is needed.
Keep scheduled automations, Remote Connect, or desktop cards alive when you click the window close button by setting Close Behavior to Minimize to Tray.
Switch the entire interface among Simplified Chinese, English, and Traditional Chinese right at the top of General without restarting OpenBitFun.

items.titleZh: 在通用页切换简体中文、English 或繁體中文界面语言
items.titleEn: Switch the UI language among Simplified Chinese, English, and Traditional Chinese in General
items.descriptionZh: 位于“通用”页最上方，切换后立即刷新全局菜单、设置文案与提示语，无需重启；你也可以直接让智能体帮你切换语言。
items.descriptionEn: Located right at the top of General; switching updates menus, settings labels, and prompts immediately without a restart, or you can ask the Agent to switch it directly.

control.reasonZh: “在通用页切换简体中文、English 或繁體中文界面语言”在图形界面中位于“应用与界面 → 通用”顶部下拉框；智能体既可通过语言选项直接修改，也可为你打开通用设置页直观选择。
control.reasonEn: “Switch the UI language among Simplified Chinese, English, and Traditional Chinese in General” lives at the top of Application & Interface → General in the graphical UI; the Agent can either switch the language option directly or open General settings for visual selection.

items.titleZh: 启用或停用启动后自动检查更新
items.titleEn: Enable or disable automatic update checks on startup
items.descriptionZh: 默认开启。启动后会静默检查新版本并在有更新时温和提醒，不会在你写代码或跑任务中途强行重启。
items.descriptionEn: Enabled by default. OpenBitFun quietly checks for new releases after startup and notifies you when one is ready without interrupting active work.

items.titleZh: 手动检查并后台下载更新，确认后安装并重启，或稍后从关于页面安装
items.titleEn: Check and download updates in the background, then confirm installation and restart or install later from About
items.descriptionZh: 想立即尝鲜新功能时可手动触发检查，安装包在后台下载完成后由你决定何时重启安装，手头未收尾的会话不会被直接打断。
items.descriptionEn: Check for a new release on demand, let the installer download in the background, and decide when to restart so active sessions are never cut off unexpectedly.

control.reasonZh: “手动检查并后台下载更新，确认后安装并重启，或稍后从关于页面安装”需要下载完成后由你亲自确认安装与重启时机；智能体会打开精确入口，并把后续交互保留在可见界面。
control.reasonEn: “Check and download updates in the background, then confirm installation and restart or install later from About” requires your confirmation after downloading before installing and restarting; the Agent opens the exact entry and keeps the remaining interaction visible to you.

items.titleZh: 控制登录桌面系统后是否自动启动 OpenBitFun
items.titleEn: Choose whether OpenBitFun launches automatically after desktop sign-in
items.descriptionZh: 默认关闭。若你常把本机作为手机远程连接宿主或跑早间定时任务，开启后开机即可就绪。
items.descriptionEn: Off by default. Useful when you rely on morning scheduled tasks or connect to this computer from your phone via Remote Connect.

items.titleZh: 开启或关闭运行期间阻止电脑空闲自动睡眠
items.titleEn: Prevent idle system sleep while OpenBitFun is running
items.descriptionZh: 默认关闭。开启后可防止系统因无人操作而自动休眠中断长任务，但不会阻止你手动睡眠、合上笔记本盖子或系统自动息屏。
items.descriptionEn: Off by default. Prevents idle OS sleep from dropping long tasks, while still respecting manual sleep, closing the laptop lid, and normal display turn-off.

items.titleZh: 选择点击主窗口关闭按钮时最小化到托盘、直接退出或每次询问
items.titleEn: Choose whether clicking the window close button minimizes to tray, quits, or asks each time
items.descriptionZh: 默认设为“最小化到托盘”，避免随手关窗把正在跑的智能体回合或远程连接一起掐断；偏爱彻底退出的用户可改为“退出”或“每次询问”。
items.descriptionEn: Defaults to Minimize to Tray so closing the window does not kill running turns or remote connections; switch to Quit or Ask Each Time if you prefer.

items.titleZh: 分别开启或关闭任务完成通知与权限请求通知
items.titleEn: Independently toggle turn-completion and permission-request notifications
items.descriptionZh: 两项默认均开启。当你切到浏览器或终端干别的事时，智能体跑完任务或卡在权限审批上都会发系统通知提醒你，避免干等。
items.descriptionEn: Both are enabled by default. When OpenBitFun is in the background, you get a native OS notification as soon as a turn finishes or an agent needs approval.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（macOS）或 Ctrl+,（Windows / Linux）打开设置，进入“应用与界面 → 通用”
在顶部选择界面语言，或按需切换开机启动、防睡眠与自动更新开关
在“窗口与通知”区设定关闭按钮默认动作与两类系统通知，所有修改即时自动保存
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (macOS) or Ctrl+, (Windows / Linux) to open Settings, then go to Application & Interface → General
Pick your UI language at the top, or toggle launch at login, sleep prevention, and automatic update checks
Choose close-button behavior and notification preferences under Window & Notifications — changes save automatically
agentExamplesZh: 帮我开启阻止电脑自动睡眠
把关闭窗口行为改成最小化到托盘
关闭自动检查更新，只保留权限请求通知
agentExamplesEn: Keep my computer from sleeping while OpenBitFun is running
Set the close button to minimize to tray
Turn off automatic update checks and keep permission notifications on
tipsZh: 界面语言选择器现已放在“应用与界面 → 通用”顶部，不再藏在外观页里；你也可以直接对智能体说“把界面语言切成英文”。
“阻止电脑睡眠”只抑制系统空闲休眠，允许屏幕正常熄灭省电；若合上笔记本盖子，系统仍会按硬件策略休眠。
如果没收到桌面通知，请检查操作系统的“通知 / 专注模式（勿扰模式）”是否允许 OpenBitFun 发送提醒。
tipsEn: The UI language dropdown now lives right at the top of Application & Interface → General rather than Appearance — or simply ask the Agent to switch languages for you.
Prevent System Sleep only blocks idle sleep so your display can still dim or turn off normally; closing a laptop lid still follows OS hardware sleep rules.
If notifications do not appear, check macOS Focus / Windows Do Not Disturb and confirm OpenBitFun is allowed in OS notification settings.

options.descriptionZh: 登录当前桌面系统后自动在后台启动 OpenBitFun（默认关闭）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically start OpenBitFun after signing in to your desktop OS (off by default).

options.descriptionZh: 在 OpenBitFun 运行期间抑制系统空闲自动睡眠，适合长耗时任务或远程宿主场景（默认关闭）。
options.descriptionEn: Prevent idle system sleep while OpenBitFun is running — ideal for long tasks or remote hosts (off by default).

options.descriptionZh: 应用启动后自动检查新版本提醒，安装与重启仍需你确认（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically check for new versions after startup while keeping install and restart under your confirmation (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 控制点击主窗口关闭按钮时是最小化到托盘（默认）、直接退出应用，还是每次弹窗询问。
options.descriptionEn: Choose whether clicking the window close button minimizes to tray (default), quits the app, or asks each time.

options.descriptionZh: 当窗口不在前台且智能体完成当前回合时发送系统通知（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Send a desktop notification when a session turn finishes while the window is unfocused (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 当智能体暂停等待你批准工具或命令权限时发送系统通知（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Send a desktop notification when an agent is waiting for your permission approval (on by default).

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 外观
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Appearance
capabilities.summaryZh: 自由切换跟随系统与 9 套内置主题、导入动态视觉皮肤包，并定制全局字号、左侧导航栏、对话宽度与侧边面板布局。
capabilities.summaryEn: Switch between system mode and all 9 built-in themes, import visual skin packs with video backdrops, and customize UI font size, left sidebar items, chat width, and Side by side / Overlay session panels.
highlightsZh: 跟随系统 + 9 套精选内置主题（暗色、浅色、黑白撞色、午夜、墨韵、墨夜、赛博、石板灰、东京夜）
视觉皮肤包导入与预览（支持 .openbitfun-skin / .zip / .json 及动态视频背景）
全局界面字号档位与 12–20 px 自定义像素微调
左侧导航栏固定排序、对话内容宽度与会话侧边面板（并排 / 覆盖）布局
highlightsEn: Follow System plus all 9 built-in themes (Dark, Light, Black & White, Midnight, Ink Charm, Ink Night, Cyber, Slate, Tokyo Night)
Declarative visual skin packs (.openbitfun-skin / .zip / .json) including looping video backdrops
Global UI font-size presets plus custom 12–20 px sizing with live preview
Left sidebar pinning & ordering, preferred chat width, and Side by side vs Overlay session panels
scenariosZh: 白天在明亮屏幕下用“浅色”或国风“墨韵”，晚上切到低眩光的“东京夜”“午夜”或直接选“跟随系统”自动日夜切换。
换上大尺寸高分屏后觉得聊天气泡太窄或界面字偏小，把全局字号调到“中等 / 16 px”并拉宽对话内容区，长段代码与方案对照更舒展。
想精简工作台左侧图标栏，把不常用的入口取消固定、把高频场景挪到顺手位置，并在小屏笔记本上将会话侧边面板改为“覆盖”模式节省横向空间。
scenariosEn: Use Light or Ink Charm during bright daytime hours, switch to low-glare Tokyo Night or Midnight at night, or let Follow System match your OS automatically.
On an ultrawide or high-DPI monitor, bump UI font size to Medium or a custom 16 px value and widen the chat column so code blocks and tables have room to breathe.
Declutter the left navigation bar by unpinning scenes you rarely touch, reordering favorites, and switching the session side panel from Side by side to Overlay on smaller laptop screens.

items.titleZh: 选择跟随系统或暗色、浅色、黑白撞色、午夜、墨韵、墨夜、赛博、石板灰、东京夜等内置主题
items.titleEn: Choose Follow System or Dark, Light, Black & White, Midnight, Ink Charm, Ink Night, Cyber, Slate, or Tokyo Night built-in theme appearance
items.descriptionZh: 提供“跟随系统”及全部 9 套官方调校主题，涵盖经典深浅色、高对比黑白撞色、东方水墨质感（墨韵 / 墨夜）与夜间编程配色（午夜 / 赛博 / 石板灰 / 东京夜），点击即刻生效。
items.descriptionEn: Includes Follow System plus all 9 crafted built-in themes — Dark, Light, high-contrast Black & White, Ink Charm, Ink Night, Midnight, Cyber, Slate, and Tokyo Night — applied instantaneously.

items.titleZh: 导入、预览、启用或停用自定义视觉皮肤包（支持动态视频背景）
items.titleEn: Import, preview, activate, or deactivate custom visual skin packs (including video backdrops)
items.descriptionZh: 支持导入 `.openbitfun-skin`、`.zip` 或 `.json` 格式的声明式皮肤包，先预览静态或循环视频背景效果再正式启用，也可随时一键停用回退到内置主题。
items.descriptionEn: Import `.openbitfun-skin`, `.zip`, or `.json` skin packages, preview static imagery or looping video backdrops before activating, and deactivate or clean up invalid packs anytime.

control.reasonZh: “导入、预览、启用或停用自定义视觉皮肤包（支持动态视频背景）”需要选择本地皮肤包文件并在界面中肉眼确认预览效果；智能体会打开外观页对应区域由你挑选与启用。
control.reasonEn: “Import, preview, activate, or deactivate custom visual skin packs (including video backdrops)” requires picking a local skin package file and visually reviewing its live preview; the Agent opens Appearance settings so you can preview and activate it.

items.titleZh: 调整全局界面字号档位，或按 12–20 px 自定义像素大小并实时预览
items.titleEn: Adjust global UI font-size presets or set a custom 12–20 px size with live preview
items.descriptionZh: 内置紧凑、小、默认、中等、大 5 个档位，并支持 12–20 px 精确自定义。这里控制的是界面与对话字号，代码字号可在“编程与开发 → 编辑器”中独立调节。
items.descriptionEn: Offers Compact, Small, Default, Medium, and Large presets plus custom 12–20 px sizing with a live preview box. Controls UI and chat text independently from code editor font size.

control.reasonZh: “调整全局界面字号档位，或按 12–20 px 自定义像素大小并实时预览”适合边看实时预览边微调最顺眼的阅读比例；智能体会为你打开外观页字号区域。
control.reasonEn: “Adjust global UI font-size presets or set a custom 12–20 px size with live preview” works best with visual inspection against the live preview card; the Agent opens the Appearance font-size section for you.

items.titleZh: 固定、取消固定或调整左侧导航栏场景入口顺序
items.titleEn: Pin, unpin, reorder, or reset left sidebar navigation entries
items.descriptionZh: “个人总览”始终固定置顶，其余场景可按你的日常动线自由增减或上下移动顺序，改乱了也能一键重置回默认布局。
items.descriptionEn: Personal Overview stays pinned at the top while you freely pin, unpin, or move other scenes up and down — with a one-click Reset button whenever you want defaults back.

control.reasonZh: “固定、取消固定或调整左侧导航栏场景入口顺序”涉及多项导航入口的可视化排序与显隐对照；智能体会直接定位到外观页“左侧导航栏”区域。
control.reasonEn: “Pin, unpin, reorder, or reset left sidebar navigation entries” involves interactive ordering and visibility review across sidebar entries; the Agent opens the Left Sidebar section directly.

items.titleZh: 微调或重置对话流内容区的首选像素宽度
items.titleEn: Adjust or reset the preferred pixel width of the conversation stream
items.descriptionZh: 可按 10 px 步进精细调节，也可以直接在会话界面拖拽对话内容区边缘调整宽度，满足窄栏沉浸阅读或宽屏大表格展示，随时可恢复默认值。
items.descriptionEn: Fine-tune chat column width in 10 px steps here or drag the edge of the conversation stream directly in chat, with one-click reset to the default width.

control.reasonZh: “微调或重置对话流内容区的首选像素宽度”取决于当前显示器尺寸与个人视觉阅读习惯；智能体会为你打开外观页宽度调节项。
control.reasonEn: “Adjust or reset the preferred pixel width of the conversation stream” depends on your monitor geometry and visual comfort; the Agent opens the Appearance width control for interactive tuning.

items.titleZh: 在“并排”与“覆盖”之间切换会话侧边面板展示模式
items.titleEn: Switch the session side-panel display mode between Side by side and Overlay
items.descriptionZh: 宽屏下选“并排”方便一边对话一边对照文件或预览；笔记本小窗口下选“覆盖”让侧边面板浮层展开，不挤压主对话区宽度。
items.descriptionEn: Choose Side by side (`split`) on wide monitors to inspect files and previews next to chat, or Overlay on compact windows so side panels float over the workspace without squeezing the conversation.

control.reasonZh: “在“并排”与“覆盖”之间切换会话侧边面板展示模式”需要结合当前窗口宽度体验分栏与浮层效果；智能体会打开外观页会话侧边面板配置项。
control.reasonEn: “Switch the session side-panel display mode between Side by side and Overlay” is easiest to judge visually against your current window width; the Agent opens the Session Panel section in Appearance settings.

items.titleZh: 通过智能体直接切换简体中文、English 或繁體中文界面语言
items.titleEn: Switch the interface language among Simplified Chinese, English, and Traditional Chinese
items.descriptionZh: 支持 `zh-CN`（简体中文）、`en-US`（English）与 `zh-TW`（繁體中文）三种界面语言；在图形设置中，语言下拉框位于“应用与界面 → 通用”顶部。
items.descriptionEn: Supports Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`), English (`en-US`), and Traditional Chinese (`zh-TW`); in the graphical Settings UI, the language dropdown is located at the top of Application & Interface → General.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“应用与界面 → 外观”
在顶部主题卡片中点选“跟随系统”或任意 9 套内置主题，或在“视觉皮肤”中导入自定义皮肤包
向下滚动调节全局界面字号、左侧导航栏顺序、对话内容宽度与会话侧边面板（并排 / 覆盖）模式
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Application & Interface → Appearance
Click Follow System or any of the 9 built-in theme cards, or import a custom pack under Visual Skins
Scroll down to tune global UI font size, left sidebar pinned entries, chat content width, and Side by side vs Overlay session panel mode
agentExamplesZh: 帮我切换成东京夜主题
把外观主题改成跟随系统
把界面语言切成英文
agentExamplesEn: Switch to the Tokyo Night theme
Set the theme to follow system appearance
Change the interface language to English
tipsZh: 如果在外观页没找到“界面语言”下拉框：它现在搬到了隔壁“应用与界面 → 通用”页最上方，或者直接让智能体替你切换即可。
调整这里“界面字号”不会改变代码编辑区字体大小；想单独放大代码字号请前往“编程与开发 → 编辑器”。
开启视觉皮肤包后会覆盖底层配色与背景，想纯粹对比内置主题效果时，先在“视觉皮肤”里点停用即可。
tipsEn: Looking for the UI Language dropdown? In the graphical Settings UI it now lives at the top of Application & Interface → General, or you can ask the Agent to switch it directly.
UI Font Size scales menus and chat without altering code text — tune code font size independently under Programming & Development → Editor.
An active Visual Skin overrides theme surfaces and backdrops; click Deactivate in Visual Skins anytime to return cleanly to your selected built-in theme.

options.descriptionZh: 选择跟随系统（system）或 9 套内置主题：暗色、浅色、黑白撞色、午夜、墨韵、墨夜、赛博、石板灰、东京夜。
options.descriptionEn: Choose Follow System (`system`) or any of the 9 built-in themes: Dark, Light, Black & White, Midnight, Ink Charm, Ink Night, Cyber, Slate, or Tokyo Night.

options.descriptionZh: 在简体中文（zh-CN）、English（en-US）与繁體中文（zh-TW）之间切换界面语言（图形界面入口位于“应用与界面 → 通用”）。
options.descriptionEn: Switch UI language among Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`), English (`en-US`), and Traditional Chinese (`zh-TW`) (graphical selector lives in Application & Interface → General).

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 宠物与助手
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Pet & assistant
capabilities.summaryZh: 按序配置客户端免提实时语音通话、桌面智能体宠物角色与 Petdex 包，以及桌面小卡片开关与 Windows 桌面固定。
capabilities.summaryEn: Configure client-wide hands-free realtime voice calls, your desktop pet mascot and Petdex character packs, and desktop cards with Windows desktop-layer pinning.
highlightsZh: 客户端实时语音通话（顶部首屏配置，本机保管火山引擎 API Key、自定义音色、右下角 Hello 入口）
桌面宠物开关、内置角色（BitBlob / 困困等）切换与 Petdex 本地包导入
桌面小卡片总开关与按卡片固定到 Windows 桌面图标层
highlightsEn: Client-wide realtime voice calls (top section: controller-local Volcengine API key, custom voice ID, bottom-right Hello launcher)
Desktop pet visibility, built-in characters (such as BitBlob), and local Petdex character pack import
Desktop cards master switch plus per-card pinning to the Windows desktop layer
scenariosZh: 手头正翻看纸质资料或双屏调试不便打字，在页面顶部配好实时语音通话后点右下角“Hello”，直接动嘴让语音助手进项目查进展、跑任务并语音播报结果。
写代码累了想换个桌面陪伴形象，导入自定义 Petdex `.zip` 包（或让智能体直接加载 `/path/to/pet` 文件夹），也可以在录屏演示前一句话暂时隐藏桌面宠物与小卡片。
在 Windows 上摆了几张倒计时、待办或指标小卡片，开启单卡“固定到桌面”让它们稳稳贴在桌面图标层上方、普通应用窗口下方，看桌面时一眼扫到却绝不挡窗口。
scenariosEn: Configure Realtime Voice Call at the top of the page once, click the bottom-right Hello button, and talk hands-free while the voice assistant enters projects, runs tasks, and speaks concise updates.
Swap your desktop companion by importing a Petdex `.zip` package in the UI (or giving a `/path/to/pet` folder path to the Agent), or hide both the pet and desktop cards before a clean screen share.
On Windows, pin specific countdown, checklist, or metric cards to the desktop layer so they sit neatly above desktop icons and behind regular app windows.

items.titleZh: 配置客户端实时语音通话开关、火山引擎 API Key 与播报音色
items.titleEn: Configure client-wide realtime voice calls, Volcengine API key, and voice ID
items.descriptionZh: 位于本页最上方：填写本机专属的火山引擎实时语音 API Key（仅保存在当前客户端，绝不转发到远程工作区或 Peer 主机），可自定义音色（默认 Jupiter 女声），开启后通过右下角“Hello”按钮发起免提语音协作。
items.descriptionEn: Located at the top of Pet & assistant: enter your Volcengine Realtime Voice API key (stored strictly on this local client and never sent to remote workspaces or peer hosts), customize the voice ID (Jupiter female voice by default), and launch hands-free calls from the bottom-right Hello button.

control.reasonZh: “配置客户端实时语音通话开关、火山引擎 API Key 与播报音色”涉及本机语音服务 API Key 凭据录入与音色核对；智能体会直接打开“宠物与助手 → 实时语音通话”区域，不会代收你的密钥。
control.reasonEn: “Configure client-wide realtime voice calls, Volcengine API key, and voice ID” involves entering your local speech-service API key credential and voice preference; the Agent opens Pet & assistant → Realtime Voice Call directly without handling your secret.

items.titleZh: 整体启用或隐藏桌面智能体宠物
items.titleEn: Enable or hide the desktop agent pet companion
items.descriptionZh: 默认开启。关闭后会隐藏独立桌面宠物窗口，但你已导入的角色包与偏好都会完整保留，随时可重新唤出。
items.descriptionEn: Enabled by default. Turning it off hides the floating pet window while keeping your imported Petdex characters and preferences intact.

items.titleZh: 从内置与已导入的 Petdex 角色中切换当前宠物外观
items.titleEn: Switch the active pet mascot appearance among built-in and imported Petdex characters
items.descriptionZh: 自带默认伙伴（BitBlob）与内置角色（如“困困”），选中后桌面伙伴窗口的形象与状态动画会立即切换。
items.descriptionEn: Browse built-in characters (including BitBlob) alongside your imported Petdex packs and switch your companion’s mascot appearance immediately.

items.titleZh: 导入本地 Petdex 角色包（界面选 .zip 包，或让智能体导入文件夹/压缩包）
items.titleEn: Import a local Petdex character pack (`.zip` in the UI, or folder / `.zip` via the Agent)
items.descriptionZh: 点击设置页的“导入”按钮可选择本地 `.zip` 角色压缩包；如果角色包是未打包的本地文件夹（如 `/path/to/pet`）或 `.zip`，也可以直接把路径发给智能体一键导入并启用。
items.descriptionEn: Clicking Import in Settings opens a `.zip` package picker, while asking the Agent (`use-pet`) can import and activate either a local `.zip` archive or an unpacked Petdex folder such as `/path/to/pet`.

items.titleZh: 刷新角色列表并删除不再需要的导入角色包
items.titleEn: Refresh the character list and delete imported Petdex packs you no longer need
items.descriptionZh: 内置角色受保护不可误删；若删除的正好是当前正在使用的导入角色，系统会自动安全回退到默认伙伴。
items.descriptionEn: Built-in characters stay protected; if you delete the currently active imported pack, OpenBitFun safely falls back to the default companion.

items.titleZh: 开启或关闭桌面小卡片总开关（关闭后隐藏全部卡片且收起小卡片工具）
items.titleEn: Turn desktop cards on or off globally (hiding cards and removing the agent tool when off)
items.descriptionZh: 默认开启。关闭后会隐藏所有桌面小卡片，且智能体上下文中不再暴露小卡片工具；已创建的卡片与布局数据会完好保留，重开即恢复。
items.descriptionEn: Enabled by default. Turning it off hides all cards and removes the desktop-card tool from agents without deleting your saved cards or positions.

items.titleZh: 将单张桌面小卡片固定到 Windows 桌面图标层（含当前隐藏的卡片）
items.titleEn: Pin individual desktop cards to the Windows desktop icon layer (including hidden cards)
items.descriptionZh: 在支持桌面层固定的 Windows 环境下，可逐张开关卡片固定状态，让卡片位于桌面图标之上、普通窗口之下；即使某张卡片当前处于隐藏状态也能在此提前设好。
items.descriptionEn: On Windows hosts that support desktop-layer pinning, toggle pinning per card so it sits above desktop icons and behind regular app windows — even for cards that are currently hidden.

control.reasonZh: “将单张桌面小卡片固定到 Windows 桌面图标层（含当前隐藏的卡片）”需要按当前机器已有的具体卡片列表逐张选择；智能体会直达“宠物与助手 → 桌面小卡片”区域供你勾选。
control.reasonEn: “Pin individual desktop cards to the Windows desktop icon layer (including hidden cards)” depends on the live list of cards on this computer; the Agent opens Pet & assistant → Desktop Cards so you can toggle each card.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“应用与界面 → 宠物与助手”
在顶部“实时语音通话”区按需开启语音通话、录入本机火山引擎 API Key 并设置音色
向下在“桌面宠物”区开关伙伴或导入 `.zip` 角色包，并在底部“桌面小卡片”区管理卡片总开关与 Windows 桌面固定
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Application & Interface → Pet & assistant
At the top under Realtime Voice Call, toggle voice calls, enter your local Volcengine API key, and set your preferred voice ID
Scroll down to Desktop Pet (toggle visibility, switch characters, or import a `.zip` pack) and Desktop Cards (master switch and Windows desktop pinning)
agentExamplesZh: 关闭桌面宠物
让 OpenBitFun 使用 /path/to/pet 里的萌宠
打开实时语音通话设置
暂时关闭桌面小卡片功能
agentExamplesEn: Turn off the desktop pet
Make OpenBitFun use the pet at /path/to/pet
Open realtime voice call settings
Turn off desktop cards for now
tipsZh: “实时语音通话”位于本页顶部，而聊天输入框里的“本地离线语音转文字（听写）”位于“输入与交互”页——两者互不干扰，可按需分别开启。
实时语音通话的 API Key 只存放在你当前这台控制端电脑上，即使连接了 SSH 远程工作区或同账号其他设备也不会外发。
关闭“启用桌面小卡片”不会清空已有卡片；等演示或录屏结束重新打开开关，原来的卡片会按原尺寸和位置回来。
tipsEn: Client-wide Realtime Voice Call sits right at the top of Pet & assistant, whereas composer dictation (local SenseVoice / Qwen3-ASR speech-to-text) lives in Input & Interaction — you can use either or both.
Your Realtime Voice API key stays strictly on this local controller device and is never forwarded to SSH remote workspaces or peer devices.
Turning off Enable Desktop Cards never deletes existing cards; toggle it back on after your meeting and every card returns in place.

operations.descriptionZh: 读取当前启用角色以及内置与已导入的 Petdex 角色列表。
operations.descriptionEn: Read the active character along with built-in and imported Petdex characters.

operations.descriptionZh: 按已安装角色 ID 直接切换，或传入本地 Petdex 文件夹 / 压缩包路径一键导入并启用。
operations.descriptionEn: Switch to an installed character by ID, or pass a local Petdex folder/archive path to import and activate it.

operations.descriptionZh: 按角色 ID 或包路径移除已导入角色；若该角色正在使用，会自动安全回退到默认伙伴。
operations.descriptionEn: Remove an imported character by ID or package path, automatically falling back to the default companion if active.

options.descriptionZh: 在桌面上显示或隐藏智能体伙伴窗口（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Show or hide the floating agent companion on your desktop (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 控制桌面小卡片整体显隐以及智能体是否可调用小卡片工具；关闭不会删除已有卡片（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Show or hide all desktop cards and control whether agents can use the desktop-card tool without deleting saved cards (on by default).

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 输入与交互
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Input & Interaction
capabilities.summaryZh: 配置本地离线语音输入（SenseVoice / Qwen3-ASR 双模型）、执行中的消息发送策略（立即纠偏 vs 排队）、侧问关闭保护与划词操作栏。
capabilities.summaryEn: Configure on-device speech-to-text dictation (SenseVoice & Qwen3-ASR local models), mid-turn message sending (immediate steering vs queueing), /btw close confirmation, and text-selection actions.
highlightsZh: 纯本地离线语音输入：可选轻量 SenseVoice Small（中/粤/英/日/韩）或高精度 Qwen3-ASR 0.6B（解锁 30+ 语种）
执行中消息发送策略：默认“立即发送”中途纠偏，或改“排队发送”等回合结束
侧问（/btw）关闭前确认提醒，防止随手关掉临时问答记录
对话文本划词自动弹出“添加批注 / 侧边提问”工具栏（页面底部同屏集成“快捷键”分区）
highlightsEn: 100% local offline speech-to-text with lightweight SenseVoice Small (`auto`/zh/yue/en/ja/ko) and higher-accuracy Qwen3-ASR 0.6B (unlocking 30+ languages)
Mid-turn message policy: Send Immediately (default live steering) vs Queue Until Turn Finishes
Confirmation prompt before closing a `/btw` side question whose messages are not saved
Automatic floating action bar (Annotate & Ask in Side Panel) on text selection, plus the Keyboard Shortcuts section at the bottom of the same page
scenariosZh: 口述一段复杂需求草稿：日常中英混说选轻快的 `SenseVoice Small INT8` 秒级出字，需要多语种或更高识别率时换上 `Qwen3-ASR 0.6B INT8`，全程离线不出本机。
看着智能体正在跑任务时突然想起漏提了一个边界条件：保持默认“立即发送”可当场插话纠偏；如果你更习惯先把下一件事写好放着、不打断当前推理，切成“排队发送”更顺手。
阅读智能体的长篇方案时划选几段关键结论，借自动弹出的操作栏一键攒批注或开侧问追问细节；若平时纯复制代码嫌浮条抢眼，也可关掉自动弹出改用右键触发。
scenariosEn: Dictate complex prompts completely offline: pick lightweight `SenseVoice Small INT8` for snappy everyday speech or `Qwen3-ASR 0.6B INT8` when you want higher accuracy or 30+ languages.
Spot a missing constraint while an agent is mid-run: keep Send Immediately to steer the active turn on the fly, or switch to Queue if you prefer jotting down the next task without interrupting.
Highlight paragraphs in a long agent proposal to annotate or spin up a quick side question from the selection toolbar — or turn off auto-popup and trigger it via right-click whenever you want.

items.titleZh: 在聊天输入框启用或停用语音输入按钮
items.titleEn: Enable or disable the voice-input button in the chat composer
items.descriptionZh: 开启后聊天输入框会显示麦克风录音入口，录音在本机离线转成可编辑文本放回输入框，确认无误再发送。
items.descriptionEn: Shows the microphone button in the chat composer so spoken audio is transcribed locally into editable text before you send.

items.titleZh: 下载、选择、验证、修复或删除本地语音模型（SenseVoice Small 与 Qwen3-ASR）
items.titleEn: Download, select, verify, repair, or delete local speech models (SenseVoice Small & Qwen3-ASR)
items.descriptionZh: 提供两款纯本地模型：默认轻量的 `SenseVoice Small INT8`（支持自动检测及中、粤、英、日、韩）与更高精度的 `Qwen3-ASR 0.6B INT8`（支持 30+ 语言），均可在此一键校验修复或删除释放空间。
items.descriptionEn: Choose between lightweight `SenseVoice Small INT8` (default: `auto`, Chinese, Cantonese, English, Japanese, Korean) and higher-accuracy `Qwen3-ASR 0.6B INT8` (unlocking 30+ languages), with built-in verify, repair, and delete controls.

control.reasonZh: “下载、选择、验证、修复或删除本地语音模型（SenseVoice Small 与 Qwen3-ASR）”涉及本地模型体积对照、实时下载进度与完整性校验；智能体会为你打开语音模型管理区。
control.reasonEn: “Download, select, verify, repair, or delete local speech models (SenseVoice Small & Qwen3-ASR)” involves model size review, live download progress, and integrity verification; the Agent opens the local speech-model section for you.

items.titleZh: 设置默认语音识别语言（自动检测或按所选模型指定语种）
items.titleEn: Choose automatic language detection or a fixed recognition language supported by the active model
items.descriptionZh: 默认“自动检测（auto）”省心应对中英混说；固定单一语种时，`SenseVoice Small` 支持中/粤/英/日/韩，切换为 `Qwen3-ASR 0.6B` 则可在设置界面中选择 30+ 种细分语言。
items.descriptionEn: Defaults to Auto-Detect (`auto`) for mixed speech; pinning a language offers Chinese, Cantonese, English, Japanese, and Korean on `SenseVoice Small`, or 30+ selectable languages in the UI when `Qwen3-ASR 0.6B` is selected (Agent direct control supports `auto`/`zh`/`en`/`ja`/`yue`).

items.titleZh: 设置单次语音输入允许的最长录音秒数（10–600 秒）
items.titleEn: Set the maximum duration of a single voice recording (10–600 seconds)
items.descriptionZh: 默认上限为 60 秒，既防忘关麦克风空录太久，也允许你在口述长段背景思路时调高到最多 600 秒（10 分钟）。
items.descriptionEn: Defaults to 60 seconds to prevent accidental open-mic recordings, and can be raised up to 600 seconds (10 minutes) when dictating detailed specs.

items.titleZh: 选择输入麦克风设备并现场测试语音转写效果与耗时
items.titleEn: Select a microphone device and run a live speech-recognition test
items.descriptionZh: 外接了耳机、声卡或会议麦时，可在此指定录音设备并当场录几秒话验证收音音量、转写文本和本地推理耗时。
items.descriptionEn: Pick the right input device when headsets or USB mics are connected, then record a short sample to check transcript quality and local inference latency.

control.reasonZh: “选择输入麦克风设备并现场测试语音转写效果与耗时”需要枚举当前在线音频硬件并由你亲自说话试音；智能体会直达语音诊断测试入口。
control.reasonEn: “Select a microphone device and run a live speech-recognition test” requires enumerating live audio input hardware and speaking a test phrase; the Agent opens the microphone diagnostic section directly.

items.titleZh: 配置智能体执行期间发送消息的默认行为（立即发送纠偏 vs 排队等待）
items.titleEn: Choose whether messages sent during an active turn steer immediately or wait in queue
items.descriptionZh: 默认“立即发送”会把新消息实时注入当前原生智能体回合，方便中途纠偏或补充条件；改为“排队发送”则会暂存消息等本轮结束后再发出（注：ACP 外部智能体会话始终等待当前回合完成）。
items.descriptionEn: Defaults to Send Immediately so new messages steer or supplement the running native Agent turn in real time; switch to Queue to hold messages until the current turn finishes (note: ACP external-agent sessions always wait for turn completion).

control.reasonZh: “配置智能体执行期间发送消息的默认行为（立即发送纠偏 vs 排队等待）”属于当前设备的交互手感偏好，智能体会直接定位到“输入与交互 → 消息发送”区域供你切换。
control.reasonEn: “Choose whether messages sent during an active turn steer immediately or wait in queue” is an interactive input preference scoped to the active surface; the Agent opens Input & Interaction → Message Sending so you can switch modes.

items.titleZh: 开启或关闭侧问（/btw）面板关闭前的丢弃确认提示
items.titleEn: Enable or disable the confirmation prompt before closing a /btw side conversation
items.descriptionZh: 侧问（`/btw`）专为不污染主会话上下文的临时追问设计，关闭后对话内容不会落盘保存；开启确认可避免误点关闭丢掉刚问出的参考答案。
items.descriptionEn: `/btw` side conversations keep quick tangents out of your main session context and discard their messages on close; keeping this confirmation on prevents accidental loss.

control.reasonZh: “开启或关闭侧问（/btw）面板关闭前的丢弃确认提示”保存在当前界面的交互偏好中，智能体会为你打开“输入与交互 → 侧问关闭确认”开关位置。
control.reasonEn: “Enable or disable the confirmation prompt before closing a /btw side conversation” is stored as a client UI interaction preference; the Agent opens Input & Interaction → Side-Question Close Confirmation for you.

items.titleZh: 开启或关闭在对话中划选文字后自动弹出快捷操作栏
items.titleEn: Enable or disable the automatic floating toolbar when selecting conversation text
items.descriptionZh: 默认开启，选中智能体回复即可一键“添加批注”或“侧边提问”；若关闭自动弹出，依然能随时通过右键菜单或提问快捷键调用同样能力。
items.descriptionEn: Enabled by default so selecting agent replies surfaces Annotate and Side Question actions right away; if turned off, both remain accessible via right-click and keyboard shortcut.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“应用与界面 → 输入与交互”
按需设定划词操作栏、执行中“立即发送 / 排队发送”策略与侧问关闭确认
在“语音”区下载本地语音模型（SenseVoice Small 或 Qwen3-ASR）并用麦克风试录一句话；继续向下滚动即同页的“快捷键”分区
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Application & Interface → Input & Interaction
Set your preferences for text-selection actions, mid-turn message sending (Immediate vs Queue), and `/btw` close confirmation
Under Voice, download a local model (`SenseVoice Small` or `Qwen3-ASR`) and run a quick microphone test; scroll to the bottom of the same page for Keyboard Shortcuts
agentExamplesZh: 启用聊天框语音输入，把识别语言设为中文
把单次最长录音时间改成 180 秒
关掉选中文字后自动弹出的操作栏
打开消息发送策略设置
agentExamplesEn: Enable voice input and set the recognition language to Chinese
Set the maximum voice recording duration to 180 seconds
Turn off the automatic text-selection toolbar in chat
Open mid-turn message sending settings
tipsZh: 两款语音模型都在本机离线推理、录音绝不上传：追求响应轻快选中英粤日韩够用的 `SenseVoice Small INT8`，需要小语种或更强抗噪识别则下载 `Qwen3-ASR 0.6B INT8`。想找免提双向对话的“实时语音通话”，请前往“应用与界面 → 宠物与助手”。
经常给智能体回复做逐段评审时，强烈建议保留“选中文字操作栏”：多选几处加上批注再一次性发给智能体修改，比来回打字高效得多。
“快捷键”就集成在本页最下方分区，滚动到底部或在设置左上角“搜索设置…”输入“快捷键”即可一键直达。
tipsEn: Both speech models run 100% offline on your machine: pick `SenseVoice Small INT8` for fast everyday dictation or `Qwen3-ASR 0.6B INT8` to unlock 30+ languages and higher accuracy. For two-way hands-free Realtime Voice Calls, visit Application & Interface → Pet & assistant.
Keep the Text Selection Toolbar on when reviewing long plans — collecting several inline annotations and sending them in one batch beats typing line references by hand.
Keyboard Shortcuts sits right at the bottom section of this same Input & Interaction page — scroll down or type “shortcuts” into the top-left Search settings box to jump straight there.

options.titleZh: 自动显示选中文字操作栏
options.descriptionZh: 划选对话文本后自动浮现批注和侧问按钮；关闭后仍可通过右键菜单与快捷键使用（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically show annotation and side-question actions when selecting chat text; right-click and shortcut access remain available when off (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 在聊天输入框显示麦克风按钮并启用本机离线语音转文字。
options.descriptionEn: Show the microphone button in the chat composer for local speech-to-text dictation.

options.descriptionZh: 通过智能体快速设为自动检测（auto）或中文（zh）、英文（en）、日文（ja）、粤语（yue）；若在界面启用 Qwen3-ASR 模型还可选 30+ 种语言。
options.descriptionEn: Set via Agent to `auto`, Chinese (`zh`), English (`en`), Japanese (`ja`), or Cantonese (`yue`), with 30+ languages selectable in the UI when using `Qwen3-ASR`.

options.descriptionZh: 单次语音输入允许录音的最长秒数（10–600 秒，默认 60 秒）。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum seconds allowed for a single voice-input recording (10–600 s, default 60 s).

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 应用与界面 → 输入与交互（底部“快捷键”分区）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Application & Interface → Input & Interaction (bottom Keyboard Shortcuts section)
capabilities.summaryZh: 按作用域浏览和搜索全部快捷键，实时录制改键、标红排查冲突、合并改绑数字组键位，并支持单项恢复与全部重置。
capabilities.summaryEn: Browse and search every shortcut by scope, record custom bindings with live conflict checks, remap number-range groups at once, and revert single items or reset all.
highlightsZh: 覆盖全局、智能体会话、代码编辑器、编辑器画布、终端、文件树与 Git 全作用域检索
“切换场景 1–3”与“切换编辑器标签 1–9”整组修饰键一次录制批量生效
同作用域键位冲突与系统保留热键实时标红拦截
支持单条还原与一键重置默认，点击“应用”后正式写入配置
highlightsEn: Search across Global, Agent Session, Code Editor, Editor Canvas, Terminal, File Tree, and Git scopes
Group-level remapping for Switch Scene (1–3) and Switch Editor Tab (1–9) in a single recording
Real-time red conflict detection and OS-reserved shortcut protection
Revert a single shortcut or reset all to defaults, then click Apply to commit your changes
scenariosZh: 刚从 VS Code、JetBrains 或 Vim 迁过来，想快速查清全局搜索（`⌘K / Ctrl+K`）、新建终端（``Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+` ``）或侧边栏折叠默认绑了什么键。
常用快捷键和本地输入法、截图工具撞车了，点开对应条目按下顺手的新组合键，看没有红色冲突提示后点“应用”即可生效。
想把切标签页统一改成自己习惯的修饰键前缀，只需在“切换编辑器标签（1–9）”录制一次修饰键 + 任意数字，1 到 9 号标签键位会自动整组同步。
scenariosEn: Coming from VS Code or JetBrains and want a quick cheat sheet for Global Search (`⌘K / Ctrl+K`), New Terminal (``Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+` ``), or split-pane navigation.
Rebind a shortcut that collides with your IME or screenshot tool — press your preferred combo, verify there is no red conflict badge, and click Apply.
Change the modifier prefix for all tab-switching keys at once by recording a single combo on the grouped Switch Editor Tab (`1–9`) row.

items.titleZh: 搜索和查看全局、智能体会话、代码编辑器、终端与 Git 等全部快捷键
items.titleEn: Search and browse all shortcuts across Global, Agent Session, Code Editor, Terminal, and Git scopes
items.descriptionZh: 按作用域清晰分组展示每一项命令的当前按键与默认按键，支持在分区搜索框按命令名称或键位关键词即时过滤。
items.descriptionEn: Lists every known shortcut grouped by scope (Global, Agent Session, Editor Canvas, Code Editor, Terminal, File Tree, Git) with instant search filtering.

control.reasonZh: “搜索和查看全局、智能体会话、代码编辑器、终端与 Git 等全部快捷键”包含当前系统的修饰键显示与你已有的自定义覆盖记录；智能体会直接定位到“输入与交互”页的快捷键分区供你检索对照。
control.reasonEn: “Search and browse all shortcuts across Global, Agent Session, Code Editor, Terminal, and Git scopes” reflects your OS modifier symbols and any custom overrides you have saved; the Agent opens the Keyboard Shortcuts section in Input & Interaction so you can browse them.

items.titleZh: 录制新快捷键、实时检测冲突、恢复单项或重置全部键位并点击应用保存
items.titleEn: Record new shortcuts, detect conflicts live, revert single bindings or reset all, and click Apply to save
items.descriptionZh: 点击键位进入录制模式并按下组合键（按 `Esc` 取消录制）；若与同作用域命令或系统保留键冲突会实时标红提示。确认无冲突后记得点击“应用”正式保存。
items.descriptionEn: Click any binding to record a new key chord (`Esc` cancels recording); overlapping bindings or OS-reserved keys highlight in red immediately. Click Apply when done to persist your edits.

control.reasonZh: “录制新快捷键、实时检测冲突、恢复单项或重置全部键位并点击应用保存”需要你亲自按下物理键盘组合并确认冲突状态后再点击“应用”；智能体会直达快捷键分区入口。
control.reasonEn: “Record new shortcuts, detect conflicts live, revert single bindings or reset all, and click Apply to save” requires pressing physical key combinations on your keyboard, reviewing conflict badges, and clicking Apply; the Agent opens the Keyboard Shortcuts section directly.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“应用与界面 → 输入与交互”并滚动到底部“快捷键”分区（或在设置左上角“搜索设置…”直接搜“快捷键”跳转）
用分区搜索框找到目标操作，点击右侧键位胶囊后按下新的组合键（按 Esc 可放弃本次录制）
确认列表没有红色冲突提示后，点击“应用”按钮使新键位正式生效
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,), go to Application & Interface → Input & Interaction, and scroll to the Keyboard Shortcuts section at the bottom (or search “Shortcuts” in the top-left Search settings box)
Filter for an action, click its keycap badge, and press your desired key combination (`Esc` cancels recording)
Verify no red conflict warnings remain, then click Apply so your new bindings take effect
agentExamplesZh: 打开快捷键设置
带我查看终端和编辑器的快捷键列表
agentExamplesEn: Open keyboard-shortcut settings
Show me the list of terminal and editor shortcuts
tipsZh: 改完键位千万别忘了点 **“应用（Apply）”** 按钮！录制过程会先进入待确认草稿区，这样即使不小心按出冲突也不会立刻搞乱当前操作。
不同作用域之间（例如“终端”内部和“代码编辑器”内部）允许使用相同按键而互不冲突；只有全局快捷键或同一作用域内重名才会被标红拦截。
“切换场景（1–3）”和“切换编辑器标签（1–9）”都是合并组，录一次 `修饰键 + 1` 就会把整串数字键一并改好。
tipsEn: Remember to click **Apply** after recording! Recorded edits stage in draft state first so accidental key presses never break your active shortcuts mid-session.
Shortcuts in separate local scopes (like Terminal vs Code Editor) can safely share the same chord; red conflicts trigger only when Global or same-scope bindings overlap.
Switch Scene (`1–3`) and Switch Editor Tab (`1–9`) are grouped bindings — record `Modifier + 1` once and the whole number range updates together.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 编程与开发 → 编辑器
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Programming & Development → Editor
capabilities.summaryZh: 按外观、行为、显示、高级四大分区精细调校代码字体、缩进换行、Minimap 缩略图与自动格式化，并支持通过智能体调整底层自动保存策略。
capabilities.summaryEn: Tune code typography, indentation, word wrap, minimap, and auto-formatting across Appearance, Behavior, Display, and Advanced sections, plus underlying autosave policy via Agent.
highlightsZh: 外观：代码字体下拉（系统默认 / Fira Code / Noto Sans SC / Consolas / Courier New，自定义字体可让智能体设置）、10–32 px 字号、行高与光标动画
行为：Tab 宽度、空格与缩进自动识别、长行自动换行、绝对/相对行号与平滑滚动
显示：Minimap 左右停靠与缩放、空白字符标记、当前行高亮与底部滚动留白
高级：语义高亮、彩色嵌套括号、保存/粘贴自动格式化，以及底层延迟自动保存配置
highlightsEn: Appearance: code font dropdown (Default, Fira Code, Noto Sans SC, Consolas, Courier New — or any custom font stack via Agent), 10–32 px size, line height, and cursor animation
Behavior: tab width, space & auto-detected indentation, word wrap, relative/normal line numbers, smooth scrolling
Display: minimap side & sizing, whitespace rendering, active-line highlight, and scroll-beyond-last-line
Advanced: semantic highlighting, bracket-pair colors, format on save/paste, plus underlying autosave policy via Agent
scenariosZh: 审查智能体生成的宽行 Diff 或阅读 Markdown 文档时不想频繁左右拖滚动条，开启“自动换行（on）”并把编辑器字号调到顺眼的 15 px。
在分栏模式下右边开着聊天、左边看代码觉得横向空间寸土寸金，关掉 Minimap 缩略图立刻给代码正文多腾出一截视野。
同时维护 2 空格前端仓库与 4 空格后端仓库，保持“自动检测缩进”开启，打开旧文件按原仓库规矩走，新建文件则使用你设定的默认缩进。
scenariosEn: Reviewing wide diffs or Markdown docs alongside chat? Enable Word Wrap (`on`) and bump editor font size to 15 px so you never have to scroll horizontally.
Working in a side-by-side split pane on a laptop? Turn off the Minimap to reclaim extra horizontal room for code.
Juggling 2-space frontend repos and 4-space backend repos? Keep Detect Indentation enabled so existing files keep their native style while new files use your default tab size.

items.titleZh: 调整编辑器外观：代码字体、字重、字号（10–32 px）、行高与光标样式
items.titleEn: Configure editor appearance: editor font, weight, size (10–32 px), line height, and cursor behavior
items.descriptionZh: 对应页面“外观”分区：默认字号 14 px、行高 1.5、竖线光标（`line`）与平滑闪烁（`smooth`）；界面下拉内置系统默认、Fira Code、Noto Sans SC、Consolas、Courier New，想指定其他本机等宽字体也可直接让智能体设置。
items.descriptionEn: Matches the Appearance section: defaults to 14 px font size, 1.5 line height, `line` cursor, and `smooth` blinking; the UI dropdown offers Default, Fira Code, Noto Sans SC, Consolas, and Courier New, while any custom monospace font stack can be set via the Agent.

items.titleZh: 调整编辑行为：Tab 宽度、空格缩进、自动检测缩进、自动换行、行号与平滑滚动
items.titleEn: Configure editor behavior: tab size, space indentation, auto-detected indentation, word wrap, line numbers, and smooth scrolling
items.descriptionZh: 对应“行为”分区：默认 4 空格缩进、开启自动识别已有文件缩进、关闭长行换行、显示常规行号并启用平滑滚动（Vim 习惯用户可将行号切为 `relative` 相对行号）。
items.descriptionEn: Matches the Behavior section: defaults to 4-space indentation, auto-detect indentation on open, word wrap off, standard line numbers (switchable to `relative`), and smooth scrolling.

items.titleZh: 调整编辑器显示：Minimap 缩略图、空白字符渲染、当前行高亮与底部滚动边界
items.titleEn: Control editor display: minimap, whitespace rendering, current-line highlight, and scroll-beyond-last-line
items.descriptionZh: 对应“显示”分区：Minimap 默认停靠右侧（支持按比例/填充/适配三种尺寸），空白字符默认仅在选中文本时显现（`selection`），“滚过最后一行”默认关闭（可在“行为”分区切换）。
items.descriptionEn: Matches Display controls: right-docked minimap (on by default with proportional/fill/fit modes), selection-only whitespace markers, active-line highlight, and scroll-beyond-last-line.

items.titleZh: 调整高级编辑能力：语义高亮、括号配色、保存/粘贴格式化、空白清理与底层自动保存
items.titleEn: Control advanced editing: semantic highlighting, bracket colors, format on save/paste, whitespace trimming, and underlying autosave
items.descriptionZh: 对应“高级”分区的 5 个可视化开关（默认均开启）；此外底层自动保存默认采用延迟 1000 ms（`afterDelay`）策略，虽不在本设置页展示图形开关，但可直接让智能体或通过配置文件修改。
items.descriptionEn: Covers all 5 toggles in the Advanced section (all enabled by default); underlying autosave defaults to `afterDelay` (`1000` ms) and can be changed via the Agent or config even though it has no UI toggle on this page.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“编程与开发 → 编辑器”
依次在“外观、行为、显示、高级”四个分区调整字体、缩进、Minimap 与格式化开关
所有控件修改后会自动保存，并即时同步到已打开的代码编辑器标签页
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Programming & Development → Editor
Adjust font, indentation, minimap, and formatting controls across Appearance, Behavior, Display, and Advanced
Every change saves automatically and updates open code editor tabs immediately
agentExamplesZh: 把编辑器字号改成 15，开启自动换行
关闭编辑器的 Minimap 缩略图
把自动保存延迟改成 2000 毫秒
agentExamplesEn: Set the editor font size to 15 and turn on word wrap
Hide the code editor minimap
Change the editor autosave delay to 2000 ms
tipsZh: 编辑器页没有显示“自动保存”图形开关并非漏装：系统默认开启 1 秒延迟自动保存（`afterDelay`, `1000 ms`），如果你偏爱手动 `⌘S / Ctrl+S` 才落盘，直接对智能体说“关闭编辑器自动保存”即可。
当“自动检测缩进”开启时，已有文件会优先沿用文件自身的 2 空格或 Tab 风格；只有新建空文件或无法判断时才会回退到你设定的 Tab 宽度。
这里的字号只作用于代码编辑器；想把左侧目录树和聊天气泡的字一起调大，请去“应用与界面 → 外观 → 界面字号”。
tipsEn: Wondering why Autosave has no toggle on this page? Delayed autosave (`afterDelay`, `1000` ms) is active under the hood by default — if you prefer strictly manual `⌘S / Ctrl+S` saves, just ask the Agent to set editor autosave to `off`.
While Detect Indentation is enabled, existing files preserve their own 2-space or tab style; your configured Tab Size acts as the fallback for brand-new files.
Editor Font Size affects code buffers only; to scale sidebar labels and chat messages, adjust UI Font Size in Application & Interface → Appearance.

options.descriptionZh: 界面下拉提供系统默认、Fira Code、Noto Sans SC、Consolas、Courier New；也可通过智能体或配置写入任意本机字体族与回退链。
options.descriptionEn: UI dropdown offers Default, Fira Code, Noto Sans SC, Consolas, and Courier New; custom font stacks and fallbacks can also be set via the Agent or config.

options.descriptionZh: 在普通（normal，默认）与粗体（bold）字重之间切换。
options.descriptionEn: Choose between `normal` (default) and `bold` code font weight.

options.descriptionZh: 设置代码文字像素大小（范围 10–32 px，默认 14 px）。
options.descriptionEn: Set code font size in pixels (10–32 px, default 14 px).

options.descriptionZh: 设置代码行高倍数（范围 1.0–3.0，默认 1.5）。
options.descriptionEn: Set the code line-height multiplier (1.0–3.0, default 1.5).

options.descriptionZh: 选择竖线（line，默认）、实心块（block）、下划线（underline）及对应细线样式。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `line` (default), `block`, `underline`, `line-thin`, `block-outline`, or `underline-thin`.

options.descriptionZh: 选择平滑渐变（smooth，默认）、普通闪烁（blink）、柔和（phase）、展开（expand）或常亮（solid）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `smooth` (default), `blink`, `phase`, `expand`, or `solid` cursor animation.

options.descriptionZh: 设置一个制表位对应的空格宽度（1–8，默认 4）。
options.descriptionEn: Set the number of spaces per indentation level (1–8, default 4).

options.descriptionZh: 按下 Tab 键时插入空格而非制表符（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Insert spaces instead of a literal tab character when pressing Tab (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 打开已有文件时自动沿用文件现有缩进风格，仅在无法判断时回退默认设置（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically adopt an existing file’s indentation on open, falling back to your defaults for new files (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 选择不换行（off，默认）、按视口换行（on）、按固定列宽换行（wordWrapColumn）或取较小值（bounded）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `off` (default), viewport wrap (`on`), `wordWrapColumn`, or `bounded`.

options.descriptionZh: 选择常规行号（on，默认）、隐藏（off）、相对行号（relative）或每 10 行间隔显示（interval）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `on` (default), `off`, `relative`, or 10-line `interval` numbering.

options.descriptionZh: 为代码滚动启用平滑过渡动画（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Animate vertical scrolling smoothly inside code buffers (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 显示或隐藏代码侧边全景缩略图（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Show or hide the code overview minimap (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 将代码缩略图停靠在编辑器右侧（right，默认）或左侧（left）。
options.descriptionEn: Dock the minimap on the `right` (default) or `left` edge of the editor.

options.descriptionZh: 选择按比例缩放（proportional，默认）、填满高度（fill）或自适应高度（fit）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose `proportional` (default), `fill`, or `fit` minimap scaling.

options.descriptionZh: 选择仅选区显示（selection，默认）、不显示（none）、行尾/词间边界（boundary）、行尾（trailing）或全部（all）。
options.descriptionEn: Render spaces and tabs for `selection` only (default), `none`, `boundary`, `trailing`, or `all`.

options.descriptionZh: 选择仅高亮代码行（line，默认）、仅行号栏（gutter）、整行（all）或关闭（none）。
options.descriptionEn: Highlight `line` (default), `gutter`, `all`, or `none` for the active cursor line.

options.descriptionZh: 允许将文件末尾继续向上滚动到视口中部（默认关闭，位于“行为”分区）。
options.descriptionEn: Allow scrolling past the final line of a file (off by default, shown under Behavior in the UI).

options.titleZh: 自动保存策略（底层配置）
options.descriptionZh: 控制文件自动保存方式：默认延迟保存（afterDelay），也可通过智能体设为关闭（off）、编辑器失焦（onFocusChange）或窗口失焦（onWindowChange）；不在编辑器设置页单独显示开关。
options.descriptionEn: Controls file autosave (`afterDelay` by default, or `off`, `onFocusChange`, `onWindowChange`); adjustable via the Agent or config rather than shown as a UI toggle on this page.

options.titleZh: 自动保存延迟（底层配置）
options.descriptionZh: 当自动保存设为 `afterDelay` 时的等待毫秒数（默认 1000 ms，可通过智能体或配置修改）。
options.descriptionEn: Delay in milliseconds when autosave is `afterDelay` (`1000` ms default; adjustable via the Agent or config).

options.descriptionZh: 启用基于语言语义的符号着色（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Enable language-aware semantic token coloring (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 用不同颜色区分多层嵌套括号，方便快速定位闭合位置（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Colorize nested bracket pairs to make matching scopes easy to scan (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 保存文件时自动运行可用的代码格式化器（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically run available code formatters whenever a file is saved (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 粘贴代码片段时自动整理缩进与格式（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically tidy indentation and formatting when pasting code snippets (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 自动移除换行缩进时残留的多余尾随空格（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically strip trailing whitespace inserted by auto-indentation (on by default).

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 模型与智能体 → 模型
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Models & Agents → Models
capabilities.summaryZh: 一站式管理 AI 供应商与订阅账号，分配主模型、快速模型与经济模型等默认槽位，并配置智能路由、模型池、独立生图、网络代理与流式超时。
capabilities.summaryEn: Manage AI providers and subscription accounts in one place, assign Primary, Fast, and Economy default slots, and configure Smart Mode routing, model pools, standalone image generation, proxies, and streaming timeouts.
highlightsZh: 接入内置厂商、自定义兼容端点、多号订阅池与 Magpie 网关一键发现
为主模型、快速模型、经济模型及视觉、生图、语音分配默认槽位
按需配置智能模式路由（主模型 + 经济模型 + 路由分类模型）或多成员模型池
支持 OpenAI Images 与阿里云百炼（DashScope Native）两种独立图像生成服务
切换请求格式时实时预览派生 URL，并在“更多设置”中分别保存代理、首次响应超时与响应间隔超时（默认均 600 秒）
highlightsEn: Connect built-in providers, custom compatible endpoints, multi-account subscription pools, and Magpie gateways
Assign Primary, Fast, and Economy defaults plus vision, image-generation, and speech slots
Configure Smart Mode routing (Primary + Economy + router classifier) or multi-member model pools
Set up standalone image generation with OpenAI Images or DashScope Native dialects
Preview derived request URLs live per API format and save proxy, First response timeout, and Response idle timeout (600s default) under More settings
scenariosZh: 第一次打开 OpenBitFun 准备写代码：先登录订阅账号（如 Codex、ZCode、OpenCode、Grok）或填入供应商 API Key 测试连通，再把主力编程模型设为主模型、轻量低延迟模型设为快速模型与经济模型。
接入企业内网网关或第三方中转站遇到 404：在供应商表单切换请求格式（如 OpenAI chat/completions、OpenAI responses、Anthropic messages、Gemini generateContent），直接核对输入框下方的实时派生请求地址预览。
高频并行任务容易撞上限流：将多个同平台账号加入订阅池自动轮换，或把不同供应商的同档模型编入模型池并配置备用通道路由，出现抖动时自动平滑切换。
scenariosEn: Getting started on day one: sign in to a subscription account (Codex, ZCode, OpenCode, Grok) or paste a provider API key, run a quick connectivity test, and assign your flagship coder to Primary and a snappy lightweight model to Fast and Economy.

Debugging a 404 on a custom gateway or relay: switch the API format (OpenAI chat/completions, OpenAI responses, Anthropic messages, Gemini generateContent) and check the live derived request URL preview right below the Base URL field.

Staying productive under rate limits: combine multiple accounts in a subscription pool for automatic rotation, or group cross-provider models into a model pool with per-model fallback channel routing.

items.titleZh: 添加内置或自定义供应商、探测 Magpie 网关与配置独立生图服务
items.titleEn: Add built-in or custom providers, probe Magpie gateways, and set up standalone image services
items.descriptionZh: 除主流厂商与兼容端点外，还支持一键探测 Magpie 网关批量导入模型，以及按 OpenAI Images 或阿里云百炼（DashScope Native）方言配置独立生图服务（含分辨率、质量、透明背景、水印与提示词扩展）。
items.descriptionEn: Supports built-in vendors, custom compatible endpoints, one-click Magpie gateway discovery, and standalone image services using OpenAI Images or DashScope Native dialects (with resolution, quality, background, watermark, and prompt extension controls).

control.reasonZh: “添加内置或自定义供应商、探测 Magpie 网关与配置独立生图服务”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Add built-in or custom providers, probe Magpie gateways, and set up standalone image services” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 配置 API Key、Base URL、请求格式（含实时派生 URL 预览）与备用通道
items.titleEn: Configure API keys, base URLs, API formats with live derived URL preview, and fallback channels
items.descriptionZh: 切换 chat/completions、responses、Anthropic messages、Gemini generateContent 或 Gemini Code Assist 时可实时查看最终请求路径，一键拉取远端模型清单，并为单模型绑定备用通道路由。
items.descriptionEn: See the exact derived request URL update live as you switch between chat/completions, responses, Anthropic messages, Gemini generateContent, or Gemini Code Assist, fetch remote model lists, and bind fallback channel routing.

control.reasonZh: API Key 必须通过受保护的模型凭据表单录入；智能体可以打开对应设置，但不会把秘密值纳入能力目录或工具结果。
control.reasonEn: API keys must be entered through the protected model-credential form; the Agent can open that setting but never places secret values in the capability graph or tool results.

items.titleZh: 登录 Codex、ZCode、OpenCode、Grok、Antigravity、Hermes 等订阅账号与多号订阅池
items.titleEn: Sign in to Codex, ZCode, OpenCode, Grok, Antigravity, Hermes, and multi-account subscription pools
items.descriptionZh: 支持浏览器或设备码授权登录（含智谱国内版与 Z.ai 国际版 ZCode），可在卡片上直观查看 OpenCode 与 Grok 实时额度面板，并将多个账号编成订阅池在限流时自动故障轮换。
items.descriptionEn: Sign in via browser or device code (including ZCode CN and Z.ai Intl), view live OpenCode and Grok quota panels, and group multiple accounts into a subscription pool that rotates automatically on rate limits.

control.reasonZh: 订阅账户登录需要在供应商网页或设备授权流程中确认；智能体可以打开入口，但不能代替用户完成外部认证。
control.reasonEn: Subscription sign-in requires confirmation in a provider web or device-authorization flow; the Agent can open the entry but cannot complete external authentication for the user.

items.titleZh: 选择主模型、快速模型、经济模型以及图像理解、图像生成和语音识别默认模型
items.titleEn: Choose Primary, Fast, Economy, image-understanding, image-generation, and speech-recognition defaults
items.descriptionZh: 主模型承担主力编码与推理，快速模型负责自动标题与即时交互，经济模型承接轻量后台或智能路由分流；主模型不含对应多模态能力时，可单独指定视觉、生图与语音模型。
items.descriptionEn: Primary drives core coding and reasoning, Fast powers snappy helpers like session titles, and Economy handles lightweight background or routed turns, complemented by dedicated vision, image-generation, and speech slots.

control.reasonZh: “选择主模型、快速模型、经济模型以及图像理解、图像生成和语音识别默认模型”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose Primary, Fast, Economy, image-understanding, image-generation, and speech-recognition defaults” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 按模型能力选择推理预设或自定义思考预算
items.titleEn: Choose reasoning presets or a custom thinking budget per model
items.descriptionZh: 针对支持思考链的模型调节推理强度挡位，让复杂重构获得充分推演，或让日常简单问答更快返回首包。
items.descriptionEn: Adjust reasoning effort per model so complex refactors get deep deliberation while everyday questions respond quickly.

control.reasonZh: “按模型能力选择推理预设或自定义思考预算”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose reasoning presets or a custom thinking budget per model” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 配置智能模式路由：联动主模型、经济模型与路由分类模型
items.titleEn: Configure Smart Mode routing with Primary, Economy, and router classifier models
items.descriptionZh: 当执行宿主支持模型路由时，可在“智能模式”弹窗中绑定主模型、经济模型与路由分类模型并一键测试连通性，在会话中选择智能模式后即可按任务复杂度自动分流。
items.descriptionEn: When the execution host supports model routing, open the Smart Mode dialog to pair Primary, Economy, and router classifier models with built-in connectivity checks so turns automatically route by complexity.

control.reasonZh: “配置智能模式路由：联动主模型、经济模型与路由分类模型”依赖当前执行宿主的路由支持状态以及主模型、经济模型与路由分类模型的连通校验，需要在模型设置弹窗中确认保存；智能体会直接为你定位到该入口。
control.reasonEn: “Configure Smart Mode routing with Primary, Economy, and router classifier models” depends on execution-host routing availability plus live connectivity checks across the Primary, Economy, and router classifier models; the Agent opens the exact model settings entry so you can configure and verify them.

items.titleZh: 管理多成员模型池、路由策略、健康状态与会话模型选择
items.titleEn: Manage multi-member model pools, routing strategies, health status, and session selection
items.descriptionZh: 将多个已启用模型组合成池并设定按序故障转移或轮询策略，既可在会话选择器中直接选用，也能查看成员冷却状态并手动重试恢复。
items.descriptionEn: Group enabled models into a pool with ordered failover or round-robin routing, select the pool in chat or for subagents, and inspect or retry cooled-down members.

control.reasonZh: 通过模型池编辑器选择已配置成员、顺序与路由策略，并查看健康状态。
control.reasonEn: Use the pool editor to select configured members, their order and routing strategy, and inspect health.

items.titleZh: 测试模型连接或实测图像生成服务，并刷新运行时客户端
items.titleEn: Test model connections or standalone image generation and refresh the runtime client
items.descriptionZh: 随时验证供应商密钥与网络连通性；注意对独立图像生成服务点击测试会真实调用生图接口生成图片，可能消耗对应平台的额度。
items.descriptionEn: Verify provider credentials and network reachability anytime; note that testing a standalone image service generates a real sample image and may consume provider quota.

control.reasonZh: “测试模型连接或实测图像生成服务，并刷新运行时客户端”需要用户在具体配置卡片中主动发起；图像生成测试会实际调用远端接口并可能产生费用，智能体只会打开对应设置入口。
control.reasonEn: “Test model connections or standalone image generation and refresh the runtime client” requires starting the check on a chosen configuration; image-service tests generate an actual image and may consume quota, so the Agent only opens the settings entry.

items.titleZh: 设置或取消首次响应超时与响应间隔超时（默认均 600 秒）
items.titleEn: Set or disable First response timeout and Response idle timeout (600s default)
items.descriptionZh: 两项默认均为 600 秒，留空（或设为 null）表示不设超时；深度推理模型首段输出较慢时可调高“首次响应超时”，修改后分别点击“保存首次响应超时”或“保存响应超时”。
items.descriptionEn: Both default to 600 seconds, and leaving a field blank (or null) disables that timeout; raise First response timeout for long-thinking models, then click Save first response timeout or Save response timeouts.

items.titleZh: 配置 AI 请求使用的 HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 网络代理与绕过规则
items.titleEn: Configure HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS5 network proxies and bypass rules for AI requests
items.descriptionZh: 仅作用于模型请求流量，支持认证凭据与免代理域名列表（如内网网关或本地地址），在“更多设置”填写后点击代理区块的“保存”生效。
items.descriptionEn: Applies specifically to AI model traffic with optional proxy credentials and bypass hosts (such as localhost or intranet gateways); click Save in the proxy section under More settings after editing.

control.reasonZh: “配置 AI 请求使用的 HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 网络代理与绕过规则”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Configure HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS5 network proxies and bypass rules for AI requests” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 按供应商添加自定义 Header、请求体扩展字段与 SSL 证书校验行为
items.titleEn: Add custom headers, extra request-body fields, and SSL verification behavior per provider
items.descriptionZh: 满足企业网关自定义鉴权头、厂商特有 JSON 参数透传以及自签名内网证书跳过 SSL 校验的需求。
items.descriptionEn: Pass custom gateway headers, vendor-specific request JSON fields, or self-signed SSL verification overrides per provider.

control.reasonZh: 自定义 Header 与请求体可能包含令牌或其他秘密值，必须通过受保护的模型配置入口编辑，不能进入智能体可读目录。
control.reasonEn: Custom headers and request bodies may contain tokens or other secrets, so they must be edited in the protected model configuration flow and cannot enter Agent-readable discovery data.

items.titleZh: 让智能体读取当前已配置且可用的模型与能力清单
items.titleEn: Let an agent inspect models and capabilities available under the current configuration
items.descriptionZh: 智能体调用 ListModels 获取当前真实启用的模型列表与多模态标签，避免编造不存在的模型名称。
items.descriptionEn: Agents call ListModels to inspect enabled models and multimodal capabilities at runtime instead of guessing model IDs.

workflowZh: 用 ListModels 读取当前运行时真实可用模型及其能力，再基于用户任务选择
模型列表为空或供应商不可用时返回具体配置状态，并打开模型设置；不得猜测模型 ID
workflowEn: Use ListModels to read models and capabilities actually available to the current runtime before choosing for the task
If no model is available or a provider is unhealthy, surface the specific configuration state and open model settings; never guess model IDs

items.titleZh: 查看 models.dev 目录同步状态、手动刷新并打开本地缓存目录
items.titleEn: Inspect models.dev catalog sync status, refresh manually, and reveal the local cache folder
items.descriptionZh: 同步最新的模型上下文长度、视觉/工具支持与推理挡位元数据，无外网环境时自动沿用本地缓存。
items.descriptionEn: Keep context-window sizes, vision/tool support flags, and reasoning metadata up to date while seamlessly falling back to the local cache offline.

control.reasonZh: ListModels 可读取运行时可用模型，但 models.dev 刷新、缓存定位和维护仍属于设置界面生命周期。
control.reasonEn: ListModels reads runtime-available models, while models.dev refresh, cache reveal, and maintenance remain owned by the Settings lifecycle.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 模型”
登录订阅账号（或配置多号订阅池），或添加内置/自定义供应商、Magpie 网关并点击“测试”确认连通
在默认模型区指定主模型、快速模型与经济模型，按需绑定图像理解、独立图像生成或语音识别服务
需要自动分流或高可用时，配置“智能模式”路由或新建多成员模型池；若调整了“更多设置”中的代理、首次响应超时或响应间隔超时，记得点击对应项的保存按钮（“保存”、“保存首次响应超时”或“保存响应超时”）
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Models & Agents → Models
Sign in to a subscription account (or pool), or add a built-in/custom provider or Magpie gateway and click Test to verify connectivity
Assign your Primary, Fast, and Economy default models, plus optional vision, standalone image-generation, or speech services

Optionally configure Smart Mode routing or a multi-member model pool; if you edited proxy or timeout fields under More settings, click each control’s save button (Save, Save first response timeout, or Save response timeouts)
tipsZh: “更多设置”里的网络代理、“首次响应超时”和“响应间隔超时”（两项默认均为 600 秒，留空表示不限时）各自拥有独立的保存按钮——改完后记得分别点击代理的“保存”、“保存首次响应超时”或“保存响应超时”。
自定义兼容端点若返回 404，优先核对“请求格式”（例如 OpenAI chat/completions 与 OpenAI responses 路径不同）以及表单底部实时显示的实际请求 URL。
未单独指定快速模型或经济模型时会自动回退使用主模型；绑定一个低延迟小模型能让自动标题、候选建议和智能路由分类既快又省 Token。
独立图像生成服务的“测试”按钮会真实生成一张校验图片并消耗对应供应商额度。
tipsEn: Under More settings, the network proxy, First response timeout, and Response idle timeout (both default to 600s; leave blank for no timeout) each have their own save button—click Save, Save first response timeout, or Save response timeouts respectively so changes persist.
If a custom compatible endpoint returns 404, check the selected API format (for example OpenAI chat/completions vs OpenAI responses) against the live derived URL preview below Base URL.
Fast and Economy slots fall back to your Primary model when unset, but pairing a snappy lightweight model keeps auto-titles, prompt suggestions, and Smart Mode classification fast and inexpensive.
Clicking Test on a standalone image-generation service produces a real sample image and may consume provider quota.
agentExamplesZh: 打开模型设置帮我配置默认模型
深度思考模型经常断流，把首次响应超时调到 900 秒
我想查看并配置 AI 网络代理
agentExamplesEn: Open model settings so I can pick default models
Raise the first response timeout to 900 seconds for reasoning models
Take me to the AI network proxy settings

options.descriptionZh: 发出请求后等待首段有效响应的最长秒数（默认 600 秒）；设为 null（或界面留空）表示不限时，适合深度思考耗时较长的推理模型。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum seconds to wait for the first valid output after sending a request (600s default); null (or blank in UI) disables the timeout.

options.descriptionZh: 响应开始后等待下一段数据块的最长秒数（默认 600 秒）；设为 null（或界面留空）表示不限时。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum seconds to wait for the next data chunk after streaming starts (600s default); null (or blank in UI) disables the timeout.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 模型与智能体 → 权限规则
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Models & Agents → Permission Rules
capabilities.summaryZh: 设定智能体执行工具时的默认安全边界（需要确认、自动审批或完全访问），配置自动审批审查模型与超时兜底策略，并集中维护全局 Allow / Ask / Deny 规则。
capabilities.summaryEn: Set the default safety posture for agent tool calls (Ask, Auto-approve, or Full access), configure the auto-approval screener model and timeout fallbacks, and manage global Allow / Ask / Deny rules.
highlightsZh: 清晰对比“需要确认（默认）”、“自动审批”与带风险确认的“完全访问”三档模式
自动审批支持复用快速/主模型等聊天模型，或接入专用 Jev 决策模型（jev-latest）
可调 1–300 秒审批超时（默认 30 秒），自由指定模型不确定或异常时的回退动作
统一编排全局 Allow / Ask / Deny 规则，并控制聊天输入框底部的权限切换器显隐
highlightsEn: Compare Ask (default), Auto-approve, and warning-gated Full access permission postures
Power Auto-approve with your Fast/Primary chat model or the dedicated Jev decision model (jev-latest)
Tune the 1–300s approval timeout (30s default) and choose ask-vs-reject fallbacks on uncertainty or errors
Order global Allow / Ask / Deny baseline rules and toggle the composer permission-mode switcher
scenariosZh: 想顺畅推进开发又不愿盲目放开全部权限：切到“自动审批”，让快速模型或专用 Jev 决策模型自动放行常规构建与查看命令，遇到删改关键资源或拿不准的操作再交回给你确认。
团队或个人有明确的红线命令（如禁止访问特定目录或禁止执行发布脚本）：打开“全局规则”配置高优先级 Deny 规则，同时为高频本地测试脚本添加 Allow 规则免打扰。
在隔离容器或临时实验分支里跑无人值守长任务：阅读风险提示后临时切到“完全访问”，任务结束后直接从聊天输入框下方切回“需要确认”或“自动审批”。
scenariosEn: Staying in flow without giving up safety: switch to Auto-approve so your Fast chat model or the dedicated Jev decision model clears routine build/test steps automatically and only prompts you when an action looks risky or ambiguous.
Enforcing personal or team guardrails: add Deny rules in Global Rules for sensitive paths or deploy commands while whitelisting trusted local test scripts with Allow.
Running unattended experiments inside a disposable sandbox: confirm the warning to use Full access during the run, then switch right back to Ask or Auto-approve from below the chat input.

items.titleZh: 在需要确认（默认）、自动审批与完全访问三种默认权限模式间切换
items.titleEn: Switch the default permission mode between Ask (default), Auto-approve, and Full access
items.descriptionZh: “需要确认”默认放行普通工作区编辑、已识别的只读命令、任务调度和会话间消息，对其他命令、删除、敏感文件和发布操作保持人工把关；“自动审批”先由模型评估风险；“完全访问”需二次确认高风险提示，跳过常规询问但依然遵守产品底层硬性安全限制。
items.descriptionEn: Ask allows ordinary workspace edits, recognized read-only commands, scheduling, and messages between sessions, while keeping other commands, deletions, sensitive files, and publishing subject to confirmation; Auto-approve screens calls with an AI reviewer first; Full access requires confirming a risk warning and skips routine prompts while keeping hard product safety limits intact.

control.reasonZh: “在需要确认（默认）、自动审批与完全访问三种默认权限模式间切换”会改变后续工具调用的安全边界（切换到完全访问还需显式确认高风险警告）；智能体会打开权限规则页交由你亲自选择。
control.reasonEn: “Switch the default permission mode between Ask (default), Auto-approve, and Full access” changes your tool-execution safety boundary (and Full access requires an explicit high-risk confirmation dialog); the Agent opens Permission Rules so you choose directly.

items.titleZh: 为自动审批选择聊天审查模型或专用 Jev 决策模型并加密保存凭据
items.titleEn: Choose a chat screener model or dedicated Jev decision model for auto-approval with encrypted credentials
items.descriptionZh: 聊天模型模式默认优先选用“快速模型”（亦可改为“主模型”或任一已启用模型）；专用决策模型模式默认使用 jev-latest，其 API Key 仅加密保存在当前执行主机。
items.descriptionEn: Chat-model mode defaults to your Fast slot (or Primary / any enabled model), while Decision-model mode uses jev-latest by default and stores its API key encrypted on the current execution host.

control.reasonZh: 专用决策模型（Jev）的 API Key 属于设备级机密凭据，必须在受保护的权限规则设置页中录入或清除，智能体不会读取或回显密钥原值。
control.reasonEn: The dedicated Jev decision-model API key is a device-encrypted secret that must be saved or cleared in the protected Permission Rules form; the Agent never reads or echoes raw keys.

items.titleZh: 设置自动审批超时（默认 30 秒）及模型不确定或报错时的兜底动作
items.titleEn: Configure auto-approval timeout (30s default) and fallback actions on uncertainty or errors
items.descriptionZh: 超时支持 1–300 秒调节；当审查模型返回“不确定”或遭遇网络/超时错误时，可分别设为转为向你弹出确认（默认，防止无故中断任务）或直接拒绝执行。
items.descriptionEn: Set the timeout anywhere from 1 to 300 seconds, and decide independently whether uncertain verdicts or model/network errors fall back to asking you (default) or rejecting the call.

control.reasonZh: “设置自动审批超时（默认 30 秒）及模型不确定或报错时的兜底动作”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Configure auto-approval timeout (30s default) and fallback actions on uncertainty or errors” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 编辑与排序全局 Allow、Ask、Deny 权限规则
items.titleEn: Edit and order global Allow, Ask, and Deny permission rules
items.descriptionZh: 在弹窗中管理跨项目通用的允许、询问或禁止规则；单个项目或特定智能体的专属规则可按需覆盖全局默认值。
items.descriptionEn: Maintain cross-workspace Allow, Ask, and Deny baseline rules in a dedicated dialog; project- or agent-specific rules can override global defaults when needed.

control.reasonZh: “编辑与排序全局 Allow、Ask、Deny 权限规则”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Edit and order global Allow, Ask, and Deny permission rules” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 控制是否在聊天输入框下方显示权限模式快捷选择器
items.titleEn: Choose whether to show the quick permission-mode switcher below the chat input
items.descriptionZh: 开启后可在每个会话底部一眼确认当前处于需要确认、自动审批还是完全访问，并随时按当前任务切换。
items.descriptionEn: Keep the active permission posture visible right below the composer for per-session switching, or hide it if you prefer a minimal input area.

control.reasonZh: “控制是否在聊天输入框下方显示权限模式快捷选择器”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose whether to show the quick permission-mode switcher below the chat input” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 权限规则”
在“默认权限模式”中选择“需要确认”、“自动审批”或“完全访问”，并按习惯决定是否在聊天输入框下方保留快捷切换器
若选择“自动审批”，在下方挑选聊天审查模型（推荐快速模型）或配置专用决策模型（Jev）及加密 API Key，再核对 30 秒超时与异常兜底策略
在“全局规则”行点击“管理规则”，添加并排序跨项目通用的允许、询问或拒绝规则后保存
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Models & Agents → Permission Rules
Under Default permission mode, pick Ask for confirmation, Automatic approval, or Full access, and choose whether to show the quick switcher below the chat input
If using Automatic approval, select a chat screener model (Fast model recommended) or configure Decision model (Jev) and its encrypted API key, then review the 30s timeout and fallback policies
Click Manage rules beside Global rules to add, reorder, and save cross-workspace Allow, Ask, or Deny rules
tipsZh: “自动审批”模式下，只有默认设为“自动审批”时下方的模型类型、超时与回退下拉框才可编辑；若在远程控制或手机端使用，建议将“不确定时”和“出错时”保留为“询问”，这样远端也能收到审批卡片而不会静默失败。
填写专用决策模型（Jev）的 API Key 后，记得点击输入框右侧的保存图标写入主机加密凭据库；清空密钥同理点击删除图标。
即使开启“完全访问”，OpenBitFun 内置的产品级硬性安全边界依然生效；项目级规则可在具体工作区中覆盖全局规则。
命令规则选择 process.execute，并用 git clone * 这样的参数模式匹配已解析的单条命令；尾部 * 不会跨过 &&、管道或重定向。其他命令和文件访问仍分别检查；无法解析的命令继续请求确认。已有 bash 规则仍可使用。
