tipsEn: The Auto-approve screener, timeout, and fallback controls become editable once the default mode is set to Auto-approve; keeping both fallbacks on Ask ensures mobile or Remote Connect sessions can still approve edge cases interactively.
After typing a dedicated Jev decision-model API key, click the Save icon beside the password box to store it in the host encrypted credential vault.
Even in Full access mode, hard product safety boundaries remain enforced, and project-scoped rules can still refine global defaults.

Use process.execute with an argument pattern such as git clone * to match a parsed command. A trailing * does not span &&, pipelines, or redirections. Other commands and file accesses are checked separately; unsupported syntax still asks for approval. Existing bash rules remain usable.
agentExamplesZh: 打开权限规则设置，我想开启自动审批
带我去配置全局 Allow 和 Deny 权限规则
我想看看 Jev 决策模型在哪里配置
agentExamplesEn: Open Permission Rules settings so I can set up Auto-approve
Take me to global Allow and Deny permission rules
Where do I configure the Jev decision model for tool approval?

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 模型与智能体 → 会话与记忆（记忆区块）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Models & Agents → Sessions & Memory (Memory section)
capabilities.summaryZh: 控制 OpenBitFun 是否自动生成记忆并在会话中使用记忆，支持自定义外部工具隐私策略、BTW 侧问参与度、两阶段提取/整理模型、会话回溯与候选保留天数及本地记忆目录维护。
capabilities.summaryEn: Control whether OpenBitFun generates memories automatically and uses memories in sessions, with fine-grained privacy rules for external tool outputs, BTW side-chat opt-in, two-stage models, lookback and candidate retention windows, and local folder access.
highlightsZh: 界面可分别开关“自动生成记忆”与“在会话中使用记忆”（或让智能体一键同步开关两项）
两阶段流水线：会话空闲后后台提取候选记忆，再归并整理为精炼长期经验
三种外部工具上下文隐私策略（默认清除工具原始输出），守护外部敏感数据
可分别为提取阶段与整理阶段指定轻量或主力模型，兼顾质量与 Token 成本
右上角“⋯”菜单支持直接打开本地记忆文件夹审阅编修、恢复默认参数或一键清空记忆
highlightsEn: Toggle Generate memories automatically and Use memories in sessions in Settings (or let an agent switch both together)
Two-stage pipeline extracts raw candidates from idle chats and consolidates them into durable notes
Three privacy policies for external tool context—stripping raw tool outputs by default
Assign separate models for Phase 1 extraction and Phase 2 consolidation to balance cost and quality
Use the ⋯ menu to open the local memory folder for manual inspection/pruning, reset defaults, or erase all memories
scenariosZh: 长期深耕同一个仓库，不想每次新开会话都重复交代代码规范与目录习惯：开启“自动生成记忆”和“在会话中使用记忆”，让智能体在会话空闲后自动沉淀你的架构偏好与常见踩坑点。
会话中经常调用连接内部系统的 MCP 工具，担心敏感返回内容被写进记忆文件：将“外部上下文策略”保持为默认的“清除工具结果”或设为更严格的“跳过会话”。
发现智能体记住了已经过时的旧方案：点击记忆区块右上角“⋯ → 打开记忆目录”直接修改或删除对应记忆文件，或一键清空重来。
scenariosEn: Working in the same codebase week after week: enable Generate memories automatically and Use memories in sessions so conventions, build quirks, and debugging lessons carry over naturally.

Using MCP tools that query internal company data: keep External context policy on Clear tool results (default) so raw external payloads are stripped before extraction, or choose Skip session for strict isolation.
Pruning outdated project assumptions: click ⋯ → Open memory folder in the Memory header to inspect and edit the plain files directly, or erase stored memories cleanly.

items.titleZh: 启用或停用“自动生成记忆”与“在会话中使用记忆”
items.titleEn: Enable or disable Generate memories automatically and Use memories in sessions
items.descriptionZh: 设置界面提供“自动生成记忆”与“在会话中使用记忆”两个独立开关（通过智能体控制时支持一键同时开启或关闭两项），按需控制后台经验提取与新会话注入。
items.descriptionEn: Settings exposes separate Generate memories automatically and Use memories in sessions toggles (while agent control can flip both together in one step).

items.titleZh: 决定 BTW 顺手侧问是否参与长期记忆提取
items.titleEn: Choose whether lightweight BTW side-questions contribute to memory
items.descriptionZh: 默认关闭，让随手一问的临时百科或语法小问题不污染项目记忆；如果你常在 /btw 中确认关键结论，可开启纳入提取。
items.descriptionEn: Off by default so quick /btw side-questions do not clutter long-term memory; turn it on if your side-chats often capture keepers.

items.titleZh: 存在外部工具上下文时选择清除工具结果、允许保留或跳过整个会话
items.titleEn: Choose whether external tool context clears tool results, is allowed, or skips the session
items.descriptionZh: 默认采用“清除工具结果”，既保留你在对话中的决策脉络，又剔除外部工具原始输出；对高敏环境可选“跳过会话”完全不提取。
items.descriptionEn: Defaults to clearing raw tool outputs while keeping your reasoning; choose to skip the entire session for strict confidentiality.

items.titleZh: 设置提取前最短空闲时长、会话回溯天数与启动扫描上限
items.titleEn: Set minimum idle hours, Session lookback days, and startup scan limits
items.descriptionZh: 确保正在活跃推进的会话不会被中途打扰，同时控制回溯多少天内的历史会话以及客户端启动时最多扫描与整理的批次数量。
items.descriptionEn: Waits until chats have been idle before extracting, bounds how many days of session history are eligible, and caps startup scan/processing batches.

items.titleZh: 设置第一阶段记忆提取并发数与原始候选上限
items.titleEn: Set Phase 1 memory-extraction concurrency and the raw-candidate limit
items.descriptionZh: 调节后台同时运行多少个第一阶段提取任务，以及进入第二阶段去重整理前保留多少条原始候选记忆。
items.descriptionEn: Controls how many Phase 1 extraction jobs run in parallel and how many raw candidate notes feed into Phase 2 consolidation.

items.titleZh: 从已启用模型中选择第一阶段记忆提取模型或跟随主模型
items.titleEn: Choose the Phase 1 memory-extraction model or follow the Primary model
items.descriptionZh: 第一阶段需要批量阅读历史轮次，指定一个高性价比或快速模型能大幅节省后台 Token 消耗。
items.descriptionEn: Because Phase 1 scans historical turns in batches, picking a fast or cost-effective model here saves significant background tokens.

control.reasonZh: 可选模型集合来自当前启用的模型配置，必须按实时列表选择；智能体可准确打开该设置而不会把任意字符串冒充为有效模型。
control.reasonEn: The choices come from the live set of enabled model configurations and must be selected against that list; the Agent can open the exact setting without pretending any arbitrary string is a valid model.

items.titleZh: 选择第二阶段记忆整理模型（跟随主模型、提取模型或指定模型）
items.titleEn: Choose the Phase 2 consolidation model (follow Primary, Extraction, or a specific model)
items.descriptionZh: 第二阶段负责去重、消解冲突并归纳长期结论，适合跟随主模型以获得更准确的结构化整理质量。
items.descriptionEn: Phase 2 deduplicates and reconciles candidates into clean long-term notes, making your Primary model a great fit for synthesis quality.

control.reasonZh: “选择第二阶段记忆整理模型（跟随主模型、提取模型或指定模型）”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose the Phase 2 consolidation model (follow Primary, Extraction, or a specific model)” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 设置未被使用的候选保留天数
items.titleEn: Set Candidate retention days for unused raw memories
items.descriptionZh: 超过“候选保留天数”仍未被用到的陈旧原始候选会自动淘汰，避免过时上下文长期堆积。
items.descriptionEn: Automatically expires stale, unused raw memory candidates past the Candidate retention window so old assumptions do not pile up.

items.titleZh: 通过“⋯”菜单打开本地记忆目录、恢复默认设置或清空全部记忆
items.titleEn: Open the local memory folder, restore default settings, or erase all memories from the ⋯ menu
items.descriptionZh: 记忆区块标题栏右侧提供透明可控的维护入口：可随时打开磁盘目录检查和手改记忆内容，也可单独重置参数或彻底清空已存记忆。
items.descriptionEn: Use the ⋯ menu in the Memory section header to inspect or hand-edit memory files on disk, reset tuning parameters, or permanently clear all stored memories.

control.reasonZh: “通过“⋯”菜单打开本地记忆目录、恢复默认设置或清空全部记忆”包含不可逆的清空确认或文件管理器跳转；智能体会直接打开记忆设置区块，由你在可见界面中确认操作。
control.reasonEn: “Open the local memory folder, restore default settings, or erase all memories from the ⋯ menu” includes destructive erase confirmation or opening the host file manager; the Agent opens the Memory section so you confirm visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 会话与记忆”并滚动到“记忆”区块
按需开启“自动生成记忆”和“在会话中使用记忆”两个开关，并确认 BTW 侧问参与度与外部上下文隐私策略
需要精细调优时，分别指定第一阶段提取模型、第二阶段整理模型，以及空闲时长、“会话回溯天数”与“候选保留天数”
想查看智能体到底记住了什么，点击记忆标题栏右上角的“⋯ → 打开记忆目录”直接浏览或修剪文件
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, go to Models & Agents → Sessions & Memory, and scroll to the Memory section
Toggle Generate memories automatically and Use memories in sessions as needed, then review BTW side-session participation and the External context policy
Optionally tune Phase 1 extraction and Phase 2 consolidation models along with idle hours, Session lookback days, and Candidate retention
Click ⋯ → Open memory folder in the Memory header anytime to inspect, edit, or prune what was learned
tipsZh: “会话回溯天数”不能大于“候选保留天数”（否则刚从较早会话提取出的候选记忆会被立即当成过期清理），界面输入时会自动帮你联动约束这两个数值。
想省钱又想要好记忆？实用搭配是：第一阶段“记忆提取模型”选便宜轻快的快速/经济模型，第二阶段“记忆整理模型”跟随主模型。
个人长期记忆适合沉淀你的日常使用习惯；如果是整个团队共享的硬性仓库规范，推荐在会话中运行 `/init` 生成或维护仓库根目录的 `AGENTS.md`，两者配合效果最好。
tipsEn: Session lookback days cannot exceed Candidate retention (otherwise newly extracted notes from older chats would expire right away); the UI automatically keeps both bounds consistent.
A great cost/quality pairing: assign a fast, inexpensive model to Phase 1 extraction and keep Phase 2 consolidation following your Primary model.
Personal long-term memory is great for individual habits; for shared team-wide repository rules, run `/init` in chat to generate or maintain `AGENTS.md` in Git alongside Memory.
agentExamplesZh: 帮我关闭长期记忆
把外部上下文策略设为跳过会话以保护隐私
打开记忆设置，我想看看记忆目录里存了什么
agentExamplesEn: Turn off long-term memory for now
Set memory external context policy to skip sessions for privacy
Open Memory settings so I can inspect the memory folder

options.titleZh: 自动生成并在会话中使用记忆
options.descriptionZh: 一键同时开启或关闭“自动生成记忆”与“在会话中使用记忆”。
options.descriptionEn: Toggle both Generate memories automatically and Use memories in sessions together.

options.descriptionZh: 控制轻量 /btw 侧问对话是否纳入后台记忆提取范围（默认关闭）。
options.descriptionEn: Allow lightweight /btw side-conversations to contribute memories (off by default).

options.descriptionZh: 会话包含外部工具上下文时，选择清除工具原始结果（默认）、允许完整保留，或直接跳过该会话不提取记忆。
options.descriptionEn: When external tool context is present, choose to strip raw tool outputs (default), keep them, or skip extracting memories from that session.

options.titleZh: 提取前最短空闲时长（小时）
options.descriptionZh: 会话静置达到指定小时数后才进入后台提取队列，避免打断仍在进行中的工作。
options.descriptionEn: Hours a session must remain idle before becoming eligible for background extraction.

options.descriptionZh: 仅从最近指定天数以内的历史会话提取记忆（不大于候选保留天数）。
options.descriptionEn: Extract memories only from sessions within this many days (bounded by Candidate retention).

options.titleZh: 每次启动整理批次上限
options.descriptionZh: 每次启动应用后后台最多处理的待整理记忆会话数量。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum pending session rollouts processed in the background per app launch.

options.titleZh: 每次启动扫描会话上限
options.descriptionZh: 每次启动应用寻找记忆候选时最多扫描的历史会话总数。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum historical sessions scanned for memory candidates per app launch.

options.descriptionZh: 限制第一阶段同时运行的后台记忆提取任务数。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum concurrent Phase 1 background extraction tasks.

options.descriptionZh: 限制送入第二阶段去重整理的第一阶段原始候选记忆条数。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum Phase 1 raw memory candidates passed into Phase 2 consolidation.

options.descriptionZh: 设置长期未被召回使用的原始候选记忆最多保留多少天。
options.descriptionEn: Number of days unused raw memory candidates are kept before automatic cleanup.

capabilities.titleZh: 会话与工作区搜索设置
capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 模型与智能体 → 会话与记忆（工作区搜索位于：编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git）
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Models & Agents → Sessions & Memory (Workspace search: Programming & Development → Workspace & Git)
capabilities.summaryZh: 管理新建会话的默认智能体执行模式、会话标题自动生成与选型、答复后的下一步候选建议，以及本地项目的加速全文搜索开关。
capabilities.summaryEn: Configure the Default agent execution mode for new sessions, automatic session titles and their model, post-reply next-step suggestions, and accelerated local workspace search.
highlightsZh: 新建会话可跟随聊天输入框上次选择，也可固定为你偏爱的默认智能体执行模式
自动根据首轮对话归纳清晰会话标题，并可绑定快速模型降低延迟与开销
智能体回复后在聊天输入框给出一句话追问建议，按 Tab 或 → 即可采纳
在本地仓库开启加速搜索以提速代码查找，远程工作区自动切换远程搜索路径
highlightsEn: Let new sessions follow your last chat input choice or lock in a preferred Default agent execution mode
Generate clear session titles automatically and bind them to your Fast model to save latency
Show a one-line next-step prompt suggestion in the chat input after replies—press Tab or → to accept
Enable accelerated local repository search while remote workspaces cleanly use remote search paths
scenariosZh: 每天在多个会话间来回切换总是分不清哪个是哪个：保持“自动生成会话标题”开启，并把标题模型设为轻量快速模型，几秒内就能生成一目了然的主题名。
习惯固定用同一种智能体执行模式开工：在“默认智能体执行模式”中从“跟随上一次选择”改为“固定默认模式”，以后每次新建普通会话都保持一致体验。
本地几十万行代码仓库全文检索偏慢：前往“编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git”确认开启“启用加速工作区搜索”；连接 SSH 远程工作区时该本地开关会自动隐藏，搜索直接走远端主机。
scenariosEn: Keeping dozens of parallel threads recognizable: leave Automatic session titles enabled and point the title model to your Fast slot so every new chat gets a concise topic title in seconds.
Starting every fresh chat in the same mode: under Default agent execution mode, switch from following your last chat input selection to a fixed default mode.

Speeding up code search across a large local monorepo: enable Accelerated workspace search under Programming & Development → Workspace & Git; on SSH remote workspaces the local-only toggle hides automatically and search runs directly on the remote host.

items.titleZh: 设置默认智能体执行模式：跟随聊天输入框上一次选择，或固定默认模式
items.titleEn: Set Default agent execution mode: follow the last chat input selection or fix a default mode
items.descriptionZh: 经常在不同执行模式间切换时选“跟随上一次选择”最顺手；希望每次新建普通会话都使用固定模式时可直接锁定目标。
items.descriptionEn: Follow your last chat input choice when you switch modes often, or fix a default execution mode so every new regular session starts identically.

control.reasonZh: “设置默认智能体执行模式：跟随聊天输入框上一次选择，或固定默认模式”由“会话与记忆”设置页中的关联控件共同管理，目前没有单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开该入口供你选择。
control.reasonEn: “Set Default agent execution mode: follow the last chat input selection or fix a default mode” is managed by linked controls on the Sessions & Memory settings page; the Agent opens the exact section so you can pick visibly.

items.titleZh: 启用或停用根据会话内容自动生成标题
items.titleEn: Enable or disable automatic titles generated from session content
items.descriptionZh: 开启后会在对话起步阶段自动提炼简短标题替换默认的“新会话”，省去手动重命名的麻烦。
items.descriptionEn: Summarizes early conversation context into a concise session title so your sidebar stays organized without manual renaming.

items.titleZh: 让标题模型继承快速模型、主模型或使用指定轻量模型
items.titleEn: Make title generation inherit the Fast or Primary model, or use a selected lightweight model
items.descriptionZh: 推荐继承“快速模型”或单独选一个响应快、价格低的轻量模型，避免为生成几字标题占用昂贵推理模型额度。
items.descriptionEn: Pointing this to your Fast model or a small low-latency model keeps title generation instant without spending flagship reasoning tokens.

control.reasonZh: “让标题模型继承快速模型、主模型或使用指定轻量模型”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Make title generation inherit the Fast or Primary model, or use a selected lightweight model” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 启用或停用智能体答复后在聊天输入框显示的一句话候选建议
items.titleEn: Enable or disable the one-sentence next-step suggestion in the chat input after replies
items.descriptionZh: 答复结束后在聊天输入框给出贴合上下文的下一步追问提示，按 Tab 或方向右键即可填入输入框继续编辑；喜欢纯净界面可随时关闭。
items.descriptionEn: Displays a context-aware follow-up suggestion inside the chat input after a turn finishes—press Tab or Right Arrow to accept and edit, or turn it off for a clean composer.

items.titleZh: 远程工作区明确走远端搜索数据面，绝不静默回退到本机文件
items.titleEn: Use an explicit remote-workspace search path without silently falling back to local files
items.descriptionZh: 当当前项目位于 SSH 或容器远程工作区时，系统会自动隐藏仅限本机的索引开关并在远端主机执行搜索，杜绝本机与远端内容混淆。
items.descriptionEn: When working in an SSH or container remote workspace, local-only index toggles hide automatically and searches execute on the remote host without leaking local files.

control.reasonZh: “远程工作区明确走远端搜索数据面，绝不静默回退到本机文件”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Use an explicit remote-workspace search path without silently falling back to local files” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 为本地工作区启用 Flashgrep 加速搜索
items.titleEn: Enable Flashgrep-backed accelerated search for local workspaces
items.descriptionZh: 位于“设置 → 编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git”中的“加速工作区搜索”区块，开启“启用加速工作区搜索”即可为本地大型代码库显著提速文件名与全文检索。
items.descriptionEn: Located under Settings → Programming & Development → Workspace & Git as Enable accelerated workspace search, speeding up filename and full-text search across large local repositories.

items.titleZh: 后台自动维护本地 Flashgrep 搜索索引并在文件搜索入口查看状态
items.titleEn: Maintain local Flashgrep search indexes automatically and inspect status from search surfaces
items.descriptionZh: 开启“启用加速工作区搜索”后索引会在后台自动构建与增量更新（设置页本身只提供启用开关，不设手动重建按钮；如需查看仓库索引状态或触发重建，可通过文件搜索服务完成）。
items.descriptionEn: Once Enable accelerated workspace search is turned on, indexes build and update automatically in the background (the Settings page intentionally has only the toggle, while index status and rebuild hooks belong to the workspace search service).

control.reasonZh: “后台自动维护本地 Flashgrep 搜索索引并在文件搜索入口查看状态”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Maintain local Flashgrep search indexes automatically and inspect status from search surfaces” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 会话与记忆”
在“默认智能体执行模式”中选择跟随上一次选择或固定默认模式，并按需调整自动生成会话标题（及标题模型）与候选输入建议开关
如需调整本地项目的代码加速搜索开关，切换到左侧“编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git”开启或关闭“启用加速工作区搜索”
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Models & Agents → Sessions & Memory
Under Default agent execution mode, choose whether new sessions follow your last selection or use a fixed mode, then adjust automatic session titles (and title model) and prompt suggestions
To toggle accelerated local repository search, switch to Programming & Development → Workspace & Git in the sidebar and toggle Enable accelerated workspace search
tipsZh: 原本合并展示的会话与工作区搜索项，在实际设置界面中分属两处：会话相关项都在“模型与智能体 → 会话与记忆”，而“加速工作区搜索”开关在“编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git”。
聊天输入框出现灰色一句话候选建议时，按 Tab 或右方向键（→）才会采纳；直接打字输入自己的内容会立即覆盖它，完全不影响正常输入。
“加速工作区搜索”在界面中只有一个启用开关，开启后后台自动维护本地索引，没有手动重建按钮；在远程工作区下该区块会自动隐藏。
tipsEn: In the Settings sidebar, session preferences live under Models & Agents → Sessions & Memory, whereas Accelerated workspace search lives under Programming & Development → Workspace & Git.
When a gray follow-up suggestion appears in the chat input, press Tab or Right Arrow (→) to accept it—simply typing your own message replaces it immediately.

Accelerated workspace search exposes just a clean Enable toggle in Settings (indexes maintain themselves automatically with no manual rebuild button on that page) and hides automatically on remote workspaces.
agentExamplesZh: 关闭答复后的候选输入建议
把默认智能体执行模式设为跟随聊天输入框上一次选择
为本地项目开启工作区加速搜索
agentExamplesEn: Turn off next-input suggestions after replies
Set Default agent execution mode to follow my last chat input selection
Enable accelerated workspace search for local projects

options.descriptionZh: 在新会话首轮交流后自动生成简明易辨认的标题。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically summarize early conversation turns into a recognizable session title.

options.descriptionZh: 智能体答复完成后，在聊天输入框中提示一句话的下一步追问建议（按 Tab 或 → 采纳）。
options.descriptionEn: Suggest a one-sentence follow-up in the chat input after an agent reply (press Tab or → to accept).

options.descriptionZh: 为本地工作区启用 Flashgrep 加速索引搜索（位于“编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git”，远程工作区自动停用隐藏）。
options.descriptionEn: Enable Flashgrep-backed indexed search for local workspaces (under Programming & Development → Workspace & Git; hidden on remote workspaces).

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Programming & Development → Workspace & Git
capabilities.summaryZh: 管理本地加速工作区搜索、AI Git 提交联合作者署名（Co-authored-by），以及并行隔离 Worktree 的存储目录、分支前缀、自动清理与生命周期。
capabilities.summaryEn: Configure local accelerated workspace search, AI Git commit co-author attribution (`Co-authored-by`), and managed Git worktree root path, branch prefix, cleanup rules, and lifecycle.
highlightsZh: 本地工作区加速搜索开关（关闭后常规搜索照常可用，远程工作区自动隐藏）
Git 提交署名：控制智能体提交时是否默认附带 Co-authored-by 联合作者标记
受管 Worktree 统一根目录（默认 ~/.openbitfun/worktrees）、分支前缀与自动清理保留上限（默认 15 个）
盘点当前执行主机上受管根目录内的现有 Worktree（未提交修改 / 未推送提交 / 关联会话）并安全清理
highlightsEn: Local accelerated workspace search toggle (falls back cleanly to normal search when off; hidden on remote workspaces)
Git commit attribution toggle for appending the OpenBitFun `Co-authored-by` trailer on AI-created commits (on by default)
Managed Worktree root (`~/.openbitfun/worktrees`), `openbitfun/` branch prefix, and auto-cleanup retention limit (default 15)
Managed-root Worktree inventory on the current execution host showing dirty files, unpushed commits, session restore, and safe/force removal
scenariosZh: 同时让两个智能体会话试做两套不同重构方案又不想把当前工作区改乱：提前设好 Worktree 分支前缀与保留数量，新开隔离会话时各自拥有干净分支目录，互不踩踏。
团队仓库规范要求提交记录不带外部工具署名，进入“工作区与 Git → Git 提交署名”一键关掉 `Co-authored-by` 即可。
跑完十几轮并行实验想释放磁盘空间，在底部受管 Worktree 列表里看清哪些工作树还有未推送提交、哪些已合并完毕，放心安全删除或找回当时的关联会话。
scenariosEn: Run two competing refactors in parallel without dirtying your main checkout: set your preferred branch prefix and retention cap once, then launch isolated sessions in clean managed worktrees.
Working in a repository whose commit hygiene policy forbids tool attribution trailers? Flip off Git Commit Attribution under Workspace & Git in one click.
Reclaim disk space safely after parallel experiments by checking the managed Worktrees list for dirty state or unpushed commits before deleting or jumping back to a linked session.

items.titleZh: 为本地工作区开启或关闭加速工作区搜索
items.titleEn: Enable or disable accelerated workspace search for local projects
items.descriptionZh: 位于本页顶部，开启后利用本地索引显著加快大仓库的文件与代码内容检索；关闭后普通搜索依然可用，连接到远程工作区时该分区会自动隐藏。
items.descriptionEn: Located at the top of Workspace & Git for local projects to speed up large-repo file and content queries; standard search keeps working when off, and remote workspaces hide this local-only section.

control.reasonZh: “为本地工作区开启或关闭加速工作区搜索”会结合当前工作区是否为本机项目动态展示；智能体会为你打开“工作区与 Git → 加速工作区搜索”区域。
control.reasonEn: “Enable or disable accelerated workspace search for local projects” renders dynamically when a local workspace is active; the Agent opens Workspace & Git → Accelerated Workspace Search for you.

items.titleZh: 开启或关闭智能体创建 Git 提交时的 Co-authored-by 联合作者署名
items.titleEn: Enable or disable OpenBitFun Co-authored-by attribution on agent-created Git commits
items.descriptionZh: 默认开启。启用时智能体生成的 Git 提交说明末尾会自动附带 OpenBitFun 联合作者署名；若团队仓库要求纯个人提交信息，随时可在此关闭。
items.descriptionEn: Enabled by default. Appends an OpenBitFun `Co-authored-by` trailer when an agent creates a Git commit; turn it off anytime if your repository policy prefers plain commit messages.

control.reasonZh: “开启或关闭智能体创建 Git 提交时的 Co-authored-by 联合作者署名”可在“工作区与 Git → Git 提交署名”中一键切换并即时保存；智能体会为你直达该开关位置。
control.reasonEn: “Enable or disable OpenBitFun Co-authored-by attribution on agent-created Git commits” toggles immediately under Workspace & Git → Git Commit Attribution; the Agent opens that exact section for you.

items.titleZh: 了解会话级隔离 Worktree 机制并配置创建与清理默认策略
items.titleEn: Understand per-session isolated worktrees and configure creation and cleanup defaults
items.descriptionZh: 隔离模式在每次新建会话时按需选用，而非强制一刀切；本页负责统一设定受管 Worktree 的存放位置、命名规则与自动清理上限。
items.descriptionEn: Worktree isolation is chosen per session when you need parallel branches rather than forced globally; this page sets the shared directory, naming, and retention defaults.

control.reasonZh: 是否为某个新会话启用隔离需要在创建会话时结合仓库状态选择；此设置页只保存隔离 Worktree 的默认参数，契约不会虚构一个不存在的全局启用开关。
control.reasonEn: Whether a new session uses isolation is selected at session creation against the live repository state; this page stores only managed-worktree defaults, so the contract does not invent a global enable switch.

items.titleZh: 设置受管 Worktree 的统一存放根目录（默认 ~/.openbitfun/worktrees）
items.titleEn: Set the common storage root directory for managed worktrees (`~/.openbitfun/worktrees` by default)
items.descriptionZh: 所有由 OpenBitFun 托管创建的并行工作树都会集中放在该目录下，不会把临时副本散落在你的项目源码目录旁边；系统盘紧张时也可改到大容量分区。
items.descriptionEn: Keeps managed parallel checkouts organized in one place (`~/.openbitfun/worktrees` by default) instead of cluttering sibling project folders — or point it at a larger drive.

items.titleZh: 设置隔离工作树自动新建分支的名称前缀（默认 openbitfun/）
items.titleEn: Set the branch-name prefix used for automatically created worktree branches (`openbitfun/` by default)
items.descriptionZh: 默认使用 `openbitfun/` 前缀，让你在 `git branch` 列表和代码托管平台上一眼认出哪些分支来自隔离智能体任务，也可改成团队约定的如 `ai/` 或个人缩写。
items.descriptionEn: Defaults to `openbitfun/` so agent-created branches are easy to spot in `git branch` and PR lists; customize it to `ai/` or your team’s naming convention.

items.titleZh: 选择新建隔离工作树时是否带上当前未提交的本地改动
items.titleEn: Choose whether uncommitted local edits are copied into newly created isolated worktrees
items.descriptionZh: 默认关闭（从干净的 `HEAD` 起步最稳妥）；如果你经常改了一半突然想基于手头草稿分叉试验，开启它即可自动把未提交改动同步进新 Worktree。
items.descriptionEn: Off by default so new worktrees start from a clean `HEAD`; enable it if you often want parallel experiments to inherit in-progress local edits.

items.titleZh: 启用受管 Worktree 自动清理并设定最多保留数量（默认保留 15 个）
items.titleEn: Enable automatic worktree cleanup and set the maximum retained count (15 by default)
items.descriptionZh: 默认开启并保留最近 15 个受管 Worktree（可设 1–100），超出上限且可安全回收的旧工作树会被自动清理，防止长期并行开发撑爆磁盘。
items.descriptionEn: Enabled by default with a retention limit of 15 worktrees (configurable from 1–100) so older finished checkouts do not quietly eat disk space.

items.titleZh: 盘点受管 Worktree 的生命周期、未提交改动、未发布提交与关联会话
items.titleEn: Inspect managed worktree lifecycle, dirty files, unpublished commits, and linked sessions
items.descriptionZh: 列出当前执行主机上 OpenBitFun 受管 Worktree 根目录内的工作树（按项目筛选查看，不扫描该根目录外的任意手动检出目录），清楚标记未提交改动与未推送提交，也可让智能体通过 `Worktree` 工具读取。
items.descriptionEn: Lists worktrees inside OpenBitFun’s managed worktree root on the current execution host (filtered by project, without scanning arbitrary external checkouts outside that root), highlighting dirty files, unpushed commits, and linked sessions.

workflowZh: 若 Worktree 是延迟工具，先加载契约，再用 list 读取受管 Worktree 与关联会话
Worktree 工具只在本地主项目可用；远程工作区必须明确报告不支持，不得在控制器仓库上代跑
workflowEn: Load Worktree if deferred, then use list to inspect managed worktrees and associated sessions
Worktree is available only for the local main project; remote workspaces must report unsupported instead of operating on the controller repository

items.titleZh: 一键打开或恢复关联会话，并在脏工作区/未发布提交保护检查后删除 Worktree
items.titleEn: Open or restore linked sessions and safely delete or force-delete worktrees after protection checks
items.descriptionZh: 点击关联会话即可跳回当时的上下文；删除 Worktree 前会自动检测未提交改动与未推送分支提交，仅在你明确二次确认后才允许强制移除，严防误删心血代码。
items.descriptionEn: Jump straight back into a worktree’s linked session, or remove finished worktrees safely — dirty trees and unpushed commits trigger an explicit protection prompt before force deletion.

control.reasonZh: “一键打开或恢复关联会话，并在脏工作区/未发布提交保护检查后删除 Worktree”涉及跨会话跳转及未保存代码/未推送提交的安全确认弹窗；智能体会打开管理列表由你核对确认。
control.reasonEn: “Open or restore linked sessions and safely delete or force-delete worktrees after protection checks” involves jumping across sessions or confirming protection warnings for uncommitted edits and unpushed commits; the Agent opens the management list so you stay in control.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“编程与开发 → 工作区与 Git”
按需切换“加速工作区搜索”与“Git 提交署名”开关（这两项立即生效）
在“Worktrees”默认参数区修改根目录、分支前缀或清理上限后点击该区域底部的“保存”（右上角可“恢复默认值”），并在下方管理列表巡检或清理受管 Worktree
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Programming & Development → Workspace & Git
Toggle Accelerated Workspace Search or Git Commit Attribution at the top (both save immediately)

Edit root path, branch prefix, or cleanup limit under Worktrees and click Save in the action bar at the bottom of the defaults section (Reset to defaults sits in the section header), or manage existing checkouts below
agentExamplesZh: 打开工作区与 Git 设置
把受管 Worktree 自动清理上限改成 25 个
帮我看看当前项目有哪些受管 Worktree 还没清理
agentExamplesEn: Open Workspace & Git settings
Set the managed worktree retention limit to 25
List managed worktrees for this project and check if any have uncommitted changes
tipsZh: 注意页面保存差异：上方的“加速工作区搜索”和“Git 提交署名”拨动开关即刻生效；而“Worktrees”默认参数属于草稿表单，改完记得点该表单底部的 **“保存”** 按钮（标题栏右侧是“恢复默认值”）！
自动清理只会回收无未提交改动、无活跃运行任务的旧受管 Worktree，不会悄悄删掉你还没合并的重要改动。
受管 Worktree 列表仅扫描当前执行主机上受管根目录内的工作树；连接 SSH 远程工作区时不会误在本地控制端电脑上代建或误删工作树。
tipsEn: Heads-up on saving: the Accelerated Workspace Search and Git Commit Attribution switches save on toggle, whereas edits in the Worktrees defaults form stage as a draft until you click **Save** in the bottom action bar (while **Reset to defaults** sits in the section header)!
Automatic cleanup never silently wipes dirty worktrees or active sessions — protected checkouts stay untouched until you review them.
The management list tracks checkouts inside OpenBitFun’s managed worktree root on the active host, and never creates or deletes local controller checkouts when you are on a remote SSH workspace.

options.descriptionZh: OpenBitFun 集中存放受管隔离 Worktree 的根目录（留空使用默认 `~/.openbitfun/worktrees`）。
options.descriptionEn: Root folder where OpenBitFun places managed isolated worktrees (defaults to `~/.openbitfun/worktrees` when left blank).

options.descriptionZh: 隔离工作树自动新建 Git 分支时使用的名称前缀（默认 `openbitfun/`）。
options.descriptionEn: Prefix prepended to branch names created automatically for isolated worktrees (`openbitfun/` by default).

options.descriptionZh: 创建隔离 Worktree 时是否把当前工作区未提交的本地修改一并复制过去（默认关闭）。
options.descriptionEn: Copy current uncommitted workspace edits into newly created isolated worktrees (off by default).

options.descriptionZh: 超出保留上限时自动清理已完成且干净的旧受管 Worktree（默认开启）。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically prune older clean managed worktrees once the retention limit is exceeded (on by default).

options.descriptionZh: 触发自动清理前最多保留的受管 Worktree 数量（范围 1–100，默认 15）。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum number of managed worktrees retained before automatic cleanup runs (1–100, default 15).

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 模型与智能体 → 执行与协作
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Models & Agents → Execution & Collaboration
capabilities.summaryZh: 集中调优工具超时、向用户提问等待时间、子智能体默认模型与并发策略、按需加载工具、PTC 工具呈现、参数 JSON 修复、Deep Review 容量，并串联权限及设备控制开关。
capabilities.summaryEn: Tune tool call and user-question timeouts, subagent default models and concurrency, Load tools as needed, PTC presentation, JSON argument repair, Deep Review capacity alongside linked permission and device controls.
highlightsZh: 分别控制单次工具调用超时与向用户提问等待超时（默认 180 秒）
为子智能体指定默认模型（继承父会话、快速/主模型、具体模型或模型池）及并发策略
开启“按需加载工具”、切换 PTC TypeScript/Python 工具编排与安全 JSON 修复
调整 Deep Review 并行评审容量
通过统一产品控制契约联动权限切换器、浏览器启动自动连接与“允许桌面控制”开关
highlightsEn: Configure per-tool call timeouts and the user-question response timeout (180s default)
Pick the subagent default model (inherit parent, Fast/Primary, specific model, or pool) and batch policy
Toggle Load tools as needed, PTC TypeScript/Python orchestration, and safe JSON argument repair
Tune Deep Review parallel reviewer capacity
Coordinate linked permission-switcher, browser startup auto-connect, and Allow desktop control toggles
scenariosZh: 接入了好几个 MCP 服务后发现首轮对话上下文偏大：开启“按需加载工具”，让智能体只在真正用到某个大型工具时才按需拉取参数说明，既省 Token 又能减少选错工具。
主会话用旗舰推理模型、但并行派发十几个子智能体查代码太贵或太慢：把“子智能体默认模型”设为快速模型或高吞吐模型池，并按任务性质在“尽量并行”与“安全并行”间切换。
本地跑全量编译或大型测试脚本经常超过默认时限被中断：调高或设为 0（不限制）单次工具调用超时；若你常离开座位思考回答，也可调大 180 秒的提问等待超时。
scenariosEn: Keeping initial context lean with many MCP servers enabled: turn on Load tools as needed so large tool schemas load on demand only when an agent actually needs them.
Controlling cost and speed during fan-out research: keep your flagship model on the main chat while pointing Subagent default model to your Fast model or a high-throughput model pool.

Preventing long builds or test suites from timing out mid-run: raise or disable (0 / null) the per-tool call timeout, and lengthen the 180s user-question timeout if you often step away before answering.

items.titleZh: 开启“按需加载工具”（延迟加载工具），减少智能体初始上下文
items.titleEn: Enable Load tools as needed (deferred tool loading) to reduce initial agent context
items.descriptionZh: 启用后不再把所有低频大体积工具的完整 Schema 一次性塞进首轮系统提示词，而是在智能体需要时按需检索加载，显著节省输入 Token。
items.descriptionEn: Keeps bulky, less-frequent tool schemas out of the initial system prompt and loads them on demand only when needed, saving input tokens.

items.titleZh: 设置或取消单次工具调用超时
items.titleEn: Set or disable the per-tool call timeout
items.descriptionZh: 限制单次命令或工具最长可持续运行的秒数；遇到耗时较长的全量构建、端到端测试时可适当调大或取消限制（界面设 0 或通过智能体设 null 表示不限时）。
items.descriptionEn: Caps how many seconds a single tool or command execution may run; raise it or disable the limit (0 in UI or null via Agent) for long builds and test suites.

items.titleZh: 设置向用户提问的最长等待响应时间（默认 180 秒）
items.titleEn: Set how long user questions wait for your reply (180s default)
items.descriptionZh: 控制智能体发起提问卡片后等待你开始作答的秒数（默认 180 秒，设为 0 表示一直等待不超时），避免远程或后台协作时因短暂离开而提前中断。
items.descriptionEn: Controls how long AskUserQuestion waits for you to start answering (180s default; set 0 for no timeout) so turns do not time out while you review options.

control.reasonZh: “设置向用户提问的最长等待响应时间（默认 180 秒）”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Set how long user questions wait for your reply (180s default)” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 指定子智能体默认模型：继承父会话、快速/主模型、指定模型或模型池
items.titleEn: Choose the default model for subagents: inherit parent, Fast/Primary, a model, or a model pool
items.descriptionZh: 为未单独绑定模型的子智能体提供统一默认模型；设为快速模型或专用模型池可在并行检索和审查时大幅降低主模型开销与限流压力。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the fallback model for any subagent without its own explicit model binding; picking Fast or a dedicated model pool speeds up parallel research and spares flagship quota.

control.reasonZh: 可选目标来自当前实时启用的模型与模型池列表，需在“执行与协作”设置页按当前目录选择；单个子智能体的独立模型仍可在智能体管理中覆盖。
control.reasonEn: Selectable targets come from your live enabled models and model pools in Execution & Collaboration settings, while per-subagent overrides live in Agent management.

items.titleZh: 设置子智能体与 Swarm 并发上限及任务并行方式
items.titleEn: Set subagent and Swarm concurrency limits plus batch parallelism policy
items.descriptionZh: 分别调节普通子智能体最大并发（1–20）与 Swarm 并发工作上限（1–32）；界面提供“尽量并行”（默认，尽可能同时运行多个任务）与“安全并行”（仅同时运行不会修改内容的只读任务），通过智能体或配置还可设为串行执行。
items.descriptionEn: Control regular subagent concurrency (1–20) and Swarm worker concurrency (1–32) independently; choose between maximizing parallel runs (UI default) and running only non-mutating read-only tasks in parallel (with serial execution also available via Agent or config).

items.titleZh: 选择模型使用原生工具调用、PTC TypeScript 或 PTC Python 模式
items.titleEn: Choose native tool calling, PTC TypeScript, or PTC Python mode for the model
items.descriptionZh: 原生模式由模型逐次发起标准工具调用；PTC（Programmatic Tool Calling）允许强编码模型用受控脚本编排多步工具调用以减少往返轮次，切换后对新建会话生效。
items.descriptionEn: Native tools issue standard per-step calls, while PTC lets capable coding models orchestrate multi-step tool calls through TypeScript or Python—changes apply to newly created sessions.

items.titleZh: 控制是否在安全边界内自动修复模型生成的轻微格式错误 JSON
items.titleEn: Choose whether minor malformed tool-argument JSON from models is safely auto-repaired
items.descriptionZh: 部分开源或中转模型偶尔在工具参数末尾多写逗号或漏闭合引号，开启后可在不猜测业务语义的前提下自动修复，减少无谓重试。
items.descriptionEn: Fixes harmless syntax slips (such as trailing commas) in model-generated tool arguments without inventing missing parameters, cutting down wasted retries.

items.titleZh: 设置 Deep Review 最大并行评审者数量与队列等待时间
items.titleEn: Set maximum parallel Deep Review reviewers and queue wait time
items.descriptionZh: 根据当前模型供应商的并发限额调整深度代码评审同时运行的 Reviewer 数量与排队超时，避免一次性并发过高触发 429。
items.descriptionEn: Match parallel Deep Review worker counts and queue wait limits to your provider rate limits so thorough reviews do not trigger 429 throttling.

control.reasonZh: “设置 Deep Review 最大并行评审者数量与队列等待时间”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Set maximum parallel Deep Review reviewers and queue wait time” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 选择需要确认、自动审批或完全访问权限模式并确认高风险提示
items.titleEn: Choose Ask, Auto-approve, or Full access permission mode and confirm high-risk warnings
items.descriptionZh: 点击后将自动跳转至“模型与智能体 → 权限规则”页调整全局默认权限姿态与自动审批审查器。
items.descriptionEn: Routes directly to Models & Agents → Permission Rules to switch your default permission posture and tune Auto-approve.

control.reasonZh: “选择需要确认、自动审批或完全访问权限模式并确认高风险提示”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose Ask, Auto-approve, or Full access permission mode and confirm high-risk warnings” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 控制权限模式快捷选择器是否显示在聊天输入框下方
items.titleEn: Choose whether the permission-mode switcher appears below the chat input
items.descriptionZh: 对应“模型与智能体 → 权限规则”中的快捷选择器显隐开关，智能体可直接按你的指令开启或隐藏。
items.descriptionEn: Backed by the quick-switcher toggle in Models & Agents → Permission Rules and directly controllable by an agent on request.

items.titleZh: 创建、排序和保存全局或项目级 Allow、Ask、Deny 规则
items.titleEn: Create, reorder, and save global or project-level Allow, Ask, and Deny rules
items.descriptionZh: 全局规则位于“模型与智能体 → 权限规则”，项目级规则绑定在具体工作区中并可按需覆盖全局预设。
items.descriptionEn: Global rules live under Models & Agents → Permission Rules, while project-scoped rules stay with the workspace and can override global defaults.

control.reasonZh: “创建、排序和保存全局或项目级 Allow、Ask、Deny 规则”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Create, reorder, and save global or project-level Allow, Ask, and Deny rules” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 查看、撤销或清空当前项目中已记住的权限授权与审计记录
items.titleEn: Review, revoke, or clear remembered project permission grants and audit records
items.descriptionZh: 当你在会话中勾选了“记住此授权”，可随时审查或撤回单条项目授权记录，恢复每次询问。
items.descriptionEn: Inspect or revoke project-scoped "remember this choice" permission grants and audit entries whenever you want prompts restored.

control.reasonZh: “查看、撤销或清空当前项目中已记住的权限授权与审计记录”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Review, revoke, or clear remembered project permission grants and audit records” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 开启或关闭已获系统授权的“允许桌面控制”开关
items.titleEn: Enable or disable the Allow desktop control switch after OS authorization
items.descriptionZh: 界面位于“工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制”，无需撤销系统隐私权限即可一键暂停或恢复桌面操作能力。
items.descriptionEn: Located in Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control so you can pause or resume desktop control without revoking OS privacy grants.

items.titleZh: 查看并请求辅助功能与屏幕录制系统权限
items.titleEn: Inspect and request Accessibility and Screen Recording OS permissions
items.descriptionZh: 打开“工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制”核查系统授权状态并拉起操作系统隐私设置。
items.descriptionEn: Opens Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control to check OS permission status and jump to system privacy settings.

control.reasonZh: 操作系统权限必须由用户在系统界面中确认；智能体可打开准确入口，但不会把配置开关冒充为系统授权。
control.reasonEn: Operating-system permissions require user confirmation in system UI; the Agent can open the exact entry without pretending that an app setting grants OS authorization.

items.titleZh: 控制 OpenBitFun 启动时是否自动连接外部 CDP 浏览器
items.titleEn: Choose whether OpenBitFun automatically connects to your CDP browser on startup
items.descriptionZh: 默认关闭，避免每次启动客户端时触发外部浏览器的远程调试确认弹窗；需要高频自动化时可开启。
items.descriptionEn: Off by default so launching OpenBitFun does not trigger unexpected browser remote-debugging prompts; enable it if you automate Chrome or Edge daily.

items.titleZh: 发现并选择外部浏览器、开启默认 CDP 配置或按需重启连接
items.titleEn: Discover and choose an external browser, enable default CDP, or reconnect on demand
items.descriptionZh: 前往“工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制”选择 Chrome / Edge 并查看实时 CDP 端口连接状态。
items.descriptionEn: Opens Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control to pick Chrome or Edge and manage live CDP connections.

control.reasonZh: 可用浏览器和 CDP 状态来自当前机器且可能要求重启确认；智能体可打开配置入口，实际网页操作则使用统一的 ControlHub 浏览器契约。
control.reasonEn: Available browsers and CDP state come from the current machine and may require restart confirmation; the Agent can open setup, while page automation uses the shared ControlHub browser contract.

items.titleZh: 允许 Agent 指定子 Agent 模型
items.titleEn: Allow agents to choose subagent models

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 执行与协作”
在“工具运行”与“执行行为”区块按任务耗时设置“工具超时”与“提问超时”（默认 180 秒，设为 0 表示不限制）
在“子智能体”区块选择“子智能体默认模型”，并调整普通子智能体、Swarm 的并发上限与任务并行方式（“尽量并行”或“安全并行”）
按需开启“按需加载工具”、切换“工具呈现模式”（对新会话生效）、调整 Deep Review 容量
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Models & Agents → Execution & Collaboration
Under Tool execution, adjust the per-tool timeout and user-question timeout (180s default; set 0 for no timeout)
Under Subagents, pick the subagent default model and tune regular subagent concurrency, Swarm concurrency, and batch policy
Toggle Load tools as needed, tool presentation mode (applies to new sessions), Deep Review capacity
tipsZh: 旧版“执行与权限”已拆分为三个更清晰的页面：日常运行与并发参数在本页（“模型与智能体 → 执行与协作”），审批策略与全局规则在“模型与智能体 → 权限规则”，浏览器与桌面控制则在“工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制”。
多个子智能体同时改写同一目录文件容易产生冲突；如果任务包含写文件，把任务并行方式切到“安全并行”可确保只有只读探索任务并发执行，写操作稳妥排队。
修改“工具呈现模式”（原生工具 / PTC）只对切换之后新建的会话生效。
tipsEn: Settings formerly grouped under Execution & Permissions now live in three focused places: runtime and concurrency here in Execution & Collaboration, approval policy in Models & Agents → Permission Rules, and Browser/Computer Use in Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control.
If subagents will edit files in the same repository, switch the batch policy to safe-only parallelism so read-only exploration runs concurrently while file writes queue safely.
Changing Tool presentation (Native vs PTC) applies only to newly created sessions.
agentExamplesZh: 开启按需加载工具帮我节省初始上下文
把子智能体最大并发改为 8，任务并行方式设为安全并行
单次工具调用超时改成 600 秒
agentExamplesEn: Turn on Load tools as needed to save initial context
Set maximum subagent concurrency to 8 and use safe-only parallelism
Change the tool call timeout to 600 seconds

options.descriptionZh: 在聊天输入框下方显示或隐藏权限模式快捷切换器（界面位于“模型与智能体 → 权限规则”）。
options.descriptionEn: Show or hide the quick permission-mode switcher below the chat input (configured in Models & Agents → Permission Rules).

options.descriptionZh: 按需向模型提供大型或低频工具详情，显著减少每轮对话的初始上下文占用。
options.descriptionEn: Provide large or infrequent tool details to the model on demand to keep initial turn context compact.

options.descriptionZh: 选择标准原生工具调用，或允许模型通过 PTC TypeScript / Python 脚本编排多步工具调用（对新会话生效）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose standard native tool calls or let capable models orchestrate multi-step tool pipelines via PTC TypeScript or Python (applies to new sessions).

options.titleZh: 子智能体任务并行方式
options.descriptionZh: 在尽量并行（界面默认）、安全并行（仅并发执行不会修改内容的任务）或串行执行之间选择。
options.descriptionEn: Choose maximizing parallel execution (UI default), safe-only parallelism for read-only tasks, or serial execution.

options.descriptionZh: 限制同一时刻并行运行的普通子智能体任务数（范围 1–20）。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum number of regular subagents allowed to run concurrently (1–20).

options.descriptionZh: 限制 Swarm 协作中同时运行的工作与审核智能体上限（范围 1–32）。
options.descriptionEn: Maximum concurrent worker and reviewer agents inside a Swarm (1–32).

options.descriptionZh: 单次工具或命令执行允许持续的最长秒数；设为 null（或界面填 0）表示不限制。
options.descriptionEn: Timeout in seconds for a single tool execution; null (or 0 in the UI) disables the timeout.

options.descriptionZh: 在系统权限已授予的前提下，一键允许或暂停智能体使用桌面控制能力（界面位于“工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制”）。
options.descriptionEn: Allow or pause desktop-control actions once OS permissions are granted (displayed in Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control).

options.titleZh: 启动时自动连接浏览器
options.descriptionZh: 控制 OpenBitFun 启动时是否自动尝试连接外部 CDP 浏览器（默认关闭）。
options.descriptionEn: Choose whether OpenBitFun automatically tries to connect external CDP browser control on launch (off by default).

options.titleZh: 工具参数 JSON 安全修复
options.descriptionZh: 在严格安全边界内自动修复模型输出的轻微 JSON 语法瑕疵，减少因格式小错导致的调用失败。
options.descriptionEn: Automatically repair minor JSON syntax glitches in model tool arguments within strict safety bounds.

options.titleZh: 允许 Agent 指定子 Agent 模型
options.titleEn: Allow agents to choose subagent models
options.descriptionZh: 控制 Agent 能否在启动或继续执行子 Agent 时指定模型。
options.descriptionEn: Control whether agents can override subagent models when launching or continuing work.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 编程与开发 → 终端
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Programming & Development → Terminal
capabilities.summaryZh: 为新建终端标签页与本地工作区智能体命令选择默认 Shell（支持自动检测或指定已安装的 zsh / bash / PowerShell 等）。
capabilities.summaryEn: Choose the default shell used by newly opened terminal tabs and local workspace Agent commands (auto-detected or selected from installed shells like zsh, bash, or PowerShell).
highlightsZh: 自动扫描本机可用 Shell（推荐“自动检测”，也可手动指定 zsh、bash、Fish、PowerShell、Git Bash 等）
同时作为新建终端标签页与本地工作区智能体执行命令的默认 Shell 偏好
修改后对新打开的终端立即生效，不打断已在运行的服务进程
highlightsEn: Discovers installed shells automatically (Auto-Detect recommended, or pick zsh, bash, Fish, PowerShell, Git Bash, etc.)
Shared shell preference for both new interactive terminal tabs and local workspace Agent commands
Applies cleanly to newly opened terminals without disrupting processes already running
scenariosZh: Windows 机器上同时装了 PowerShell 7（`pwsh`）、Windows PowerShell 与 Git Bash，在此固定选好主力 Shell，以后每次按快捷键开新终端都直接进熟悉的环境。
macOS / Linux 上装了 Homebrew 新版 `zsh` 或 `fish`，指定后你的交互终端与智能体本地命令都能加载一致的工具链配置。
scenariosEn: On Windows with PowerShell 7 (`pwsh`), Windows PowerShell, and Git Bash installed side by side, lock in your preferred default shell so every new terminal tab opens in the right environment.
Point OpenBitFun at a Homebrew `zsh` or `fish` binary on macOS/Linux so interactive terminals and local Agent runs share your expected toolchain environment.

items.titleZh: 自动检测或从本机已安装列表中指定默认终端 Shell
items.titleEn: Auto-detect or choose your default terminal shell from installed shells
items.descriptionZh: 默认推荐“自动检测（跟随系统默认 Shell）”；手动选定具体 Shell 后，新打开的终端标签页与本地工作区智能体命令都会优先使用它（注：Windows 下若选 `Cmd`，交互终端会打开 `Cmd`，而智能体命令仍通过 PowerShell 执行以保障结构化返回）。
items.descriptionEn: Auto-Detect (recommended) follows your OS login shell, or you can pick any detected shell on your machine for new terminal tabs and local Agent commands (on Windows, selecting `Cmd` opens `Cmd` for interactive tabs while Agent commands continue using PowerShell).

items.titleZh: 兼容旧版终端面板位置配置项（当前终端停靠已由工作台分栏布局接管）
items.titleEn: Maintain legacy terminal-panel position compatibility setting (superseded by workbench split-pane layout)
items.descriptionZh: 该底层配置字段（`app.terminal_panel_position`）仅为兼容旧版本配置保留，不在“编程与开发 → 终端”页面展示图形开关；日常调整终端位置请直接在工作台中拖拽标签页或使用分栏布局。
items.descriptionEn: Retained strictly as an underlying config compatibility field (`app.terminal_panel_position`) and not shown on the Terminal settings page; arrange or dock terminals directly via workbench tabs and split panes.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“编程与开发 → 终端”
在“默认终端”下拉框保持“自动检测（推荐）”或选择本机已安装的指定 Shell
新开一个终端标签页（Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+`）即可使用刚选好的 Shell，已有运行中的终端不受影响
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Programming & Development → Terminal
Keep Auto-Detect (Recommended) or select a specific installed shell from the Default Terminal dropdown
Open a new terminal tab (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+`) to use the updated shell while existing running tabs stay untouched
agentExamplesZh: 打开终端设置
把默认终端 Shell 改回自动检测
agentExamplesEn: Open terminal settings
Reset the default terminal shell to automatic detection
tipsZh: 切换默认 Shell 只会影响**之后新打开**的终端会话，当前正在跑 `pnpm dev` 或 `cargo watch` 的终端不会被重启或打断。
在 SSH 远程工作区中，终端直接在远端主机登录自身的 Shell 中运行，不会套用你本机电脑上的 Shell 可执行文件路径。
如果想为某个特定项目配置“打开终端自动激活虚拟环境或跑启动脚本”，可以在工作台终端面板的“新建带启动命令的终端”里按项目单独保存。
tipsEn: Changing Default Shell affects **newly opened** terminals only — running dev servers or watchers in existing tabs keep running uninterrupted.
In SSH remote workspaces, terminals launch the remote host’s own shell rather than applying a local controller shell path.
Need per-project virtualenvs or startup commands? Configure a named Startup Command profile right from the workbench Terminal menu.

options.descriptionZh: 指定新建终端与本地智能体使用的 Shell 类型或路径；空字符串表示自动检测系统默认 Shell。
options.descriptionEn: Shell identifier or executable path for new terminals and local Agent runs; an empty string enables automatic detection.

options.titleZh: 终端面板位置（旧版兼容字段）
options.descriptionZh: 保留用于旧版配置读写的兼容字段（`right` / `bottom`），当前工作台已改为通过分栏与标签自由排布终端。
options.descriptionEn: Legacy config compatibility field (`right` / `bottom`); current workbench terminal placement is controlled directly through split panes and tabs.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control
capabilities.summaryZh: 管理智能体操作原生桌面应用界面的“允许桌面控制”总开关，清晰核查并引导授予系统“辅助功能”与“屏幕录制”权限，在可控安全边界内完成跨应用自动化。
capabilities.summaryEn: Manage the Allow desktop control master switch for native desktop GUI automation, inspect Accessibility and Screen Recording OS grants, and jump straight to system privacy settings.
highlightsZh: 独立应用内“允许桌面控制”总开关：无需去系统设置反复撤权，随时一键开启或暂停桌面操作
直观显示“辅助功能”（键鼠输入所需）与“屏幕录制”（画面观察所需）两项系统授权状态
一键请求授权或直达操作系统“隐私与安全性”对应面板完成勾选
执行中配合实时状态预览卡片、单应用窗口共享（App Sharing）与权限模式确认，操作随时可停
highlightsEn: Dedicated Allow desktop control switch lets you pause or resume Computer Use anytime without revoking OS privacy grants
Shows live grant status for both Accessibility (mouse/keyboard input) and Screen Recording (visual capture)
One-click permission request or direct jump into your operating system’s Privacy & Security settings
Works alongside single-window App Sharing, live control status cards, and immediate stop controls
scenariosZh: 需要智能体帮你点击验证原生桌面客户端、模拟器或无法通过命令行驱动的图形软件：先在本页确认“辅助功能”与“屏幕录制”两项均显示已授权，再开启“允许桌面控制”。
平时只写代码、希望彻底杜绝智能体触碰鼠标键盘：直接关闭本页的“允许桌面控制”开关，即使系统层面曾经授过权，智能体也无法发起桌面控制。
scenariosEn: Testing a native desktop app, mobile simulator, or GUI tool that has no CLI or web port: verify both Accessibility and Screen Recording show Granted here, then turn on Allow desktop control.
Locking down desktop input during regular coding: turn off Allow desktop control on this page—agents immediately lose desktop control even if OS permissions remain granted.

items.titleZh: 查看“允许桌面控制”开关及“辅助功能”、“屏幕录制”系统授权状态并完成授权
items.titleEn: Inspect Allow desktop control plus Accessibility and Screen Recording grants and authorize in OS settings
items.descriptionZh: 在 macOS 上需同时授予“辅助功能”（用于模拟点击与键盘输入）和“屏幕录制”（用于截取目标画面）才能完整运行桌面自动化；未就绪时可直接点击“系统设置”跳转授权。
items.descriptionEn: macOS requires both Accessibility (to send clicks and keystrokes) and Screen Recording (to see the target window or screen); click System settings whenever either grant is missing.

control.reasonZh: 操作系统权限必须由用户在系统界面中确认；智能体会打开独立的桌面控制页，并保留系统授权步骤给用户完成。
control.reasonEn: Operating-system permissions require confirmation in system UI; the Agent opens the dedicated Desktop Control page and leaves authorization visible to the user.

items.titleZh: 结合应用级总开关、单窗口共享与主机边界安全管控桌面操作
items.titleEn: Keep desktop automation bounded with the in-app toggle, per-window sharing, and host isolation
items.descriptionZh: Computer Use 仅在拥有图形界面的桌面执行宿主上可用；无头 CLI 或远程不支持环境会明确显示不可用，绝不会暗中回退去操作你本机控制端的屏幕。
items.descriptionEn: Computer Use runs only on Desktop hosts with a real GUI session; headless CLI or unsupported remote hosts report explicit unavailability instead of touching your local controller screen.

control.reasonZh: “结合应用级总开关、单窗口共享与主机边界安全管控桌面操作”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Keep desktop automation bounded with the in-app toggle, per-window sharing, and host isolation” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制”并查看“桌面控制”区块
检查“辅助功能”与“屏幕录制”两项状态；若有未授权项，点击“系统设置”在“隐私与安全性”中勾选允许 OpenBitFun（macOS 修改屏幕录制权限后按提示重新打开应用生效）
返回本页开启“允许桌面控制”开关；实际会话中优先共享单个目标应用窗口（App Sharing），并在用完后随时关闭
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, go to Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control, and locate Desktop control

Check Accessibility and Screen Recording status; if either is missing, click System settings to enable OpenBitFun under Privacy & Security (reopening the app if macOS prompts after granting Screen Recording)
Turn on Allow desktop control here; during tasks, prefer single-window App Sharing over full-screen control and switch Allow desktop control off anytime you finish
tipsZh: macOS 常见卡点：在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 屏幕录制”里勾选 OpenBitFun 后，macOS 通常要求退出并重新打开应用，状态卡片才会更新为“已授权”；开发调试模式下实际授权主体可能是启动它的终端应用。
不想把整块桌面暴露给智能体？发起任务时优先使用“共享单个应用窗口（App Sharing）”，把视觉捕获和点击严格限定在目标窗口内，配合默认“需要确认”权限模式更安心。
如果只是操作网页或本地前端项目，优先使用内置浏览器或 CDP 浏览器控制——基于 DOM 元素的自动化比桌面截图像素点击更快、更稳且不占用你的鼠标焦点。
tipsEn: macOS tip: after enabling OpenBitFun under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, macOS typically requires quitting and reopening the app before Screen Recording shows as Granted.
Prefer sharing a single application window (App Sharing) rather than the entire screen whenever possible so visual capture and clicks stay scoped to that app.
If your target is a website or localhost web app, use the Built-in browser or Chrome/Edge CDP instead—DOM-level browser actions are faster, sharper, and do not steal your mouse cursor.
agentExamplesZh: 打开桌面控制设置，帮我检查辅助功能和屏幕录制权限齐了没
暂时关闭允许桌面控制开关
agentExamplesEn: Open Desktop control settings so I can check Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions
Turn off Allow desktop control for now

capabilities.titleZh: 浏览器控制与网页链接
capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control
capabilities.summaryZh: 设置对话中的网页链接默认用内置浏览器还是系统默认浏览器打开，并连接本机 Chrome / Edge 的 CDP 远程调试端口，让智能体直接复用你已登录的浏览器环境协作。
capabilities.summaryEn: Choose whether chat web links open in the built-in browser or your system default browser, and connect Chrome or Edge over CDP remote debugging so agents can work with your signed-in tabs.
highlightsZh: 自由选择对话网页链接默认在“内置浏览器”并排打开，还是跳转“系统默认浏览器”
自动发现本机 Chrome、Edge 等受支持浏览器并展示实时 CDP 连接与标签页状态
通过 CDP 接入日常浏览器后，智能体可直接复用已登录的内网后台或业务页面，免去重复扫码登录
支持配置“启动时自动连接”（默认关闭，避免每次打开应用弹出浏览器调试确认提示）
highlightsEn: Choose whether links clicked in chat open side-by-side in the built-in browser or in your system default browser
Auto-discover installed Chrome and Edge browsers and inspect live CDP connection and page status
Reuse your existing signed-in browser profile and intranet/SaaS sessions over CDP without logging in again
Control whether OpenBitFun auto-connects CDP on startup (off by default to prevent unexpected browser prompts)
scenariosZh: 前端联调 localhost 页面时想边聊边看效果：把“网页链接默认打开方式”设为“内置浏览器”；平时查外部长文资料想用自己的书签和插件，则设为“系统默认浏览器”（右键任意链接也能临时选）。
需要智能体帮你查看需要 SSO 单点登录或二次验证的内网系统：在你平时已登录的 Chrome 地址栏打开 `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging`（Edge 打开 `edge://inspect/#remote-debugging`）开启远程调试，再回到本页一键连接即可直接复用登录态。
scenariosEn: Previewing localhost dev servers vs reading external docs: set Default link target to Built-in browser for side-by-side workspace previews, or System default browser for everyday reading (right-clicking any link always lets you pick on the spot).

Letting an agent inspect a dashboard behind corporate SSO or 2FA: enable remote debugging in your already signed-in Chrome (`chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging`) or Edge (`edge://inspect/#remote-debugging`) and click Connect here to reuse that live session.

items.titleZh: 设置对话中的网页链接默认在内置浏览器还是系统默认浏览器中打开
items.titleEn: Choose whether web links in chat open in the built-in browser or your system default browser
items.descriptionZh: 选“内置浏览器”适合在工作区侧边直接预览本地服务与点选页面元素；选“系统默认浏览器”适合沿用日常插件与书签，平时右键点击链接也可随时切换打开方式。
items.descriptionEn: Built-in browser keeps previews beside your chat, while System default browser uses your everyday tabs and extensions; right-clicking any link lets you override per click.

control.reasonZh: “设置对话中的网页链接默认在内置浏览器还是系统默认浏览器中打开”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Choose whether web links in chat open in the built-in browser or your system default browser” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 选择 Chrome 或 Edge 浏览器，查看、建立或断开 CDP 远程调试连接
items.titleEn: Choose Chrome or Edge and inspect, establish, or disconnect its CDP remote-debugging connection
items.descriptionZh: 支持一键配置默认 CDP 调试或接入已开启远程调试端口的现有浏览器实例，并可配合“启动时自动连接”开关管理自动重连行为。
items.descriptionEn: Connect to an existing Chrome/Edge instance with remote debugging enabled or configure default CDP setup, alongside the startup auto-connect toggle.

control.reasonZh: 浏览器与 CDP 状态来自当前执行主机，并可能需要浏览器确认或重启；智能体会打开“浏览器与桌面控制”设置页供用户完成。
control.reasonEn: Browser and CDP state comes from the current execution host and may require browser confirmation or restart; the Agent opens the Browser & Desktop Control settings page for completion.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“工具与集成 → 浏览器与桌面控制”
在顶部“网页链接”区块选择点击会话链接时默认用“内置浏览器”还是“系统默认浏览器”打开
在“浏览器控制”区块选择目标浏览器（如 Chrome 或 Edge）；若想复用正在运行的已登录浏览器，先在浏览器访问 `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging`（或 `edge://inspect/#remote-debugging`）开启调试，再点击连接
按日常使用频率决定是否开启“启动时自动连接”
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Tools & Integrations → Browser & Desktop Control
Under Web links, choose whether chat links open in the Built-in browser or your System default browser by default

Under Browser control, select Chrome or Edge; to reuse an already running signed-in browser, enable remote debugging at `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` (or `edge://inspect/#remote-debugging`) and click Connect
Optionally toggle Connect on startup if you use external browser automation every day
tipsZh: 只是调试无需登录的本地前端页面（如 `http://localhost:3000`），直接用 OpenBitFun **内置浏览器**最省心，完全不用折腾外部 CDP 端口；只有需要复用已有账号 Cookie、插件或跨站登录态时才需连接外部 Chrome / Edge。
新版 Chrome / Edge 连接 CDP 时可能会在浏览器内弹出一次“允许远程调试连接”确认框，点击允许后智能体才能读取页面快照。
“启动时自动连接”默认关闭，这样平时纯写代码时打开 OpenBitFun 不会无故唤醒浏览器或弹出连接提示。
tipsEn: For local dev servers like `http://localhost:3000` that need no external cookies, the **Built-in browser** works immediately with zero CDP setup—use external Chrome/Edge CDP when you want your signed-in sessions or extensions.
Recent Chrome and Edge builds may show a one-time in-browser prompt asking you to allow the incoming DevTools debugging connection—approve it so page snapshots succeed.
Auto-connect on startup stays off by default so ordinary coding sessions never trigger unexpected browser popups when OpenBitFun launches.
agentExamplesZh: 打开浏览器控制设置，我想把网页链接改成默认用系统浏览器打开
带我连接本地已登录的 Chrome 浏览器
开启启动时自动连接浏览器
agentExamplesEn: Open Browser control settings so I can open chat links in my system browser by default
Take me to Browser & Desktop Control to connect my signed-in Chrome
Turn on browser auto-connect on startup

capabilities.titleZh: 自动化：快捷动作与 Hooks
capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 工具与集成 → 自动化
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Tools & Integrations → Automation
capabilities.summaryZh: 定制编码完成后的一键快捷动作（如提交代码、创建 PR 或自定义检查 Prompt），并通过双门禁安全模型管理兼容 Codex 契约的生命周期 Hooks。
capabilities.summaryEn: Customize one-click post-coding Quick actions (Commit, Create PR, or custom prompts) and manage Codex-compatible lifecycle hooks protected by a two-gate safety model.
highlightsZh: 编码结束后浮现一键“快捷动作”按钮：可调内置提交 / 创建 PR 提示词，也能自建专属后续动作
兼容 Codex Hook 契约：在会话启动、用户提交、工具执行前后与结束等节点自动运行命令处理器
双门禁安全机制：用户级 config/hooks.json 默认开启且保存即热重载；项目级 .openbitfun/config/hooks.json 默认关闭防注入
支持只读浏览 Claude Code、Codex 等外部应用的 Hooks 目录并按冲突预览导入
highlightsEn: One-click post-coding Quick actions: customize built-in Commit and Create PR prompts or add your own follow-up buttons
Implements the Codex hook contract across session, prompt, tool, and stop lifecycle events
Two-gate safety model: user config/hooks.json is on by default with instant hot-reload, while repo .openbitfun/config/hooks.json stays off by default
Browse read-only external hook catalogs from Claude Code or Codex and apply conflict-checked import plans
scenariosZh: 每次智能体改完代码，你都要手敲同一段“按 Conventional Commits 提交并附上测试结果”：在“快捷动作”里微调内置提交按钮或新增自定义快捷按钮，以后改完代码点一下就行。
想在智能体每次改完文件后自动跑 lint，或者在执行危险命令前做自定义拦截：编辑个人用户级 `config/hooks.json`，无需重启客户端，保存瞬间即对下一轮事件生效。
克隆了一个包含 `.openbitfun/config/hooks.json` 的团队仓库：先用编辑器审阅里面的 Shell 脚本确认安全无虞，再来本页打开第二道门禁“启用项目 Hook 文件”。
scenariosEn: Repeating the same follow-up after every coding turn: customize the built-in Commit / Create PR quick actions or add your own "Run tests & summarize" button so post-coding wrap-up takes one click.
Running automatic formatters, notifications, or custom policy checks on agent events: edit your user-level `config/hooks.json`—changes hot-reload immediately with no app restart.
Opening a repository that ships `.openbitfun/config/hooks.json`: inspect its shell commands first, then opt in to the second gate (Enable project hook files) once you trust the repo.

items.titleZh: 启用或微调内置的“提交”与“创建 Pull Request”编码后快捷动作
items.titleEn: Enable and customize the built-in Commit and Create Pull Request post-coding quick actions
items.descriptionZh: 控制智能体完成文件修改后是否展示内置的提交与创建 PR 快捷按钮，并可按团队规范定制触发时发送的 Prompt。
items.descriptionEn: Show or hide the built-in Commit and Create PR buttons after coding turns and tailor their prompts to your team conventions.

control.reasonZh: “启用或微调内置的“提交”与“创建 Pull Request”编码后快捷动作”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Enable and customize the built-in Commit and Create Pull Request post-coding quick actions” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 添加、编辑和删除自定义编码后快捷动作按钮与专属 Prompt
items.titleEn: Add, edit, and delete custom post-coding quick action buttons and prompts
items.descriptionZh: 把高频后续步骤（例如“补充边界单测”、“自查安全漏洞”或“更新 CHANGELOG”）沉淀为一键直达按钮。
items.descriptionEn: Turn recurring post-edit steps—like adding unit tests, running a security pass, or updating changelogs—into one-click buttons.

control.reasonZh: “添加、编辑和删除自定义编码后快捷动作按钮与专属 Prompt”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Add, edit, and delete custom post-coding quick action buttons and prompts” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 整体启用或停用智能体生命周期 Hooks（默认开启用户级配置）
items.titleEn: Enable or disable agent lifecycle hooks globally (user-level hooks on by default)
items.descriptionZh: 第一道总门禁：默认开启并加载你个人配置目录下的 `config/hooks.json`；排查问题时关闭此开关可一键暂停全部用户级与项目级 Hooks。
items.descriptionEn: Gate 1 master switch: enabled by default for your personal `config/hooks.json`; turning it off immediately suspends both user and project hooks.

items.titleZh: 为已审阅的可信仓库开启第二道门禁：启用项目级 .openbitfun/config/hooks.json
items.titleEn: Opt in to Gate 2 for trusted repos: enable project-level .openbitfun/config/hooks.json
items.descriptionZh: 默认关闭！因为项目 Hook 文件中的命令会以你的当前系统用户权限直接执行，请仅在核查过仓库 `.openbitfun/config/hooks.json` 内容可信后再开启（且需总开关同时开启）。
items.descriptionEn: Off by default! Because project hooks execute shell commands with your user permissions, enable this only after inspecting `.openbitfun/config/hooks.json` in repositories you trust.

items.titleZh: 定位并编辑用户级或项目级 hooks.json 配置文件（保存后即时生效）
items.titleEn: Locate and edit user or project hooks.json files with instant hot-reload on save
items.descriptionZh: 修改 `hooks.json` 后运行时会自动重新加载，无需重启 OpenBitFun；也可以让智能体按你描述的规则帮你检查或精确编辑该文件。
items.descriptionEn: Edits to `hooks.json` hot-reload automatically without restarting OpenBitFun, and agents can inspect or cleanly edit requested handlers for you.

workflowZh: 按 Hooks 说明定位用户级或项目级配置文件，先用 Read 检查现有 JSON；路径不确定时用 Glob 搜索
只对用户明确要求的处理器或事件做精确 Edit，并重新读取验证；运行时会按既有 Hooks 契约自动重载
workflowEn: Locate the user- or project-level Hooks config from the manual, inspect the existing JSON with Read, and use Glob when the path is uncertain
Apply a focused Edit only to handlers or events the user requested, then read back to verify; the existing Hooks contract reloads it at runtime

items.titleZh: 在会话、用户输入、工具调用前后及结束等 Codex Hook 事件上运行处理器
items.titleEn: Run handlers on Codex hook events across session, prompt, tool, and stop stages
items.descriptionZh: 严格遵循 Codex Hook 事件负载与决策返回结构，可用于上下文注入、命令合规阻断、自动格式化或完成通知。
items.descriptionEn: Follows the standard Codex hook event payload and decision schema for context injection, pre-tool policy checks, post-edit formatting, or notifications.

control.reasonZh: “在会话、用户输入、工具调用前后及结束等 Codex Hook 事件上运行处理器”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Run handlers on Codex hook events across session, prompt, tool, and stop stages” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 只读预览外部 AI 应用（如 Claude Code、Codex）的现有 Hook 目录
items.titleEn: Browse read-only external-AI hook catalogs from tools like Claude Code and Codex
items.descriptionZh: 自动扫描本机已安装的外部 AI 工具中配置了哪些 Hooks，让你在决定迁移前先看清每条命令的作用。
items.descriptionEn: Inspect existing hooks discovered from external AI tools in read-only mode before deciding what to bring over.

control.reasonZh: “只读预览外部 AI 应用（如 Claude Code、Codex）的现有 Hook 目录”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Browse read-only external-AI hook catalogs from tools like Claude Code and Codex” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 预览、筛选并应用外部 Hook 导入计划，保留冲突与兼容性提示
items.titleEn: Preview, customize, and apply external hook import plans with conflict diagnostics
items.descriptionZh: 将选中的外部 Hooks 安全转换为 OpenBitFun 副本并展示事件兼容或同名冲突诊断，绝不改动原外部应用的配置文件。
items.descriptionEn: Convert selected external hooks into OpenBitFun copies with clear compatibility and conflict diagnostics while leaving original external files untouched.

control.reasonZh: “预览、筛选并应用外部 Hook 导入计划，保留冲突与兼容性提示”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Preview, customize, and apply external hook import plans with conflict diagnostics” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“工具与集成 → 自动化”
在上方“快捷动作”区块开关或编辑内置的提交 / 创建 PR 动作，或点击新增自定义编码后快捷按钮
在下方“事件 Hooks”区块确认“启用 Hooks”总开关；若需编辑个人规则，修改用户配置目录下的 `config/hooks.json` 即可即时热重载
若当前仓库带有 `.openbitfun/config/hooks.json`，请先审阅文件内容确认安全，再按需开启“启用项目 Hook 文件”
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Tools & Integrations → Automation
Under Quick actions, toggle or customize built-in Commit / Create PR prompts, or add your own post-coding action buttons
Under Event Hooks, verify Enable hooks is on; edit your user `config/hooks.json` anytime and changes hot-reload immediately
If a repository includes `.openbitfun/config/hooks.json`, inspect its commands first and only then turn on Enable project hook files
tipsZh: 安全红线提醒：克隆陌生开源仓库时请保持“启用项目 Hook 文件”关闭！开启该开关意味着允许仓库里的 `.openbitfun/config/hooks.json` 在智能体生命周期中运行任意本机 Shell 命令。
两个 Hooks 开关是层级关系：如果关闭了第一道“启用 Hooks”总开关，即使“启用项目 Hook 文件”处于勾选状态，项目级 Hooks 也不会执行。
需要定期按时间表（如每天早上 9 点）自动跑任务而非响应会话事件？请使用主侧边栏的「任务看板」（而非设置页中的 Hooks）。
tipsEn: Security first: keep Enable project hook files turned OFF when cloning unfamiliar repositories, as `.openbitfun/config/hooks.json` runs shell commands with your user account permissions.
The two gates are hierarchical: turning off the main Enable hooks switch disables project-level hooks as well.
Looking to run jobs on a clock (such as every weekday morning) rather than on turn lifecycle events? Open Task Board in the main sidebar rather than Hooks.
agentExamplesZh: 打开 Hooks 设置
帮我暂时关闭所有生命周期 Hooks 排查问题
带我去添加一个编码后自动跑测试的快捷动作
agentExamplesEn: Open Hooks settings
Temporarily disable all lifecycle hooks while I debug
Take me to Quick actions so I can add a post-coding test button

options.descriptionZh: 生命周期 Hooks 总开关（默认开启，自动加载用户级 config/hooks.json 并支持热重载）。
options.descriptionEn: Master switch for agent lifecycle hooks (on by default; loads user config/hooks.json with live hot-reload).

options.titleZh: 启用项目 Hook 文件
options.descriptionZh: 允许加载当前工作区 `.openbitfun/config/hooks.json` 中的处理器（默认关闭，请仅对审阅过的可信仓库启用）。
options.descriptionEn: Allow handlers from `{workspace}/.openbitfun/config/hooks.json` to run (off by default—enable only for inspected, trusted repositories).

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 工具与集成 → 网页搜索
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Tools & Integrations → Web Search
capabilities.summaryZh: 为智能体的 WebSearch 工具选择运行时搜索服务（开箱即用的“Exa MCP（免费）”、Exa Search API、Tavily Search API、DeepSeek Search API、Keenable Search API 或自定义 HTTP 服务），并在当前执行主机加密管理搜索凭据。
capabilities.summaryEn: Choose the runtime search provider backing the agent WebSearch tool—from zero-setup Exa MCP (free) to Exa Search API, Tavily Search API, DeepSeek Search API, Keenable Search API, or Custom HTTP service—with host-encrypted credential storage.
highlightsZh: 默认内置“Exa MCP（免费）”，免填 API Key 即可让智能体联网查阅最新文档与报错
支持切换 Exa Search API、Tavily Search API、DeepSeek Search API 与 Keenable Search API（免密钥可用，填密钥提升限额）
选择“自定义 HTTP 服务”即可查看并复制 OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol v1 规范，对接企业内网搜索网关
API Key 与 Secret 仅在当前执行主机的凭据库中加密存储，不会随普通配置明文同步
highlightsEn: Works out of the box with Exa MCP (free)—agents can look up fresh docs and release notes with zero API key setup
Switch anytime to Exa Search API, Tavily Search API, DeepSeek Search API, or Keenable Search API (works keyless; adding a key raises rate limits)
Select Custom HTTP service to copy the OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol v1 spec for internal search gateways
API keys and secrets are encrypted in the current execution host vault rather than stored in plain config files
scenariosZh: 让智能体查阅今天刚发布的框架版本变更或线上罕见报错：保持默认的“Exa MCP（免费）”或免密可用的“Keenable Search API”，无需任何前置注册即可直接触发 `WebSearch`。
重度调研任务遇到公共免费通道限流：填入你自己的 Tavily、Exa Search API、DeepSeek 或 Keenable API Key 并点击“保存更改”，获得更高并发配额。
公司内网环境无法访问公网搜索引擎，但有自建检索服务：选择“自定义 HTTP 服务”，复制页面底部的 OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol v1 请求/响应 JSON 契约完成轻量适配并配置内网端点。
scenariosEn: Checking brand-new library docs or obscure error messages right away: leave the default Exa MCP (free) (or keyless Keenable Search API) selected so agents can call `WebSearch` with zero setup.

Running heavy research workflows without hitting public rate limits: switch to Tavily Search API, Exa Search API, DeepSeek Search API, or Keenable Search API with your own API key and click Save changes.

Operating inside an enterprise network with an internal search gateway: pick Custom HTTP service, copy the built-in OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol v1 JSON contract, and point to your internal endpoint.

items.titleZh: 在 Exa MCP（免费）、Exa Search API、Tavily、DeepSeek、Keenable 与自定义 HTTP 服务间选择搜索服务
items.titleEn: Choose Exa MCP (free), Exa Search API, Tavily, DeepSeek, Keenable, or Custom HTTP service
items.descriptionZh: 当智能体判断本地仓库信息不足、需要核实最新外部文档或网页事实时会自动调用所选服务；切换后记得点击页面上的“保存更改”。
items.descriptionEn: Powers the `WebSearch` tool whenever an agent needs fresh documentation, release notes, or online facts; remember to click Save changes after switching.

control.reasonZh: “在 Exa MCP（免费）、Exa Search API、Tavily、DeepSeek、Keenable 与自定义 HTTP 服务间选择搜索服务”与所选服务商的端点及密钥就绪状态联动，需在网页搜索设置页核对后点击保存；智能体会直接为你打开该页面。
control.reasonEn: “Choose Exa MCP (free), Exa Search API, Tavily, DeepSeek, Keenable, or Custom HTTP service” depends on provider-specific endpoint and credential readiness that must be reviewed and saved together on the Web Search settings page; the Agent opens the exact entry for you.

items.titleZh: 查看当前执行主机的搜索凭据状态，并加密保存、替换或清除 API Key / Secret
items.titleEn: Inspect search credential status on the current execution host and save, replace, or clear API keys
items.descriptionZh: 凭据严格绑定在当前执行智能体轮次的主机上加密保存（对端或远程主机拥有各自独立的设备凭据状态），智能体永远无法读取明文密钥。
items.descriptionEn: Credentials are stored encrypted on the host that executes agent turns (peer/remote hosts maintain their own vault state) and are never readable in plaintext by agents.

control.reasonZh: WebSearch API Key 和 Secret 只应在受保护的设备凭据输入框中录入或清除；智能体可以打开该设置入口，但不会读取、回显或代填凭据原值。
control.reasonEn: WebSearch API keys and secrets must only be entered or cleared through the protected device-credential field; the Agent can open that settings entry but does not read, echo, or fill raw credential values.

items.titleZh: 为 OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol 配置请求端点、鉴权方式与安全受限 Header 名
items.titleEn: Configure the endpoint URL, auth mode, and validated header name for OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol
items.descriptionZh: 支持无需认证、Bearer Token 或自定义请求头（自动拦截覆盖 Host / Content-Length 等危险保留头），确保自建搜索网关接入规范安全。
items.descriptionEn: Supports unauthenticated, Bearer token, or custom header auth (automatically blocking unsafe reserved HTTP headers) for custom search gateways.

control.reasonZh: “为 OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol 配置请求端点、鉴权方式与安全受限 Header 名”包含端点 URL、安全限制与鉴权头等关联字段，需要在设置页一起校验并明确保存；智能体会打开对应入口而不猜测端点配置。
control.reasonEn: “Configure the endpoint URL, auth mode, and validated header name for OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol” combines endpoint URL, transport restrictions, and authentication fields that must be validated and explicitly saved together in Settings; the Agent opens the entry without guessing.

items.titleZh: 查看并一键复制 OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol v1 的请求、响应与传输限制说明
items.titleEn: Inspect and copy the OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol v1 request, response, and transport spec
items.descriptionZh: 选中自建协议模式后页面会展开完整的 JSON 示例与超时/体积约束说明，可直接复制给智能体让它帮你快速写出适配包装服务。
items.descriptionEn: Displays the full copyable v1 JSON request/response schema and transport limits when selected—handy to paste into a chat so an agent can scaffold your adapter.

control.reasonZh: 协议说明仅在选中 OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol 时显示，并由设置页提供完整可复制内容；智能体会打开精确入口，避免用不完整摘要替代产品内协议。
control.reasonEn: The protocol specification is shown only when OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol is selected and the Settings page owns the complete copyable content; the Agent opens the exact entry instead of substituting an incomplete summary.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“工具与集成 → 网页搜索”
在服务商下拉框中选择目标搜索服务（日常轻度使用保持默认“Exa MCP（免费）”即可即开即用）
若所选服务需要密钥（或想为 Keenable Search API 提升速率上限），在设备凭据区输入并保存 API Key；若选“自定义 HTTP 服务”则补齐端点与鉴权方式
点击“保存更改”使新的运行时搜索服务立即生效
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Tools & Integrations → Web Search
Select your preferred runtime search provider (Exa MCP (free) works immediately with no key required)
Enter and save an API key in the device credential box if required (or optional for higher Keenable Search API limits), or fill in your Custom HTTP service endpoint details
Click Save changes so subsequent `WebSearch` tool calls use the new provider
tipsZh: 切换服务商或修改自建端点参数后，别忘了点击页面上的“保存更改”按钮；未保存前智能体的 `WebSearch` 仍会沿用上一次已保存的配置。
`Keenable Search API` 在未填写 API Key 时也能正常使用基础配额，需要更高请求频率时再填入密钥即可；而 `Exa Search API`、`Tavily Search API` 与 `DeepSeek Search API` 则必须先配置有效 API Key。
在 Peer Device 对端设备模式下，搜索凭据保存在实际执行任务的对端主机上，不会把你本机控制端的密钥暗中拷贝过去。
tipsEn: Remember to click Save changes after switching providers or editing endpoint settings so active `WebSearch` calls pick up the new configuration.

`Keenable Search API` works without an API key at baseline limits (add a key anytime for higher throughput), whereas `Exa Search API`, `Tavily Search API`, and `DeepSeek Search API` require a configured key.
In Peer Device Mode, search credentials belong to the peer execution host vault rather than silently reusing keys from your local controller.
agentExamplesZh: 打开网页搜索设置，我想换成 Tavily 搜索
带我看看自建网页搜索 HTTP 协议的接口格式
agentExamplesEn: Open Web Search settings so I can switch to Tavily
Take me to the OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol specification

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 工具与集成 → MCP
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Tools & Integrations → MCP
capabilities.summaryZh: 通过表单或 JSON 添加和管理 Model Context Protocol（MCP）服务器，支持本机 stdio 进程、Docker 容器与远程 Streamable HTTP（Bearer / OAuth），并查看健康状态、工具清单、Prompt、Resource 与交互式 MCP App。
capabilities.summaryEn: Add and manage Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers via form or JSON across local stdio processes, Docker containers, and remote Streamable HTTP (Bearer or OAuth), while inspecting health, tools, prompts, resources, and interactive MCP Apps.
highlightsZh: 支持本机 stdio 命令（npx / uvx / 二进制）、Docker 容器与远程 Streamable HTTP 三类接入
远程 MCP 原生支持自定义 Bearer Header 鉴权与浏览器 OAuth 授权重连（不支持旧版远程 SSE）
表单向导与全局 JSON 配置双向切换，实时查看初始化、健康、重连与工具数量
支持智能体按需读取 MCP Prompts / Resources，以及打开带界面的交互式 MCP App
highlightsEn: Connect local stdio commands (npx / uvx / binaries), Docker containers, or remote Streamable HTTP servers
Authenticate remote MCP servers with Bearer headers or browser OAuth flows (legacy remote SSE is not supported)
Edit through guided forms or raw JSON and track live initialization, health, reconnects, and tool counts
Read MCP Prompts and Resources from agents and interact with tool-provided MCP App/UI surfaces
scenariosZh: 想让智能体直接查设计稿、工单库或内部文档：优先接入官方远程 Streamable HTTP MCP 地址，点击发起浏览器 OAuth 或填入 Bearer Token，连接成功后在聊天输入框敲 @ 就能选用该服务。
接入社区开源的 npx / uvx 本地 MCP 工具包：用表单填入命令、参数与环境变量，保存后在服务器卡片上确认状态变为已连接并核对加载出的工具列表。
从 Claude Code 或 Cursor 迁移现成 mcpServers 配置：直接打开 JSON 配置视图粘贴（或通过“外部导入”审阅导入），再补齐需要保密的环境变量与远程认证信息。
scenariosEn: Connecting cloud issue trackers, docs, or design tools: add a remote Streamable HTTP MCP URL, complete browser OAuth or save a Bearer header, then type @ in chat to scope that server into your turn.
Running an open-source npx or uvx MCP server locally: add a local stdio server with its command, arguments, and env vars, then verify its live status badge and discovered tool list.
Bringing over existing mcpServers JSON: paste or edit non-secret server definitions in JSON view (or import via External import), then fill in any secret tokens or OAuth sign-ins.

items.titleZh: 通过表单或 JSON 查看服务器状态并增量保存非秘密配置
items.titleEn: Inspect server state and save non-secret configuration via form or JSON
