items.descriptionZh: 既可用引导表单逐项添加，也可切到 JSON 视图批量维护服务器定义；智能体增量修改配置时会自动保留未改动服务器与已有加密凭据。
items.descriptionEn: Manage servers through a guided dialog or raw JSON; incremental updates preserve other servers and existing stored credentials.

items.titleZh: 添加本机 stdio 进程、Docker 容器或远程 Streamable HTTP MCP 服务器
items.titleEn: Add local stdio-process, Docker-container, or remote Streamable HTTP MCP servers
items.descriptionZh: 远程服务使用标准 Streamable HTTP 协议（不支持旧版远程 SSE）；本地与容器服务通过 stdio 在当前 OpenBitFun 产品宿主本机启动，不会在 SSH 远程工作区内部运行。
items.descriptionEn: Remote servers speak standard Streamable HTTP (legacy remote SSE is not supported), while local stdio and Docker servers run on the OpenBitFun product host rather than inside an SSH remote workspace.

items.titleZh: 单独启动、停止、重启或删除指定的 MCP 服务器
items.titleEn: Start, stop, restart, or delete individual MCP servers
items.descriptionZh: 临时不用的本地进程可随时停止以释放资源，环境变量或网络恢复后一键重启即可重连，无需删除重建配置。
items.descriptionEn: Stop idle local processes to free memory, restart a server after network or environment changes, or remove servers you no longer use.

items.titleZh: 实时查看初始化、已连接、重连中、待鉴权与失败诊断状态
items.titleEn: Inspect live initialization, connected, reconnecting, auth-required, and failure states
items.descriptionZh: 清晰区分“配置已保存”与“运行时真正连通”，连接异常时直接展示错误原因以方便排查命令路径或认证问题。
items.descriptionEn: Distinguishes saved configuration from actual runtime connectivity and surfaces actionable error messages when a binary path or token fails.

items.titleZh: 配置远程 Bearer / 自定义 Header 与本地环境变量凭据，或清除已有密钥
items.titleEn: Configure remote Bearer/custom headers and local env secrets, or clear stored credentials
items.descriptionZh: 敏感 Token 与 API 密钥在受保护的设置表单中单独写入或清除，不会暴露在智能体可读的普通列表结果中。
items.descriptionEn: Secret headers and environment tokens are entered or cleared through protected settings fields without leaking raw values to agent discovery.

control.reasonZh: 远程 Header 和环境变量可能携带秘密凭据，必须在受保护的 MCP 设置入口录入或清除，智能体不读取其原值。
control.reasonEn: Remote headers and environment variables may carry secret credentials; they must be entered or cleared through the protected MCP settings flow, and the Agent does not read their raw values.

items.titleZh: 发起、等待、取消或重新连接远程 MCP 浏览器 OAuth 授权
items.titleEn: Start, poll, cancel, or reconnect remote MCP browser OAuth authorization
items.descriptionZh: 针对支持 OAuth 的远程 Streamable HTTP 服务，一键拉起浏览器完成账号登录授权，令牌过期后可随时重新认证。
items.descriptionEn: Launch browser OAuth for supported Streamable HTTP MCP servers and easily re-authenticate whenever an access token expires.

control.reasonZh: MCP OAuth 必须由用户在外部授权页面确认；智能体可以打开和定位流程，但不能替账户持有人授予权限。
control.reasonEn: MCP OAuth requires the account holder to confirm an external authorization page; the Agent can open and locate the flow but cannot grant consent on their behalf.

items.titleZh: 列出服务器提供的 MCP Prompts 并按参数渲染指定模板
items.titleEn: List server-provided MCP Prompts and load a chosen prompt with arguments
items.descriptionZh: 智能体可查询已连接 MCP 服务器暴露的标准提示词模板，并传入所需参数获取结构化上下文。
items.descriptionEn: Agents can discover standardized prompt templates exposed by a connected MCP server and render them with structured arguments.

workflowZh: 先通过 list-servers 取得用户服务器 ID，再对明确的 server_id 调用 ListMCPPrompts
取得名称和参数模式后用 GetMCPPrompt 渲染指定 Prompt；连接或权限失败必须原样返回
workflowEn: Resolve a user server ID with list-servers, then call ListMCPPrompts for that explicit server_id
After obtaining the name and argument shape, render it with GetMCPPrompt and preserve connection or permission failures

items.titleZh: 列出并按 URI 读取 MCP 服务器暴露的 Resources
items.titleEn: List and read MCP Resources by URI from connected servers
items.descriptionZh: 无需复制粘贴外部资料，智能体可直接列出服务器资源目录并按真实 URI 拉取正文内容。
items.descriptionEn: Agents list available resource URIs on a connected server and read their contents directly into context.

workflowZh: 先对明确的 server_id 调用 ListMCPResources，取得真实 URI 后再用 ReadMCPResource 读取
资源属于服务器边界；刷新、连接和权限错误应明确返回，不能用空内容伪装成功
workflowEn: Call ListMCPResources for an explicit server_id, then read a returned URI with ReadMCPResource
Resources belong to the server boundary; refresh, connection, and permission failures must be explicit rather than represented as empty success

items.titleZh: 浏览每个 MCP 服务器加载出的工具清单并识别附带的交互界面
items.titleEn: Browse discovered MCP tool inventories and identify tool-provided App/UI surfaces
items.descriptionZh: 展开服务器详情即可核对每个工具的名称、描述与输入定义，确认智能体可见范围是否符合预期。
items.descriptionEn: Expand any connected server to inspect its discovered tools, descriptions, and UI attachments.

control.reasonZh: 当前智能体工具可直接读取 Prompt 与 Resource，但工具 UI URI 和交互式 App 仍由 MCP 场景承载；契约不会把资源读取冒充成 UI 控制。
control.reasonEn: Agent tools directly read prompts and resources, while tool UI URIs and interactive apps remain owned by the MCP surface; the contract does not pretend resource reads control that UI.

items.titleZh: 打开交互式 MCP App/UI 面板、双向收发消息并完成界面内确认
items.titleEn: Open interactive MCP App/UI panels, exchange messages, and complete in-app interactions
items.descriptionZh: 当 MCP 工具返回可交互视图时，可在 OpenBitFun 内直接渲染并与服务端双向通信。
items.descriptionEn: Render interactive UIs provided by MCP servers inside OpenBitFun with two-way message and confirmation support.

control.reasonZh: “打开交互式 MCP App/UI 面板、双向收发消息并完成界面内确认”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Open interactive MCP App/UI panels, exchange messages, and complete in-app interactions” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“工具与集成 → MCP”
点击添加服务器（或打开 JSON 配置），选择本地进程（stdio）、Docker 容器或远程 Streamable HTTP 类型
填写启动命令/参数或远程 URL，按需配置 Bearer Header、环境变量或发起浏览器 OAuth 登录
保存后确认服务器卡片状态变为“已连接”，展开核对工具数，之后在对话中可用 @ 精确选用该 MCP 服务
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Tools & Integrations → MCP
Click Add Server (or open JSON config) and choose Local process (stdio), Docker container, or Remote Streamable HTTP
Enter the command/args or remote endpoint URL, and supply any required Bearer header, env var, or browser OAuth login
Verify the server badge reaches Connected and check its tool count; you can then @-mention the server right in chat
tipsZh: 协议避坑：OpenBitFun 远程 MCP 使用标准 Streamable HTTP 协议（常见路径以 `/mcp` 结尾），不支持旧版纯远程 SSE（`/sse`）传输；若服务端只提供旧版 SSE，可通过本地 `mcp-remote` 等 stdio 桥接包接入。
执行位置说明：本地 `stdio`（`npx` / `uvx`）与 `Docker` MCP 进程运行在当前 OpenBitFun 桌面宿主本机上，而不是在 SSH 远程工作区的远端服务器内执行；对端设备模式（Peer Mode）下同样不支持直接改写本页宿主 MCP 配置。
加载了较多 MCP 工具担心拖慢对话？配合开启“模型与智能体 → 执行与协作”中的“按需加载工具”，即可按需向模型提供工具详情。
tipsEn: Protocol tip: Remote MCP in OpenBitFun uses standard Streamable HTTP (typically `/mcp` endpoints)—legacy remote SSE (`/sse`) is not supported directly, though you can bridge legacy SSE endpoints via a local stdio wrapper if needed.

Host boundary: Local `stdio` (`npx` / `uvx`) and `Docker` MCP servers execute on the OpenBitFun Desktop product host, not inside an SSH remote workspace, and host MCP edits are disabled while controlling a Peer device.
If you connect many MCP servers, pair them with Load tools as needed under Models & Agents → Execution & Collaboration so schemas only enter context when needed.
agentExamplesZh: 列出当前所有 MCP 服务器和连接状态
帮我重启刚修改过配置的 MCP 服务器
打开 MCP 设置，我要完成远程服务的 OAuth 登录
agentExamplesEn: List all configured MCP servers and their connection status
Restart my MCP server and check whether it reconnects cleanly
Open MCP settings so I can sign in with remote OAuth

operations.titleZh: 列出服务器与连接状态
operations.descriptionZh: 返回当前执行宿主上的用户级 MCP 服务器 ID、实时连接状态与配置版本校验摘要，不会暴露已保存的密钥、启动参数或私有地址。
operations.descriptionEn: Return user-level MCP server IDs, live connection status, and the configuration version token on the executing host without exposing stored secrets, arguments, or URLs.

operations.titleZh: 增量添加或更新服务器配置
operations.titleEn: Add or update a server configuration
operations.descriptionZh: 基于最新配置版本按服务器 ID 增量保存非机密字段，自动保留其他服务器与已存凭据，并在保存后核实服务是否已重新加载连通。
operations.descriptionEn: Incrementally save non-secret fields for a server against the latest configuration version while preserving other servers and stored secrets, then verify live connectivity.

operations.descriptionZh: 按用户级服务器 ID 启动指定 MCP 服务并回读实时连接状态；若需要浏览器 OAuth 则交由你完成网页确认。
operations.descriptionEn: Start a user MCP server by ID and read back live status, leaving any required OAuth browser consent to you.

operations.descriptionZh: 停止指定的 MCP 服务运行进程，同时完整保留其配置与凭据以便随时再次启动。
operations.descriptionEn: Stop the running MCP server while keeping its saved configuration and credentials intact.

operations.descriptionZh: 在不改写配置文件的前提下重启指定 MCP 服务器并回读最新健康状态。
operations.descriptionEn: Restart the selected MCP server without rewriting config and read back its updated health state.

operations.descriptionZh: 仅在你明确要求删除时，基于最新配置版本移除指定 MCP 服务器并清理其运行进程。
operations.descriptionEn: Only when explicitly requested, remove the selected MCP server against the latest configuration version and stop its runtime.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 工具与集成 → ACP
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Tools & Integrations → ACP
capabilities.summaryZh: 通过 Agent Client Protocol（ACP）把外部命令行智能体接入同一工作台，利用“本机”、“SSH”与“高级 JSON”三页签管理预设安装、“预下载 ACP”、远端探测与会话权限策略。
capabilities.summaryEn: Connect external CLI coding agents into OpenBitFun over Agent Client Protocol (ACP) across Local, SSH, and Advanced JSON tabs—covering presets, Predownload ACP, remote detection, and per-agent tool confirmation.
highlightsZh: 清晰划分“本机”、“SSH”与“高级 JSON”三个页签，兼顾图形向导与底层配置掌控
内置两类主流预设：原生实现 ACP 的 CLI（opencode、dsh、omp）与基于 npx 官方桥接适配器的 Claude Code、Codex
一键探测命令路径、版本、缓存与登录就绪度，支持点击“预下载 ACP”提前缓存适配器，并按智能体设定工具调用“询问”或“自动通过”
在 SSH 远程工作区自动扫描远端主机已安装的 ACP 智能体，不支持项明确说明原因
highlightsEn: Organized into Local, SSH, and Advanced JSON tabs for guided setup, remote workspace awareness, and raw config editing
Covers both native ACP CLIs (`opencode`, `dsh`, `omp`) and official `npx`-bridged ACP adapters (`Claude Code`, `Codex`)
One-click readiness probing plus Predownload ACP to warm adapter caches and per-agent Ask vs Auto-approve tool posture
Scans SSH remote workspace hosts for installed ACP agents and explains explicitly whenever an entry is unavailable remotely
scenariosZh: 习惯在同一个 OpenBitFun 窗口里对比原生智能体与 Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode 的解法：在“本机”页签启用对应预设、点一下“预下载 ACP”并完成探测，回到聊天输入框就能直接切换外部执行模式。
在无外网或网络较慢的环境使用 Claude Code / Codex ACP：提前在网络通畅时点击“预下载 ACP”，避免首次发起会话时卡在 `npx` 拉包。
连上 SSH 开发机后想直接调用服务器上装好的 `opencode` 或 `dsh`：切到“SSH”页签点击刷新探测，勾选需要的远端智能体并隐藏不用的条目。
scenariosEn: Running Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode side-by-side inside OpenBitFun: enable the preset on the Local tab, click Predownload ACP if needed, run Probe to confirm readiness, and pick it right from the chat composer.
Avoiding first-turn `npx` download delays for Claude Code or Codex: click Predownload ACP ahead of time while on a fast connection.
Using ACP agents already installed on a remote Linux dev box: open the SSH tab while connected to that workspace, refresh detection, and hide any unused entries.

items.titleZh: 在“本机”页签启用原生 ACP CLI（opencode、dsh、omp）或 npx 桥接预设（Claude Code、Codex）
items.titleEn: Enable native ACP CLIs (opencode, dsh, omp) or npx-bridged presets (Claude Code, Codex) on the Local tab
items.descriptionZh: OpenCode、DeepSeek Harness（dsh）与 Oh My Pi（omp）直接通过自身原生 ACP 命令通信；Claude Code 与 Codex 则通过官方 `npx` ACP 适配器桥接接入，并支持为每个智能体选择工具调用“询问”或“自动通过”。
items.descriptionEn: OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`), and Oh My Pi (`omp`) speak ACP natively, while Claude Code and Codex connect via official `npx` ACP adapters—with per-agent Ask or Auto-approve tool posture.

control.reasonZh: “在“本机”页签启用原生 ACP CLI（opencode、dsh、omp）或 npx 桥接预设（Claude Code、Codex）”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Enable native ACP CLIs (opencode, dsh, omp) or npx-bridged presets (Claude Code, Codex) on the Local tab” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 一键探测 CLI 可执行路径、版本号、适配器状态与连接就绪度
items.titleEn: Probe CLI binary paths, versions, adapter cache status, and connection readiness
items.descriptionZh: 不确定为什么某个外部智能体置灰不可选？点一下探测即可逐项看清是缺 CLI、缺 Node/`npx` 适配器，还是尚未在对应终端完成账号登录。
items.descriptionEn: Run a probe whenever an external agent appears unavailable to pinpoint missing binaries, missing Node/`npx` adapters, or unauthenticated CLI accounts.

control.reasonZh: “一键探测 CLI 可执行路径、版本号、适配器状态与连接就绪度”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Probe CLI binary paths, versions, adapter cache status, and connection readiness” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 一键安装受支持的外部智能体 CLI 或点击“预下载 ACP”缓存适配器
items.titleEn: Install supported external-agent CLIs or click Predownload ACP to cache adapters
items.descriptionZh: 对支持应用内安装的预设可直接触发 CLI 安装，并通过“预下载 ACP”为 Claude Code / Codex 预热适配器缓存；注意 `Oh My Pi (omp)` 需你在系统终端手动安装并加入 `PATH` 后再回来探测。
items.descriptionEn: Install supported preset CLIs and click Predownload ACP to warm `npx` adapter caches right from Settings; note that `Oh My Pi (omp)` must be installed manually in your system `PATH` before probing.

control.reasonZh: “一键安装受支持的外部智能体 CLI 或点击“预下载 ACP”缓存适配器”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Install supported external-agent CLIs or click Predownload ACP to cache adapters” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.titleZh: 在“SSH”页签探测远程工作区服务器上的可用 ACP 智能体并查看不支持原因
items.titleEn: Detect available ACP agents on SSH remote hosts on the SSH tab with explicit unsupported reasons
items.descriptionZh: 连接 SSH 远程工作区时直接检测远端机器环境，支持刷新探测与按需隐藏条目，绝不拿本机安装的 CLI 冒充远端能力。
items.descriptionEn: Inspects the remote SSH host directly when a remote workspace is active, lets you refresh or hide entries, and never confuses local binaries with remote availability.

control.reasonZh: “在“SSH”页签探测远程工作区服务器上的可用 ACP 智能体并查看不支持原因”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Detect available ACP agents on SSH remote hosts on the SSH tab with explicit unsupported reasons” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

items.descriptionZh: 适合接入预设之外的自研 ACP 兼容智能体，或为启动命令自定义特定参数、工作目录与环境变量。
items.descriptionEn: Ideal for registering custom ACP-compatible agents beyond built-in presets or customizing startup flags and environment variables.

items.descriptionZh: 连接成功后，会话内会动态读取该外部智能体自身声明的模型列表与可调开关，无需回到设置页硬编码。
items.descriptionEn: Once connected, ACP sessions dynamically surface the models and options advertised by that external agent.

control.reasonZh: “在 ACP 会话中选择外部智能体暴露的模型与客户端配置项”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。

items.titleZh: 浏览并执行外部 ACP 智能体在会话中公开的斜杠或专属命令
items.titleEn: Browse and execute session commands exposed by an external ACP agent
items.descriptionZh: 不同 ACP 智能体自带的特色命令会自动同步到当前会话中供你调用。
items.descriptionEn: Surfaces agent-specific slash or session commands advertised over ACP right inside the conversation.

control.reasonZh: “浏览并执行外部 ACP 智能体在会话中公开的斜杠或专属命令”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。

items.titleZh: 发起或取消 ACP 会话轮次，并在本地或远程回答外部智能体的权限请求
items.titleEn: Start or cancel ACP dialog turns and answer external-agent permission prompts locally or remotely
items.descriptionZh: 外部智能体请求读写或执行命令时，同样接入统一的权限确认卡片链路，即使在远程控制场景下也不会卡死在不可见终端。
items.descriptionEn: Routes external-agent permission prompts through OpenBitFun’s interactive approval cards so turns stay answerable locally and remotely.

control.reasonZh: “发起或取消 ACP 会话轮次，并在本地或远程回答外部智能体的权限请求”涉及多项联动表单、实时状态检查或用户确认，无法由单一结构化命令静默替代；智能体会直接打开对应设置位置，方便你在界面中确认调整。
control.reasonEn: “Start or cancel ACP dialog turns and answer external-agent permission prompts locally or remotely” involves linked form fields, live state checks, or explicit confirmation that no single structured command should silently bypass; the Agent opens the exact settings section so you can review and adjust visibly.

stepsZh: 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“工具与集成 → ACP”
本机使用选“本机”页签：从预设中启用 OpenCode、dsh、omp、Claude Code 或 Codex，按提示安装 CLI 或点击“预下载 ACP”（`omp` 需自行在终端安装并加入 `PATH`）
点击探测确认可执行文件与登录状态就绪，并按习惯将该智能体的工具确认设为“询问”或“自动通过”
连接 SSH 远程项目时可切到“SSH”页签刷新远端可用智能体；自定义命令参数则切到“高级 JSON”页签保存
stepsEn: Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Tools & Integrations → ACP
On the Local tab, enable a preset (`opencode`, `dsh`, `omp`, `Claude Code`, or `Codex`) and install the CLI or click Predownload ACP (`omp` requires manual CLI installation in `PATH`)
Run Probe to confirm the binary and account login are ready, then pick Ask or Auto-approve for that agent’s tool calls
Switch to the SSH tab to detect agents installed on active SSH workspaces, or use Advanced JSON for custom ACP commands
tipsZh: `Claude Code` 与 `Codex` 并非其 CLI 本身直接监听 ACP，而是通过官方 `npx` ACP 客户端适配器桥接，因此机器上需要可用的 Node.js / `npx` 环境，首次使用前点一下“预下载 ACP”体验最流畅。
`Oh My Pi (omp)` 不提供应用内自动安装脚本，需你先在外部终端自行安装并确保 `omp` 在系统 `PATH` 可执行后再回来启用探测。
只是想把之前在 Codex 或 ZCode 里聊到一半的历史会话接过来用 OpenBitFun 继续聊，或者导入 Claude Code 的 Skills / MCP / Hooks？请去隔壁的“工具与集成 → 外部导入”。
tipsEn: `Claude Code` and `Codex` connect via official `npx` ACP adapter packages rather than built-in native flags, so Node.js/`npx` is required—clicking Predownload ACP avoids first-session startup lag.
`Oh My Pi (omp)` does not offer one-click in-app CLI installation; install `omp` in your system `PATH` manually first, then probe it on the Local tab.
Want to continue past Codex/ZCode conversation histories or import Claude Code Skills, MCP servers, and Hooks instead? Head to Tools & Integrations → External import.

agentExamplesEn: Open ACP settings so I can connect Claude Code
Take me to the SSH tab in ACP settings to check remote agents

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 数据与维护 → 调用统计
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Data & Maintenance → Call Statistics
capabilities.summaryZh: 通过活跃度热力图、时间范围汇总卡片、输入/输出 Token 趋势图与按模型/按服务商/按端点分布明细，清晰掌握本机 AI 调用情况与缓存命中效率。
capabilities.summaryEn: Review your local AI usage through an activity heatmap, summary cards, Input + Output token trend bars, cache hit-rate metrics, and breakdowns by model, provider, and endpoint.
highlightsZh: 顶部使用活跃度热力图：一眼回顾近期每天的 AI 协作活跃密度
支持最近 24 小时、今天、本周、本月（默认）与全部时间五档切换，自动适配小时/天趋势粒度
核心指标卡与详情区完整呈现总 Token、输入/输出拆分、请求次数、缓存 Token 与缓存命中率
按“模型”与“服务商”双标签对比分布并支持关键词搜索，详情同步列出各请求端点（Endpoint）明细
highlightsEn: Top Activity Heatmap visualizing daily AI collaboration intensity at a glance
Five time windows (Last 24 Hours, Today, This Week, This Month [default], All Time) with automatic hourly/daily chart bucketing
Headline and detail metrics for Total Tokens, Input/Output split, Requests, Cached Tokens, and Cache Hit Rate
Searchable Model and Provider distribution tabs plus per-endpoint (`byEndpoint`) breakdown rows
scenariosZh: 月底复盘主力模型与快速模型各自消耗了多少输入/输出 Token，切到“本月”在“按模型”分布里一眼看出谁是消耗大户。
排查长会话上下文缓存有没有真正省到开销，展开详情核对缓存命中率（Cache Hit Rate）与缓存读取 Token 占比。
配置了多个中转或直连 API 端点后想确认流量落到了哪个地址，在详情分布里查看按请求端点（Endpoint）统计与关键词过滤。
scenariosEn: Check how much traffic went to your primary reasoning model versus your fast lightweight model this month using the By Model distribution tab.
Verify whether prompt caching is working effectively on long coding sessions by checking Cache Hit Rate and Cached Tokens in the details section.
Audit multi-provider or custom relay setups by filtering the Provider tab and inspecting per-endpoint (`byEndpoint`) request counts.

items.titleZh: 通过顶部使用活跃度热力图回顾每日 AI 协作密度
items.titleEn: Review daily AI collaboration intensity on the top Activity Heatmap
items.descriptionZh: 在调用统计页顶部按日历网格展示长期调用活跃度，哪几天高强度编码冲刺、哪几天空闲一目了然。
items.descriptionEn: Displays a calendar-style heatmap at the top of Call Statistics so you can spot high-intensity coding streaks and usage patterns over time.

control.reasonZh: “通过顶部使用活跃度热力图回顾每日 AI 协作密度”属于可视化统计图表展示，智能体会直接为你打开“数据与维护 → 调用统计”页面查看。
control.reasonEn: “Review daily AI collaboration intensity on the top Activity Heatmap” is a visual analytics chart; the Agent opens Data & Maintenance → Call Statistics so you can inspect it directly.

items.titleZh: 按最近 24 小时、今天、本周、本月（默认）或全部时间切换统计窗口
items.titleEn: Switch the time window among Last 24 Hours, Today, This Week, This Month (default), or All Time
items.descriptionZh: 打开页面默认展示“本月”数据，切换时间窗口后下方的汇总指标、分布排行与趋势柱状图会同步刷新。
items.descriptionEn: Defaults to This Month on open; switching the range updates summary cards, model/provider rankings, and trend bars together.

control.reasonZh: “按最近 24 小时、今天、本周、本月（默认）或全部时间切换统计窗口”用于在面板中交互切换不同时间维度的图表；智能体会为你打开调用统计页。
control.reasonEn: “Switch the time window among Last 24 Hours, Today, This Week, This Month (default), or All Time” lets you interactively slice charts and rankings across time windows; the Agent opens Call Statistics for you.

items.titleZh: 随时间范围自动适配小时级或天级趋势柱状图粒度
items.titleEn: Automatically match hourly or daily trend granularity to the selected time range
items.descriptionZh: 查看“最近 24 小时”与“今天”时趋势图自动按小时聚合；切换到“本周、本月、全部时间”时自动改为按天聚合，省去手动来回切换。
items.descriptionEn: Last 24 Hours and Today automatically plot hourly buckets, while This Week, This Month, and All Time automatically aggregate by day.

control.reasonZh: “随时间范围自动适配小时级或天级趋势柱状图粒度”随你在调用统计页所选的时间跨度联动更新；智能体会打开调用统计页供你浏览。
control.reasonEn: “Automatically match hourly or daily trend granularity to the selected time range” updates automatically alongside your chosen time range in the Call Statistics view; the Agent opens the page for you.

items.titleZh: 查看总 Token、输入/输出 Token、请求次数以及缓存 Token 与缓存命中率
items.titleEn: Inspect total tokens, input/output tokens, request count, cached tokens, and cache-hit rate
items.descriptionZh: 顶部主卡片直观汇总总消耗、输入输出结构与请求数，并在详情区列出缓存命中率与缓存读取 Token，帮你判断长上下文复用效果。
items.descriptionEn: Top cards summarize total tokens, input/output split, and total requests, while the details section surfaces Cached Tokens and Cache Hit Rate.

control.reasonZh: “查看总 Token、输入/输出 Token、请求次数以及缓存 Token 与缓存命中率”用于对照多项实时汇总指标，智能体会为你直达调用统计面板。
control.reasonEn: “Inspect total tokens, input/output tokens, request count, cached tokens, and cache-hit rate” presents multi-metric usage summaries visually; the Agent opens Call Statistics directly.

items.titleZh: 切换“按模型”与“按服务商”分布排行，并在详情查看按请求端点明细
items.titleEn: Compare usage across Model and Provider tabs and inspect per-endpoint details
items.descriptionZh: 清晰对比各模型或各供应商分组的请求占比与 Token 用量，详情区同时提供按请求端点（Endpoint）维度的拆分；即使某个旧模型配置已被删除，历史记录仍会保留可读的模型与服务商名称。
items.descriptionEn: Compare share of requests and tokens across Model and Provider tabs plus per-endpoint (`byEndpoint`) detail rows — historical attribution labels remain intact even if an old model config was later deleted.

control.reasonZh: “切换“按模型”与“按服务商”分布排行，并在详情查看按请求端点明细”支持在多个统计维度间切换并查看占比条，智能体会为你打开调用统计页。
control.reasonEn: “Compare usage across Model and Provider tabs and inspect per-endpoint details” supports interactive tab switching and proportion inspection; the Agent opens Call Statistics for you.

items.titleZh: 输入关键词筛选模型、服务商或请求端点的调用明细
items.titleEn: Filter model, provider, or endpoint usage rows by search keyword
items.descriptionZh: 当接入了很多模型或网关时，直接在搜索框输入模型名、供应商名或接口片段即可快速定位目标行的调用数字。
items.descriptionEn: Type any part of a model ID, provider name, or endpoint URL into the search box to narrow long distribution tables immediately.

control.reasonZh: “输入关键词筛选模型、服务商或请求端点的调用明细”适合在可视化列表中边搜边对比数据，智能体会为你打开调用统计页。
control.reasonEn: “Filter model, provider, or endpoint usage rows by search keyword” is designed for interactive filtering inside the usage table; the Agent opens Call Statistics for you.

items.titleZh: 通过堆叠柱状图查看输入与输出 Token 随时间的变化趋势
items.titleEn: Track Input and Output token volume over time in the stacked bar chart
items.descriptionZh: 趋势图按时间桶堆叠绘制输入（Input）与输出（Output）Token 用量，鼠标悬停在任意柱体上可查看该时间段的精确数字。
items.descriptionEn: Plots stacked Input and Output token bars across each hourly or daily bucket, with hover tooltips showing exact per-bucket counts.

control.reasonZh: “通过堆叠柱状图查看输入与输出 Token 随时间的变化趋势”需要结合柱状图悬停提示查看各时段波动，智能体会打开调用统计页由你浏览。
control.reasonEn: “Track Input and Output token volume over time in the stacked bar chart” is best explored visually with bar hover tooltips; the Agent opens Call Statistics for you.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“数据与维护 → 调用统计”
先看顶部活跃度热力图与默认“本月”汇总卡片，或切换为“今天 / 最近 24 小时 / 本周 / 全部时间”
在下方切换“按模型 / 按服务商”标签、输入关键词过滤，或悬停趋势柱状图查看输入与输出明细
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Data & Maintenance → Call Statistics
Scan the top Activity Heatmap and This Month summary cards, or switch to Last 24 Hours, Today, This Week, or All Time
Toggle between Model and Provider tabs, filter by keyword, or hover trend bars to inspect Input and Output counts
agentExamplesZh: 打开调用统计看看这周的 Token 用量
带我查看各模型的调用统计
agentExamplesEn: Open Call Statistics so I can check this week’s token usage
Take me to model call statistics
tipsZh: 调用统计只诚实记录客观的请求数与 Token 数量（含缓存 Token），**不做虚估的美元/人民币账单换算**——因为不同渠道套餐、订阅额度、阶梯折扣差异巨大，实际扣费请以供应商后台账单为准。
如果你只是在单次对话里想看“当前这个会话窗口已经占了多少上下文 Token”，直接看聊天输入框附近的实时上下文指示器或输入 `/usage` 更直观。
刚跑完大任务想马上看最新数字，点页面右上角刷新按钮即可重新拉取最新统计。
tipsEn: Call Statistics reports exact request and token counts (including cached tokens) rather than guessing dollar costs — subscription tiers, credits, and custom gateway pricing vary widely, so check your provider dashboard for billing.
Want to check context usage for the single conversation you are currently in? Check the live context indicator near the chat composer or run `/usage` right in chat.
Click the Refresh button in the top-right corner of Call Statistics anytime to pull in turns that just finished.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 数据与维护 → 已归档会话
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Data & Maintenance → Archived Sessions
capabilities.summaryZh: 按工作区折叠分组盘点已归档的对话历史，支持一键恢复回原项目侧栏、单条删除或移除外部导入来源，以及二次确认清空全部归档。
capabilities.summaryEn: Review archived conversations grouped by collapsible workspace headers, restore sessions back to their original workspace, delete individual native or imported entries, or clear all archives.
highlightsZh: 按项目工作区自动分组折叠（默认收起，项目再多也清爽不刷屏）
一键“恢复”：将会话、历史轮次与视图状态完整迁回原工作区活跃列表
区分原生归档会话与外部只读历史来源（如 Codex / Zcode），安全删除不伤外部原文件
支持单条删除与顶部“全部删除”，所有破坏性清理均带明确二次确认
highlightsEn: Grouped by collapsible workspace sections (collapsed by default so multi-project lists stay tidy)
One-click Restore brings a session and its full turn history right back into its original workspace
Distinguishes native OpenBitFun sessions from imported external history views (such as Codex / Zcode) on removal
Supports both per-session deletion and Delete All, guarded by explicit confirmation dialogs
scenariosZh: 平时在项目侧边栏随手把阶段性完结的会话归档保持列表清爽；几周后客户突然追问当时的排查细节，来此展开对应工作区分组点“恢复”，整段上下文原封不动回到项目里。
大版本发布结束后想彻底清理早期废弃试验的归档记录，展开对应项目逐条删除，或确认无留存必要后一键清空全部归档释放本地存储。
scenariosEn: Keep your daily workspace sidebar clean by archiving finished feature threads — then unfold that project here weeks later and click Restore when you need the full conversation back.
Do a clean sweep after a major milestone by removing obsolete archived threads individually or clicking Delete All after confirming nothing else needs to be kept.

items.titleZh: 按可折叠的工作区分组浏览全部已归档会话与更新时间
items.titleEn: Browse archived sessions and timestamps grouped by collapsible workspace sections
items.descriptionZh: 自动按项目路径聚合归档记录并显示每组条数；默认折叠所有工作区，点开目标项目即可查看标题、归档时间与来源标记，右上角支持手动刷新。
items.descriptionEn: Groups archived threads under collapsible project headers with session counts (collapsed by default for easy scanning) plus a top Refresh button.

control.reasonZh: “按可折叠的工作区分组浏览全部已归档会话与更新时间”需要展开具体项目分组核对会话标题与时间，智能体会为你直达“已归档会话”管理页。
control.reasonEn: “Browse archived sessions and timestamps grouped by collapsible workspace sections” lets you expand specific project groups to review session titles and timestamps; the Agent opens Archived Sessions directly.

items.titleZh: 一键取消归档并将选中会话连同完整轮次恢复回原工作区
items.titleEn: Unarchive and restore a selected session with all its turns back to its original workspace
items.descriptionZh: 恢复后该会话会重新出现在对应项目的会话侧栏中，过往对话轮次、工具调用记录与上下文均可继续查看或接着追问。
items.descriptionEn: Restoring puts the thread right back in its project’s session list with full message turns and tool transcripts ready to read or continue.

control.reasonZh: “一键取消归档并将选中会话连同完整轮次恢复回原工作区”需要你在归档列表中挑出要找回的那条历史会话，智能体会打开归档管理入口。
control.reasonEn: “Unarchive and restore a selected session with all its turns back to its original workspace” requires picking the exact historical thread you want back from the workspace list; the Agent opens Archived Sessions for you.

items.titleZh: 二次确认后永久删除单条归档会话，或移除导入的外部会话来源
items.titleEn: Permanently delete a selected archived session or remove an imported external source after confirmation
items.descriptionZh: 删除原生会话会彻底清理本机持久化记录；若条目来自 Codex / Zcode 等外部工具导入视图，按钮会变为“移除来源”，只从 OpenBitFun 列表移除而不触碰外部工具的原始数据。
items.descriptionEn: Deleting a native session permanently removes its local persisted record; for imported external history (like Codex or Zcode), Remove Source detaches it from OpenBitFun without touching the external tool’s files.

control.reasonZh: “二次确认后永久删除单条归档会话，或移除导入的外部会话来源”属于不可逆的历史数据移除操作，必须由你在界面中逐条确认；智能体会打开归档列表交由你操作。
control.reasonEn: “Permanently delete a selected archived session or remove an imported external source after confirmation” is a destructive history action that requires your explicit confirmation on the target row; the Agent opens Archived Sessions so you can confirm safely.

items.titleZh: 明确确认后一键永久清空全部已归档会话
items.titleEn: Permanently delete all archived sessions at once after explicit confirmation
items.descriptionZh: 适合定期大扫除一次性清理所有项目的归档积压；正在活跃使用、尚未归档的工作区会话不受任何影响。
items.descriptionEn: Clears every archived thread across workspaces in one confirmed action while leaving all active unarchived sessions completely untouched.

control.reasonZh: “明确确认后一键永久清空全部已归档会话”会永久清空全部归档历史且无法撤销，必须由你在确认弹窗中亲自批准；智能体会打开对应设置页。
control.reasonEn: “Permanently delete all archived sessions at once after explicit confirmation” permanently erases all archived history and cannot be undone, so it always requires your direct confirmation dialog approval; the Agent opens Archived Sessions.

items.titleZh: 通过会话侧栏或聊天框 @ 引用按标题与正文检索历史会话
items.titleEn: Search historical sessions by title and content from the session panel or `@` picker
items.descriptionZh: “已归档会话”设置页专注按工作区分组清点与恢复，未放置独立搜索框；想按关键词全文检索过往对话内容，可在工作区会话列表或输入框输入 `@` 调出历史会话搜索。
items.descriptionEn: The Archived Sessions settings page focuses on per-workspace browsing and cleanup rather than hosting its own search box; to search session titles and full message content, use the workspace session panel or type `@` in the chat composer.

control.reasonZh: “通过会话侧栏或聊天框 @ 引用按标题与正文检索历史会话”结合你在聊天框或会话列表输入的实时关键词进行检索；若需要按项目找回已归档记录，智能体也会为你打开已归档会话页。
control.reasonEn: “Search historical sessions by title and content from the session panel or `@` picker” runs interactively as you type keywords in the session panel or `@` picker, while Archived Sessions lets you browse and restore archived threads by workspace.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“数据与维护 → 已归档会话”
点击任意工作区分组标题展开该项目下的已归档会话列表
对需要继续使用的会话点“恢复”，对不再保留的记录点“删除 / 移除来源”或右上角“全部删除”
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Data & Maintenance → Archived Sessions
Click any workspace header to expand the archived threads belonging to that project
Click Restore to return a session to its workspace, or click Delete / Remove Source (or Delete All) and confirm
agentExamplesZh: 打开已归档会话管理页
带我恢复之前归档的一个旧会话
agentExamplesEn: Open Archived Sessions settings
Take me to restore an archived session
tipsZh: 小贴士：归档不等于删除！平时做完一个需求把会话归档，既能让项目侧栏干干净净，又能在需要时随时从这里完整恢复。
本设置页没有顶部搜索框——如果你只记得以前聊过某个报错关键词，直接在会话面板搜索或在聊天输入框敲 `@` 搜历史会话会更快。
外部导入的 Codex / Zcode 会话在这里点“移除来源”非常安全，不会删掉你电脑上外部 CLI 自己的会话记录。
tipsEn: Archiving is reversible! Archive completed task threads to keep your daily sidebar focused, knowing you can restore any of them in one click.
Looking for a search bar? This page groups archives by project folder — to full-text search across past conversations by keyword, use the workspace session list or type `@` in the chat composer.
Clicking Remove Source on an imported Codex or Zcode entry only detaches it from OpenBitFun and never deletes the external CLI’s own transcript files.

capabilities.entryPathZh: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 数据与维护 → 日志与诊断
capabilities.entryPathEn: Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Data & Maintenance → Logs & Diagnostics
capabilities.summaryZh: 即时调整运行日志级别、一键打开本机日志目录、查看上次崩溃或配置恢复提示，并在本地生成自动定位展示的可控隐私 ZIP 诊断包。
capabilities.summaryEn: Change backend log verbosity without restarting, open the runtime log folder, review crash or config-recovery notices, and export privacy-checked local ZIP diagnostic bundles.
highlightsZh: 后端日志级别实时切换（Trace / Debug［默认］/ Info / Warn / Error / Off），无需重启客户端
敏感调试信息保护开关（默认关闭，防止提示词与工具参数无意落入本地日志）
当前运行日志目录一键打开，自动高亮上次异常退出与启动自愈横幅
隐私确认后在日志目录下生成 ZIP 诊断包并自动在访达/资源管理器中定位（绝不自动上传）
highlightsEn: Live backend log-level switching (`Trace`, `Debug` [default], `Info`, `Warn`, `Error`, `Off`) with zero restart required
Sensitive debug logging guard (off by default so prompts and tool payloads stay redacted unless you opt in)
One-click Open Folder for active runtime logs plus automatic banners for previous crashes or startup recovery
Privacy-confirmed ZIP bundle written to `<logs>/diagnostics/` and revealed automatically in Finder / Explorer (never auto-uploaded)
scenariosZh: 遇到偶发卡顿、MCP 连接失败或远程重连异常想提 Issue 反馈：点“导出诊断包”阅读隐私提示并点“继续导出”，系统会在日志目录打包好 ZIP 并自动弹出文件夹选中它，你可先解压核对再分享。
开发插件或深入追查某个底层流式请求问题时，临时切到 `Trace` 并短暂勾选“包含敏感调试信息”复现一次，抓完日志立刻关回，兼顾排障效率与代码隐私。
scenariosEn: Hit a tricky MCP connection error or reconnect hiccup? Click Export Diagnostics, confirm the privacy notice (`Continue export`), and OpenBitFun writes a timestamped ZIP into `<logs>/diagnostics/` and reveals it in Finder / Explorer so you can inspect it before sharing.
Chasing a low-level streaming or plugin issue? Temporarily switch Log Level to `Trace`, reproduce the problem once, export the bundle, and turn Sensitive Debug Info right back off.

items.titleZh: 即时切换 Trace、Debug、Info、Warn、Error 或关闭后端运行日志
items.titleEn: Switch backend runtime logging among Trace, Debug, Info, Warn, Error, or Off immediately
items.descriptionZh: 配置默认级别为 `Debug`，修改后立即对当前运行进程生效，无需重启应用；日常若想进一步减少日志写入量可调至 `Info` 或 `Warn`。
items.descriptionEn: Defaults to `Debug` in configuration and takes effect immediately without restarting OpenBitFun; step down to `Info` or `Warn` anytime if you want quieter disk logging.

items.titleZh: 控制日志与诊断包是否允许记录敏感调试上下文（默认关闭）
items.titleEn: Control whether logs and diagnostic bundles may include sensitive debug context (off by default)
items.descriptionZh: 默认关闭以保护隐私。开启后可能会把完整提示词、工具调用参数或模型原始返回写入本机日志；建议仅在深度复现问题时临时打开，排查完立即关闭。
items.descriptionEn: Off by default to protect your privacy. Enabling it allows full prompts, tool arguments, or raw model responses into local logs — turn it on only briefly while reproducing a bug, then switch it back off.

items.titleZh: 查看当前会话日志目录路径并一键打开本地日志文件夹
items.titleEn: Inspect the active session log directory path and open the log folder in one click
items.descriptionZh: 直接展示当前实例正在写入的精确日志目录，点“打开文件夹”即可在访达（Finder）或资源管理器中用自己的编辑器查看实时日志文件。
items.descriptionEn: Shows the exact directory where this running instance writes its logs and opens it directly in Finder or Explorer so you can tail or inspect files locally.

control.reasonZh: “查看当前会话日志目录路径并一键打开本地日志文件夹”涉及打开本机操作系统文件管理器查看实时目录；智能体会为你直达“日志与诊断”页。
control.reasonEn: “Inspect the active session log directory path and open the log folder in one click” opens your local OS file manager on the live runtime directory; the Agent opens Logs & Diagnostics directly.

items.titleZh: 确认隐私说明后导出本地 ZIP 诊断包并自动在文件管理器中定位
items.titleEn: Confirm the privacy notice to export a local ZIP diagnostics bundle and reveal it in your file manager
items.descriptionZh: 点击“导出诊断包”会先弹出应用内隐私说明弹窗，确认“继续导出”后自动在 `<logs>/diagnostics/` 目录生成 `openbitfun-diagnostics-<时间戳>.zip`（含运行状态、配置健康与近期会话日志），并在访达 / 资源管理器中高亮该文件，**绝不自动上传**。
items.descriptionEn: Clicking Export Diagnostics opens an in-app privacy confirmation dialog (`Continue export`), writes `openbitfun-diagnostics-<timestamp>.zip` (metadata, run state, config health, and recent session logs) into `<logs>/diagnostics/`, and automatically reveals the `.zip` file in Finder / Explorer — **never auto-uploading**.

control.reasonZh: “确认隐私说明后导出本地 ZIP 诊断包并自动在文件管理器中定位”需要你先阅读并确认应用内导出隐私提示弹窗（继续导出），随后在系统文件管理器中查看生成的压缩包；智能体会为你打开诊断页入口。
control.reasonEn: “Confirm the privacy notice to export a local ZIP diagnostics bundle and reveal it in your file manager” requires confirming the in-app privacy notice dialog (`Continue export`) before revealing the generated `.zip` archive in Finder or Explorer; the Agent opens Logs & Diagnostics for you.

items.titleZh: 查看上次异常退出、崩溃记录以及启动与配置自动恢复详情
items.titleEn: Inspect previous crashes, unclean shutdown notices, and startup or configuration recovery details
items.descriptionZh: 如果上一次运行发生了崩溃或配置文件局部损坏回退，页面顶部会用醒目卡片列出原因摘要与对应历史日志位置，帮你快速定位现场。
items.descriptionEn: Whenever the previous run exited abnormally or triggered startup/config recovery, a banner highlights what happened and points straight to the preserved crash log.

control.reasonZh: “查看上次异常退出、崩溃记录以及启动与配置自动恢复详情”需要根据本机启动自检记录动态呈现异常摘要；智能体会为你打开“日志与诊断”页查看。
control.reasonEn: “Inspect previous crashes, unclean shutdown notices, and startup or configuration recovery details” displays live startup-recovery findings from this machine; the Agent opens Logs & Diagnostics so you can inspect them.

items.titleZh: 仅开发构建：检查桌面窗口 DevTools 可用状态并打开或关闭调试器
items.titleEn: Development builds only: check desktop DevTools availability and open or close them
items.descriptionZh: 专为本地开发调试 OpenBitFun 客户端准备的内部入口，正式发布版客户端默认隐藏该能力，普通日常使用无需关心。
items.descriptionEn: Internal debugging hook available only when running a development build of OpenBitFun; hidden in standard release builds.

control.reasonZh: “仅开发构建：检查桌面窗口 DevTools 可用状态并打开或关闭调试器”仅在开发构建宿主中开放交互调试窗口；智能体不会在常规生产环境中误触该入口。
control.reasonEn: “Development builds only: check desktop DevTools availability and open or close them” is available only inside development host builds for interactive window inspection; standard release builds keep it disabled.

items.titleZh: 仅开发构建：启用主窗口界面元素拾取器并回传选中组件信息
items.titleEn: Development builds only: inspect main-window UI elements and report the selected element
items.descriptionZh: 同样仅在开发构建中启用，用于在联调桌面界面时点选主窗口 DOM 元素获取组件定位，正式版不会暴露此调试钩子。
items.descriptionEn: Also restricted to development builds for picking and inspecting main-window DOM elements during UI development; not exposed in release builds.

control.reasonZh: “仅开发构建：启用主窗口界面元素拾取器并回传选中组件信息”需要开发者在开发构建主窗口中用鼠标点选目标元素；智能体将交互保留在可见界面。
control.reasonEn: “Development builds only: inspect main-window UI elements and report the selected element” requires clicking a target element directly inside a development-build main window; the Agent keeps the interaction visible.

stepsZh: 打开设置（⌘, / Ctrl+,），进入“数据与维护 → 日志与诊断”
遇到问题复现前可确认日志级别为 Debug（或临时调为 Trace），修改即时生效无需重启
点击“打开文件夹”查阅实时日志，或点击“导出诊断包”并在弹窗点“继续导出”，系统会在 `<logs>/diagnostics/` 生成 ZIP 并自动打开文件夹定位
stepsEn: Open Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) and go to Data & Maintenance → Logs & Diagnostics
Confirm Log Level is set to Debug (or temporarily switch to Trace before reproducing an issue) — no restart needed
Click Open Folder to inspect live log files, or click Export Diagnostics → Continue export to generate a `.zip` in `<logs>/diagnostics/` and reveal it automatically in Finder / Explorer
agentExamplesZh: 把日志级别改成 info
打开日志与诊断设置，我要导出诊断包
帮我关闭敏感调试信息记录
agentExamplesEn: Set the backend log level to info
Open Logs & Diagnostics so I can export a diagnostic bundle
Turn off sensitive debug logging
tipsZh: 安心承诺：**“导出诊断包”100% 在你本机日志目录下打包生成 `.zip` 文件并自动打开文件夹高亮，绝不会自动上传网络**；你可以先解压看看里面有哪些文本文件，确认放心后再分享。
如果你在正式版界面里没看到 DevTools 或元素检查按钮，这是完全正常的——那两项仅对源码开发构建开放。
命令行环境下也可以直接运行 `openbitfun doctor` 快速做一轮运行环境与配置健康自检。
tipsEn: Privacy guarantee: **Export Diagnostics writes a local `.zip` inside `<logs>/diagnostics/`, reveals it in your file manager, and never uploads anything automatically** — unzip and review every file before sharing.
Not seeing DevTools or Element Inspector controls? That is expected in normal release builds — those hooks appear only in local development builds.
Working from a terminal? You can also run `openbitfun doctor` in the CLI to check runtime health and configuration.

options.descriptionZh: 设置后端运行日志详细程度（`trace` / `debug`［默认］/ `info` / `warn` / `error` / `off`），修改后即时生效无需重启。
options.descriptionEn: Set backend runtime log verbosity (`trace`, `debug` [default], `info`, `warn`, `error`, or `off`), applied live without restarting.

options.descriptionZh: 控制本地日志与导出的诊断包是否允许记录提示词、工具参数等敏感上下文（默认关闭，仅建议排障时临时启用）。
options.descriptionEn: Allow prompts, tool arguments, and raw payloads in local logs and exported bundles (off by default; enable only temporarily when debugging).

Explore calendars, request waterfalls, sampled CPU profiles, and error stacks
